aditiruvāca tāha voḍhuṃ kṣamā deva tvāmādyapuruṣaṃ param / asaṃkhyātāṇḍaromāṇaṃ sarveśaṃ sarvakāraṇam
yatprabhāvaṃ na jānanti śrutayaḥ sarvadevatāḥ / tamahaṃ devadeveśaṃ dhārayāma kithaṃ prabho
aṇoraṇīyāṃsamajaṃ parātparataraṃ prabhum / dhārayāmi kathaṃ deva tvāmahaṃ puruṣottamam
mahāyātakayukto 'pi yannāmasmṛtimātrataḥ / mucyate sa kathaṃ devogrāmyeṣu janimarhati
yathā śūkaramatsyādyā avatārāstava prabho / tathāyamapi ko veda tava viśveśa ceṣṭitam
tvatpādapahmapraṇatātvannāmasmṛtitatparā / tvāmeva cintaye deva yathecchāsi tathā kuru
sanaka uvāca tayoktaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā devadevo janārdanaḥ / dattvābhayaṃ devamāturidaṃ vacanamabravīt
śrībhagavānuvāca satyamuktaṃ mahābhāge tvayā nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ / tathāpi śṛṇu vakṣyāmi guhyādguhyataraṃ śubhe
rāgadveṣavihīnā ye madbhaktā matparāyaṇāḥ / vaṃhati satataṃ teṃ māṃ gatāsūyā adāmbhikāḥ
paropatāpavimukhāḥ śivabhaktiparāyaṇaḥ / matkathāśravaṇāsaktā vahanti satataṃ hi mām
pativratāḥ pariprāṇāḥ patibhaktiparāyaṇāḥ / vahanti satataṃ devi striyo 'pi tyaktapratsarāḥ
mātāpitrośca śuśrūṣurgurubhakto 'tithipriyaḥ / hitakṛdvāhyaṇānāṃ yaḥ sa māṃ vahati sarvadā
puṇyatīrtharatā nityaṃ satsaṅganiratāstathā / lokānugrahaśīlāśca satataṃ te vahanti mām
paropakāraviratāḥ paradravyaparāṅmukhāḥ / naṣuṃsakāḥ parastrīṣu te vahanti ca māṃ sadā
tulasyupāsanaratāḥ sadā nāmaparāyaṇāḥ / gorakṣaṇaparā ye ca satataṃ māṃ vahanti te
pratigrahanivṛttā ye parānnavimukhāstathā / annodakapradātāro vahṝnti satataṃ hi mām
tvaṃ tu devi patiprāṇā sādhvī bhūtahite ratā / saṃprāpya putrabhāvaṃ te sādhayiṣye manoratham
ityuktvā devedevaśo hyaditiṃ devamātaram / dattvā kaṇṭhagatāṃ mālāmabhayaṃ ca tirodadhe
sā tu saṃhṛṣṭamanasā devasīrdakṣanandinī / praṇamya kamalākāntaṃ punaḥ svasthaānamāvrajat
tato 'ditirmahābhāgā suprītā lokavanditā / asūta samaye putraṃ sarvalokanamaskṛtam
śaṅgacakradharaṃ śāntaṃ candramaṇḍalamadhyagam / sudhākalaśadadhyannakaraṃ vāmanasaṃjñitam
sahasrādityasaṃkāśaṃ vyākośakamalekṣaṇam / sarvābharaṇaṃsaṃyuktaṃ pītāmbaradharaṃ harim
stutyaṃ munigaṇairyuktaṃ sarvalokaikanāyakam / āvirbhūtaṃ hariṃ jñātvā kaśyapo harṣavihvalaḥ / praṇamya prañjalirbhūtva stotuṃ samupacakrame
kaśyapa uvāca namonamaste 'khilakāraṇāya namonamaste 'khailapālakāya / namonamaste 'maranāyakāya namonamo daiteyavināśanāya
namonamo bhaktajanapriyāya namonamaḥ sajjanarañjitāya / namonamo durjananāśanāya namo 'stu tasmai jagadīśvarāya
namonamaḥ kāraṇavāmanāya nārāyaṇāyāmitavikramāya / saśārṅgacakrāsigadādhārāya namo 'stu tasmai puruṣottamāya
namaḥ payorāśinivāsanāya namo 'stu saddhṛtkamalasthitāya / namo 'stu sūryādyamitaprabhāya namonamaḥ puṇyakathāgatāya
namonamor'kenduvilocanāya namo 'stu te yajñaphalapradāya / namo 'stu yajñāṅgavirājitāya namo 'stu te sajjanavallabhāya
namo jagatkāraṇakāraṇāya namo 'stu śabdādivivarjitāya / namo 'stu te divyasukhapradāya namo namo bhaktamanogatāya
namo 'stu te dhvāntavināśakāya namo 'stu śabdādivivarjitāya / namo 'stu te dhvāntavināśakāya mandaradhārakāya / namo 'stu te yajñavarāhanāmne namo hiraṇyākṣavidārakāya
namo 'stu te vāmanarupabhāje namo 'stu te kṣatrakulāntakāya / namo 'stu te rāvaṇamardanāya namo 'stu te nandasutāgrajāya
namaste kamalākānta namaste sukhadāyine / smṛtārtināśine tubhyaṃ bhūyo bhūyo namonamaḥ
yajñeśa yajñavinyāsa yajñavinghavināśana / yajñarupa yajadrūpa yajñāṅgaṃ tvāṃ yajāmyaham
iti stutaḥ sa deveśo vāmano lokapāvanaḥ // uvāca prahasanharṣaṃ vardhdayankaśyapasya saḥ
śrībhagavānuvāca tāta tuṣṭo 'smi bhadraṃ te bhaviṣyati surārcitā / acirātsādhayiṣyāmi nikhilaṃ tvanmanoratham
ahaṃ janmadvaye tvevaṃ yuvayoḥ putraghatāṃ gataḥ / asmiñjanmanyapi tathā sādayāmyuttamaṃ sukham
atrāntare balirdaityo dīrghasatraṃ mahāmakham / ārebhe guruṇā yuktaḥ kāvyena ca munīśvaraiḥ
tasminmakhe samāhūto viṣṇurlakṣmīsamanvitaḥ / haviḥ svīkaraṇārthāya ṛṣibhirbrahmavādibhiḥ
pravṛddhaiśvaryardaityasya varttamāne mahākratau / āmantrya mātāpitarau sa baṭurvāmano yayau
smitena mohayaṃllokaṃ vāmano bhaktavatsalaḥ / havirbhoktumivāyāto baleḥ pratyakṣato hariḥ
durvṛtto vā suvṛtto vā jaḍo vāyaṃ hito 'pi vā / yo bhaktiyuktastasyāntaḥ sadā saṃnihito hariḥ
āyāntaṃ vāmanaṃ dṛṣṭvā ṛṣayo jñānacakṣauṣaḥ / jñātvā nārāyaṇaṃ devamudyayuḥ sabhyasaṃyutāḥ
etajjñātvā daityagururekānte balimabravīt / svasāramavicāryaiva khalāḥ kāryāṇi kurvate
śukra uvāca bho bho daityapate saumya hyapahartā tava śriyam / viṣṇurvāmanarupeṇa hyaditeḥ putrātāṃ gataḥ
tavādhvaraṃ sa āyāti tvayā tasyāsureśvara / na kiñcidapi dātavyaṃ manmataṃ śṛṇu paṇḍita
ātmabuddhiḥ sukhakarī gurubuddhirviśeṣataḥ / parabuddhirvināśāya strībudhdiḥ pralayaṅkarī
śatrūṇāṃ hitakṛtadyastu sa hantavyo viśeṣataḥ
baliruvāca evaṃ guro na vaktavyaṃ dharmamārgavirodhataḥ / yadādatte svayaṃ viṣṇuḥ kimasmādadhikaṃ varam
kurvanti viduṣo yajñānviṣṇuprīṇanakāraṇāt / sa cetsākṣāddhavirbhogī mattaḥ ko 'bhyadhiko bhuvī
daridreṇāpi yatkiñciddīyate viṣṇave guro / tadeva paramaṃ dānaṃ dattaṃ bhavati cākṣayam
smṛto 'pi parayā bhaktyā punāti puruṣottamaḥ / yena kenāpyarcitaśveddadāti paramāṃ gatim
harirharati pāpāniduṣṭacittairapi smṛtaḥ / anicchayāpi saṃspṛṣṭo dahatyeva hi pāvakaḥ
jihvāgre vasate yasya hari rityakṣaradvayam / sa viṣṇulokamānpoti punarāvṛttidurlabham
govindeti sadā dhyāyedyastu rāgādivarjitaḥ / sa yāti viṣṇubhavanamiti prāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ
agnau vā brahmaṇe vāpihūyate yadvavirguro / haribhaktyā mahābhāga tena viṣṇuḥ prasīdati
ahaṃ tu harituṣyyarthaṃ karomyadhvaramuttamam / svayamāyāti cedviṣṇuḥ kṛtārtho 'smi na saṃśayaḥ
evaṃ vadati daityandre viṣṇurvāmanarupadhṛk / praviveśādhvarasthānaṃ hutavahnimanoramam
taṃ dṛṣṭvā koṭisūryābhaṃ yogyāvayavasundaram / vāmanaṃ sahasotthāya pratyagṛhṇātkṛtāñjaliḥ
dattvāsanaṃ ca prakṣālya pādau vāmanarupiṇam / sakuṭuṃbo vahanmūrdhnā paramāṃ mudamātpavān
viṣṇave 'smai jagaddhānme dattvārghyaṃ vidhivadūliḥ / romāñcitatanurbhūtvā harṣāśrunayano 'bravīt
baliruvāca adya me saphalaṃ janma adya me saphalo maravaḥ / jīvitaṃ saphalaṃ me 'dya kṛtārtho 'smi na saṃśayaḥ
amoghāmṛtavṛṣṭirme samāyātātidurlabhā / tvadāgamanamātreṇa hyanāyāso mahotsavaḥ
ete ca ṛṣayaḥ sarve kṛtārthāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ / yaiḥ pūrvaṃ hi tapastaptaṃ tadadya saphalaṃ prabho
kṛtārtho 'smi kṛtārtho 'smi kṛtārtho 'smi na saṃśayaḥ / tasmāttubhyaṃ namastubhyaṃ namastubhyaṃ namastubhyaṃ namonamaḥ
tvadājñayā tvanniyogaṃ sādhayāmīti manmanaḥ / atyutsāhasamāyuktaṃ samājñāpaya māṃ prabho
evamurke dīkṣitena prahasanvāmano 'bravīt / dehi me tapasi sthātuṃ bhūmiṃ tripadasaṃmitām
etacchṛātvā baliḥ prāha rājyaṃ yācitavānnahi / grāmaṃ vā nagaraṃ cāpi dhanaṃ vā kiṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā
tanniśamya baliṃ prāha viṣṇuḥ sarvaśarīrabhṛt / āsannabhraṣṭarājyasya vairāgyaṃ janamannivā
śrībhagavānuvāca śṛṇu daityandra vakṣyāmi guhyādguhyatamaṃ param / sarvasaṃgavihīnānāṃ kimarthaiḥ sādhyatevada
ahaṃ tu sarvabhūtānāmantaryāmīti bhāvaya / mayi sarvamidaṃ daitya kimanyaiḥ sādhyate vada
rāgadveṣavihīnānāṃ śāntānāṃ tyaktamāyinām / nityānandasvarupāṇāṃ kimanyaiḥ sādhyate dhanaiḥ
ātmavatsarvabhūtāni paśyatāṃ śāntacetasām / abhinnamātmanaḥ sarvaṃ ko dātā dīyate ca kim
pṛthvīyaṃ kṣatriyavaśā iti śāstreṣu niścitam / tadājñāyāṃ sthitāḥ sarve labhante paramaṃ sukham
dātavyo munibhiścāpi ṣaṣṭāṃśo bhūbhuje bale / mahīyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tu dātavyā sarva yatnataḥ
bhūmidānasya māhātmyaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati / paraṃ nirvāṇamānpoti bhūmido nātra saṃśayaḥ
svalpāmapi mahīṃ dattvā śrotriyāyāhitāgnaye / brahmalokamavāpnoti punarāvṛttidurlabham
bhūmidaḥ sarvadaḥ prokto bhūmido mokṣabhāgbhavet / atidānaṃ tu tajjñeyaṃ sarvapāpaprāṇāśanam
mahāpātakayukto vā yukto vā sarvapātakaiḥ / daśahastāṃ mahīṃ dattvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
satpātre bhūmidātā yaḥ sarvadānaphalaṃ labhet / bhūmidānasamaṃ nānyatriṣu lokeṣu vidyate
dvijāya vṛttihīnāya yaḥ pradadyānmahīṃ bale / tasya puṇyaphalaṃ vaktuṃ na kṣamo 'bdaśatairaham
saktāya devapūjāsu vṛttihīnāya daityapa / svalpāmapi mahīṃ dadyādyaḥ sa viṣṇurna saṃśayaḥ
ikṣugodhūma tuvarīpūgavṛkṣādisaṃyutā / pṛthvī pradīyate yena sa viṣṇurnātra saṃśayaḥ
vṛttihīnāya viprāya daridrāya kuṭumbine / svalpāmapi mahīndattvā viṣṇusāyujyamānpuyāt
saktāya devapūjāsu viprāyāḍhakikāṃ mahīm / dattvā labheta gaṅgāyāṃ trirātrasnānajaṃ phalam
viprāya vṛttihīnāya sadācāraratāya ca / droṇikāṃ pṛthivīṃ dattvā yatphalaṃ labhate śṛṇu
gaṅgātīrthāśvamedhānāṃ śatāni vidhivannaraḥ / kṛtvā yatphalamānpoti tadāpnoti sa puṣkalam
dadāti khārikāṃ bhūmiṃ daridrāya dvijāya yaḥ / tasya puṇyaṃ pravakṣyāmi vadato me niśāmaya
aśvamedhasahasrāṇi vājapeyaśatāni ca / vidhāya jāhnavītīre patphalaṃ tallabheddhuvam
bhūmidānaṃ mahādānamatidānaṃ prakīrttitam / sarvapāpapraśamanamapavargaphalapradam
atrotihāsaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu daityakuleśvara / yacchutvā śraddhayā yukto bhūmidānaphalaṃ labhet
āsītpurā dvijavaro brāhmakalpe mahāmatiḥ / daridro vṛttihīnaśca nāmnā bhadramatirbale
śrutāni sarvaśāstrāṇi tena vedadivāniśam / śrutāni ca purāṇāni dharmaśāstrāṇi sarvaśaḥ
abhavaṃstasya ṣaṭpatnyaḥ śrutiḥ sindhuryaśovatī / kāminī mālinī caiva śobhā ceti prakīrtitāḥ
āsu pantīṣu tasyāsañcatvariṃśacchatadvayam / putrāṇāmasuraśreṣṭha sarve nityaṃ bubhukṣitāḥ
akiñcano bhadramatiḥ kṣudhārttānātmajānpriyāḥ / paśyansvayaṃ kṣudhārttaśca vilalāpākulendriyaḥ
dhigjanma bhāgyarahitaṃ dhigjanma dhanavarjitam / dhigjanma dharmarahitaṃ dhigjanma khyātivarjitam
narasya bahvapatyasya dhigjanmaiśvaryavārjitam / aho guṇāḥ saumyatā ca vidvattā janma satkule
dāridyāmbudhimagnasya sarvametanna śobhate / priyāḥ putrāścapautrāśca bāndhavā bhrātarastathā
śiṣyāśca sarvamanujāstyajantyaiśvaryavārjitam / cāṇḍālo vā dvijo vāpi bhāgyavāneva pūjyate
daridraḥ puruṣo loke śavavallokaninditaḥ / aho saṃpatsaṃmāyukto niṣṭuro vāpyaniṣṭhuraḥ
guṇahīno 'pi guṇavānmūrkho vāpyatha paṇḍitaḥ / aiśvaryaguṇayuktaścetpūjya eva na saṃśayaḥ
aho daridratā duḥkhaṃ tatrāpyāśātiduḥkhadā / āśābhibhūtāḥ puruṣā duḥkhamaśnuvate 'kṣayam
āśayādāsā ye dāsāste sarvalokasya / āśā dāsī yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ dāsāyate lokaḥ
māno hi mahatāṃ loke dhanamakṣayamucyate / tasminnāśākhyaripuṇā māne naṣṭe daridratā
sarvaśāstrārthavettāpi daridro bhāti mūrkhavat / naiṣkiñcanyamahāgrāhagrastānāṃ ko vimocacakaḥ
aho duḥkhamaho duḥkhamaho duḥkhaṃ daridratā / tatrāpi putrabhāryāṇāṃ bāhulyamatiduḥkhadam
evamuktvā bhadramatiḥ sarvaśāstrārthapāragaḥ / anyamaiśvaryadaṃ dharmaṃ manasācintayattadā
bhūmidānaṃ viniścitya sarvadānottamottamam / dānena yo 'numantāti sa eva kṛtavānpurā
prāpakaṃ paramaṃ dharmaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam / dānānāmuttamaṃ dānaṃ bhūdānaṃ parikīrtitam
yaddattvā samavānpoti yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ naraḥ / iti niścatya matimāndhīro bhadramatirbale
kauśāmbīṃnāma nagarīṃ kalatrāpatyayugyayau / sughoṣanāmaviprendraṃ sarvaiśvaryasamanvalitam
gatvā yācitavānbhūmiṃ pañcahastāyatāṃ bale / sughoṣo dharmaniratastaṃ nirīkṣya kuṭumbikram
manasā prīyamāṇena samabhyarcyedamabravīt / kṛtārtho 'haṃ bhadramate saphalaṃ mama janma ca
matkula pāvanaṃ jātaṃ tvadanugrahato dvija / ityuktvā taṃ samabhyarcya sughoṣo dharmatatparaḥ
pañcahastamitāṃ bhūmiṃ dadau tasmai mahāmatiḥ / pṛthivī vaiṣṇavī puṇyā pṛthivīṃ viṣṇupālitā
pṛthivyāstu pradānena prīyatāṃ me janārdanaḥ / mantreṇānena daityendra sughoṣastaṃ dvijottamam
viṣṇubuddhyā samabhyarcya tāvatīṃ pṛthivīṃ dadau / so 'pi bhadramatirvipro dhīmatā yācitāṃ bhuvam
dattavānharibhaktāya śrotriyāya kuṭumbine / sughoṣo bhūmidānena koṭivaṃśasamanvitaḥ
prapede viṣṇubhavanaṃ yatra gatvā na śocati / bale bhadramatiścāpi yataḥ prārthitavāñchriyam
sthitavānviṣṇubhavane sakuṭumbo yugāyutam / tathaiva brahmasadane sthitvā koṭiyugāyutam
aindraṃ padaṃ samāsādya sthitavānkalpapañcakam / tato bhuvaṃ samāsādya sarvaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ
jātismaro mahābhāgo bubhuje bhogamuttamam / tato bhadramatirdaitya niṣkāmo viṣṇutatparaḥ
pṛthivīṃ vṛttihīnebhyo brahmaṇebhyaḥ pradattavān / tasya viṣṇuḥ prasannātmā tattvaiśaavaryamanuttamam
koṭivaṃśasametasya dadau mokṣamanuttamam / tasmāddaityapate mahyaṃ sarvadharmaparāyaṇa
tapaścariṣyemokṣāya dehi me tripadāṃ mahīm / vairocanistato dṛṣṭaḥ kalaśaṃ jalapūritam
ādade pṛthivīṃ dātuṃ varṇine vāmanāya / viṣṇuḥ sarvagatojñātvā jaladhārāvarodhinam
kāvyaṃ hastasthadarbhāgraṃ tacchare saṃnyaveśayat / darbhāgre 'bhūnmahāśāstraṃ koṭisūryasamaprabham
amodhaṃ brahmamatyugraṃ kāvyākṣigrāsalolupam / āyāya bhārgavasurānasurānekacakṣuṣā
paśyeti vāndideśe ca darbhāgraṃ śastrasannibham / balirdadau mahāviṣṇormahīṃ tripadasaṃmitām
vavṛdhe so 'pi viśvātmā ābrahmabhuvanaṃ tadā / amimīta mahīṃ dvābhyāṃ padbhyāṃ viśvatanurhariḥ
sa ābrahmakaṭāhāntapadānyetāni saprabhaḥ / pādāṅkuṣṭāgranirbhinnaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ vibhide dvidhā
taddārā bāhyasalilaṃ bahudhāraṃ samāgatam / dhautaviṣṇupadaṃ toyaṃ nirmalaṃ lokapāvanam
ajāṇḍabāhyanilayaṃ dhārārupamavarttata / tajjalaṃ pāvanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ brahmādīnpāvayatsurān
satparṣisevitaṃ caiva nyapatanmerumūrddhani
etaddaṣṭvādbhutaṃ karma brahmādyā devatāgaṇāḥ / ṛṣayo manavaścaiva hyastuvanharṣavihvalāḥ
devā ūcuḥ namaḥ pareśāya parātmarupiṇe parātparāyāpararupadhāriṇe / brahmātmane brahmaratātmabuddhaye namo 'stu te 'vyāhatakarmaśīline
pareśa paramānanda paramātmanparātpara / sarvātmane jaganmūrtte pramāṇātīta te namaḥ
viśvataśvakṣuṣe tubhyaṃ viśvato bāhave namaḥ / viśvataḥ śirase caiva viśvato gataye namaḥ
evaṃra stuto mahāviṣṇurbrahmādyaiḥ svarddavaukasām / dattvābhayaṃ ca mumude devadevaḥ sanātanaḥ
virocanātmajaṃ daityaṃ padaikārthaṃ babandha ha / tataḥ prapannaṃ tu baliṃ jñātvā cāsmai rasātalam / dadau tadvārapālaśca bhaktavaśyo babhūva ha
nārada uvāca rasātale mahāviṣṇurvirocanasutasya vai / kiṃ bhojyaṃ kalpayāmāsa ghore sarpabhayākule
sanaka uvāca amantritaṃ haviryattu hūyate jātavedasi / apātre dīyate yacca taddhoraṃ bhogasādhanam
hutaṃ haviraśucinā dṛttaṃ satkarma yatkṛtam / tatsarvaṃ tatra bhogārhamadhaḥ pātaphalapradam
evaṃ rasātalaṃ viṣṇurbalaye sāsurāya tu / dattvābhayaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ surāṇāṃ tridivaṃ dadau
pūjyamāno 'maragaṇaiḥ stūyamāno maharṣibhiḥ / gandharvairgīyamānaśca punarvāmanatāṃ gataḥ
etaddṛṣṭvā mahatkarmamuno brahmavādinaḥ / paraspare smitamukhāḥ praṇebhuḥ puruṣottamam
sarvabhūtatmako viṣṇurvāmanatvamupāgataḥ / mohayannikhilaṃ lokaṃ prapede tapase vanam
evaṃ prabhāvā sā devī gaṅgā viṣṇupadodbhavā / yasyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
idaṃ tu gaṅgāmāhātmyaṃ yaḥ paṭhe cchṛṇuyādapi / devālaye nadītīre so 'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet

iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde gaṅgotpattirgaṅgāmāhātmyaṃ nāmaikādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ nātada uvāca śrutaṃ tu gaṅgāmāhātmyaṃ vāñchitaṃ pāpanāśanam / adhunā lakṣaṇaṃ brūhi bhrātarme dānapātraghayoḥ
sanaka uvāca sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ brahmaṇaḥ paramo guruḥ / tasmai tānāni deyāni dattasyānantyamicchatā
brāhmaṇaḥ pratigṛhṇīyātsarvato bhayavarjitaḥ / na kadāpi kṣatraviśo gṛhṇīyātāṃ pratigraham
caṇḍasya putrahīnasya dambhācāraratasya ca / svakarmatyāginaścāpi dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam
paradāraratasyāpi paradravyābhiliṣiṇaḥ / nakṣatrasūcakasyāpi dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam
asūyāviṣṭamanasaḥ kṛtanghasya ca māyinaḥ / ayājyayājakasyāpi dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam
nityaṃ yācñāparasyāpi hiṃsakasya khalasya ca / rasavikrayiṇaśvaiva dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam
nāmaikā da vedavikrayiṇaścāpi smṛtivikrayiṇastathā / dharmavikrayiṇo vipra dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam
gānena jīvikā yasya yasya bhāryā ca puścalī / paropatāpinaścāpi dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam
asijīvī maṣījīvī devalo grāmayājakaḥ / dhāvako vā bhavetteṣāṃ dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam
pākakartuḥ parasyārthe kavaye gadahāriṇe / abhakṣya bhakṣakasyāpi dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam
śūdrānnabhojinaścaiva śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhinaḥ / paiṃśvalānnabhujaścāpi dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam
nāmavikrayiṇo viṣṇoḥ saṃdhyākarṃmorjjhitasya ca / duṣpratigrahadagdhasya dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam
divāśayanaśīlasya tathā maithunakāriṇaḥ / sadhyābhojina evāpidattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam
mahāpātakayuktasya tyaktasya jñātibāndhavaiḥ / kuṇḍasya cāpi golasya dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam
parivatteḥ śaṭhasyāpi parivattuḥ pramādinaḥ / strījitasyātiduṣṭasya dattaṃ bhavita niṣphalam
madyamāṃsāśinaścāpi strīviṭasyātilobhinaḥ / caurasya piśunasyāpi dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam
ye kecitpāpaniratā ninditāḥ sujanaiḥ sadā / na tebhyaḥ pratigṛhṇīyānna ca vadyāddijottama / satkarmaniratāyāpi deyaṃ yatnena nārada
yaddānaṃ śraddhayā dattaṃ tathā viṣṇusamarpaṇam / yācitaṃ vāpi pātreṇa bhavettaddānamuttamam
paralokaṃ samuddaśya hyaihikaṃ vāpi nārada / yaddānaṃ dīyate pātre tatkāmyaṃ madhyamaṃ smṛtam
dagbhena cāpi hiṃsārthaṃ parasyāvidhināpi ca / kruddhenāśraddhayāpātre taddānaṃ madhyamaṃ smṛtam
adhamaṃ balitoṣāyamadhyamaṃ svārthasiddhaye / uttamaṃ hariprītyarthaṃ prāhurvedavidāṃ varāḥ
dānabhogavināśāśca rāyaḥ syurgatayastridhā
yo dadāti ca nobhukte taddhanaṃ nāśakāraṇam / dhanaṃ dharmaphalaṃ vipra dharmo mādhavatuṣṭikṛt
taravaḥ kiṃ na jīvanti te 'pi loke parārthakāḥ / yatra mūlaphalairvṛkṣāḥ parakāryaṃ prakurvate
manuṣyā yadi viprāgthra na parārthāstadā mṛtāḥ / parakāryaṃ na ye martyāḥ kāyenāpi dhanena vā
manasā vacasā vāpi te jñeyāḥ pāpakṛttamāḥ / atretihāsaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu nārada tattvataḥ
yatra dānādikānāṃ tu lakṣaṇaṃ parikīrtitam / gaṅgāmāhātmyasahitaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam
bhagīrathasya dharmasya saṃvādaṃ puṇyakāraṇam / āsīdbhagīratho rājā sagarānvayasaṃbhavaḥ
śaśāsa pṛthivīṃ metāṃ satpadvīpāṃ sasāgarām / sarvadharmarato nityaṃ satyasaṃdhaḥ pratāpavān
kandarpasaddaśo rupe yāyajṛko vicakṣaṇaḥ / prāleyādrisamo dhairye dharme dharmasamo nṛpaḥ
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannaḥ sarvaśāstrārthapāragaḥ / sarvasaṃpatsamāyuktaḥ sarvānandakaro mune
ātithyaprayato nityaṃ vāsudevārcanerataḥ / parākramī guṇanidhirmaitraḥ kāruṇikaḥ sadhīḥ
etādṛśaṃ taṃ rājānaṃ jñātvā dṛṣṭo bhagīratham / dharmarājo dvijaśreṣṭha kadāciddraṣṭumāgataḥ
samāgataṃ dharmarājamarhayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ / śāstradṛṣṭena vidhinā dharmaḥ prī uvāca tam
dharmarāja uvāca rājandharmavidāṃ śreṣṭhaprasiddho 'si jagattraye / dharmarājo 'tha kīrtiṃ te śrutvā tvāṃ draṣṭumāgataḥ
sanmārganirataṃ satyaṃ sarvabhūtahite ratam / draṣṭumicchanti vibudhāratavo tkuṣṭaguṇapriyāḥ
kīrtirnītiśca saṃpattirvartate yatra bhūpate / vasanti tatra niyataṃ guṇāḥsantaśca devatāḥ
aho rājanmahābhāga śobhanīcaritaṃ tava / sarvabhūtahitatvādi mādṛśāmapi durlabham
ityuktavantaṃ taṃ dharmaṃ praṇipatya bhagīrathaḥ / provāca vinayāviṣṭaḥ saṃhṛṣṭaḥ ślakṣṇayā gitaṃ
bhagīratha uvāca bhagavansarvadharmajña samadarśit sureśvara / kṛpayā parayāviṣṭo yatpṛcchāmi vadasva tat
dharmā kīdṛgvidhāḥ proktāḥ ke lokā dharmaśālinām / kiyatyo yātanāḥ proktāḥ keṣāṃ tāḥ parikīrtitāḥ
tvayā saṃmānanīyā ye śāsanīyāśca ye yathā / tatsarvaṃ me mahābhāga vistarādvaktumarhasi
dharmarāja uvāca sādhu sādhu mahāvuddhe matiste vimalorjitā / dharmādharmānpravakṣyāmitattvataḥ śṛṇu bhaktitaḥ
dharmā bahuvidhāḥ proktāḥ puṇyalokapradāyakāḥ / tathaiva yātanāḥ proktā asaṃkhyā ghoradarśatāḥ
vistarādgadituṃ nālamapi varṣaśatāyutaiḥ / tasmātaṃsamāsato vakṣye dharmādharmamidarśanam
tathaiva yātanāṃ vai mahāpuṇyaṃ prakīrtatam / tathaivādhyātmaviduṣo dattaṃ bhavati cākṣayam
kuṭumbinaṃ yā śāstrajñaṃ śrotriyaṃ vā guṇānvitam / yo dattvā syāpayedṛtiṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu
mātṛtāḥ pitṛtaścaiva dvijaḥ koṭikulanvitaḥ / nirviśya viṣṇubhavanaṃ kalpaṃ tatraiva mādate
gaṇyante pāṃsavo bhūmergaṇyante vṛṣṭivindavaḥ / na gaṇyante vidhātrāpi brahahmavṛttiphalāni vai
samastadevatārupo brāhmaṇaḥ parikīrtitaḥ / jīvanaṃ dadatastasya kaḥ puṇyaṃ gadituṃ kṣamaḥ
yo viprahitakṛnnityaṃ sa sarvānkṛtavānmakhān / sa strātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu tatpaṃ tenākhilaṃ tapaḥ
yo dadasveti viprāṇāṃ jīvanaṃ prerayetparam / so 'pi tatphalamāpnoti kimanyairbahubhāṣitaiḥ
taḍāgaṃ kārayedyastu svayamevāpareṇa vā / vaktuṃ tatpuṇyasaṃkhyānaṃ nālaṃ varṣaśatāyuṣā
ekaścedadhvago rājaṃstaḍāgasya jalaṃ pibet / katkartuḥ sarvapāpāni naśyantyeva na saṃśayaḥ
ekāhamaṣi yatkuryādbhūmisthamudakaṃ naraḥ / sa muktaḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ śatavarṣaṃ vaseddivi
kartuṃ taḍāgaṃ yo martyaḥ sāhyakaḥ śaktito bhavet / so 'pi tatphalanāpnoti tuṣṭaḥ preraka eva ca
mṛdaṃ siddhārthamātrāṃ vā taḍāgādyo vahiḥ kṣipet / tiṣṭatyabdaśataṃ svarge vimuktaḥ pāpakoṭibhiḥ
devatā yasya tuṣyanti guravo vā nṛpottama / taḍāgapuṇyabhāksa syādityeṣā śāśvatī śrutiḥ
iti hāsaṃ pravakṣyāmi tavātra nṛpasattama / yaṃ śṛtvā sarvapāyebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
gauḍadeśe 'tivikhyāto rājāsīdvīrabhadrakaḥ / mahāpratīpī vidyāvānsadā vipraprapūjakaḥ
vedaśāstrakulācārayukto mitrakvirdhanaḥ / tasya rājñī mahābhāgā nānmā campakamañjarī
tasya rājño mahāmātyāḥ kṛtmākṛsyavicāraṇāḥ / dharmāṇāṃ dharmaśāstrestu sadā kurvanti niścayam
prāyaścittaṃ cikittsāṃ ca jyotiṣe dharmanirṇayam / vināśāstreṇa yo brūyāttamāhurbrahmaghātakam
iti niścitya manasā manvādīritadharmkān / ācāryebhyaḥ sadā bhūpaḥ śṛṇoti vidhipūrvakam
na ko 'pyanyāyavartī tasya rājye 'varo 'pi ca / dharmeṇa pālyamānasya tasya deśasya bhūpateḥ
jātaṃ samatvaṃ svargasya saurājyasya śubhāvaham / sa caikadā tu nṛpatirmṛgayāyāṃ mahāvane
mantryādibhiḥ parivṛto babhrāma madhyabhāskaram / daivādākheṭaśūnyasya hyatiśrāntasya tatra vai
nṛparītasya saṃjātaṃ saraso darśanaṃ nṛpa / tataḥ śuṣkāṃ tu sarasīṃ dṛṣṭvā tatra vyacintayat
kimayaṃ sarasīśṛṅgebhuvaḥ kena vinirmitā / kathaṃ jalaṃ bhavedatra yena jīvedayaṃ nṛpaḥ
tato buddhiḥ samabhavatkhāte tasyā nṛpottama / hastamātraṃ tato garttaṃ khātvā toyamavātpavān
tena toyena pītena rājñastṛtpirajāyata / mantriṇaścāpi bhūmiśa buddhisāgarasaṃjñinaḥ
sa buddhisāgaro bhūpaṃ prāha dharmārthakovidaḥ / rājanniyaṃ puṣkariṇī varṣājalavatī purā
adyaināṃ baddhavaprāṃ ca karttuṃ jātā matirmama / tadbhavānmodatāṃ deva dattādājñāṃ ca me 'nagha
iti śrutvā vacastasya mantriṇo nṛpasattamaḥ / mumude 'titarāṃ bhūpaḥ svayaṃ kartuṃ samudyataḥ
tameva mantriṇāṃ tatra yuyoja śubhakarmaṇi / tato rājājñayā so 'pi buddhisāgarako mudā
sarasīṃ sāgaraṃ karttumudyataḥ puṇyakṛttamaḥ / dhanuṣāṃ caiva pañcāśatsarvato vistṛtāyatām
sarasīṃ baddhasu śilāṃ cakārāgādhaśambarām / tāṃ vinirmāya sarasīṃ rājñe sarvaṃ nyavedayat
tasyāṃ tataḥ prabhṛti vai sarve 'pi vanacāriṇaḥ / pānthāḥ pipāsitā bhūpa labhante sma jalaṃ śubham
kadācitsvāyuṣaścānte sa mantrī buddhisāgaraḥ / pramṛto gatavāṃllokaṃ lokaśāsturmama prabho
tadarthaṃ tu mayā pṛṣṭo dharmo dharmalipiṅkaraḥ / citragutpastu tatkarma mahyaṃ sarvaṃ nyavedayat
upadeṣṭā svayaṃ cāsau dharmakāryasya bhūpateḥ / tasmāddharmavimānaṃ tu samāroḍhumihārhati
ityukte citragutpena samājñatpo mayā nṛpa / vimānaṃ dharmasaṃjñaṃ tu āroḍhuṃ buddhisāgaraḥ
atha kālāntare rājansarājā vīrabhadrakaḥ / mṛto gato mama sthānaṃ namaścakre mudānvitaḥ
mayā tu tatra tasyāpi pṛṣṭaṃ karmākhilaṃ nṛpa / kathitaṃ citragutpena dharmaṃ sarasisaṃbhavam
tadā samyaṅmayā rājā bodhito 'bhūdyathāśṛṇu / adhityakāyāṃ bhūpāla saikatasya gireḥ parā
lāvakenāmunācañcvā khātaṃ dvyaṃṅguprambuni / tataḥ kālāntare tena vārāheṇa nṛpottama
khanitaṃ hastamātraṃ tu jalaṃ tuṇḍena cātmanaḥ / tato 'nyadāmuyā kālyāhasta yugmamitaḥ kṛtaḥ
khāto jale mahārāja toyaṃ māsadvayaṃ sthitam / pītaṃ kṣudrairvanacaraiḥ sattvaistṛṣṇāsamākulaiḥ
tato varṣatrāyānte tu gajatānena suvrata / hastatrayamitaḥ khātaḥ kṛtastatrādhikaṃ jalam
māsatraye sthitaṃ tacca payo jīvairvanecaraiḥ / bhavāṃstatra samāyāto jalaśoṣāda nantaram
māse tatra tu saṃprātpaṃ hastaṃ khātvā jalaṃ nṛpa / tatastasyopadeśena mantriṇo nṛpate tvayā
pañcāśaddhanurutkhātaṃ jātaṃ tatatra mahājalam / punaḥ śilābhiḥ sudṛḍhaṃ baddhaṃ jātaṃ mahatsaraḥ / vṛkṣāśca ropitāstatra sarvalokopakāriṇaḥ
tena svasvena puṇyena pañcaite jagatīpate / vimānaṃ dharmyamāruḍhāstvamāṇyenaṃ samāruha
iti vākyaṃ samākarṇya mama rājā sa bhūmipa / āruroha vimānaṃ tatṣaṣṭho rājā samāṃśabhāk
iti te sarvamākhyātaṃ taḍāgajanitaṃ phalam / śrutvaitanmucyate pāpādājanmamaraṇāntikāt
yo naraḥ śraddhayo yukto vyākhyātaṃ śruṇuyātpaṭhet / so 'pyāpnotyakhilaṃ puṇyaṃ saronirmāṇasaṃbhavam
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde dharmākhyāne dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ dharmarāja uvāca devatāyatanaṃ yastu kurute kārayatyapi / śivasyāpi harervāpi tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu
mātṛtaḥ pitṛtaścaiva lakṣakoṭikulānvitaḥ / kalpatrayaṃ viṣṇupade tiṣṭatyeva na saṃśayaḥ
mṛdaiva kurute yastu devatāyatanaṃ niraḥ / mṛdaiva kurute yastu devatāyatanaṃ naraḥ / yāvatpuṇyaṃ bhavettasya tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu
divyadehadharo bhūtvā vimānavaramāsthitaḥ / kalpatrayaṃ viṣṇupade tiṣṭatyeva na saṃśayaḥ
mṛdaiva kurute yastu devatāyatanaṃ naraḥ / yāvatpuṇyaṃ bhavettasya tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu
divyadehadharo bhūtvā vimānavaramāsthitaḥ / kalpatrayaṃ viṣṇupade sthitvā brahmapuraṃ vrajet
kalpavadvayaṃ sthitastatra punaḥ kalpaṃ vaseddivi / tatastu yogināmeva kule jāto dayonvitāḥ
vaiṣṇavaṃ yogamāsthāya muktiṃ vrajati śāśvatīm / dārubhiḥ kurute yastu tasya syāddiguṇaṃ phalam
triguṇaṃ ceṣṭakābhistu śilābhistaccaturgaṇam / sphuṭikābhiḥ śilābhistu jñeyaṃ daśaguṇottaram
tānmībhistacchataguṇaṃ hemnā koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet / devālayaṃ taḍāgaṃ vā grāmaṃ vā pālayettu yaḥ
kartuḥ śataguṇaṃ tasya puṇyaṃ bhavati bhūpate / devālayasya śuśrūṣāṃ lepasecanamaṇḍanaiḥ
kuryādyatsatataṃ bhaktyā tasya puṇyamanantakam / vetanādviṣṭito vāpi puṇyakarmapravarttitāḥ
te gacchanti dharādhārāḥ śāścataṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ padam / tāḍāgārddhaphalaṃ rājankāsāre parikīrtitam
kūpe pādaphalaṃ jñeyaṃ vāpyāṃ padmākaronmitam / vāpīśataguṇaṃ proktaṃ kulyāyāṃ bhūpateḥ phalam
dṛṣadbhistudhanīḥkuryānmṛdā niṣkiñcano janaḥ / tayoḥ phalaṃ samānaṃ syādityāha kamalodbhavaḥ
dadyādāḍhyāstu nagaraṃ hastamātramakiñcanaḥ / bhuvaṃ tayoḥ samaphalaṃ prāhurvedavido janāḥ
dhanāḍhyaḥ kurute yastu taḍāgaṃ phalasādhanam / daridraḥ kurute kūpaṃ samaṃ puṇyaṃ prakīrtitam
āśramaṃ kārayedyastu bahujantūpakārakam / sa yāti brahmabhuvanaṃ kulatrayasamanvitaḥ
dhenurvā brahmaṇo vāpi yo vā ko vāpi bhūpate / kṣaṇārddhaṃ tasya chāyāyāṃ tiṣṭansvargaṃ nayatyamum
ārāmakārakā rājandevatāgṛhakāriṇaḥ / taḍāgagrāmakarttāraḥ pūjyante hariṇā saha
sarvalokopakārārthaṃ puṣpārāmaṃ janeśvarā / kurvate devatārthaṃ vā teṣāṃ puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu
tatra yāvanti parṇāni kusumāni bhavanti ca / tāvadvarṣāṇi nākastho modate kulakoṭibhiḥ
prākārakāriṇastasya kaṇṭakāvaraṇapradāḥ / prayānti brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ yugānāmekasatpatim
tulasīropaṇaṃ ye tu kurtate manuje śvara / teṣāṃ puṇyaphalaṃ rājanvadato me niśāmaya
satpakoṭikulairyukto mātṛtaḥ pitṛtastathā / vasetkalpaśataṃ sāgraṃ nārāyaṇapadaṃ nṛpa
ūrddhapuṇḍradharo yastu tulasīmūlamṛtstrayā / gopikācandanenāpi citrakūṭamṛdāpi vā / gaṅgāmṛtikayā caiva tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu
vimānavaramāruḍho gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ / saṃgīyamānacarito modate viṣṇuṃmadire
patrāṇi tulasīmūlādyāvanti patitāni vai / tāvanti brahmahatyādipātakāni hatāni ca
tulasyāṃ secayedyastu jalaṃ culukamātrakam / kṣīrodavāsinā sārddhaṃ vasedācandratārakam
dadāti brāhmaṇānāṃ yaḥ komalaṃ tulasīdalam / sa yāti brahmasadane kulatritayatasaṃyutaḥ
śālaprāmer'payedyastu tulasyāstu dalāni ca / sa vasedviṣṇubhavane yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam
kaṇṭakāvaraṇaṃ yastu prākāraṃ vāpi kārayet / so 'pyekaviṃśatikulairmodate viṣṇumandire
yo 'rccayeddharipādābjaṃ tulasyāḥ komalairdalaiḥ / na tasya punarāvṛttirviṣṇulokānnareśvara
dvādaśyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ yaḥ kṣīreṇa snāpayeddharim / kulāyutayutaḥ so 'pi modate vaiṣṇave pade
prasthamātreṇa payasā yaḥ snāpayati keśavam / kulāyutāyutayutaḥ so 'pi viṣṇupure vaset
ghṛtaprasthena yo viṣṇuṃ dvādaśyāṃ snāpayennaraḥ / kulakoṭiyuto rājansāyujyaṃ labhate hareḥ
pañcāmṛtena yaḥ snānamekādaśyāṃ tu kārayet / viṣṇoḥ sāyujyakaṃ tasya bhavetyulaśatāyutaiḥ
ekādaśyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ vā nṛpottama / nālikerodakairviṣṇuṃ snāpayettatphalaṃ śṛṇu
daśajanmārjitaiḥ pāpairvimukto nṛpasattama / śatadvayakulairyukto modate viṣṇunā saha
ikṣutoyena deveśaṃ yaḥ snāpayati bhūpate / keśavaṃ lakṣapitṛbhiḥ sārddhaṃ viṣṇupadaṃ vrajet
puṣpodakena govindaṃ tathā gandhodakena ca / snāpayitvā hariṃ bhaktyā vaiṣṇavaṃ padamānpuyāt
jalena vastrapūtena yaḥ snāpayati mādhavam / sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇunā saha modate
kṣīrādyaiḥ snāpayedyastu ravisaṃkramaṇe harim / sa vasedviṣṇusadane trisatpapuruṣaiḥ saha
śuklapakṣe caturddaśyāmaṣṭamyāṃ pūrṇimādine
ekādaśyāṃ bhānuvāre dvādaśyāṃ pañcamītithau / somasūryoparāge ca manvādiṣuyugādiṣu
arddhodaye ca sūryasya puṣyārke rohiṇībudhe / tathaiva śaniro hiṇyāṃ bhaumāśvinyāṃ tathaiva ca
śanyāṃ bhṛvabhṛge caivabhṛgurevurevatisaṅgame / tathā budhānurādhāyāṃ śravaṇārke tathaiva ca
tathā ca somaśravaṇe hastayukte bṛhaspatau / budhāṣṭamyāṃ budhāṣāḍhe puṇye vine tathā
strāpaye tpayasā viṣṇuṃ śāntimān vāgyataḥ śuciḥ / ghṛtena madhunā vāpi dadhnā vā tatphalaṃ śṛṇu
sarvayajñaphalaṃ prāpye sarvapāpavivaparjitaḥ / vaseṣṭiṣṇupure sārdaṃ trisatpapuruṣairmṛpa
tatraiva jñānamāsādya yogināmapi durlabham / mokṣamāproti nṛpate punarāvṛttidurlabham
kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśaayāṃ somavāre ca bhūpate / śivaṃ saṃstrāpya dugdhena śivasāyujyamānpuyāt
nālikerodakenāpi śivaṃ saṃstrāpya bhaktitaḥ / aṣṭamyāminduvāre vā śivasāyujyamaśnute
śuklapakṣe caturdaśyāmaṣyamyāṃ vāpi bhūpate / ghṛtena madhunā strāpya śivāṃ tatsāmyatāṃ vrajet
tilatailena saṃstrāpya viṣṇuṃ vā śivamevaṃ ca / sa yāti tattatsārupyaṃ pitṛbhiḥ saha satpabhiḥ
śivamiśrurasenāpi yaḥ snāpayati bhaghaktitaḥ / śivaloke vasetkalpaṃ sasatpapuruṣaiḥ saha
ghṛtena snāpayelliṅgamutthāne dvādaśīdine / kṣīreṇa vā mahābhāga tatphalaṃ śṛṇu madgirā
janmāyutakṛtakaiḥ pāpairdarmukto manujo nṛpa / koṭi saṃkhyaṃ samuddhṛkatya svakulaṃ śivatāṃ vrajet
sampūjya gandhakusumairviṣṇuṃ viṣṇutithau nṛpa / janmāyutārjitaiḥ pāpairmukto vrajati tatpadam
padmapuṣpeṇa yo viṣṇuṃ śivāṃ vā pūjayennaraḥ / sa yāti viṣṇubhavanaṃ kulakoṭisamanvitaḥ
hariṃ ca ketakīpuṣpaiḥ śivaṃ dhattūrajairniśi / saṃpūjya pāpanirmukto vasedbhiṣṇupure yugam
hariṃ tu cāmpakaiḥ purṣperarkaṣpaiśca śaṅkaram / samabhyarcya mahārāja tattatsālokyamānpuyāt
śaṅkara syāthavā viṣṇorghṛtayuktaṃ ca gugagulum / dattvā dhūpe naro bhaktyā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
tilatailānvitaṃ dīpaṃ viṣṇorvā śaṅkarasya vā / dattvā naraḥ sarvakāmānmaṃprāpnoti nṛpottama
ghṛtena dīpaṃ yo dadyācchaṅkarāyātha viṣṇave / sa muktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo gaṅgāsnānaphalaṃ labhet
grāmayena vāpi tailena rājannanyena vā punaḥ / dīpaṃ tattvā mahāviṣṇoḥ śivasyāpi phalaṃ śṛṇu
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sarvaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ / tattatsālokyamāpnoti triḥbhatpapuruṣānvitaḥ
yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ bhojyaṃ tattadīśāya viṣṇave / dattvā tattatpadaṃ yāti catvāriśatkulānvitaḥ
yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ vastu natadviprāya dāpayet / sa yāti viṣṇubhavanaṃ punarāvṛttidurlabham
bhrūṇahāsvarṇadānena śuddho bhavati bhūpate / annatoyasamandānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati
annadaḥ prāṇadaḥ proktaḥ prāṇadaścāpi sarvadaḥ / sarvadānaphalaṃ yasmādannadasya nṛpottama
annado brahmasadanaṃ yātivaṃśāyutānvitaḥ / na tasya punarāvṛttiriti śāstreṣu niścitam
sadyastuṣṭikaraṃ jñeyaṃ jaladānaṃ yato 'dhikam / annadānānnṛpaśreṣṭha nirdiṣṭaṃ śrahmavādibhiḥ
mahāpātakayukto vā yukto vāpyupapātakaiḥ / jalado mucyate tebhya ityāha kamalodbhavaḥ
śarīramannājaṃ prāhuḥ prāṇāmapyannajānviduḥ / tasmādannaprado jñeyaḥ prāṇadaḥ pṛthivīpate
yadyatuṣṭikaraṃ dānaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam / tasmādannasamaṃ dānaṃ nāsti bhūpāla bhūpale
annadasya kule jātā āsahaṃstra nṛpotma / napakaṃ te na paśaayanti tasmādannaprado varaḥ
pādābhyaṅgaṃbhaktiyukto yo 'titheḥ kurute naraḥ / sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu gaṅgāsnānapuraḥsaram
tailābhyaṅgaṃ mahārāja brāhmaṇānāṃ karoti yaḥ / sa strāto 'ṣṭaśataṃ sāgraṃ gaṅgāyāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ
rogitānbrahmāṇānyastu premṇā rakṣati rakṣakaḥ / sa koṭikulasaṃyukto vasedvūhyapure yugam
yo rakṣetpṛthivīpāla raṅgaṃ vā rogiṇaṃ naram / tasya viṣṇuḥ prasannātmā sarvānkāmānprayacchati
manasā karmaṇā vācā yo rakṣedāmayānvitam / sarvānkāmānavānpoti sarvepāpavivārjitaḥ
yo dadāti mahīpāla nivāsaṃ brāhmaṇāya vai / tasya prasanno deveśaḥ svalokaṃ saṃprayacchati
brāhmaṇāyaṃ brahmavide yo dadyādgāṃ payasvinīm / sa yātibrahmasadanamanyeṣāmatidurlabham
anyebhyaḥ pratigṛhyāpi yo ddyādgāṃ payasvinīm / tasya puṇyaphalaṃ vaktuṃ nāhaṃ śakto 'smi paṇḍita
kapilāṃ vedaviduṣe yo dadāti payasvinīm / sa eva rudro bhūpāla sarvapāpavivarjitaḥ
viprāya vedaviduṣe dadyādubhayatomukhīm / yastasya puṇyaṃ saṃkhyātu na śakto 'bdaśatairapi
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ rājañśṛṇu vakṣyāmi tattvataḥ / ekataḥ kratavaḥ sarve samagravaradakṣiṇāḥ
ekato bhayabhītasyata prāṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇam / saṃrakṣati mahīpāla yo vipraṃ bhayavihvalam
sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣitaḥ / vastrado rudrabhavanaṃ kanyādo brahmaṇaḥ padam
hemado viṣṇu bhavanaṃ prayāti svakulānvitaḥ / yastu kanyāmalaṅkṛtya dadātyadhyātmavedine
śatavaṃśasamāyuktaḥ sa vrajedrūhyaṇaḥ padam / kārtikyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vā āṣāḍhyāṃ vāpi bhūpate
vṛṣabhaṃ śivatuṣṭyarthamutsṛjettatphalaṃ śṛṇu / satpajanmārjitaiḥ pāpairvimukto rudrarupabhāk
kulasatpatisaṃyukto rudreṇa saha modate / śivaliṅgāṅkitaṃ kṛtvā mahiṣaṃ yaḥ samutsṛjet
na tasya yātanāloko bhavennṛpatisattam / tāmbūladānaṃ yaḥ kuryācchaktito nṛpasattama
tasya viṣṇuḥ prasannātmā dadātyāyuryaśaḥ śriyam / kṣīrodo ghṛtadaścaiva madhudo dadhidastathā
. divyābdāyutaparyantaṃsvargaloke mahīyate / prayāti brahmasadanamikṣudātā nṛpottama
gandhadaḥ puṇyaphaladaḥ prayāti brahmaṇaḥ padam / guḍekṣurasadaścaiva prayāti kṣīrasāgaram
bhaṭānāṃ jalado yāti sūryalokamanuttamam / vidyādānena sāyujyaṃ mādhavasya vrajennaraḥ
vidyādānaṃ mahīdānaṃ godānaṃ cottamottamam / narakāduddharantyeva japavāhanadohanāt
sarveṣāmapi dānānāṃ vidyādānaṃ viśiṣyate / vidyādānena sāyujyaṃ viṣṇoryāti nṛpottama
narastviṃndhanadānena mucyate hyupapātakaiḥ / śālagrāmaśilādānaṃ mahādānaṃ prakīrtitam
yaddattvā mokṣamānpoti liṅgadānaṃ tathā smṛtam / brahmāṇḍa koṭidānena yatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ
tatphalaṃ samavānpoti liṅgadānānna saṃśayaḥ / śālagrāmaśilādāne tato 'pi dviguṇaṃ phalam
śāla grāmaśilārūpī viṣṇureveti viśrutaḥ / yo dadāti naro dānaṃ gṛhatāṃ prabho
gaṅgāstrānaphalaṃ tasya niścitaṃ nṛpa jāyate / ratnānvitasavarṇasya pradānena nṛpottama
bhuktimuktimavānpoti mahādānaṃ yataḥ smṛtam / naro māṇikyadānena paraṃ mokṣamavānpuyāt
ghruvalokamavānpoti vajradānena mānavaḥ / svargaṃ vidrumadānena rudralokamavānpuyāt
prayāti yānadānena muktādānena caindavam / vaiḍūryado rudralokaṃ puṣparāgapradastathā
puṣparāgapradānena sarvatra sukhamaśnute / aśvasāṃnidhyaṃ ciraṃ vrajati bhūmipa
gajadānena mahatā sarvānkāmānavānpuyāt / prayāti yānadānena svargaṃ svaryānamāsthitaḥ
mahiṣīdo jayatyeva hyapamṛkatyuṃ na saṃśayaḥ / gavāṃ tṛṇapradānena rudralokamavānpuyāt
vāruṇaṃ lokamānpoti mahīśa lavaṇapradaḥ / svaśramācāraniratāḥ sarvabhūtahiteratāḥ
adāmbhikā gatāsūyāḥ prayānti bagrahmaṇaḥ padam / paropadeśa niratā vītarāgā vimatsārāḥ
haripādārcanaratāḥ prayānti sadanaṃ hareḥ / satsaṅgāhlādaniratāḥ satkarmasu sadodyatāḥ
parāpavādavimukhāḥ prāyānti harimandiram / nityaṃ hitakarā ye tu brāhmaṇeṣu ca goṣu ca
parastrīsaṅgavimukhā na paśyanti yamālayam / jitendriyā jitāhārā goṣu kṣāntāḥ suśīlinaḥ
brāhmaṇeṣu kṣamāśīlāḥ prayānti bhavanaṃ hareḥ / agniśuśrūṣavaścaiva guruśuśrūṣakāstathā
patiśuśrūṣaṇaratā na vai saṃsṛtibhāginaḥ / sadā devārcanaratā harinamaparāyaṇāḥ
pratigrahanivṛttāśca prayānti paramaṃ padam / anāthaṃ viprakuṇapaṃ ye daheyurnṛpottama
aśvamedhasahasrāṇāṃ phalamaśnuvate sadā / patraiḥ purṣpeḥ phalairvāpi jalairvā manujeśvara
pūjayā rahitaṃ liṅgamacaryattetphalaṃ śṛṇu / apsarogaṇagandharvaiḥ stūyamāno vimānagaḥ
prayāti śivasānnidhyamityāha kamalodbhavaḥ / culukodakamātreṇa liṅgaṃ saṃsnāpya bhūmipa
lakṣāśvamedhajaṃ puṇyaṃ saṃprānpoti na saṃśayaḥ / pūjayā rahitaṃ liṅgaṃ kusumairyor'cayetsudhīḥ
aśvamedhāyutaphalaṃ bhavettasya janeśvara / bhakṣyairbhojyaiḥ phalairvāpi śūnyaṃ liṅgaṃ prapūjya ca
śivasāyujyamānpoti punarāvṛttivarjitam / pūjayā rahitaṃ viṣṇuṃ yor'cayedakarvaṃśaja
jalenāpi sa sālokyaṃ viṣṇoryāti narottama / devatāyatane yastu kuryātsaṃmārjanaṃ sudhīḥ
yāvatpāṃsu yugāvāsaṃ vaiṣṇave mandirelabhet / śīrṇaṃ sphaṭikaliṅgantu yaḥ saṃdadhyānnṛpottama
śatajanmārjitaiḥ pāpairmucyate sa tu mānavaḥ / yastu devālaye rājannapi gocarmamātrakam
jalena siñcidbhūbhāgaṃ so 'pi svargaṃ labhennaraḥ / gandhodakena yaḥ siñceddevatāyatane bhuvam
yāvatkaṇānukalpaṃ tu tiṣṭheta devasannidhau / mṛdā dhātuvikārairvā yo limpeddevatāgṛham
sa koṭikulamuddhṛtya yāti sāmyaṃ madhudviṣaḥ / śilācūrṇena yo martyo devāgāraṃ tu lopayet
svastikādīni vā kuryāttasya puṇyamanantakam / yaḥ kuryāddīparacanāṃ devatāyatane nṛpa
tasya puṇyaṃ prasaṃkhyātuṃ notsahe 'bdaśatairapi / akhaṇḍadīpaṃ yaḥ kuryādviṣṇorvā śaṅkarasya ca
kṣaṇe kṣaṇe 'śvamedhasya phalaṃ tasya na durlabham / arcitaṃ śaṅkaraṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣṇuṃ vāpi namettu yaḥ
sa viṣṇubhavanaṃ prāpya modate ca yugāyutam / devyāḥ pradakṣiṇāmekāṃ satpa sūryasya bhūmipa
tistro vināyakasyāpi catastro viṣṇumandire / kṛtvā tattadgṛhaṃ prāpya modate yugalakṣakam
yo viṣṇorbhaktibhāvena tathaiva godvijasya ca / pradakṣiṇāṃ cararettasya hyaśvamedhaḥ pade pade
kāśyāṃ maheśvaraṃ māheśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ saṃpūjya praṇamettu yaḥ / na tasya vidyate kṛtyaṃ saṃsṛtirnaiva jāyate
śivaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā savyenaiva vidhānataḥ / naro na cyavate svargācchaṅkarasya prasādataḥ
stutvā stotrairjagannāthaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam / sarvānkāmānavānpoti manasā yadyadicchati
devatāyatane yastu bhaktiyuktaḥ pranṛtyati / gāyate vā sa bhūpāla rudraloke ca muktibhāk
ye tu vādyaṃ prakurvanti devatāyatane narāḥ / te haṃsayānamāruḍhā vrajanti brahmaṇaḥ padam
karatālaṃ prakurvanti devatāyatane tu yete / sarvapāpanirmuktā vimānasthā yugāyutam
devatāyatane ye tu ghaṇṭānādaṃ prakurvate / teṣāṃ puṇyaṃ nigadituṃ na samarthaḥ śivaḥ svayam
bherīmṛdaṅgapaṭahamurajaiśva saḍiṇḍimaiḥ / saṃprīṇayanti deveśaṃ teṣāṃ puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu
devastrīgaṇasaṃyuktāḥ sarvakāmaiḥ samarcitāḥ / svargalokamanuprāpya modante kalpapañcakam
devatāmandire kurvannaraḥ śaṅkharavaṃ nṛpa / sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇunā saha modate
tālakāṃsyādininadaṃ kurvan viṣṇugṛhe naraḥ / sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇulokamavānpuyāt
yo devaḥ sarvadṛgviṣṇurjñānarupī nirañjanaḥ / sarvadharmaphalaṃ pūrṇaṃ saṃtuṣṭaḥ pradadāti ca
yasya smaraṇamātreṇa devadevasya cakriṇaḥ / saphalāni bhavantyeva sarvakarmāṇi bhūpate
paramātmā jagannāthaḥ sarvakarṃmaphalapradaḥ / satkarmakartṛbhirnityaṃ smṛtaḥ sarvārtināśanaḥ / tamuddiśya kṛtaṃ yacca tadānantyāya kalpate
dharmāṇi viṣṇuśca phalāni viṣṇuḥ karmāṇi viṣṇuśca phalāni bhoktā / kāryaṃ ca viṣṇuḥ karaṇāni viṣṇurasmānna kiñcivdyatiriktamasti

iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde dharmānukathanaṃ nāma trayodaśo 'dhyāyaḥ dharmarāja uvāca śrutismṛtyuditaṃ dharmaṃ varṇānāmanupūrvaśaḥ / prabravīmi nṛpaśreṣṭha taṃ śṛṇuṣva samāhitaḥ
yo bhuñjāno 'śuciṃ vāpi cāṇḍālaṃ patitaṃ spṛśet / krodhādajñānato vāpiṃ tasya vakṣyāmi niṣkṛtim
trirātraṃ vātha ṣaḍrātraṃ yathāsaṃkhyaṃ samācaret / snānaṃ triṣavaṇaṃ viprapañcagavyena śudhyati
bhuñjānasya tu viprasya kadācajitstravate gudam / ucchiṣṭatve 'śucitve ca tasya śuddhiṃ vadāmi te
pūrvaṃ kṛtvā dvijaḥ śaucaṃ paścādapa upaspṛśet / ahorātroṣito bhūtvā pañcagavyena śudhyati
nigiranyadi meheta bhuktvā vā mehane kṛte / ahorātroṣito bhūtvā juhuyātsarpiṣānalam
yadā bhojanakāle syādaśucirbrāhmaṇaḥ kvacit / bhūmau nidhāya taṃ grāsaṃ strātvā śuddhimavānpuyāt
bhakṣayitvā tu tad āsamupavālena śuddhyati / aśitvā caiva tatsarvaṃ trirātramaśucirbhavet
aśrataścedvamiḥ syādvai hyasvasthastriśrataṃ japet / svasthastrīṇi sahasrāṇi gāyatryāḥ śodhanaṃ param
cāṇḍālaiḥ śvaparcaiḥ spṛṣṭo viṇmūtre ca kṛte dvijaḥ
trirātraṃ tu prakurvīta bhuktocchiṣṭaḥ ṣahācaret / udakyāṃ sūtikāṃvāpi saṃspṛśedantyajo yadi
trirātreṇa viśuddhiḥ syāditi śātātapo 'bravīt / rajasvalā tu saṃspṛṣṭā śvabhirmātaṅgavāyasaiḥ
nirāhārā śucistiṣṭetkāle snānena śuddhyati / rajasvale yadā nāryāvanyonyaṃ spṛśataḥ kvacit
śuddhete brahmakūrcena brahmakūrcena copari / ucchiṣṭena ca saṃspṛṣṭo yo na snānaṃ samācaret
ṛtau tu garbhaṃ śaṅkitvā snānaṃ maithuninaḥ smṛtam / anṝtau tu striyaṃ gatvā śaucaṃ mūtrapurūṣavat
ubhāvapyaśucī syātāṃ dampatī yābhasaṃgatau / śayanādutthitā nārī śuciḥ syādaśuciḥ pumān
bharttuḥ śarīraśuśrūṣāṃ daurātmyādaprakurvatī / daṇḍyā dvādaśakaṃ nārī varṣaṃ tyājyā dhanaṃ vinā
tyajanto patitānbagandhūndaṇḍyānuttamasāhasam / pitā hi patitaḥ kāmaṃ na tu mātā kadācana
ātmānaṃ ghātayedyastu rajjvādibhirupakramaiḥ / mṛte medhyena letpavyo jīvato dviśataṃ damaḥ
daṇḍyāstatputramitrāṇi pratyekaṃ pāṇikaṃ damam / prāyaścittaṃ tataḥ kuryuryathāśāstrapracoditam
jalāgnyudvandhanabhraṣṭāḥ pravrajyānāśakacyutāḥ / viṣaprapatanadhvastāḥ śastraghātahatāśca ye
na caite pravratyavasitāḥ sarvalokabahiṣkṛtāḥ / cāndrāyaṇena śuddhyaṃnti tatpakṛcchradvayena vā
ubhayāvasitaḥ pāpaśyāmacchabalakāccyutaḥ / cāndrāyaṇābhyāṃ śuddhyeta dattvā dhenuṃ tathā vṛṣam
svaśṛgālaplavaṅgādyairmānuṣaiśca ratiṃ vinā / spṛṣṭaḥ strātvā śuciḥ sadyo divā saṃdhyāsu rātriṣu
ajñānādvā tu yo bhuktvā cāṇḍālānnaṃ kathañcana / gomūtrayāvakāhāro māsārddhena viśuddhyati
gobrāhmaṇagṛhaṃ dagdhvā mṛtaṃ codvandhanādinā / pāśaṃ chitvā tathā tasya kṛcchramekaṃ careddijaḥ
cāṇḍālapulpasānāṃ ca bhuktvā hatvā ca yoṣitam / kṛcchrārdhdamācarejjñānādajñānādaindavadvayam
kopālikānnabhoktṛāṇāṃ tannārīgāmināṃ tathā / agamyāgamane vipro madyago māṃsabhakṣaṇe
tatpakṛcchraparikṣitpo maurvīhomena śuddhyati / mahāpātakakarttāraścatvāro 'tha viśeṣataḥ
agniṃ praviśya śuddhyantisthitvāvā mahati kratau / rahasyakaraṇo 'pyevaṃ māsamabhyasya puruṣaḥ
aghamarṣaṇasūktaṃ vā śuddhyedantarjale japan / rajakaścarmakāraśca naṭo buruḍa eva ca
kaivarttamedabhillāśva satpaite hyantyajāḥ smṛtāḥ / bhuktvā caiṣāṃ striyo gatvā pītvā yaḥpratigṛhyate
kṛcchrārddhamācarejjñānādaindavadvayam / mātaraṃ gurupatnīṃ ca duhitṛbhaginīsnuṣāḥ
saṃgamya praviśedagniṃ nānyāśuddhirvidhīyate / rājñīṃ pravrajitāṃ dhātrīṃ tathāvarṇottamāmapi
gatvākṛcchradvayaṃ kuryātsagotrāmabhigamya ca / amūṣu pitṛgotrāsu mātṛgotragatāsu ca
padadāreṣu sarveṣu kṛcchrārddhaṃ tapanaṃ caret / veśyābhigamane pāpaṃ vyapohanti dvijā stathā
pītvā sakṛtsutatpaṃ ca pañcarātraṃ kuśodakam / gurutalpagato kuryārdbāhmaṇo vidhivadrūtam
gonghasya kecidicchanti keciccaivāvakīrṇinaḥ / daṇḍādūrdhvaṃ prahāreṇa yastu gāṃ vinipātayet
dviguṇaṃ govrataṃ tasya prāyaścitaṃ viśodhayet / aṅguṣṭhamātrasthūlastu bāhumātraghapramāṇakaḥ
sārdrakaḥsapālāśca godaṇḍaḥ parikīrttitaḥ / gavāṃ nipātane caiva garbho 'pi saṃbhavedyadi
ekaikaśaśvaretkṛcchraṃ eṣā gonghasya niṣkṛtiḥ / bandhane rodhane caiva poṣaṇe vā gavāṃ rujām
saṃpadyate cenmaraṇaṃ nimittenaiva lipyate / mūrcchitaḥ patito vāpi daṇḍenābhihatastataḥ
utthāya ṣaṭpadaṃ gacchetsatpa pañcadaśāpi vā / grāsaṃ vā yadi gṛhṇīyāttoyaṃ vāpi pibedyadi
sarvavyādhipranaṣṭānāṃ prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate / kaṣṭaloṣṭāśmabhirgāvaḥ śastrairvā nihatā yadi
prāyaścittaṃ smṛtaṃ tatra śastre nigadyate / kāṣṭe sāntapanaṃ proktaṃ prājāpatyaṃ tu loṣṭake
tatpakṛcchraṃ tu pāṣāṇe śastre cāpyatikṛcchrakam / auṣadhaṃ snehamāhāraṃ dadyādgobrāhmaṇeṣu ca
dīyamāne vipattiḥ syātprāyaścittaṃ tadā nahi / tailabheṣajapāne ca bheṣajānāṃ ca bhakṣaṇe
niśalyakaraṇe caiva prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate / vatsānāṃ kaṇṭhabandhena kriyayābheṣajena tu
sāyaṃ saṃgopanārthaṃ ca tvadoṣo roṣabandhayoḥ / pāde caivāsya romāṇi dvipāde śmaśru kevalam
tripāde tu śikhāvartaṃ mūle sarvaṃ samācaret / sarvānkeśānsamuddhṛtya chedayedaṅguladvayam
evameva tu nārīṇāṃ muṇḍanaṃ śirasaḥ smṛtam / na stiyā vapanaṃ kāryaṃ na ca vīrāsanaṃ smṛtam
na ca goṣṭe nivāso 'sti na gacchantīmanuvrajet / rājā vā rājaputragho vā brāhmaṇo vā bahuśrutaḥ
akṛtvā vapanaṃ teṣāṃ prāyaścittaṃ vinirddiśet / keśānāṃ rakṣaghaṇārthaṃ ca dviguṇaṃ vratamādiśet
dviguṇe gatu vrate cīrṇe dviguṇā vratadakṣiṇā
pāpaṃ na kṣīyate hanturdātā ca narakaṃ vrajet / aśrautasmārtavihitaṃ prāyaścittaṃ vadanti ye
tāndharmavinghakartṝṃśca rājā daṇḍena pīḍayet / na caitānpīḍayedrājā kathañcitkāmamohitaḥ
tatpāpaṃ śatadhābhūtvā tameva parisarpati / prāyaścitte tataścīrṇe kuryādbrāhmaṇabhojanam
viṃśatirgā vṛṣaṃ caikaṃ dadyātteṣāṃ ca dakṣiṇām / krimibhistṛṇa saṃbhūtairmakṣikādinipātitaiḥ
kṛcchrārddhaṃ sa prakurvīta śaktyā dadyāñca dakṣiṇām / prāyaścittaṃ ca kṛtvā vai bhojayitvā dvijottamān
suvarṇamānikaṃ dadyāttataḥ śuddhirvidhīyate / cāṇḍālaśvapacaiḥ spṛṣṭe niśi snānaṃ vidhīyate
na vasettatra rātrau tu sadyaḥ snānena śuddhyati / vasedatha yadā rātrāvajñānādavicakṣaṇaḥ
tadā tasya tu tatpāpaṃ śatadhā parivartate / udgacchanti ca nakṣatrāṇyupariṣṭācca ye grahāḥ
saṃspṛṣṭe raśmibhisteṣāmudakasnānamācaret / yāścāntarjalavalmīkamūṣikoṣaravartmasu
śmaśāne śaucaśeṣe ca na grāhyāḥ satpa mṛttikāḥ / iṣṭāpūrtaṃ tu karttavyaṃ brāhmaṇena prayatnataḥ
iṣṭena labhate svargaṃ mokṣaṃ pūrttena cānpuyāt / vittakṣepo bhavediṣṭaṃ taḍāgaṃ pūrttamucyate
ārāmaśca viśeṣeṇa devadroṇyastathaiva ca / vāpīkūpataḍāgāni devatāyatanāni ca
patitānyuddharedyastu sa pūrvaphalamaśnute / śuklāyā āharenmūtraṃ kṛṣṇāyā goḥ śakṛttathā
tāmrāyāśca payo grāhyaṃ śvetāyāśca dadhi smṛtam / kapilāyā ghṛtaṃ grāhyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam
kuśaistīrthanadītauyaiḥ sarvadravyaṃ pṛthak pṛthak / āhṛtya praṇavenaiva utthāpya praṇavena ca
praṇavena samāloḍya praṇavenaiva saṃpibet / pālāśe madhyame parṇe bhāṇḍe tāmramaye śubhe
pibetpuṣkaraparṇe vā mṛnmaye vā kuśodakam / sūtake tu samutpanne dvitīye samupasthite
dvitīye nāsti doṣastu prathamenaiva śudhyati / jātena śudhyate jātaṃ mṛtena mṛtakaṃ tathā
garbhasaṃstravaṇe māse trīṇyahāni vinirdiśet
rātribhirmāsatulyābhirgarbhastrāve viśuddhyati / rajasyuparate sādhvī snanena strī rajasvalā
svagotrādbhṛśyate nārī vivāhātsatpame pade / svāmigotreṇa karttavyāstasyāḥ piṇḍodakakriyāḥ
uddeśyaṃ piṇḍadāne syātpiṇḍe piṇḍe dvināmataḥ / ṣaṇṇāṃ deyāstrayaḥ piṇḍā evaṃ dātā na muhyati
svena bhartrā sahasrābdaṃ mātābhuktā sudaivatam / pitāmahyapi svenaiva svenaiva prapitāmahī
varṣe tu kurvīta mātāpitrostu satkṛtim / adaivaṃ bhojayecchrāddhaṃ piṇḍamekaṃ tu nirvapet
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ vṛddhiśrāddhamathāparam / pārvaṇaṃ ceti vijñeyaṃ śrāddhaṃ pañcavidhaṃ budhaiḥ
grahoparāge saṃkrāntau parvotsa vamalālaye / nirvapertrīnnaraḥ piṇḍānekameva mṛte 'hani
anūḍha na pṛthakkanyā piṇḍe gotre ca sūtake / pāṇigrahaṇamantrābhyāṃ svagotrādbhraśyate tataḥ
yena yena tu varṇena yā kānyā pariṇīyate / tatsamaṃ sūtakaṃ yāti tathāpiṇḍodake 'pi ca
vivāhe caiva saṃvṛtte caturthe 'hanirātriṣu / ekatvaṃ sā vrajedbhartuḥ piṇḍe gotre ca sūtake
prathame 'ṅni dvitīye vā tṛtīye vā caturthake / asthisaṃcayanaṃ kāryaṃ bandhubhirhitabuddhibhiḥ
caturthe pañcame caiva satpame navame tathā / asthisaṃcayanaṃ proktaṃ varṇānāmanupūrvaśaḥ
ekādaśāhe pretasya yasya cotsṛjyate vṛṣaḥ / mucyate pretalokātsa svargaloke mahīyate
nābhimātre jale sthitvā hṛdayena tu cintayet / āgacchantu me pitaro gṛhṇantvetāājāñjalīn
hastau kṛtvā tu saṃyuktau pūracitvā jalena ca / gośṛṅgamātramuddhṛtya jalamadhye viniḥ kṣipet
ākāśe ca kṣipedvāri vāristho dakṣaghiṇāmukhaḥ / pitṝṇāṃ sthānamākāśaṃ dakṣiṇādik tathaiva ca
āpo devagaṇāḥ proktā āpaḥ pitṛgaṇāstathā / tasmādasya jalaṃ deyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ hitamicchatā
divāsūryāṃśusaṃtatpaṃ rātrau nakṣatramārutaiḥ / madhyayorapyubhābhyāṃ ca pavitraṃ sarvadā jalam
svabhāvayuktamavyaktamamedhyena sadā śuciḥ / bhāṇḍasthaṃ dharaṇīsthaṃ vā pavitraṃ sarvadā jalam
devatānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca jalaṃ dadyājjalāñjalīn / asaṃskṛtapramītānāṃ sthale dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ
śraddhe havanakāle ca dadyādekena pāṇinā / ubhābhyāṃ tarpaṇe dadyādeṣa dharmo vyavasthitaḥ

iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde dharmaśāntinirdeśo nāma caturdaśo 'dhyāyaḥ dharmarāja uvāca pāpa bhedānpravakṣyāmi yathā sthūlāśca yātanāḥ / śṛṇuṣva dhairyamāsthāya raudrā ye narakā yataḥ
pāpino ye durātmāno narakāgniṣu santatam / pacyante yeṣu tānvakṣye bhayaṅkaraphalapradān
tapanovālukākumbhaumahārauravarauravau / kumbhaghīpāko nirucchvāsaḥ kālasūtraḥ pramardanaḥ
asipatravanaṃ ghoraṃ lālābhakṣohimotkaṭaḥ / mūṣāvasthā vasākūpastathā vaitaraṇī nadī
bhakṣyante mūtrapānaṃ ca purīṣahlada eva ca / tatpaśūlaṃ tatpaśilā śālmalīdruma eva ca
tathā śoṇitakūpaśca ghoraḥ śoṇitabhojanaḥ / svamāṃsabhojanaṃ caiva vahnijvālāniveśanam
śilāvṛṣṭiḥ śastravṛṣṭirvahnivṛṣṭistathaiva ca / kṣārodakaṃ coṣṇatoyaṃ tatpāyaḥ piṇḍabhabhaṇam
atha śiraḥśoṣaṇaṃ ca marutprapatanaṃ tathā / tathā pāśāṇavarṇaṃ ca kṛmibhojanameva ca
kṣāro dapānaṃ bhramaṇaṃ tathā krakacadāraṇam / purīṣalepanaṃ caiva purīṣasya ca bhojanam
retaḥ pānaṃ mahāghoraṃ sarvasandhiṣudāhanam / dhūmapānaṃ pāśabandhaṃ nānāśūlānulepanam
aṅgāraśayanaṃ caiva tathā musalamarddanam / bahūni kāṣṭhayantrāṇi kaṣaṇaṃ chedanaṃ tathā
patanotpatanaṃ caiva gadādaṇḍādipīhanam / gajadantapraharaṇaṃ nānāsarpaiśca daṃśanam
śītāmbusecanaṃ caiva nāsāyāṃ ca mukhe tathā / ghorakṣārāmbupānaṃ ca tathā lavaṇabhakṣaṇam
strāyucchedaṃ snāyubandhamasthicchedaṃ tathaiva ca / kṣārāmbupūrṇarandhrāṇāṃ praveśaṃ māṃsabhojanam
pittapānaṃ mahāghoraṃ tathaivaḥśleṣmabhojanam / vṛkṣāgrātpātanañcaiva jalāntarmajjanaṃ tathā
pāṣāṇadhāraṇaṃ caiva śayanaṃ kaṇṭakopari / pipīlikādaṃśanaṃ ca vṛścikaiścāpi pīḍanam
vyāghrapīḍā śivāpīḍā tathā mahiṣamīḍanam / karddame śayanaṃ caiva durgandhaparipūraṇam
bahuśaścārdhaśayanaṃ mahātiktaniṣevaṇam / atyuṣṇatailapānaṃ ca mahākaṭuniṣevaṇam
kaṣāyodakapānaṃ ca tatpapāṣāṇatakṣaṇam / atyuṣṇaśītasnānaṃ ca tathā daśanaśīrṇanam
tatpāyaḥ śayanaṃ caiva hyayobhārasya bandhanam / evamādyāmahābhāga yātanāḥ koṭikoṭiśaḥ
api varṣasahasreṇa nāhaṃ nigadituṃ kṣamaḥ / eteṣu yasya yatprātpaṃ pāpinaḥ kṣitirakṣaka
tatsarvaṃ saṃprapakṣyāmi tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu / brahmahā ca surāpī ca steyī ca gurutalpagaḥ
mahāpātakinastvete tatsaṃsargī ca pañcamaḥ / pantibhedīvṛthāpākī nityaṃ brahmaṇadūṣakaḥ
ādeśī vedavikretā pañcaite brahmadhātakāḥ / brahmaṇaṃ yaḥ samāhūya dāsyāmīti dhanādikam / eścānnāstīti yo bruyāttamāhurbrahmaghātinam
snānārthaṃ pūjanārthaṃ vā gacchato brāhmaṇasya yaḥ / samāyātyantarāyatvaṃ tamāhurbrahmadhātinam
pasnindāsu nirataścātmotkarṣarataśva yaḥ / asatyanirataśvacaiva brahmahā parikīrtitaḥ
adharmasyānumantā ca brahmahā parikīrtitaḥ / anyodvegarataścaiva anyeṣāṃ doṣasūvakaḥ
dambhācārarataśvaiva brahmahetyabhidhīyate / nityaṃ pratigraharatastathā prāṇivadhe rataḥ
adharmasyānumamantā ca brahmahā parikīrtitaḥ / brahmahatyā samaṃ pāpameva bahuvidhaṃ nṛpa
surāpānasamaṃ pāpaṃ pravakṣyāmi samāsataḥ / gaṇānnabhojanaṃ caiva gaṇikānāṃ niṣevaṇam
patitānnādanaṃ caiva surāpānasamaṃ smṛtam / upāsamāparityāgo devalānāṃ ca bhojanam
surāpayoṣitsaṃyogaḥ surāpānasamaḥ smṛtaḥ / yaḥ śūdreṇa samāhato bhojanaṃ kurute dvijaḥ
surāpī sa hi vijñeyaḥ sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtaḥ / yaḥ śūdreṇābhyanujñātaḥ preṣyakarma kariti ca
surāpāna samaṃ pāpaṃ labhate sa narādhamaḥ / evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ pāpaṃ surāpānasamaṃ smṛtam
hemasteyasamaṃ pāpaṃ pravakṣyāmi niśāmaya / kandamūlaphalānāṃ ca kastūrī paṭavāsasām
sadā steyaṃ ca ratnānāṃ svarṇasteyasamaṃ smṛtam / tāmrāyastrapukāṃsyānāmājyasya madhunastathā
steyaṃ sugandhadravyāṇṇāṃ svarṇasteyasamaṃ smṛtam / kramukasyāpiharaṇamambhasāṃ candanasya ca
parṇarasāpaharaṇaṃ svarṇasteyasamaṃ smṛtam / pitṛyajñaparityāgo dharmakāryavilopanam
yatīrnāṃ nindataṃ caiva svarṇasteyasamaṃ smṛtam / bhakṣyāṇāṃ cāpaharaṇaṃ dhānyānāṃ haraṇaṃ tathā
rudrākṣaharaṇaṃ caiva svarṇasteyasamaṃ smṛtam / bhāgīnīgamanaṃ caiva putrastrīgamanaṃ tathā
rajasvalādigamanaṃ gurutalpasamaṃ smṛtam / hīnajātyābhigamanaṃ madyapastrīniṣevaṇam
parastrīgamanaṃ caiva gurutalpasamaṃ smṛtam / bhrātṛstrīgamanaṃ caiva vayasyastrīniṣevaṇam
viśvastāgamanaṃ caiva gurutalpasamaṃ smṛtam / akāle karmakaraṇaṃ putrīgamana meva ca
dharmalopaḥ śāstranindā gurutalpasamaṃ smṛtam / ityevamādayo rājanmahāpātakasaṃjñitāḥ
eteṣvekatamenāpi saṅgakṛttatsamo bhavet / yathākathañcitpāpānāmeteṣāṃ paramarṣibhiḥ
śāntaistu niṣkṛtirdṛṣṭā prāyaścitādikalpanaiḥ / prāyaścittavihīnāni pāpāni śṛṇu bhūpate
samastapāpatulyāni mahānarakadāni ca / brahmahatyādipāpānāṃ kathañcinniṣkṛtirbhavet
brahmaṇaṃ dveṣṭi yastasya niṣkṛtirnāsti kutracit / viśvastaghātinaṃ caiva kṛtanghānāṃ nareśvara
śūdrastrīsaṅgināṃ caiva niṣkṛtirnāsti kutracit / śūdrānnapuṣṭadehānāṃ vedanindāratātmanām
satkathānindakānāñca nehāmutracaniṣkṛtiḥ
bauddhālayaṃ viśedyastu mahāpadyapi vaidvijaḥ / natasyaniṣkṛtirdṛṣṭāprāyaścitaśatairapi
bauddhāḥ pāṣaṃṇḍinaḥ proktā yato vedavinindakāḥ / tasmādvijastānnekṣeta yato dharmabahiṣkṛtāḥ
jñānato 'jñānato vāpi dvijo boddhālayaṃ viśet / jñātvā cenniṣkṛtirnāsti śāstrāṇāmiti niśvayaḥ
eteṣāṃ pāpabāhulyānnarakaṃ koṭikalpakam / prāyaścittavihīnāni proktānyanyāni ca prabho
pāpāni teṣāṃ narakāngadato me niśāmaya
mahāpātakinasteṣu pratyekaṃ yugavāsinaḥ / tadante pṛthivīmetya satpajanmasu gardabhāḥ
tataḥ śvāno viddhadehā bhaveyurdaśajanmasu / āśatābdaṃ viṭkṛmayaḥ sarpā dvādaśajanmasu
tataḥ sahasrajanmāni mṛgādyāḥ paśavo nṛpa / śatābdaṃ sthāvarāścaiva tato godhāśarīriṇaḥ
tatastu satpajanmāni caṇḍālāḥ pāpakāriṇaḥ / tataḥ ṣoḍaśa janmāni śūdrādyā hīnajātayaḥ
tatastu janmadvitaye daridrāvyādhipīḍitāḥ / pratigrahaparā nityaṃ tato nirayagāḥ punaḥ
asūyāviṣṭamanaso raurave narake smṛtam / tatra kalpadvayaṃ sthitvā cāṇḍālāḥ śatajanmasu
mā dadasveti yo brūyādgavāngibrāhmaṇeṣu ca / śunāṃ yoniśataṃ gatvā cāṇḍāleṣūpajāyate
tato viṣṭhākṛtimiścaiva tato vyāghrastrijanmasu / tadante narakaṃ yāti yugānāmekaviṃśatim
paranindāparā ye ca ye ca niṣṭhurabhāṣiṇaḥ / dānānāṃ vinghakarttārasteṣāṃ pāpaphalaṃ śṛṇu
muśalolū khalābhyāṃ tu cūrṇyante taskarā bhṛśam / tadante tatpapāṣāṇagrahaṇaṃ vatsaratraghayam
tataśca kālasūtreṇa bhidyante satpa vatsarān / śocantaḥ svṛnikarmāṇi paradravyāpahārakāḥ
karmaṇā tatra pacyante narakāngiṣu santatam
parasvasūcakānāṃ ca narakaṃ śṛṇu dāruṇam / yāvadyugasahasraṃ tu tatpāyaḥ piṇḍabhakṣaṇam
saṃpīḍyate ca rasanā saṃdaṃśairbhṛśadāruṇaiḥ / nirucchvāsaṃ mahāghore kalpārddhaṃ nivasanti te
parastrīlolupānāṃ ca narakaṃ kathayāmi te / tatpatāmrastriyastena surupābharaṇairyutāḥ
yādṛśīstādṛśīstāśca ramante prasabhaṃ bahu / vidvavantaṃ bhayenāsāṃ gṛhṇanti prasabhaṃ ca tam
kathayantaśca tatkarma nayante narakānkramāt / anyaṃ bhajante bhūpāla patiṃ tyaktvā ca yāḥ striyaḥ
tatpāyaḥpuruśāstāstu tatpāyaḥśayanebalāt / pātayitvā ramante ca bahukālaṃ balānvitāḥ
tatastairyoṣito muktā hutāśanasamojjvalam / a yaḥ stambhaṃ samāśsiṣya tiṣṭhantyabdasahasrakam
tataḥ kṣārodakasnānaṃ kṣārodakaniṣevaṇam / tadante narakān sarvān bhuñjate 'bdaśataṃ śatam
yo hanti brāhmaṇaṃ gāṃ ca kṣatriyaṃ ca nṛpottamam / sa cāpi yātanāḥ sarvā bhuṅkte kalpeṣu pañcasu
yaḥ śṛṇoti mahannindāṃ sādaraṃ tatphalaṃ śṛṇu / teṣāṃ karṇeṣu dāpyante tatpāyaḥ kīlasaṃcayāḥ
tataśca teṣu chidreṣu tailamatyuṣṇamulbaṇam / pūryate ca tataścāpiṃ kumbhīpākaṃ prapadyate
nāstikānāṃ pravakṣyāmi vimukhānāṃ hare harau / abdānāṃ koṭiparyantaṃ lavaṇaṃ bhuñjate hi te
tataśca kalpaparyantaṃ raurave tatpasaikate / bhajyante pāpakarmaṇo 'nyepyevaṃ narādhipa
brāhmaṇanye nirīkṣante kopadṛṣṭyā narādhamāḥ / tatpasūcīsahasreṇa cakṣusteṣāṃ prasūryate
tataḥ kṣārāmbudhārābhiḥ secyante nṛpasattama / tataśca krakarcerghorairbhidyante pāpakarṃmaṇaḥ
viśvāsaghātināṃ caiva maryādābhedināṃ tathā / parānnalollupānāṃ ca narakaṃ śṛṇu dāruṇam
svamāṃsabhojino nityaṃ bhakṣamāṇāḥ śvabhistu te / narakeṣu samasteṣu pratyekaṃ hyabdavāsinaḥ
pratigraharatā ye ca ye vai nakṣatrapāṭhakāḥ / ye ca devalakānnānāṃ bhojinastāñśṛṇuṣva me
rājannākalpaparyantaṃ yātanāsvāsu duḥkhitāḥ / pacyante satataṃ pāpāviṣṭā bhogaratāḥ sadā
tatastailena pūryante kālasūtraprapīḍitāḥ / tataḥ kṣārodakasnānaṃ mūtraviṣṭāniṣevaṇam
tadante bhuvamāsādya bhavanti mlecchajātayaḥ / anyodvegaratā ye tu yānti vaitaraṇīṃ nadīm
tyaktapañcamahāyajñā lālābhakṣaṃ vrajanti hi / upāsanāparityāgī rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet
vipragrāmakarādānaṃ kurvatāṃ śṛṇu bhūpate / yātanāsvāsu pacyante vāvadācandratārakam
grāmeṣu bhūpālavaro yaḥ kuryādadhikaṃ karam / sa sahasrakulo bhuṅktenarakaṃ kalpapañcasu
vipragrāmakarādāne yo 'numantātu pāpakṛt / sa eva kṛtavān rājanbrahmahatyāsahasrakam
kālasūtre mahāghore sa vaseddicaturyugam / ayonau ca viyonau ca paśuyonau ca yo naraḥ
tyajedreto mahāpāpī saretobhojanaṃ labhet / vasākūpaṃ tataḥ prāpya sthitvā divyābdasatpakam
retobhojī bhavenmartyaḥ sarvalokeṣu ninditaḥ / upavāsadine rājandantadhāvanakṛnnaraḥ
sa ghoraṃ narakaṃ yātivyāghrapakṣaṃ caturyugam / yaḥ svakarmaparityāgī pāṣaṇḍītyucyate budhaiḥ
tatsaṃgakṛtamoghaḥ syāttāvubhāvatipāpinau / kalpakoṭisahasreṣu prānputo narakānkramāt
devadravyāpaharttāro gurudravyāpahārakāḥ / brahmahatyāvratasamaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ bhuñjate nṛpa
anāthadhanaharttāro hyanāthaṃ ye dviṣanti ca / kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi narake te vasanti ca
strīśūdrāṇāṃ samīpe tu ye vedādhyayane ratāḥ / teṣāṃ pāpaphalaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva susamāhitaḥ
adhaḥśīrṣordhvapādāśca kīlitāḥ stambhaghakadvaye / dhrūmrapānaratā nityaṃ tiṣṭhantyābrahmavatsaram
jale devālaye vāpi yastyajeddehajaṃ malam / bhrūṇahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ saṃprānpotyatidāruṇam
dantāsthikeśanakharānye tyajyantyamarālaye / jale vā bhuktaśeṣaṃ ca teṣāṃ pāpaphalaṃ śṛṇu
prāsaprotā halairbhinnā ārttarāvavirāviṇaḥ / atyuṣṇatailapāke 'titapyante bhṛśadāruṇe
kurvanti duḥkhasaṃtatpāstato 'nyeṣu vrajanti ca / brahmasaṃharate yastu gandhakāṣṭaṃ tathaiva ca
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ yāvadācandratārakam / brahmasvaharaṇaṃ rājannihāmātra ca duḥkhadam
ihasaṃpadvināśāyaparatranarakāya ca / kūṭasākṣyaṃvadedyastu tasya pāpaphalaṃśṛṇu
sa yāti yātanāḥ sarvā yāvadindrāścaturdaśa / ihaputrāśca vinaśyanti paraghatra ca
rauravaṃ narakaṃ bhuṅkte tato 'nyānapi ca kramāt / ye cātikāmino martyā ye ca mithyāpravādinaḥ
teṣāṃ sukhe jalaukā stu pūryyante pannagopamāḥ / evaṃ ṣaṣṭisahasrābde tataḥ kṣārāmbagusecanam
ye vṛthāmāṃsaniratatāste yānti kṣārakardamam / tato gajairnipātatyante marutprapatanaṃ yathā
tadante bhavamāsādya hīnāṅgāḥ prabhavanti ca / yastvṛtau nābhigaccheta svastriṃya manujeśvara
sa yāti rauravaṃ ghoraṃ brahmahakatyāṃ ca vindati / anyācārarataṃ dṛṣṭvā yaḥ śakto na nivārayet
tatpāpaṃ samavānpoti narakaṃ tāvubhāvapi / pāpināṃ pāpagaṇanāṃ kṛtvānyebhyo diśanti vindati
astitve tulyapāpāste mithyātve dviguṇā nṛpa / apāpe pātakaṃ yastu samaropya vinindati
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ yāvañcardrārkatārakam / pāpināṃ nindyamānānāṃ pāpārddhaṃ kṣayameti ca
yastu vratāni saṃgṛhya asamāpya parityajyet / so 'sipatre 'nubhūyārtiṃ hīnāṅgojāyate bhuvi
anyaiḥ saṃgṛhyamāṇānāṃvratānāṃ vinghakṛnnaraḥ / atīva duḥkhadaṃraudraṃ sa yāti śloṣmabhojanam
nyāye ca dharmaśikṣāyāṃ pakṣapātaṃ karoti yaḥ / na tasya niṣkṛtirbhūyaḥ prāyaścittāyutairapi
abhojyabhojī saṃprāpyaṃ viṅbhojyaṃ tu samāyutam / tataścaṇḍālayonau tu gomāṃsāśī sadā bhavet
avamānya dvijānvāgbhirbrahmahatyāṃ ca vindati / sarvāścayātanā bhuktvā cāṇḍālo daśajanmasu
vigrāya dīyamāne tu yastu vinghaṃ samācaret / brahmahatyāsamaṃ tena karttavyaṃ vratameva ca
apahṛtya paḥsyārthaṃ yaḥ parebhyaḥ prayacchati / apaharttā tu nirayī yasyārthastasya tatphalam
pratiśrutyāpradānena lālābhakṣaṃ vrajennaraḥ / yatinindāparo rājan śilānamātre prayāti hi
ārāmacchedino yānti yugānāmekaviṃśatim / śvabhojanaṃ tataḥ sarvā bhuñjate yātanāḥ kramāt
devatāgṛhabhettārastaḍāgānāṃ ca bhūpate / puṣpārāmabhidaścaiva yāṃ gatiṃ yānti tacchṛṇu
yātanāsvāsu sarvāsu pacyante vai pṛthak pṛthak / tataśca viṣṭākṛmayaḥ kalpānāmekaviṃśatim
tataścāṇḍālayonau tu śatajanmāni bhūpate / grāmavidhvaṃ sakānāṃ tu dāhakānāṃ ca lumpatām
mahatpāpaṃ tadādeṣṭuṃ na kṣamo 'haṃ nijāyuṣā / ucchiṣṭabhojino ye ca mitradrohaparāśva ye
eteṣāṃ yātanāstīvrā bhavantyācandratārakam / ucchinnapitṝdevejyā vendamārgabahiḥsthitāḥ
pāpānāṃ yātānānāṃ ca dharmāṇāṃ cāpi bhūpate / evaṃ bahuvidhā bhūpa yātanāḥ pāpakāriṇaṇām
teṣāṃ tāsāṃ ca saṃkhyānaṃ karttuṃ nāsamahaṃ prabho / pāpānāṃ yātanānāṃ ca dharmāṇāṃ cāpi bhūpate
saṃkhyāṃ nigadituṃ loke kaḥ kṣamo viṣṇunā vinā / eteṣāṃ sarvapāpānāṃ dharmaśāstravidhānataḥ
prāyaścitteṣu cīrṇeṣu pāparāśiḥ praṇaśyati / prāyaścittāni kāryāṇi samīpe kamalāpateḥ
nyūnātiriktakṛtyānāṃ saṃpūrtikaraṇāya ca / gaṅgā catulasī caiva satsaṅgo harikīrttanam
anasūyā hyahiṃsā ca sarvepyete hi pāpahāḥ / viṣṇvarpitāni karmāṇi saphalāni bhavanti hi
anarppitāni karmāṇi bhasmavinyastadravyavat / nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ yaccānyanmokṣamādhanam
viṣṇau samārpitaṃ sarvaṃ sāttvikaṃ saphalaṃ bhavet / haribhaktiḥ parā nṛṇāṃ sarvaṃ pāpaprāṇāśinī
sā bhaktidraśadhā jñeyā pāpāraṇyadavopamā / tāmasai rājasaiśvaiva sāttvikaiśca nṛpottama
yaccānyasya vināśārthaṃ bhajanaṃ śrīpaternṛpa / sā tāmasyadhamā bhaktiḥ khalabhāvadharā yataḥ
yor'cayetkaitavadhiyā svairiṇī svapatiṃ yathā / nārāyaṇaṃ jagannāthaṃ tāmasī madhyamā tu sā
devāpūjāparāndṛṣṭvā mātsaryādyor'cayeddhīram / sā bhaktiḥ pṛthivīpāla tāmasī cottamā smṛtā
dhanadhānyādikaṃ yastu prārthayannarcayedvarim / śraddhayā parayā yuktaḥ sā rājasyadhamā smṛtā
yaḥ sarvalokavikhyātakīrtimuddiśya mādhavam / arcayetparayā bhaktyā sā madhyā rājasī matā
sālokyādi padaṃ yastu samuddiśyārcayeddharim / sā rājasyuttamā bhaktiḥ kīrtitā pṛthivīpate
yastu svakṛtapāpānāṃ kṣayārthaṃ prārcayedvarim / śraddhayā parayopetaḥ sā sāttvikyadhamā smṛtā
hareridaṃ priyamiti śuśrūṣāṃ kurute tu yaḥ / śraddhayā saṃyuto bhūyaḥ sāttvikī madhyamā tu sā
vidhibuddhyārcayedyastu dāsavacchrīpatiṃ nṛpa / bhaktīnāṃ pravarā sā tu uttamā sāttvikī smṛtā
mahīmānaṃ hareryastu kiñcitkṛtvā priyo naraḥ / tanmayatvena saṃtuṣṭaḥ sā bhaktiruttamottamā
ahameva paro viṣṇurmayisarvamidaṃ jagat / iti yaḥ satataṃ paśyettaṃ vidyāduttamottamam
evaṃ daśavidhā bhaktiḥ saṃsāracchedakāriṇī / tatrāpi sāttvikī bhaktiḥ sarvakāmaphala pradā
tasmācchṛṇuṣva bhūpāla saṃsāravijigīṣathuṇā / svakarmaṇo virodhena bhaktiḥ kāryā janārdane
yaḥ svadharmaṃ parityajya bhaktimātreṇa jīvati / na tasya tuṣyate viṣṇurācāreṇaiva tuṣyate
sarvāgamānāmācāraḥ prathamaṃ parikalpate / ācāraprabhavo dharmo dharmasya prabhuracyutaḥ
tasmātkāryā harerbhaktiḥ svardhamasyāvirodhinī / sadācāravihīnānāṃ dharmā apyasukhapradāḥ
svadharmahīnā bhaktiśvāpyakṛtaiva prakīrtitā / yattu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā bhūyastatsarvaṃ gaditaṃ mayā
tasmāddharmaparo bhūtvā pūjayasva janārdanam / nārāyaṇamaṇīyāṃsaṃ sukhameṣyasi śāśvakatam
śiva eva hariḥ sākṣāddharireva śivaḥ svayam / dvayorantaradṛgyāti narakārankoṭiśaḥ khalaḥ
tasmādviṣṇuṃ śivaṃ vāpi samaṃ buddhā samarcaya / bhedakṛdduḥkhamāpnoti iha loke paratragha ca
yadarthamahamāyātastvatsamīpaṃ janādhipa / tatte vakṣyāmi sumate sāvadhānaṃ niśāmaya
ātmaghātakapāpmāno dagdhāḥ kapilakopataḥ / vasanti narake te tu rājaṃstava pitāmahāḥ
tānuddhara mahābhāga gaṅgānayanakarmaṇā / gaṅgā sarvāṇi pāpāni nāśayatyeva bhūpate
keśāsthinakhadandāśca bhasmāpira nṛpasattama / nayati viṣṇusadanaṃ spṛṣṭā gāṅgenara vāriṇā
yasyāsthi bhasma vā rājan gaṅgāyāṃ kṣipyate naraiḥ / sa sarvapāpanirmuktaḥ prayāti bhavanaṃ hareḥ
yāni kāni ca pāpāni proktāni tava bhūpate / tāni karmāṇira naśyanti gaṅgābindvabhiṣecanāt
sanaka uvāca ityuktvā muniśārdūla mahārājaṃ bhagīratham / dharmātmānaṃ dharmarājaḥ sadyaśvāntardadhetadā
sa tu rājā mahāprājñaḥ sarvaśāstrārthapāragāḥ / nikṣipya pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ saciveṣu yayau vanam
tuhinādrau tato gatvā naranārāyaṇāśramāt / paścime tuhinākrānte śṛṅgeṣoḍaśayojane
tapastaptvānayāmāsa gaṅgāṃ trailokyapāvanīm

iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde dharmākhyāne dharmarājopadeśena bhagīrathasya gaṅgānayanodyamavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ nārada uvāca himavadgirimāsādya kiṃ cakāra mahīpatiḥ / kathamānītavāngaṅgāmetanme vaktumarhasi
sanaka uvāca bhagīratho mahārājo jaṭācīradharo mune / gacchanhimādriṃ tapase prāpto godāvarī taṭam
tatrāpaśyanmahāraṇye bhṛgorāśramamuttamam / kṛṣṇasārasamākīrṇaṃ mātaṅgagaṇasevitam
bhramadbhūmarasaṃghuṣṭaṃ kūjadvihagasaṃkulam / vrajadvarāhanikaraṃ camarīpucchavīcitam
nṛtyanmayūranikaraṃ sāraṅgādiniṣevitam / pravarddhitamahāvṛkṣaṃ munikanyābhirādarāt
śālatālatamālāḍhyaṃ nūnahintālamaṇḍitam / mālatīyūthikākundacampakāśaavatthabhūṣitam
utpullakusumopeta mṛṣisaṅghaniṣevitam / vedaśāstramahāghoṣamāśramaṃ prāviśadbhugoḥ
gṛṇantaṃ parama brahma vṛttaṃ śiṣyagaṇairmunim / tejasā sūryasadṛśaṃ bhṛguṃ tatra dadarśa saḥ
praṇanāmātha viprendraṃ pādasaṃgrahaṇādinā / ātithyaṃ bhṛgurapyasya cakre sanmānapūrvakam
kṛtātithyakriyo rājā bhṛguṇā paramarṣiṇā / uvāca prāñjalirbhūtvā vinayānmunipuṅgavam
bhagīratha uvāca bhagavansarvadharmajña sarvaśāstraviśārada / pṛcchāmi bhavabhīto 'haṃ nṛṇāmuddhārakāraṇam
bhagavāṃstuṣyate yena karmaṇā munisattama / tanmamākhyāhi sarvajña anugrāhyo 'smi te yati
bhṛguruvāca rājaṃstavepsitaṃ jñātaṃ tvaṃ hi puṇyavatāṃ varaḥ / anyathā svakulaṃ sarvaṃ kathamuddharttumarhasi
yo vā ko vāpi bhūpāla svakulaṃ śubhakarmaṇā / uddharttakāmastaṃ vidyānnararupadharaṃ harim
karmaṇā yena deveśo nṛṇāmiṣṭaphalapradaḥ / tatpravakṣyāmi rājendra śṛṇuṣva susamāhitaḥ
bhava satyaparo rājanna hiṃsāniratastathā / sarvabhūtahito nityaṃ mānṛtaṃ vada vai kvacit
tyaja durjanasaṃsargaṃ bhaja sādhusamāgamam / kuru puṇyamahorātraṃ smara viṣṇuṃ sanātanam
kuru pūjāṃ mahāviṣṇoryāhi śānti manuttamām / dvādaśāṣṭākṣaraṃ mantraṃ jaya śreyo bhaviṣyati
bhagīrathā uvāca satyaṃ tu kīdṛśaṃ proktaṃ sarvabhūtahitaṃ mune / anṛtaṃ kīdṛśaṃ proktaṃ durjanāścāpi kīdṛśāḥ
sādhavaḥ kīdṛśāḥ proktāstathā puṇyaṃ ca kīdṛśam / smartavyaśca kathaṃ viṣṇustasya pūjā ca kīdṛśī
śāntiśca kīdṛśī proktā ko mantro 'ṣṭākṣaro mune / ko vā dvādaśavarṇaśca mune tattvārthakovida
kṛpāṃ kṛtvā mayi parāṃ sarvaṃ vyākhyātamarhasi / bhṛguruvāca sādhu sādhumahāprājña tava buddhiranuttamā
yatpṛṣṭo 'haṃ tvayā bhūpa tatsarvaṃ pravadāmi te / yathārthakathanaṃ yattatsatyamāhurvipaścitaḥ
dharmāvirodhato vācyaṃ taddhi dharmaparāyaṇaiḥ / deśakālādi vijñāya svayamasyāvirodhataḥ
yadvacaḥ procyate sadbhistastatyamabhidhīyate / sarveṣāmeva jantūnāmakleṣajananaṃ hi tat
ahiṃsā sā nṛpa proktā sarvakāmapradāyinī / karmakāryasahāyatvamakāryaparipanthitā
sarvalokahitatvaṃ vai procyate dharmakovidaiḥ / icchānuvṛttakathanaṃ dharmādharmavivekinaḥ
anṛtaṃ taddhi vijñeya sarvaśreyovirodhi tat / ye loke dveṣiṇo mūrkhāḥ kumārgaratabuddhayaḥ
te rājandurjjanā jñeyāḥ sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtāḥ / dharmādharmavivekena vedamārgānusāriṇaḥ
sarvalokahitāsaktāḥ sādhavaḥ parikīrttitāḥ / hari bhaktikaraṃ yattatsadbhiśca parirañcitam
ātmanaḥ prītijanakaṃ tatpuṇyaṃ parikīrttitam / sarvaṃ jagadidaṃ viṣṇurvaṣṇuḥ sarvasya kāraṇam
ahaṃ ca viṣṇuryajjñānaṃ tadviṣṇusma raṇaṃ viduḥ / sarvadevamayo viṣṇurvidhinā pūjayāmi tam
iti yā bhavati śraddhā sā tadbhaktiḥ prakīrtitāḥ / sarvabhūtamayo viṣṇuḥ paripūrṇaḥ sanātanaḥ
ityabhedena yā buddhiḥ samatā sā prakīrttitā / samatā śatrumitreṣu vaśitvaṃ ca tathā nṛpa
yadṛcchālābhasaṃtuṣṭiḥ sā śāntiḥ parikīrtitā / ete sarve samākhyātāstapaḥ siddhipradā nṛṇām
samastapāparāśīnāṃ tarasā nāśahetavaḥ / aṣṭākṣaraṃ mahāmantraṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam
vakṣyāmi tava rājendra puruṣārthaikasādhanam / viṣṇoḥ priyakaraṃ caiva sarvasiddhipradāyakam
namo nārāyaṇāyeti japetpraṇakpūrvakam / namo bhagavate procya vāsudevāya tatparam
praṇavādyaṃ mahārāja dvādaśārṇamudāhṛtam / dvayoḥ samaṃ phalaṃ rājannaṣṭadvādaśavarṇayoḥ
pravṛttau ca nivṛttau ca sāmyamuddiṣṭametayoḥ / śaṅkhacacakradharaṃ śāntaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam
lakṣmīsaṃśritavāmāṅkaṃ tathābhayakaraṃ prabhum / kirīṭakuṇḍaladharaṃ nānāmaṇḍanaśobhitam
bhrājatkaustubhamālāḍhyaṃ śrīvatsāṅkitavakṣasam / pītāmbaradharaṃ devaṃ surāsuranamaskṛtam
dhyāyedanādinidhanaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam / antaryāmī jñānarupī paripūrṇaḥ sanātanaḥ
etatsarvaṃ samākhyātaṃ yattu puṣṭaṃ tvayā nṛpa / svasti te 'stu tapaḥ siddhiṃ gaccha labdhuṃ yathāsukham
evamukto mahīpālo bhṛguṇā paramarṣiṇā / paramāṃ prītimāpannaḥ prapedetapase vanam
himavadgirimāsādya puṇyadeśe manohare / nādeśvare mahākṣetre tapastepe 'tiduścaram
rājā triṣavaṇasnāyī kandamūlaphalāśanaḥ / kṛtātithyarhaṇaścāpi nityaṃ homaparāyaṇaḥ
sarvabhūtahitaḥ śānto nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ / patraiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalaistoyaistrikālaṃ haripūjakaḥ
evaṃ bahutithaṃ kālaṃ nītvā cātyantadhairyavān / dhyāyannārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ śīrṇaparṇāśano 'bhavat
prāṇāyāmaparo bhūtvā rājā paramadhārmikaḥ / nirucchvāsa stapastaptuṃ tataḥ samupacakrame
dhyāyannārāyaṇaṃ devamanaṃ tamaparājitam / ṣaṣṭivarṣasahastāṇi nirucchvāsaparo 'bhavat
tasya nānmāpuṭādrājño vahnirjajñaṃ bhayaṅkaraḥ / taṃ dṛṣṭvā devatāḥ sarve vitrastā vahnitā pitāḥ
abhijagmurmahāviṣṇuṃ yatrāste jagatāṃ patiḥ / kṣīrodasyottaraṃ tīra saṃprāpya tridaśeśvarāḥ / astuvandevadeveśaṃ śaraṇāgatapālakam
devā ūcuḥ natāḥ sma viṣṇuṃ jagadekanāthaṃ smaratsamastārtiharaṃ pareśam / svabhāvaśuddhaṃ paripūrṇabhāvaṃ vadanti yajjñānatanuṃ ca tajjñāḥ
dhyeyaḥ sadā yogivarairmahātmā svecchāśarīraiḥ kutadevakāryaḥ / jagatsvarupo jagadādināthastasmai natāḥ smaḥ puruṣottamāya
yanannāmasaṃkīrttanato khalānāṃ samasta pāpāni layaṃ prayānti / tamīśamīḍyaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇaṃ natāḥ sma viṣṇuṃ puruṣāthasiddhyai
yattejasā bhānti divākarādyā nātikramaṃ tyasya kadāpi śikṣāḥ / kālātmakaṃ taṃ tridaśādhināthaṃ namāmahe vai puruṣārtharupam
jagatkaro 'tyabjabhavo 'tti rudraḥ punāti lokāñśrutibhiśca viprāḥ / tamādidevaṃ guṇasannidhānaṃ sarvopadeṣṭāramitāḥ śaraṇyam
varaṃ vareṇyaṃ madhukaiṭabhāriṃ surāsurābhyarcitapādapīṭham / // sadbhaktisaṃkalpitāsiddhihetuṃ jñānaikavedyaṃ praṇatāḥ sma devam
anādimadhyāntamajaṃ pareśamanādyavidyākhyatamovināśam / saccitparānandaghanasvarupaṃ rupādihīnaṃ praṇatāḥ sma devam
nārāyaṇaṃ viṣṇumanantamīśaṃ pītāmbaraṃ padmabhavādisevyam / yajñāpriyaṃ yajñakaraṃ viśuddhaṃ natāḥ sma sarvottamamavyayaṃ tam
iti stuto mahāviṣṇurdevairindrādibhistadā / caritaṃ tasya rājarṣerdevānāṃ saṃnyavedayat
tato devānsamāśvāsya dattvābhayamanañjanaḥ / jagāma yatra rājarṣistapastapati nārada
śaṅkhacakradharo devaḥ saccidānandavigrahaḥ / pratyakṣatāmagāttasya rājñaḥ sarvajagadguruḥ
taṃ duṣṭvā puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ bhābhāsitadigantaram / atisīpuṣpaṃsaṃkāśaṃ sphuratkuṇḍalamaṇḍitam
snigdha kuntalavakrābjaṃ vibhrājanmukuṭojjvalam / śrīvatsakaustumadharaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam
dīrghabāhumudārāṅgaṃ lokeśārcitapantkajam / nanāma daṇḍavadbhūmau bhūpatirnamrakandharaḥ
atyantaharṣasaṃpūrṇaḥ saromāñcaḥ sagadgadaḥ / kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇeti śrīkṛṣṇeti samuccaran
tasya viṣṇuḥ prasannātmā hyantaryāmī jagadguruḥ / uvāca kṛpayāviṣṭo bhagavānbhūtabhāvanaḥ
śrībhagavānuvāca bhagīratha mahābhāga tavābhīṣṭaṃ bhaviṣyati / āgamiṣyanti mallokaṃ tava pūrvapitāmahāḥ
mama mūrtyantaraṃ śambhuṃ rājanstotraiḥ svaśaktivaḥ / stuhi te sakalaṃ kāmaṃ savai sadyaḥ kariṣyanti
yastu jagrāha śaśinaṃ śūraṇaṃ samupāgatam / tasmādārādhayeśānaṃ stotraiḥ stutyaṃ sukhapradam
anādinidhano devaḥ sarvakāma phalapradaḥ / tvayā saṃpujito rājansadyaḥ śreyo vidhāsyati
ityuktvā devadeveśo jagatāṃ patiracyutaḥ / antardadhe muniśreṣṭha uttasthauso 'pi bhūpatiḥ
kimidaṃ smama āhosvitsatyaṃ sākṣādvijottam / bhūpatirvismayaṃ prātpaḥ kiṃ karomīti vismitaḥ
athāntarikṣe vāgujcaiḥ prāha taṃ bhrāntacetasam / satyametaditi vyaktaṃ na cintāṃ kartumarhasi
tanniśamyāvanīpāla īśānaṃ sarvakāraṇam / samastadevatārājamastauṣīdbhaktitatparaḥ
bhagīratha uvāca praṇamāmi jagannāthaṃ praṇatārtipraṇāśanam / pramāṇāgocaraṃ devamīśānaṃ praṇavātmakam
jagadrūpamajaṃ nityaṃ sargasthityantakāraṇam / viśvarupaṃ virupākṣa praṇato 'smyugraretasam
ādimadhyāntarahitamanantamajamavyayam / samāmananti yogīndrā staṃ vande puṣṭivardhanam
namo lokādhināthāpa vañcate parivañcate / namo 'stu nīlagrīvāya pasūnāṃ pataye namaḥ
namaḥ kapālahastāya pāśapataye namaḥ / namo 'kalpaprakalpāya bhūtānāṃ pataye namaḥ
namaḥ pinākahastāya śūlahastāya te namaḥ / namaḥ kapālahastāya pāśamudgaradhāriṇe
namaste sarvabhūtāya ghaṇṭāhastāya te namaḥ / namaḥ pañcāsyadevāya kṣetrāṇāṃ pataye namaḥ
namaḥ samastabhūtānāmādibhṛtāya bhūbhṛte / anekaruparupāya nirguṇāya parātmane
namo daṇādhidevāya gaṇānāṃ pataye namaḥ / namo hiraṇyagarbhāya hiraṇyapataye namaḥ
hiraṇyaretase tubhyaṃnamo hiraṇyabāhave / namo dhyānasvarupāya namaste dhyānasākṣiṇe
namaste dhyānasaṃsthāya dhyānagamyāya te namaḥ / yenedaṃ viśvamakhilaṃ carācaravirājitam
varṣevābhreṇa janitaṃ pradhānapuruṣātmanā
svaprakāśaṃ mahātmānaṃ paraṃ jyotiḥ sanātanam / yamāmananti tattvajñāḥ savitāraṃ nṛcakṣuṣām
umākāntanandikeśantaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ sadāśivam / mṛtyuñjayaṃ mahādevaṃ parātparataraṃ vibhum
paraṃ śabdabrahmarupaṃ taṃ vande 'khilakāraṇam / kaparddine namastubhyaṃ sadyo jātāya vai namaḥ
bhavodbhavāya śuddhāya jyeṣṭhāya ca kanīyase / manyave ta iṣe traghayyāḥ pataye yajñatantave
ūrje diśāṃ ca pataye kālāyāghorarupiṇe / kṛśānuretase tubhyaṃ namo 'stu sumāhātmane
yataḥ samudrāḥ sarito 'drayaśca gandharvayakṣāsurasiddhasaṅghāḥ / sthāṇu ścariṣṇurmahadalpakaṃ ca asañca sajjīvamajīmāsa
nato 'smi taṃ yoginatāṅghripadmaṃ sarvāntarātmānamarupamīśam / svatantramekaṃ guṇunāṃ guṇaṃ ca namāmi bhūyaḥ praṇamāmi bhūyaḥ
itthaṃ stuto mahādevaḥ śaṅkaro lokaśaṅkaraḥ / āvirbabhūva bhṛpasya saṃtatpatapasogrataḥ
pañcavakraṃ daśabhujaṃ candrārdhdakṛtaśaekharam / trilocanamudārāṅgaṃ nāgayajñopavītinam
viśālavakṣasaṃ devaṃ tuhinādrisamaprabham / gajacarmāmbaradharaṃ surārcitapadāmbujam
dṛṣṭvā papāta pādāgre daṇḍavadbhuvi nārada / tata utthāya sahasā śivāgre vihitāñjaliḥ
praṇanāma mahādevaṃ kīrtayañśaṅkarāhvayam / vijñāya bhaktiṃ bhūpasya śaṅkaraḥ śaśiśekharaḥ
uvāca rājñe tuṣṭo 'smi varaṃ varaya vāñchitam / toṣito 'smi tvayā samyak stotreṇa tapasā tathā
evamuktaḥ sa devena rājā saṃtuṣṭamānasaḥ / uvāca prāñjalirbhūtvā jagatāmīśvareśvareśvaram
bhagīratha uvāca anugrāhyo 'smi yadi te varadānānmaheśvara / tadā gaṅgāṃ prayacchāsmatpitṝṇāṃ muktihetave
śrīśiva uvāca dattā gaṅgā mayā tubhyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ te gatiḥ parā / tubhyaṃ mokṣaṃ paraśceti tamuktvāntardadhe śivaḥ
parardino jaṭāstrastā gaṅgā lokaikapāvirnī / pāvayantī jagatsarvamanvagacchadbhagīratham
tataḥ prabhṛti sā devī nirmalā malahāriṇī / bhāgīrathīti vikhyātā triṣu lokeṣvabhūnmune
sagarasyātmajāḥ pūrvaṃ yatra dagdhāḥ svapāpmanā / taṃ deśaṃ plāvayāmāsa gaṅgā sarvasaridvarā
yadā saṃplāvitaṃ bhasma sāgarāṇāṃ tu gaṅgāyā / tadaiva narake magnā uddhṛtāśca gatainasaḥ
purā saṃkruśyamānena ye yamenātipūḍitāḥ / ta eva pūcitāstena gaṅgājalapariplutāḥ
gatapāpānya vijñāya yamaḥ sagarasaṃbhavān / praṇamyābhyarcya vidhivatprāha tānprītamānasaḥ
bho bho rājasutā yūyaṃ narakād bhṛśadāruṇāt / muktā vimānamāruhya gacchadhvaṃ viṣṇumandiram
ityuktāste mahātmāno yamena gatakalmaṣāḥ / divyadehadharā bhūtvā viṣṇulokaṃ prapedire
evaṃprabhāvā sā gaṅgā viṣṇupādāgrasaṃbhavā / sarvalokeṣu vikhyātā mahāpātakanāśinī
ya idaṃ puṇyamākhyānaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam / paṭhecca śṛṇuyādvāpi gaṅgāsnānaphalaṃ labhet
yastve tatpuṇyamākhyānaṃ kathayedrvāhyaṇāgrataḥ / sa yāti viṣṇubhavanaṃ punarāvṛttivarjitam

iti śrūbṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde gaṅgāmāhātmye bhagīrathagaṅgānayanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaṣo 'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ sādhu sūta mahābhāga tvayātikaruṇātmanā / śrāvitaṃ sarvapāpanghaṃ gaṅgāmāhātmya muttamam
śrutvā tu gaṅgāmāhātmyaṃ nārado devadarśanaḥ / kiṃ papraccha punaḥ sūta sanakaṃ munisattamam
sūta uvāca śṛṇudhvamṛṣayaḥ sarve nāradena surarṣiṇā / pṛṣṭaṃ punaryathā prāha pravakṣyāmi tathaiva tat
nānākhyānetihāsāḍyaṃ gaṅgāmāhātmyamuttamam / śrutvā brahmasuto bhūyaḥ pṛṣṭavānidamādarāt
nārada uvāca aho 'tidhanyaṃ sukṛtaikasāraṃ śrutaṃ mayā puṇyamasaṃvṛtārtham / gāṅgeyamāhātmyamaghapraṇāśi tvatto mune kāruṇikādabhīṣṭam
ye sādhavaḥ sādhu bhajanti viṣṇuṃ svārthaṃ parārthaṃ ca yatanta eva / nānopadeśaiḥ suvimugdhacittaṃ prabodhayanti prasabhaṃ prasannam
tataḥ samākhyāhi harervratāni kṛtaiśca yaiḥ prītimupaiti viṣṇuḥ / dadāti bhaktiṃ bhajatāṃ dayālurmuktistu tasyā viditā hi dāsī
dadāti muktiṃ bhajatāṃ mukundo vratārcanadhyānaparāyaṇānām / bhaktānusevāsu mahāprayāsaṃ vimṛśya kasyāpi na bhaktiyogam
pravṛttaṃ ca nivṛttaṃ ca yatkarma harito ṣaṇam / tadā khyāhi muniśreṣṭha viṣṇubhakto 'si mānada
sanaka uvāca sādhu sādhu muniśreṣṭha bhaktastvaṃ puruṣottameḥ / bhūyo bhūyo yataḥ puccheścaritraṃ śārṅgadhanvanaḥ
vratāni te pravakṣyāmi lokopakṛtimanti ca / prasīdati hariryaistu prayacchatyabhayaṃ tathā
yasya prasanno bhagavānyajñaliṅgo janārdanaḥ / ihāmutra sukhaṃ tasya tapovṛddhiśca jāyate
yena kenāpyupāyena haripūjāparāyaṇāḥ / prayānti paramaṃ sthānamiti prāhurmaharṣayaḥ
mārga śīrṣe site pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ jalaśāyinam / upoṣito 'ḍarcayetsamyaṅ naraḥ śraddhāsamanvitaḥ
snātvā śuklāmbaradharo dantadhāvanapūrvakam / gandhapuṣpākṣatairdhūpair dīpairnaivedyapūrvakaiḥ
vāgyato bhaktibhāvena muniśreṣṭhārcayeddharim / keśavāya namastubhyamiti viṣṇuṃ ca pūjayet
aṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā vanhau ghṛtatilāhutīḥ / rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryācchālagrāmasamīpataḥ
snāpayetprasthapayasā nārāyaṇamanāmayam / gītairvādyaiśca naivedyairbhakṣyairbhojyaiśca keśavam
trikālaṃ pūjayedbhaktyā mahālakṣmyā samanvitam / punaḥ kalye samutthāya kṛtvā karma yathocitam
pūrvavatpūjayedvevaṃ vāgyato niyataḥ śuciḥ / pāyasaṃ ghṛtasaṃmiśraṃ nālikeraphalānvitam
mantreṇānena viprāya dadyādbhaktyā sadakṣiṇam / keśavaḥ keśihā devaḥ sarvasaṃpatpradāyakaḥ
paramānnapradānena mama syādiṣṭadāyakaḥ / brahmaṇānbhojayetpaścācchaktito bandhubhiḥ saha
nārāyaṇa paro bhūtvā svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ / iti yaḥ kurute bhaktyā keśavārcanamuttamam
sa paiṇḍarīkayajñasya phalamaṣṭaguṇaṃ labhet / pauṣamāse site pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ samupoṣitaḥ
namo nārāyaṇāyeti pūjayetprayato harim / payasā snāpya naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ ca samarpayet
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryātrrikālārcanatatparaḥ / dhūpairdīpaiśca naivedyairgandhaiḥ puṣpairmanoramaiḥ
tṛṇaiśca gītavādyādyaiḥ stotraiścāpyaryayeddharim / kṛśarānnaṃ ca viprāya dadyātsaghṛtadakṣiṇam
sarvātmā sarvalokeśaḥ sarvavyāpī sanātanaḥ / nārāyaṇaḥ prasannaḥ syātkṛśarānnapradānataḥ
mantreṇānena viprāya dattvā vai dānamuttamam / dvijāṃśca bhojeyacchaktyā svayamadyātsabāndhavaḥ
evaṃ saṃpūjayedbhaktyā devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum / agniṣṭomāṣṭakaphalaṃ sa saṃpūrṇamavāpnuyāt
māghasya śukladvādaśyāṃ pūrvavatsamupoṣitaḥ / namaste mādhavāyeti hutvāṣṭau ca ghṛtāhutīḥ
pūrvamānena payasā snāpayenmādhavaṃ tadā / puṣpagandhākṣatairarcetsāvadhānena cetasā
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryātpūrvavadbhaghaktisaṃyutaḥ / kalyakarma ca nirvartya mādhavaṃ punararcayet
prasthaṃ tilānāṃ viprāya dadyādvai mantrapūrvakam / sadakṣiṇaṃ savāstrañca sarvapāpavimuktaye
mādhavaḥ sarvabhūtātmā sarvakarmaphalapradaḥ / tiladānena mahatā sarvānkāmānprayacchatu
mantreṇānena viprāya dattvā bhaktisamanvitaḥ / brahmaṇānbhojayecchaktyā saṃsmaranmādhavaṃ prabhum
evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā tiladāne vrataṃ mune / vājapeya śatasyāsau saṃpūrṇaṃ phalamāpnuyāt
phaālgunasya site pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ samupoṣitaḥ / govindāya namastubhyamiti saṃpūjayedvratī
aṣṭottagaraśataṃ dṛtvā ghṛtamiśratilāhutīḥ / pūrvamānena payasā govindaṃ snāpayecchuciḥ
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryātrrikālaṃ pūjayaittathā / prātaḥ kṛtyaṃ samāpyātha govindaṃ pūjayetpunaḥ
vrīhyāḍhakaṃ ca viprāya dadyādvastraṃ sadakṣiṇam / namo govinda sarveśa gopikājanavallabha
anena dhānya dānena prīto bhava jagadguro / evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ samyak sarvapāpavivarjitaḥ
gomedhamakhajaṃ puṇyaṃ sampūrṇaṃ labhate naraḥ / caitramāse site pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ samupoṣitaḥ
namo 'stu viṣṇave tubhyamiti pūrvavadarcayet / kṣīreṇa snāpayedviṣṇuṃ pūrvamānena śaktitaḥ
tathaiva snāpayedvipra ghṛtaprasthena sādanam / kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ rātrau pūjayetpūrvavadrūtī
tatakaḥ kalye samutthāya prātaḥ kṛtyaṃ samāpya ca / aṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā madhaavājyatilamiśritam
sadakṣiṇaṃ ca viprāya dadyādvai taṇḍulāḍhakam / prāṇarupī mahāviṣṇuḥ prāṇadaḥ sarvavallabhaḥ
taṇḍulāḍhakadānena prīyatāṃ me janārdanaḥ / evaṃ kṛtvā naro bhaktyā sarvapāpavivarjitaḥ
atyangiṣṭomayajñasya phalamaṣṭaguṇaṃ labhet / vaiśākhaśukladvādaśyāmupoṣya madhusūdanam
droṇakṣīreṇa deveśaṃ snāpayedbhaktiṃsaṃyutaḥ / jāgaraṃ tatragha karttavyaṃ trikālārcanasaṃyutam
namaste madhuhantre ca juhuyācchaktito ghṛtam / aṣṭottaraśataṃ prorcya vidhivanmadhusūdanam
vipāpo hyaśvamedhānāmaṣṭānāṃ phalamānpuyāt / jyeṣṭamāse site pakṣe dvādaśyāmupavāsakṛt
kṣīreṇāḍhakamānena snāpayedyastriviktamam / namastriviktamāyeti pūjayedbhaktisaṃyutaḥ
juhuyātpāyasenaiva hyaṣṭottaraśatāhutīḥ / kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ rātrau punaḥ pūjāṃ prakalpayet
apūpaviṃśatiṃ dattvā brāhmaṇāya sadakṣiṇam / devadeva jagannāta prasīda parameśvara
upāyanaṃ ca saṃgṛhya mamābhīṣṭaprado bhava / brāhmaṇānbhojayecchaktyā svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ
evaṃ yaḥ kurute vipra vrataṃ traivikramaṃ param / so 'ṣṭānāṃ naramedhānāṃ vipāpaḥ phalamānpuyāt
āṣāḍhaśukladvādaśyāmupavāsī jitendriyaḥ / vāmanaṃ pūrvamānena snāpayetpayasā vratī
namaste vāmanāyeti dūrvājyāṣṭottaraṃ śatam / hutvā ca jāgaraṃ kuryādvāmanaṃ cārcayetpunaḥ
sadākṣiṇaṃ ca dadhyannaṃ nālikeraphalānvitam / bhaktyā pradadyādviprāya vāmanārcanaśīline
vāmano vuddhido hotā dravyastho vāmanaḥ sadā / vāmanastārako 'smācca vāmanāya namo namaḥ
anena dattvā dadhyannaṃ śaktito bhojayeddijān / kṛtvai vamagriṣṭomānāṃ śatasya phalamāpnuyāt
śrāvaṇasya site pakṣe dvādaśyāmupavāsakṛt / kṣīreṇa madhumiśreṇa snāpayecchrīdharaṃ vratī
namo 'stu śrīdharāyeti gandhādyaiḥ pūjayetkramāt / juhuyātpṛṣadājyena śatamaṣṭottaraṃ mune
kṛtvā ca jāgaraṃ rātrau punaḥ pūjāṃ prakalpayet / dātavyaṃ caiva viprāya kṣīrāḍhakamanuttamam
dakṣiṇāṃ ca savastrāṃ vai pradadyāddhemakuṇḍale / mantreṇānena viprendru sarvakāmāśrasiddhaye
kṣīrābdhiśāyindeveśa ramākānta jagatpate / kṣīradānena suprīto bhava sarvasukhapradaḥ
sukhapradattvādviprāṃśca bhojayecchaktito vratī / eva kṛtvā śvamedhānāṃ sahasrasya phalaṃ labhet
māsi bhādrapade śukle dvādaśyāṃ samupoṣitaḥ / snāpayeddroṇapayasā hṛṣīkeśaṃ jagadgurum
hṛṣīkeśa namastubhyamiti saṃpūjayennaraḥ / caruṇā madhuyuktena śatamaṣṭottaraṃ hunet
jāgarādīnini nirvartya dadyādātmavide tataḥ / sārdhāḍhakaṃ ca godhūmāndakṣiṇāṃ hema śaktitaḥ
hṛṣīkeśa namastubhyaṃ sarvalokaikahetave / mahyaṃ sarvasukhaṃ dehi godhūmasya pradānataḥ
bhojayedvrāhmāñśaktyā svayaṃ cāśrītavāgyataḥ / sarvapāpavinirmukto brahmamedhaphalaṃ labhet
āśvine māsiśuklāyāṃ dvādaśyāṃsamupoṣitaḥ / padmanābhaṃ capayasā snāpayedbhaktitaḥ śuciḥ
namaste padmanābhāya homaṃ kuyārtsvaśaktitaḥ / tilabrīhiyavājyaiśca pūjayecca vidhānataḥ
jāmaraṃ niśi nirvartya punaḥ pūjāṃ samācaret / dadyādviprāya kuḍavaṃ madhunastu sadakṣiṇam
padmanābhagha namastubhyaṃ sarvalokapitāmaha / madhudānena suprīto bhavasarvasukhapradaḥ
evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā padmanābhavrataṃ sudhīḥ / brahmamedhasahasrasya phalamānpoti niścitam
dvādaśyāṃ kārtike śukle upavāsī jitendriyaḥ / kṣīreṇākaḍhakamānena dandhā vājyena tāvatā
namo dāmodarāyeti snāpayedbhaktibhāvataḥ / aṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā maghvājyāktatilāhutīḥ
jāgaraṃ niyataḥ kuryāttrikālārcanatatparaḥ / prātaḥ saṃpūjayeddevaṃ padmapuṣpairmanoramaiḥ
punaraṣṭottaraśataṃ juhuyātsaghṛtai stilaiḥ / pañcabhakṣyayutaṃ cānnaṃ dadyādviprāya bhaktitaḥ
dāmodara jagannātha sarvakāraṇakāraṇa / trāhimāṃ kṛpayā deva śāraṇāgatapālakaḥ
anena dattvā dānaṃ ca śrotriyāya kuṭumbine / dakṣiṇāñca yathāśaktyā brāhmaṇāṃśvāpi bhojayet
evaṅkṛtvā vrataṃ samyagaśrīyādvūndhubhiḥ saha / aśvamegha sahasrāṇāṃ dviguṇaṃ phalamaśnute
evaṃ kuryādvratī yastu dvādaśīvratamuttamam / saṃvatsaraṃ muniśreṣṭha sa yāti parama padam
