ekamāse dvimāse vāyaḥ kuryādbhaktitatparaḥ / tattatphalamavānpoti prānpoti ca hareḥ padam
pūrṇaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā kuryādudyāpanaṃ vratī / mārgaśīrṣāsite pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ ca munīśvara
snātvā prātaryathācāraṃ dantadhāvanapūrvakam / śuklamālyāmbaradharaḥ śuklagandhānulepanaḥ
maṇḍapaṃ kārayeddivyaṃ caturastraṃ suśībhanam / ghaṇṭācāmarasaṃyuktaṃ kiṅkiṇīravaśobhitam
alaṅkṛtaṃ puṣpamālyairvitānaghvajarājitān / chāditaṃ śuklavastreṇa dīpamālāvibhūṣitam
tanmadhye sarvatobhadraṃ kuryātsamyagalaṅkṛtam / tasyoparinyasetkumbhāndvādaśāmbuprapūritān
ekena śulkavanastreṇa samyaksaṃśodhitena ca / sarvānācchādayetkumbhānpañcaratnasamanvitān
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ kārayedbhaktimānvratī / henmā vā rājatenāpi tathā tāmreṇa vā dvijā
sthāpayetpratimāṃ tāṃ ca kumbhopari susaṃyamī / tanmūlyaṃ vā dvijaśreṣṭha kāñcanaṃ ca svaśaktitaḥ
sarvavrateṣu matimānvittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarja yet / yadi kuryātkṣayaṃ yānti tasyāyurddhanasaṃpadaḥ
anantaśāyinaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayaṭam / pañcāmṛtena prathamaṃ snāpayedbhaktisaṃyutaḥ
nāṃmabhiḥ keśavādyaiśca hyupacārānmakalpayet / rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryātpurāṇaśravaṇādibhaghiḥ
jitanidro bhavetsamyaksopavāso jitendriyaḥ / trikālamarcayeddevaṃ yathāvibhavavistaram
tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya prātaḥ kṛtyaṃ samāpya ca / tilahomānvyāhṛtibhiḥ sahasraṃra kāvyeddvijaiḥ
tataḥ saṃpūjayeddevaṃ gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt / devasya purataḥ kuryātpurāṇaśravaṇaṃ tataḥ
dadyāddvādaśaviprebhyo dadhyannaṃ pāyasaṃ pāyasaṃ tathā / apūpairdaśa bhiryuktaṃ saghṛtaṃ ca sadakṣiṇam
devadevajagannātha bhaktānugrahavigraha / gṛhāṇopāyanaṃ kṛṣṇa sarvābhīṣṭaprado bhava
anenopāyanaṃ dattvā prārthaye māñjaliḥ sthitaḥ / ādhāya jānunī bhūmau vinayāvananato vratī
namo namaste surarājarāja namo 'stute devaṃ jagannivāsa / kuruṣva saṃpṛrṇaphalaṃ mamādya namo 'stu tubhyaṃ puruṣottamāya
iti saṃprārthayedviprāndevaṃ ca puruṣottamam / dadyādarghyaṃ ca devāya mahālakṣmīyutāya vai
lakṣmīpate namastubhyaṃ kṣīrārṇavanivāsine / arghyaṃ gṛhāṇa deveśa lakṣmyā ca sahitaḥ prakṣo
yasya smṛtyā ca nāmoktyā tapoyajñakriyādiṣu / nyūnaṃ saṃpūrṇatāṃ yāti sadyo vande tamacyutam
iti vijñāpya deveśaṃ tatsarvaṃ saṃyamī vrate / pratimāṃ dakṣiṇāyuktāmācāryāya nivedayet
brāhmaṇānbhojayetpaścīcchaktyā dadyāja dakṣiṇām / bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ paścātsvayaṃ bevṛjanairvṛtaḥ
āsāyaṃ śṛduyādviṣṇoḥ kathāṃ vidvajjanaiḥ saha / ityevaṃ kurute yastu manujo dvādaśīvratam
sarvānkāmānsa ānpoti paraghatreha ca nārada / trisatakulasaṃyuktaḥ sarvapāpavivarjitaḥ / tapāti viṣṇubhavanaṃ yatra yattvā na śocati
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyādvipra dvādaśīvratamuttamam / vācayedvāpi sa naro vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet

iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde vratākhyāne mārgaśīrṣaśukladvādaśīvratakathanaṃ nāma satpadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ sanaka uvāca anyadvratavaraṃ vakṣya śṛṇuṣva munisattama / sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvaduḥkhanibarhaṇam
brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ yoṣitāṃ tathā / samastakāmaphaladaṃ sarvavratamyaphalapradam
duḥsvanpanāśane dharmyaṃ duṣṭagrahanivāraṇam / sarvalokeṣu vikhyātaṃ pūrṇimāvratamam / yena cīrṇena pāpānāṃ rāśikoṭiḥra praśāmyati
mārgaśīrṣe sitepakṣe pūrṇāyāṃ niyataḥ śuciḥ / snānaṃ kuryādyathācāraṃ dantadhāvanapūrvakam
śuklāmbaradharaḥ śuddho gṛhamāgagatya vāgyataḥ / prakṣālya pādāvācamya smaratrārāyaṇaṃ prabhum
nityaṃ devārcanaṃ kṛtvā paśvātsaṃkalpapūrvakam / lakṣmī nārāyaṇaṃ devamarcayedbhaktibhāvataḥ
āvāhanāsanādyaiśca gandhapuṣpādibhirvratī / namo nārāyaṇāyeti pūjayedbhaktitatparaḥ
gītairvādyaiśca nṛtyaiśca purāṇapaṭhanādibhiḥ / stotrairvārādhayeddevaṃ vratakṛtsusamāhitaḥ
devasya purataḥ kṛtvā sthaṇḍilaṃ caturastrakam / aratnimātraṃ tatrāngiṃ sthāpayedgṛhyamārgataḥ / ājyabhāgāntarpayantaṃ kṛtvā puruṣasūktataḥ / caraṇā ca tilaiśvāpi ghṛtena juhuyāttathā
ekavāraṃ dvivāraṃ vātrivāraṃ vāpi śaktitaḥ / homaṃ kuryātprayatnena sarvapāpanivṛttaye
prāyaścittā dikaṃ sarvaṃ svagṛhyoktavidhānataḥ / samāpya homaṃ vidhivacchāntisūktaṃ japedrudhaḥ
paścāddevaṃ samāgatya punaḥ pūjāṃ prakalpayet / tathopavāsaṃ devāya hyarpayedbhaktisaṃyutaḥ
paurṇamāsyāṃ nirāhāraḥ sthitvā deva tavājñayā / bhokṣyāmi puṇḍarīkākṣa pare 'hli śaraṇaṃ bhava
iti vijñāpya devāyahyarghyaṃ dadyāttathaindave / jānubhyāmavanīṃ gagatvā śuklapuṣpākṣatānvitaḥ
kṣīrodārṇavasaṃbhūta aghatrigotrasamudbhaghava / grahāṇārghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ rohiṇīnāyaka prabho / evamarghyaṃ pradāyendoḥ prārthayetprāñjalistataḥ
tiṣṭanpūrvamukho bhūtvā paśyanninduṃ ca nārada
namaḥ śuklāṃśave tubhyaṃ dvijarājāya te namaḥ / rohiṇīpataye tubhyaṃ lakṣmībhrātre namo 'stu te
tataśca jāgaraṃ kuryātpurāṇaśravaṇādibhiḥ / jitendriyaśca saṃśuddhaḥ pāṣaṇḍālokavarjitaḥ
tataḥ prātaḥ prakurvīta svācāraṃ ca yathāvidhi / punaḥ saṃpūjayeddevaṃ yathāvibhavavistaram
brāhmaṇānbhojayecchaktyā tataśca prayato naraḥ / bandhubhṛtyādibhiḥ sārdhaṃ svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ
evaṃ pauṣādimāseṣu pūrṇamāsyāmupoṣitaḥ / arcayedbhaktisaṃyukto nārāyaṇamanāyamam
evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā kārtikyāṃ pūrṇimādine / udyāpanaṃ prakurvīta tadvidhānaṃ vadāmi te
maṇḍapaṃ kārayeddivyaṃ caturastraṃ sumaṅgalam / śobhitaṃ puṣpamālābhirvitānadhvajarājitam
bahudāpasamākīrṇaṃ kiṅkiṇījālaśobhitam / darpaṃṇaiścāmaraiścaiva kalaśaiśca samāvṛtam
tanmadhye sarvatobhadraṃ pañcavarṇavirājitam / jalapūrṇaṃ tataḥ kumbhaṃ nyasettasyopari dvija
pidhāya kumbhaṃ vastreṇa susūkṣmeṇāti śobhitam / henmā vā rajatenāpi tathā tānmeṇa vā dvija / lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ kṛtvā tasyopari nyaset
pañcāmṛtena saṃsnāpyābhyarcyagandhādibhiḥ kramāt / bhakṣmairbhojyādinaivedyairbhaktitaḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ
jāgaraṃ ca tathā kuryārtsamyakchraraddhāsamanvitaḥ / pare 'hni prātarvidhiva tpūrvavadviṣṇumarcayet
ācāryāya pradātavyā pratimā dakṣaghiṇānvitā / brāhmaṇānbhojayecchaktyā vibhave satyavāritam
tiladānaṃ prakurvīta yathāśaktyā samāhitaḥ / kuryādrangau ca vidhivatilahomaṃ vicakṣiṇaḥ
evaṃ kṛtvā naraḥ samyak lakṣmīnārāyaṇavratam / iha bhuktvā mahābhogānputraghapautraghasamanvitaḥ
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ kulāyutasamanvitaḥ / prayāti viṣṇubhavanaṃ yogināmapi durlabham

iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde vratākhyāne māgaśīrṣapaurṇimāyāṃ lakṣaghmīnārāyaṇavrataṃ nāmāṣṭādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ sanaka uvāca anyadvūtaṃ pravakṣyāmi dhvajāropaṇasaṃjñitam / sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ viṣṇuprīṇanakāraṇam
yaḥ kuryādviṣṇubhavane dhvajāropaṇamuttamam / saṃpūjyate vigniñcyādyaiḥ kimanyairbahubhāṣitaiḥ
hemabhārasahasraṃ tu yo dadāti kuṭumbine / tatphalaṃ tulyamātraṃ syāddhūjāropaṇakarmaṇaḥ
dhvajāropaṇatulyaṃ syādgaṅgāsnānamanuttamam / athavā tulasūsevā śivaliṅgaprapūjanam
aho 'pūrvamaho 'pūrvamaho 'pūrvamidaṃ dvija / sarvapāpa haraṃ karma dhvajāgopaṇasaṃjñitam
santi vai yāni kāryāṇi dhvajāropaṇakarmaṇi / tāni sarvāṇi vakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva gadato mama
kārtikasya site pakṣaghe daśamyāṃ prayato naraḥ / snānaṃ kuryātprayatnena dantadhāvanapūrvakam
ekāśī brahmacārī ca svapennārāyaṇaṃ smaran / dhautāmbaradharaḥ śuddho vipro nārāyaṇāgrataḥ
tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya snātvācamya yathāvidhi / nityakarmāṇi nirvartya paścādviṣṇuṃ samarcayet
caturbhirbrāhmaṇaiḥ sārdhdaṃ kṛtvā ca svastivācanam / nāndīśrāddhaṃ prakurvīta dhvajāropaṇakarmaṇi
dhvajastambho ca gāyatryā prokṣaghayedvastrasaṃyutau / sūryaṃ ca vainateyaṃ ca himāṃśuṃ tatparor'cayet
dhātāraṃ ca vidhātāraṃ pūjayeddhajadaṇḍake / haridrākṣaghatagandhādyaiḥ śuklapuṣpairviśeṣataḥ
tato gocarmamātraghaṃ tu sthaṇḍilaṃ copalipya vai / ādhāyāngiṃ svagṛhyottyā hyājyabhāgādikaṃ kramāt
juhuyātpāyasaṃ caiva sājyamaṣṭottaraṃ śatam / prathamaṃ pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ viṣṇornukamirāvatīm
tataśca vainateyāya svāhe tyaṣṭāhutīstathā / somo dhenumudutyaṃ ca juhuyācca tato dvija
sauramantrāñjapettaghatra śāntisūtkāni śaktitaḥ / rātraghau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryādupakaṇṭhaṃ hareḥ śucuḥ
tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya nityakarma samāpya ca / gandhapuṣpādibhirdevamarcayetpūrvavatkramāt
tato maṅgalavādyaiśca sūktapāṭhaiśca śaubhanam / nṛtyaiśca ratotraghapaṭhanairnayedviṣṇavālaye dhvajam
devasya dvāradeśe vā śikhare vā mudānvitaḥ / susthuraḥ sthāpayedvipra dhvajaṃ sastambhasaṃyutam
gandhapuṣpāghakṣatairddevaṃ dhūpadīparmanoharaiḥ / bhakṣaghyabhojyādisaṃyuktairnaivedyaiśca hariṃ yajet
evaṃ devālaye sthāpya śobhanaṃ dhvajamuttamam / pradakṣaghiṇamanuvrajya stotraghametadudūrayet
namaste puṇḍarīkākṣa namaste viśvabhāvana / namaste 'stu hṛṣīkeśa mahāpuruṣa pūrvaja
yenedamakhilaṃ jātaṃ yatra sarvaṃ pratiṣṭitam / layameṣyati yatraivaṃ taṃ prapanno 'smi keśavam
na jānanti paraṃ bhāvaṃ yasya brahmādayaḥ surāḥ / yoginoyaṃ na paśyanti taṃ vandaṃ jñānarupuṇam
antarikṣantu yannābhirdyairmūrddhā yasya caiva hi / pādo 'bhūdyasya pṛthivī taṃ vande viśvarupiṇam
yasya śrotre diśaḥ sarvā yaccakṣurdinakṛcajchaśī / ṛksāmayajupī yena taṃ vande brahrarupiṇam
yanmukhādvāhmaṇā jātā yadvāhorabhavannṛpāḥ / vaiśyā yasyo ruto jātāḥ padbhaghyāṃ śūdro vyajāyata
māyāsaṅgamamātragheṇa vadanti puruṣaṃ tvajam / svabhāvavimalaṃ śuddhaṃ nirvikāraṃ nirañjanam
kṣīrabdhi śāyinaṃ devamanantamaparājitam / sadbhaktavatsalaṃ viṣṇuṃ bhaktigamyaṃ namāmyaham
pṛthivyādīni bhūtāni tanmātrāṇīṃndriyāṇi ca / sūkṣmāsūkṣyāṇi yenāsaṃstaṃ vande sarvatomukham
yadvahya paramaṃ dhāma sarvalokottamottamam / nirguṇaṃ paramaṃ sūkṣmaṃ praṇato 'sti punaḥ punaḥ
avikāramajaṃ śuddhaṃ sarvatobāhumīśvaram /. yamāmananti yogāndrāḥ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam
yo devaḥ sarvabhūtānāmantarātmā jaganmayaḥ / nirguṇaḥ paramātmā ca sa me viṣṇuḥ prasīdatu
hṛdayastho 'pi dūrastho māyayā mohitātmanām / jñānināṃ sarvago yastu sa me viṣṇuḥ prasīdatu
caturbhiśca caturbhiśca dvābhyāṃ pañcabhireva ca / hūyate ca punardvātārthaṃbhyāṃ sa me viṣṇuḥ pratīdatu
jñānināṃ karmiṇāṃ caiva tathā bhaktimatāṃ nṛṇām / gatidātā viśvamṛgyaḥ sa me viṣṇuḥ prasūdatu
jagaddhitārthaṃ ye dehā dhriyante līlayā hareḥ / tānarcayanti vibudhāḥ sa me viṣṇuḥ prasīdatu
yamāmanantive santaḥ saccidānandavigraham / nirguṇaṃ ca guṇādhāraṃ sa me viṣṇuḥ prasīdatu
iti stutvā namedviṣṇuṃ brāhmaṇāṃśca prapūjayet / ācāryaṃ pūjayetpaścāddakṣiṇācchādanādibhiḥ
brāhmaṇānbhojayecchaktyā bhakti bhāvasamanvitaḥ / putramatrikalatrādyaiḥ svayaṃ ca saha bandhubhiḥ
kurvīta pāraṇaṃ vipra nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ / yastvetatkarma kurvīta dhvajāropaṇamuttamam / tasya puṇyaphalaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva susamāhitaḥ
paṭo dhvajasya viprendra yāvaccalati vāyunā / tāvanti pāpajālāni naśyantyeva na saṃśayaḥ
mahāpātakayukto vā yukto vā sarvapātakaiḥ / dhvajaṃ viṣṇugṛhe kṛtvā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
yāvaddināni tiṣṭeta dhvajo viṣṇugṛhe dvija / tāvadyugasahasrāṇi harisārupyamaśnute
āropitaṃ dhvajaṃ dṛṣṭvā ye 'bhinandanti dhārmikāḥ / te 'pi sarve pramucyante mahāpātakakoṭibhiḥ
āropito dhvajo viṣṇugṛhe dhunvanpaṭaṃ svakam / kartuḥ sarvāṇi pāpāni dhunoti nimiṣārddhataḥ
yastvā ropya gṛhe viṣṇordhvajaṃ nityamupācaret / sa devayānena divaṃ yātīva sumatirnṛpaḥ

iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde vratākhyāne dhvajāropaṇannāmaikonaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ nārada uvāca bhagavansarvadharmajña sarvaśāstrārthapāraga / sarvakarmavariṣṭaṃ ca tvayoktaṃ dhvajadhāraṇam
yastu vai sumatirnāma dhvajāropaparo mune / tvayoktastasya caritaṃ vistareṇa mamādiśa
sanaka uvāca śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ puṇyamitihāsaṃ purātanamam / brahmaṇā kathitaṃ mahyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam
āsītpurā kṛtayuge sumatirnāma bhūpatiḥ / somavaṃśodbhavaḥ śrīmānsatpadvīpaikanāyakaḥ
dharmātmā satyasaṃpannaḥ śucivaṃśyo 'tithipriyaḥ / sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannaḥ sarvasaṃpadvibhūṣitaḥ
sadā harikathāsevī haripūjāparāyaṇaḥ / haribhaktiparāṇāṃ ca śuśrūṣurnirahṝṅkṛtiḥ
pūjyapūjārato nityaṃ samadarśī guṇānvitaḥ / sarvabhūtahitaḥ śāntaḥ kṛtajñaḥ kīrtimāṃstathā
tasya bhāryā mahābhāgā sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutā / pativratā patiprāṇā nāmrā satyamatirmune
tādubhau dampatū nityaṃ haripūjāparāyaṇau / jātismarau mahābhāgau satyajñau satparāyaṇau
annadānaratau nityaṃ jaladānaparāyaṇau / taḍāgārāmavaprādau nasaṃkhyātānvitenatuḥ
sā tu satyamatirnityaṃ śucirviṣṇugṛhe satī / nṛtyatyatyantasantuṣṭā manojñā sañjuvādinī
so 'pi rājā mahābhāgo dvādaśīddhādaśīdine / dhvajamāropayatyeva manojñaṃ bahuvistaram
evaṃ hariparaṃ nityaṃ rājānaṃ dharmakovidam / primāṃ matyamatiṃ cāmya devā api sadāstuvan
triloke viśrutau jñātvā dampatī dharmako vidau / āyayau bahubhiḥ śipyairdraṣṭukāmo vibhāṇḍakaḥ
tamāyāntaṃ muniṃ śrutvā sa tu rājā vibhāṇḍakam / pratyudyayau sapatnīkaḥ prajā bhirbahuvistaram
kṛtātithyakriyaṃ śāntaṃ kṛtāsanaparigraham / nīcāsanasthito bhūyaḥ prāñjalirmunimabravīt
rājovāca bhagavankṛtakṛtyo 'smiṃ tvadabhyāgamanena veṃ / satāmāyamanaṃ santaṃ praśaṃsanti suravāvaham
yatra syānmahatāṃ prema tatra syuḥ sarvasampadaḥ / tejaḥ kīrtirdhanaṃ putrā iti prahurvipaścitaḥ
tatra vṛddhimupāyānti theyāṃsyanudinaṃ mune / yatra santaḥ prakurvanti mahatīṃ karuṇāṃ prabho
yo mṛrdhni dhāgyedūhyanmahatpādajalaṃ rajaḥ / sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu puṇyātmā nātra saṃśayaḥ
mama putrāśca dārāśca saṃpattvayi samarpitāḥ / māmājñāpaya viprendra kiṃ priyaṃ karavāṇi te
vinañcavanataṃ bhūpaṃ sa nirīkṣya munīśaavaraḥ / spṛśaṣankareṇa taṃ prītyuvācātiharṣitaḥ
ṛṣiruvāca gajanyaduktaṃ bhavatā tatsarvaṃ tvatkulocitam / vinayāvanataḥ sarvo bahuśreyo labhediha
dharmaścārthaśca kāmaśca mokṣaśca nṛpasattama / vinayāllabhate martyo durlabhaṃ kiṃ mahātmanām
prīto 'smi tava bhāpāla sanmārgaparivarttinaḥ / svasti te satataṃ bhūyādyatpṛcchāmi taducyatām
pūjā bahuvidhāḥ santi hastuṣṭividhāyikāḥ / tāsu nityaṃ dhvajārope varttse tvaṃ sadodyataḥ
bhāryāpi tava sādhvīyaṃ nityaṃ nṛtyaparāyaṇā / kimarthametadvṛttāntaṃ yathāvadvaktumarhasi
rājovāca śṛṇuṣva bhagavansarvaṃ yatpṛcchasi vadāmi tat / āścaryabhūtaṃ lokānāmāvayoścaritaṃ tviha
ahamāsaṃ purā śūdro mālinirnāma sattama / kumārgaganirato nityaṃ sarvalokāhike rataḥ
piśuno dharmavidveṣī devadravyāpahārakaḥ / godhnaśca brahmahā cauraḥ sarvaprāṇivadhe rataḥ
nityaṃ niṣṭhuravaktā ca pāpī veśyāparāyaṇaḥ / evaṃ sthitaḥ kiyatkālamanāhatyaṃ mahadṛcaḥ
sarvabandhuparityakto duḥkhī vanamupāgataḥ / mṛgamāṃsāśano nityaṃ tathā pānthāvillampakaḥ
ekākī duḥkhabahulo nyavasannirjane vane / ekadā kṣutpariśrānto nidāghārttaḥ pipāsitaḥ
jīrṇaṃ devālayaṃ viṣṇorapaśyaṃ vijane vane / haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇaṃ tatsamīpe mahatsaraḥ
paryantavanapuṣpaughacchāditaṃ tanmunīśvara / apibaṃ tatra pānīyaṃ tattīre vigataśramaḥ
phalāni jagdhvā śīrṇāni svayaṃ kṣucca nivāritā / tasmiñjīrṇīlaye viṣṇonarnivāsaṃ kṛtakavānaham
jīrṇasphuṭitasaṃdhānaṃ tasya nityamakāriṣam / parṇaistṛṇaiśca kāṣṭhaighair gṛhaṃ samyak prakalpitam
svasurārāthaṃ tu tadbhamirmayā litpā munīśvara / tatrāhaṃ vyādhavṛttistho hatvā bahuvidhānmṛgān
ājīvaṃ vartaya nnityaṃ varṣāṇāṃ viṃśatiḥ sthitaḥ / atheyamāgatā sādhvī vindhyadeśasamudbhavā
niṣādakulajā viprā nānmā khyātā/ñavakokilā / bandhuvargaparityaktā duḥkhitā jīrṇavigrahā
kṣuttṛḍgharmapariśrāntā śocantī svakṛtaṃ hyagham / daivayogākatsamāyātābhramantī vijane vane
grīṣmatāpārdditā bāhye svānte cādhinipūḍitā / imāṃ duḥkhārditāṃ dṛṣṭvā jātā me vipulā dayā
dattaṃ mayā jalaṃ cāsyai māṃsaṃ vanyaphalāni ca / gataśramātviyaṃ brahmanmayā pṛṣṭā yathā tayam
avedayatsvavṛttāntaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva mahāmune / nānmāvakokilā cāhaṃ niṣādakulasabhbhavā
dārukasya sutā cāhaṃ vindhyaparvatavāsinī / parasvahāriṇī nityaṃ sadā paiśunyavādinī
puṃścalūtyevamuktvā tu bandhuvargaiḥ samujjhitā / kiyatkālaṃ tataḥ patyā bhṛtāhaṃ lokaninditā
daivātso 'pi gato lokaṃ yamasyātra vihāya mām / kāntāre vijane caikā bhramantī duḥkhapīḍitā
daivāttvatsavidhaṃ prātpā jīvitāhaṃ tvayādhunā / ityevaṃ svakṛtaṃ karma mahyaṃ sarvaṃ nyavedayat
tato devālaye tasmindamapatībhāvamāśritau / sthitau varṣāṇi daśa ca āvāṃ māṃsaphalāśinau
ekadā madyapānena pramattau nirbharaimune / tatra devālaye rāghatrau muditau māṃsabhojanāt
tanuvastrāparijñānau nṛtyaṃ cakṛva mohitau / prārabdhakarma bhogāntamāvāṃ yugapadāgatau
yamadūtāstadāyātāḥ pāśahastā bhayaṅkarāḥ / netumāvāṃ nṛtyaratau sudhorāṃ yamayātanām
tataḥ prasanno bhagavānkarmaṇā mama mānada / devāvasathasaṃskārasaṃjñitena kṛtena naḥ
svadūtānprepayāmāsa svabhaktāvanatatparaḥ / te dūtā devadevasya śaṅkhacakra gadādharāḥ
sahasrasūryāsaṃkāśāḥ sarve cārucaturbhujāḥ / kirīṭakuṇḍaladharā hāriṇo vanamālinaḥ
diśo vitimirā vipra kurvantaḥ svena tejasā / bhayaṅkarānyāśahastāndaṃṣṭriṇo yamakiṅkarān
āvayogrāhaṇe yattānṛcuḥ kṛṣṇaparāyaṇāḥ
viṣṇudūtā ūcuḥ bho bho krūrā dūrācārā vivekaparivarjitāḥ / muñcadhvametau niṣpāpau dampatī harivallabhau
vivekastriṣu lokeṣu saṃpadāmādikāraṇam / apāpe pāpadhīryastu taṃ vidyātpuruṣādhamam
pāpe tvapāpadhīryastu taṃ vidyādadhamādhamam
yamadūtā ūcuḥ yuṣmābhiḥ satyamevoktaṃ kiṃ tvetau pāpisattamau / yamena pāpino daṇḍyāstanneṣyāmo vayaṃ tvimau
śrutipraṇihito dharmo hyadharmastadviparyayaḥ / dharmādharmaviveko 'yaṃ tanneṣyāmo yamāntikam
etactchuvātikupitā viṣṇudūtā mahaujasaḥ / pratyūcūstānyamabhaṭānadharme dharmamāninaḥ
viṣṇadūtā ūcuḥ aho kaṣṭaṃ dharmadṛśāmadharmaḥ spṛśate sabhām / samyagvivekaśūnyānāṃ nidānaṃ hyāpadāṃ mahat
tarkāṇādyaviśeṣeṇa narakādhyakṣatāṃ gatāḥ / yūyaṃ kimarthamadyāpi karttuṃ pāpāni sodyamāḥ
svakarmakṣayaparyantaṃ mahāpātakino 'pi ca / tiṣṭanti narake ghore yāvaccandrārkatārakam
pūrvasaṃcitapāpānāmadṛṣṭvā niṣkṛtiṃ vṛthā / kimarthaṃ pāpakarmāṇi kariṣye 'tha punaḥ punaḥ
śrutipraṇihito dharmaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ / kintvābhyāṃ caritāndharmānpravakṣyāmo yathātatham
etau pāpavinirmuktau hariśuśrūṣaṇe ratau / hariṇā trāyamāṇau ca muñcadhvamavilambitam
eṣā ca nartanaṃ cakre tathaiva dhvajaroṣaṇam / antakāle viṣṇugṛhe tena niṣpāpatāṃ gatau
antakāle tu yannāma śrutvoktvāpi ca vai sakṛt / labhate paramaṃ sthānaṃ kimu śūśrūṣaṇe ratāḥ
mahāpātakayukto vā yukto vāpyupapātakaiḥ /./ kṛṣṇasevī naro 'nte 'pi labhate paramāṃ gatim
yatīnāṃ viṣṇubhaktānāṃ paricaryā parāyaṇāḥ / te dūtāḥ sahasā yānti pāpino 'pi parāṃ gatim
muhurtaṃ vā muhurtārddhaṃ yastiṣṭoddharimandire / so 'pi yāti paraṃ sthānaṃ kimudvātraghiṃśavatsarān
upalepanakarttārau saṃmārjanaparāyaṇau / etau harigṛhe nityaṃ jīrṇaśīrṇādhiropakau
jalasecanakarttārau dīpadau harimandire / kathametau mahābhāgau yātanābhogamarhatha
ityuktā viṣṇudūtāste cchitvā pāśāṃstadaiva hi / āropyāvāṃ vimānāgrayaṃ yayurviṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam
tatra sāmīpyamāpannau devadevasya cakriṇaḥ / divyānbhogānbhuktavantau tāvatkālaṃ munīśvara
divyānbhogāṃstu tatrāpi bhuktvā yātau mahīmimām / atrāpi saṃpadatulā harisevāprasādataḥ
anicchayā kṛtenāpi sevanena harermune / prātpamīdṛk phalaṃ vipra devānāmapi durlabham
icchayārādhya viśveśaṃ bhaktibhāvena mādhavam / prāpsyāvaḥ paramaṃ śreya iti heturnirupitaḥ
avaśenāpi yatkarma kṛtaṃ syātsumahatphalam / jāyate bhūmidevendra kiṃ punaḥ śraddhayā kṛtam
etaduktaṃ niśamyāsau sa munīndro vibhaṇḍakaḥ / praśasya dampatī tau tu prayayau svatapevanam
tasmājjānīhi devarṣe devadevasya cakriṇaḥ / paricaryā tu sarveṣāṃ kāmadhenūpamā smṛtā
haripūjāparāṇāṃ tu harireva sanātanaḥ / dadāti paramaṃ śreyaḥ sarvakāmaphalamapradaḥ
ya idaṃ puṇyamākhyānaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam / paṭhecca śṛṇuyādvāpi so 'pi yāti parāṃ rātim
iti śrabṛhannāradīyaparāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde sumatibhūpakathāvarṇanaṃ nāma viṃśa'dhyāyaḥ sanaka uvāca anyadvūtaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu nārada tattvataḥ / durlabhaṃ sarvalokeṣu vikhyātaṃ haripañcakam
nārīṇāṃ ca narāṇāṃ ca sarvaduḥkhanivāraṇam / dharmakāmārthamokṣāṇāṃ nidānaṃ munisattama
sarvābhīṣṭapradaṃ caiva sarvavrataphalapradam / mārgaśīrṣe site pakṣe daśamyāṃ niyatendriyaḥ
kuryātsnānādikaṃ karma dantadhāvanapūrvakama / kṛtvā devārcanaṃ samyaktathā pañca mahādhvarān
ekāśī ca bhavettasmin dine niyamamāsthitāḥ / tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya hyekādaśyāṃ munīśvaraḥ
snānaṃ kṛtvā yathācāraṃ hariṃ caivāryadṛhe / snāpayeddevadeveśaṃ pañcāmṛtavidhānataḥ
arcayetparayā bhaktyā gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ ṛmāt / dhūpairdīpeśca naivaidyaistāmbūlaiśca pradakṣiṇaiḥ
saṃpūjya devadeveśamimaṃ mantramudīrayet /. namaste ghajñānarupāya jñānadāya namo 'stute
namaste sravaparupāya sarvasiddhipradāyine / evaṃ praṇamya deveśaṃ vāsudevaṃ janārjanam
vakṣyamāṇena mantreṇa hyupavāsaṃ samarpayet / pañcarātraṃ nirāhāro hyadyaprabhṛti keśava
tvadajñayā jagatsvāminmamābhīṣṭaprado bhava / evaṃ samapya devasya upavāsaṃ jitendriyaḥ
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryādekādaśyāmatho dvija / dvādaśyāṃ ca trayodaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ jitendriyaḥ
paurṇanamāsyāṃ ca karttavyamevaṃ viṣṇvarcanaṃ mune / ekādaśyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ karttavyaṃ jāgaraṃ tathā
pañcāmṛtādipūjā tu sāmānyā dinapañcasu / kṣīreṇa snāpayedviṣṇuṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ tu śaktitaḥ / tilahomaśca karttavyastiladānaṃ tathaiva ca
tataḥ ṣaṣṭe dine prātpe nirvatyaṃ svāśramakriyām / saṃprāśya pañcagavyaṃ ca pūjayedvidhibaddharim
brāhmaṇānbhojayetpaścādvibhave satyavāritam / tataḥ svabandhubhiḥ sārddhaṃ svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ
evaṃ paupādimāseṣu kārttikānteṣu nārada / śuklapakṣe vrataṃ kuryātpūrvamivavidhinā naraḥ
evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kāryaṃ vrataṃ pāpapraṇāśanam / punaḥ prātpe mārgaśīrṣe kuryādudyapanaṃ vratī
dvija / ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāro bhavetpūrvamiva dvija / dvādaśyāṃ pañcagavyaṃ ca prāśayetsusamāhitaḥ
gandhapuṣpā dibhiḥ samyagdevadevaṃ janārdanam / abhyarcyopāyanaṃ dadyādrūhyaṇāya jitendriyaḥ
pāyasaṃ madhusaṃmiśraṃ ghṛtayuktaṃ phalānvitam / sugandhaja lasaṃyuktaṃ pūrṇakumbhaṃ sadakṣiṇam
vastreṇācchāditaṃ kumbhaṃ pañcarantasamanvitam / dadyādadhyātmaviduṣe brāhmaṇāya munīśvara
sarvātman sarvabhūteśa sarvavyāpinsanātana / paramānnapradānena suprīto bhava mādhava
anena pāyasaṃ dattvā brāhmaṇānbhojayettataḥ / śaktito bandhubhiḥ sārddhaṃ svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ
vratametattu yaḥ kuryāddharipañcakasaṃjñitam / na tasya punarāvṛttirbrahmalokātkadācana
vratametatprakarttavya micchadbhirmokṣamuttam / samastapāpakāntāradāvānalasamaṃ dvija
gavāṃ koṭisahasrāṇi dattvā yatphalamāpnuyāt / tatphalaṃ labhyate pumbhiretasmā dupavāsataḥ
yastvetacchṛṇuyādbhaktyā nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ / sa mucyate mahāghoraiḥ tāpakānāṃ ca koṭibhiḥ

iti śrībṛhannāṃradīyapurāṇaṃ pūrvabhāge prathamapāde vratākhyāne mārgaśīrṣaśulkaikādaśīmāsabhya paurṇimāparyantaṃ pañcarātrivrataṃ nāmaikaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sanaka uvāca anyad vratavaraṃ vakṣye tacchṛṇuṣva samāhitaḥ / sarvāpāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvalokopakārakam
āṣāḍhre śrāvaṇe vāpi tathā bhādrapade 'pi ca / tathaivāśvinake māse kuryādetadvataṃ dvija
eteṣvanyatame māse śulkapakṣe jitendriyaḥ / prāśayetpañcagavyaṃ ca svapedviṣṇusamīpataḥ
tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya nityakarma samāpya ca / śraddhayā pūjayedviṣṇuṃ vaśī krodhavivārjitaḥ
vidvadbhiḥ sahito viṣṇumarcayitvā yathocitam / saṃkalpaṃ tu tataḥ kuryāstvasti vācanapūrvakam
māsamekaṃ nirāhāro hyadyaprabhṛti keśava / māsāntaṃ pāraṇaṃ kurve devadeva tavājñayā
taporupa namastubhyaṃ tapasāṃ phala dāyaka / mamābhūṣṭapradaṃ dehi sarvavinghānnivāraya
evaṃ samarpya devasya viṣṇormāsavrataṃ śubham / tataḥ prabhṛti māsāntaṃ nivaseddharimandire
pratyahaṃ snāpayeddevaṃ pañcāmṛtavidhānataḥ / dīpaṃ nirantaraṃ kuryāttasminmāse harergṛhe
pratyahaṃ khādayetkāṣṭhaṃ hyapāmārga samudbhavam / tataḥ snāyīta vidhinnārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ
tataḥ saṃsnāpayedviṣṇuṃ pūrvavatprayator'cayet / brāhmaṇānbhojayecchaktyā bhaktiyuktaḥ sada kṣiṇam
svayaṃ ca bandhubhiḥ sārddhaṃ bhuñjīta prayatendriyaḥ / evaṃ māsopavāsāṃśca vratī kuryāt trayodaśa
varṣānte vedaviduṣe gāṃ pradadyātsa dakṣiṇām / bhojayedvrāhmāṇāṃstatra dvādaśaiva vidhānataḥ / śaktyā ca dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādrūhyaṇyābharaṇāni ca
māsopavāsatritayaṃ yaḥ kuryātsaṃyate ndriyaḥ / ātporyāmasya yajñatya dviguṇaṃ phalamaśnute
catuḥ kṛtvaḥ kṛtaṃ yena pārākaṃ munisattama / sa labhetparamaṃ puṇyamaṣṭāngiṣṭomasaṃbhavam
pañcakṛtvo vratamidaṃ kṛtaṃ yena mahātmanā / atyangiṣṭomajaṃ puṇyaṃ dviguṇaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ
māsopavāṣaṭkaṃ yaḥ karoti susamāhitaḥ / jyotiṣṭo syanga yajñasya phalaṃ so 'ṣṭaguṇaṃ labhet
nirāhāraḥ satpakṛtvo naro māsopavāsakān / aśvamedhasya yajñasya phalamaṣṭaguṇaṃ labhet
māso pāvāsānyaḥ kuryādaṣṭakṛtvo munīśvara / naramedhākhyayajñasya phalaṃ pañcaguṇaṃ labhet
yastu māsopavāsāṃśca navakṛtvaḥ samācaret / gomedhamakhajaṃ puṇyaṃ labhate triguṇaṃ naraḥ
daśakṛtvastu yaḥ kuryātparākaṃ munisattama / sa brahmamedhayajñasya triguṇaṃ phalamaśnute
ekādaśa parākāṃśca yaḥ kuryātsaṃyatendriyaḥ / sa yāti harisārupyaṃ sarvabhogasamanvitam
trayodaśa parākāṃśca yaḥ kuryātprayato naraḥ / sa yāti paramānandaṃ yatra gatvā na śocati
māsopavāsaniratā gaṅgāsnānaparāyaṇāḥ / dhamamāgapravaktāro muktā eva na saśaṃyaḥ
avīrābhiryatibhirbrahyacāribhiḥ / māsopavāsaḥ karttavyo vanasthaiśca viśeṣataḥ
nārī vā puruṣo vāpi vratametatsudurlabham / kṛtvā mokṣamavānpoti yogināmapi durlabham
gṛhastho vānaprastho vā vratī vā bhikṣureva vā / mūrkho vā paṇḍito vāpi śrutvaitanmokṣabhāgbhavet
idaṃ puṇyaṃ vratākhyānaṃ nārāyaṇa parāyaṇaḥ / śṛṇuyādvācayedvāpi sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate

iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde vratākhyāne māsopavāsavarṇanaṃ nāma dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ sanaka uvāca idamanyatpravakṣyāmi vrataṃ trailokyaviśrutam / sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam
brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ caiva yopitām / mokṣadaṃ kurvatāṃ bhaktyā viṣṇoḥ priyataraṃ dvija
ekādaśīvrataṃ nāma sarvābhīṣṭapradaṃ nṛṇām /. karttavyaṃ sarvathā vipraviṣṇuprītikaraṃ yataḥ
ekādaśyāṃ na bhuñjīta pakṣayorubhayopari / yo bhuṅkte so 'tra pāpīyānparatra narakaṃ vrajet
upavāsaphalaṃ lipsurjahyādbhukticatuṣṭayam / pūrvāparadine gatrāvahorātraṃ tu madhyame
ekādaśīdine yastu bhoktumicchati mānavaḥ / sa bhoktuṃ sarvalapāpāni spṛhayālurnasaṃśayaḥ
bhaveddaśamyāmekāśīdvādaśyāṃ ca munīśvara / ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāro yadi muktimabhīpsati

yāni kāni ca pāpāni brahmahatyādikāni ca / annamāśritya tiṣṭhanti tāni vipra hareśvara / ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāro yadi muktimabhīpsati yāni kāni ca pāpāni brahmahakatyādikāni ca / annamāśritya tiṣṭhanti tāni ca munīśvara / ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāro yadi muktimabhīpsati
yāni kāni ca pāpāni brahmahatyādikāni ca ca // annamāśritya tiṣṭanti tāni vipra harerdine brahmahatyādipāpānāṃ kathañcinniṣkṛtirbhavet / ekādaśyāṃ tu yo bhuṅkte tasya naivāsti niṣkṛtiḥ
mahāpātakayukto vāyukto vā sarva pānakaiḥ / ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ sthitvā yāti parāṃ gatim
ekādaśī mahāpuṇyā viṣṇoḥ priyatamā tithiḥ / saṃsevyā sarvathā vipraiḥ saṃsāracche dalipsubhiḥ
daśamyāṃ prātarutthāya dantadhāvanapūrvakam / snāpayedvidhivadviṣṇuṃ pūjayetprayatendriyaḥ
ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāro nigṛhītendriyo bhavet / śayīta sannidhau viṣṇornārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ
ekādaśyāṃ tathā snātvā saṃpūjyaca ca janārdanam / gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ samyak tatastve vasudīrayet
ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ sthitvādyāhaṃ pare 'hani / bhokṣyāmi puṇḍarīkākṣa śaraṇaṃ me bhavācyuta
imaṃ mantraṃ samuccārthaṃ deva devasya cakriṇaḥ / bhaktibhāvena tuṣṭātmā upavāsaṃ samarpayet
devasya purataḥ kuryājjāgaraṃ niyato vratī / gītairvādyaiśaaca nṛtyaiśca purāṇaśravaṇādibhiḥ
tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya dvādaśīdivase vratī / snātvā ca vidhivadviṣṇuṃ pūjayatprayatendriyaḥ
pañcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya ekādaśyāṃ janārddanam / dvādaśyāṃ payasā vipra harisārupapyamaṣaśnute
ajñānatimirāndhasya vratenānena keśava / prasīda sumukho bhūtvā jñānadṛṣṭiprado bhava
evaṃ vijñāpya viprendra mādhavaṃ susamāhitaḥ / brahmaṇānbhojayecchaktyā dadyādvai dakṣiṇāṃ tathā
tataḥ svabandhubhiḥ sārddhaṃ nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ / kṛtapañcamahāyajñaḥ svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ
evaṃ yaḥ prayataḥ kuryātpuṇyamekādaśīvratam / sa yāti viṣṇubhavanaṃ punarāvṛttidurlabham
upavāsavrataparo dharmakāryacaparāyaṇaḥ / cāṇḍālānpatakitāṃścaiva nekṣedapi kadācana
nāstikānbhinnamaryodānnindakānpiśunāṃstathā / upavāsa vrataparo nālapecca kadācana
vṛṣalīsūtipoṣṭāraṃ vṛṣalīpatimeva ca / ayājyayājakaṃ caiva nālapetsarvadā vratī
kuṇḍaśinaṃ gāyakaṃ ca tathā devalakāśinam / bhiṣajaṃ kāvyakarttāraṃ devadvijavirodhinam
parānnalolupaṃ caiva parastrīnirataṃ tathā / vratopavāsanirato vāṅmātreṇāpi nārcayet
ityevamādibhiḥ śuddho vaśī sarvahite rataḥ / upavāsaparo bhūtvā parāṃ siddhimavānpuyāt
nāsti gaṅgāsamaṃ tīrthaṃ nāsti mātṛsamoguruḥ / nāstu viṣṇusamaṃ daivaṃ tapo nānaśanātparam
nāsti kṣamāsamā mātā nāsti kīrtisamaṃ dhanam / nāsti jñānasamo lābho lābho na ca dharma samaḥ pitā
na vivekasamo bandhurmaikādaśyāḥ paraṃ vratam / atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam
saṃvādaṃ bhadraśīlasya tatpiturgulavasya ca / purā higālavo nāma muniḥ satyaparāyaṇaḥ
uvā casa narmadātīrere śānto dāntastaponidhiḥ / bahuvṛkṣasamākīrṇe gajabhalluniṣevite
siddhacāraṇagandharva yakṣavidyādharānvite / kandamūlaphalaiḥ pūrṇe munivṛndaniṣedite
gālavo nāma viprendro nivāsamakasecciram / tasyābhavadbhadraśīla iti khyātaḥ suto vaśī
jāntismaro mahābhāgo nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ / bālakrāḍanakāle 'pi bhadraśīlo mahāmatiḥ
mṛdā ca viṣṇoḥ pratimāṃ kṛtvā pūjayate kṣaṇam / vayasyānbodhayeccāpi viṣṇuḥ pūjyo naraiḥ sadā
ekādaśīvrataṃ caiva karttavyamapi paṇḍitaiḥ / evaṃ te bodhitāstena śiśavo 'pi munīśvara
hariṃ mṛdaiva nirmāya pṛthaksaṃbhūya vā mudā / arcayanti mahābhāgā viṣṇubhaktiparāyaṇāḥ
namaskurvanbhadramati rviṣṇave sarvaviṣṇave / sarveṣāṃ jagatāṃ svasti bhūyādityabravīdidam
krīḍākāle muhūrtaṃ vā muhūrtārddhamathāpi vā / ekādaśīti saṃkalpyavrataṃ yacchati keśave
evaṃ sucaritaṃ dṛṣṭvā tanayaṃ gālavo muniḥ / apṛcchadvismayāviṣṭaḥ samāliṅgya taponidhiḥ
gālava uvāca bhadraśīla mahābhāga bhadraśīlo 'si suvrata / caritaṃ maṅgalaṃ yatte yogināmapi durlabham
haripūjāparo nityaṃ sarvabhūtahiterataḥ / ekādaśīvrataparo niṣiddhācāravarjitaḥ / nirddhandvo nirmamaḥ śānto haridhyānaparāyāṇaḥ
evametādṛśī buddhiḥ kathaṃ jātārbhakasyate / vināpi mahatāṃ sevāṃ haribhaktirhi durlabhā
svabhāvato janasyāsya hyavidyākāmakarmasu / pravarttate matirvatsa kathaṃ te 'laukikī kṛtiḥ
satsaṅge 'pi manuṣyāṇāṃ pūrvapuṇyātirekataḥ / jāyate bhagavadbhaktistadahaṃ vismayaṃ gataḥ
pṛcchāmi prītimāpannastadbhavānvaktumarhati / bhadraśīlo muniśreṣṭhaḥ pitraivaṃ suvikalpitaiḥ
jātismaraḥ sukṛtātmā hṛṣathṭaprahasitānanaḥ / svānabhrutaṃ yathāvrataṃ sarvaṃ pitre nyavedayat
bhadraśīla uvāca śṛṇu tāta muniśreṣṭha hyanubhūtaṃ mayā purā / jātismaratvājjānāmi yamena paribhāṣitam
etacchatvā mahābhāgo gālavo vismayonvitaḥ / uvāca prītimāpanno bhadraśīlaṃ mahāmatim
gālava uvāca kastvaṃ pūrvaṃ mahābhāga kimuktaṃ ca yamena te / kasya vā kena vā hetostatsarvaṃ vaktumarhasi
bhadraśīla uvāca ahamāsaṃ purā tāta rājā somakulodbhavaḥ / dharmakīrtiriti khyāto dattātragheyeṇa śāsitaḥ
nava varṣasahasrāṇi mahīṃ kṛtstramapālayam / adharmāśca tathā dharmā mayā tu bahavaḥ kṛtāḥ
tataḥ śriyā pramatto 'haṃ bahvadharmama kāripam / pāpaṇḍajanasaṃsargātpāpaṇḍacarito 'bhavam
purārjitāni puṇyāni mayā tu subahūnyapi / pāpaṇḍairbādhito 'haṃ tu vedamārgaṃ samatyajam
makhāśca sarve vidhvastā kūṭayuktividā mayā / adharmanirataṃ māṃ tu dṛṣṭvā maheśajāḥ
sadaiva duṣkṛtaṃ cakruḥ ṣaṣṭāṃśastatrame 'bhavat / evaṃ pāpasamācāro vyasanābhirataḥ sadā
mṛgayābhirarato bhūtvā hyakadā prāviśaṃ vanam / sasainyo 'haṃ vane tatra hatvā bahuvidhānmṛgān
kṣuttṛṭparivṛtaḥ śrānto revātīramupāgamam / ravitīkṣṇātapalkānto revāyāṃ snānamācaram
ahaṣṭasainya ekākī pīḍyamānaḥ kṣudhā bhṛśam
sametāstatragha ye kecidrevātīranivāsinaḥ / ekādaśīvrataparā mayā dṛṣṭvā niśāmukhe
nirāhāraśca tatrāhame kākī katajjanaiḥ saha / jāgaraṃ kṛtavāṃśvāpi senayā rahito niśi
adhvaśramapariśrāntaḥ kṣutpipāsāprapīḍitaḥ / tatraiva jāgarānte 'haṃ tātapañcatvamāgataḥ
tato yamabhaṭairbaddho mahādaṃṣṭrābhayaṅkaraiḥ / anekalkeśasaṃpannamārgeṇātpo yamāntikam / daṃṣṭrākarālavadanamapaśyaṃ samavartinam
atha kāliścitragutpamāhūyedamabhāṣata / asya śikṣāvidhānaṃ ca yathāvadvada paṇḍitaṃ
evamuktaścitragutpo dharmarājena sattama / ciraṃ vicārayāmāsa punaścedamabhāpata
asau pāparataḥ satyaṃ tathāpi śṛṇu dharmapa / ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
eṣa revātaṭe ramye nirāhāro harerdine / jāgaraṃ copavāsaṃ ca kṛtvā niṣaapāpatāṃ gataḥ
yāni kāni ca pāpāni kṛtāni subahūni ca / tāni sarvāṇi naṣṭāni hyupavāsaprabhāvataḥ
evamukto dharmarājaścitragutpena dhīmatā /' nānāma daṇḍavadbhūmau mamāgre so 'nukaṃpitaḥ
pūjayāmāsa māṃ tatra bhaktibhāvena dhairmarāṭ / tataśca svabhaṭānsarvānāhūyedamuvāca ha
dharmarāja uvāca śṛṇudhvaṃ madvaco dūtā hitaṃ vakṣyāmyanuttamamam / dharmamārgaratā nmartyānmānayadhvaṃ mamāntikam
ye viṣṇupūjanaratāḥ prayatāḥ kṛtajñāścaikādaśīvrataparā vijitendriyāśca / nārāyaṇācyutahare śaraṇaṃ bhaveti śāntā vadanti satataṃ tarasātyajadhvam
nārāyaṇācyuta janārdana kṛṣṇa viṣṇo padmeśa padmajapitaḥ śiva śaṅkareti / nityaṃ vadantyakhilaloka hitāḥ praśāntā dūradbhaṭāstyajatā tānna mamaiṣu śikṣā
nārāyaṇārpitakṛtānharibhaktibhajaḥ svācāramārganiratān gurusevakāṃśca / satpātradāna niratāṃśca sudīnapāllāndūtāstyajadhvamaniśaṃ harināmasaktān
pāṣaṇḍasaṅgarahitāndvijabhaktiniṣṭhānsatsaṃgalollupatarāṃśca tathātitheyān / śaṃbhau harau ca samabuddhimatastathaiva dūtāstyajadhvamupakāraparāñjanānām
ye varjitā harikathāmṛtasevanaiśca nārāyaṇasmṛtiparāyaṇamānasaiśca // virpandrapādajalasecanato 'prahṛṣṭāṃstānpāpino mama bhaṭā gṛhamānayadhvam
ye mātṛtātaparibhartsanaśīlinaśca lokadviṣo hitajanāhitakarmaṇaśca / devasvalobhaniratāñjananāśakartṛānatrānayadhvamaparādhaparāṃśca dūtāḥ
ekādaśīvrataparāṅmukhamugraśīlaṃ lokāpavādanirataṃ paranindakaṃ ca / grāmasya nāśakaramuttamavairayuktaṃ dūtāḥ samānayata vipradhaneṣu lubdham
ye viṣṇubhaktivimukhāḥ praṇamanti naiva nārāyaṇaṃ hi śaraṇāgatapālakaṃ ca / viṣṇavālayaṃ ca nahi yānti narāḥ sumūrkhāstānānayadhvamatipāparatānprasāhya
evaṃ śrutaṃ yadā tatra yamena paribhāṣitam / mayānutāpadagdhena smṛtaṃ tatkarma ninditam
asatkarmānutāpena saddharmaśravaṇena ca / tatraiva sarvapāpāni niḥśeṣāṇi gatāni me
pāpaśeṣādvinirmuktaṃ harisārupyatāṃ gatam / sahasrasūryasaṃkāśaṃ praṇanāma yamaśca tam
evaṃ dṛṣṭvā vismitāste yamadūtā bhayotkaṭāḥ / viśvāsaṃ paramaṃ cakruryamena paribhāṣite
tataḥ saṃpūjya māṃ kālo vimānaśatasaṃkulam / sadyaḥ saṃpreṣayāmāsa tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam
vimānakoṭibhiḥ sārddhaṃ sarvabhogasamanvitaiḥ / karmaṇā tena viprarṣe viṣṇuloke mayoṣitam
kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi kalpakoṭiśatāni ca / sthitvā viṣṇupadaṃ paścādindralokamupagamam
tatrāpi sarvabhogāḍhyaḥ sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ / tāvatkālaṃ divisthitvā tato bhūmimupāgataḥ
atrāpi viṣṇubhaktānāṃ jāto 'haṃ bhavatāṃ kule / jātismaratvāḍajjānāmi sarvametanmunīśaavara
tasmādviṣṇvarcanodyogaṃ karomi saha bālakaiḥ / ekādaśīvratamidamiti na jñātavānpurā
jātismṛtiprabhāveṇa tajjñātaṃ sāṃprataṃ mayā / atra svenāpi yatkarma kṛtaṃ tasya phalaṃ tvidam
ekādaśīvrataṃ bhaktyā kurvatāṃ kimuta prabho / tasmāccariṣye viprendra śubhamekādaśīvratam
viṣṇupūjāṃ cāharahaḥ paramasthānakāṅkṣayā / ekādaśīvrataṃ yattu kurvanti śraddhayā narāḥ
teṣāṃ tu viṣṇubhavanaṃ paramānandadāyakam / evaṃ putravacaḥ śrutvā saṃtuṣṭo gālavo muniḥ
avāpa paramāṃ tuṣṭiṃ manasā cātiharṣitaḥ / majjanma saphalaṃ jātaṃ maddhaṃśaḥ pāvanīkṛtaḥ
yatastvaṃ madagṛhe jāto viṣṇubhaktiparāyaṇaḥ / iti saṃtuṣṭacittastu tasya putrasya karmaṇā
haripūjāvidhānaṃ ca yathāvatsamabodhayat / ityetatte muniśreṣṭha yathāvatkathitaṃ mayā / saṃkocavistarābhyāṃ ca kimanyacchrotumicchasi

iti śrībṛhannāradīye purāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde vratākhyāne ekādaśīvratamahimānuvarṇanaṃ nāma trayoviṃśo 'yāyaḥ sūta uvāca etanniśamya sanakoditamaprameyaṃ puṇyaṃ harerdinabhavaṃ nikhilottamaṃ ca / pāpaughaśāntikaraṇaṃ vratasāramevaṃ brahmātmajaḥ punarabhāṣata harṣayuktaḥ
nārada uvāca kathitaṃ bhavatā sarvaṃ mune tattvārthakovida / vratākhyānaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ yathāvaddharibhaktidam
idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi varṇācacāravidhiṃ mune / tathā sarvāśramācāraṃ prāyaścittavidhiṃ tathā
etatsarvaṃ mahābhāga sarvatattvārthakovida / kṛpayā parayā mahyaṃ yathāvadvaktumarhasi
sanaka uvāca śṛṇuṣva muniśārdūla yathā bhaktapriyaṅkaraḥ / varṇāśramācāraparaiḥ pūjyate hariravyayaḥ
manvādyairuditaṃ yacca varṇāśramanibandhanam / tatte vakṣyāmi vidhivadbhakto 'si tvamadhokṣaje
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāścatvāra eva te / varṇā iti samākhyātā eteṣu brāhmaṇo 'dhikaḥ
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyā dvijāḥ proktāstrayastāthā / mātṛtaścopanayanāddi jatvaṃ prāpyate tribhiḥ
etairvarṇaiḥ sarvadharmāḥ kāryā varṇānurupataḥ / svavarṇadharmatyagena pāṣaṇḍaḥ procyate budhaiḥ
svagṛhyacoditaṃ karmadvijaḥ kurvankṛtī bhavet / anyathā patito bhūyātsarvadharmabahiṣkṛtaḥ
yugadharmaḥ parigāryā verṇairetairyathocitam / deśācārāstathāgrāhyāḥ smṛtidharmāvirodhataḥ
karmaṇā manasā vācā yatnāddharṃmaṃ samācaret / asvargyaṃ lokavidviṣṭaṃ dharmyamapyācarennatu
samudrayātrāsvīkāraḥ kamaṇḍaluvidhāraṇam / dvijānāmasavarṇāsu kanyā sūpayamastathā
devarācca sutotpattirmadhuparke paśorvadhaḥ / māṃsādanaṃ tathā śrāddhe vānaprasthaāśramastathā
dattākṣatāyāḥ kanyāyāḥ punardānaṃ varāya ca / naiṣṭikaṃ brahmacaryaṃ ca naramedhāścamedhakau
mahāprasthānagamanaṃ gomedhaśca tathā makhaḥ / etāndharmānkaliyuke varjyānāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ
deśācārāḥ parigrāhyāstattaddeśagatairnaraiḥ / anyathā patito jñeyaḥ sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtaḥ
brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ ca dvijottamā / kriyāḥ sāmānyato vakṣye tacchṛṇuṣva samāhitaḥ
dānaṃ dadyārdvahmaṇebhyastathā yajñairyajetsurān / vṛttyarthaṃ yācayeccaiva anyānadhyāpayettathā
yājayedyajane yogyānvipro nityodakī bhavet / kuryyācca vedagrahaṇaṃ tathāgreśca parigraham
grāhyer dvye ca pārakye samabuddhirbhavettathā / sarvalokahitaṃ kṛryānmṛduvākyamudīrayet
ṛtāvabhigamaḥ patnyāṃ śasyate brāhmaṇasya vai / na kasyāpyahitaṃ brūyādviṣṇupūjāparo bhavet
dadyāddānāni viprebhyaḥ kṣatriyo 'pi dvijottama / kuryyācca vedagrahaṇaṃ yajñairddevānyajettathā
śastrājīvī bhaveccaiva pālayeddharmato mahīm / duṣṭānāṃ śāsanaṃ kuryyācchiṣṭānāṃ pālanaṃ tathā
pāśupālyaṃ ca vāṇijyaṃ kṛṃṣiśca dvijasattama / vedasyādhyayanaṃ caiva vaiśyasyāpi prakīrttitam
kuryācca dāragrahaṇaṃ dharmāścaiva samācaret / krayavikrayajarvāpi dhanaiḥ kārukriyodbhavaiḥ
dadyāddānāni śūdro 'pi pākayajñairyajenna ca / brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ śuśrūṣāni rato bhavet
ṛtukālābhigāmīca svadāreṣu bhavettathā / sarvalokahitoṣitvaṃ maṅgalaṃ priyavāditā
anāyāso manoharṣastitikṣā nātimānitā / sāmānyaṃ sarvavarṇānāṃ munibhiḥ parikīrtitam
sarve ca munitāṃ yānti svāśramocitakarmaṇā / brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyācāramāśrayedāpadi dvija
kṣatriyo 'pi ca viḍvṛttimatyāpadi samāśrayet / nāśrayecchūdravṛttiṃ tu atyāpadyapi vai dvijaḥ
yadyāśrayeddijo mūḍhastadā cāṇḍāsatāṃ vrajet / brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ trayāṇāṃ munisattama
catvāra āśramāḥ proktāḥ pañcamo nopapadyate / brahmacārī gṛhī vānaprastho bhikṣuśca sattama
caturbhirāśramairebhiḥ sādhyate dharma uttamaḥ / viṣṇustuṣyati viprendra karmayogaratātmanaḥ
niḥspṛhāśāntamanasaḥ svakarmaniratasya ca / tato yāti paraṃ sthānaṃ yato nāvarttate punaḥ
iti śrībṛhannārāyaṇapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde sadācāro nāma caturviśo 'dhyāyaḥ sanaka uvāca varṇāśramācāravidhiṃ pravakṣyāmi viśeṣataḥ / śṛṇuṣva tanmuniśreṣṭha sāvadhānena cetasā
yaḥ svadharmaṃ parityajya paradharmaṃ samācaret / pāṣaṇḍaḥ sa hi vijñeyaḥ sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtaḥ
garbhādhānādisaṃskārāḥ kāryā mantravidhānataḥ / strīṇāmamantrataḥ kāryā yathākālaṃ yathāvidhi
sīmantakarma prathamaṃ caturthe māsi śasyate / ṣaṣṭe vā satpame vāpi aṣṭame vāpi kārayet
jāte putre pitā snātvā sacailaṃ jātakarma ca / kuryyācca nāndīśrāddhaṃ ca svastivācanapūrvakam
hemnā vā rajatenāpi vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ prakalpayet / annena kārayedyastu sa caṇḍāla samo bhavet
kṛtvābhyudayikaṃ śrāddhaṃ pitā putraghasya vāgyataḥ / kurvīta nāmanirddeśaṃ sūtakānte yathāvidhi
aspaṣṭamarthahīnaṃ ca hyatigurva kṣarānvitam / na dadyānnāma viprenda tathā ca viṣathamākṣaram
tṛtīyavarṣe caulaṃ ca pañcame ṣaṣṭasaṃmite / satpame cāṣṭame vāpi kuryād gṛhyoktamārgataḥ
daivayogādatikrānte garbhādhānādikarmaṇi / kartavyaḥ pādakṛcchro vai caule tvarddhaṃ prakalpayet
garbhāṣṭame 'ṣṭame vābde baṭukasyopanāyanam / āṣoḍaśābdaparyantaṃ gauṇaṃ kālamuśanti ca
garbhaikādaśame 'bde tu rājanyasyopanāyanam / ādvāviṃśābdaparyantaṃ kālamāhurvipaścitaḥ
vaiśvopanayanaṃ proktaṃ garbhāddvādaśame tathā / caturviṃśābdaparyantaṃ gauṇamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ
etatkālāvadheryasya dvijasyātikramo bhavet / sāvitrīpatitaṃ vidyāttaṃ tu naivālapetkadā
dvijopanayane vipra mukhyakālavyatikrame / dvādaśābdaṃ caretkṛcchraṃ paścājcāndrāyaṇaṃ tathā / sāṃtapanadvayaṃ caiva kṛtvā karma samācaret
anyathaā patitaṃ vidyātkarttāpi brahmahā bhavet / rmauñjī viprasya vijñeyā dhanurjyā kṣattriyasya tu
āvī vaiśyasya vijñeyā śrūyatāmajine tathā / viprasya coktamaiṇeyaṃ rauravaṃ kṣatriyasya tu
ājaṃ veśyasya vijñeyaṃ daṇḍānvakṣye yathākramam / pālāśaṃ brāhmaṇasyoktaṃ nṛpasyaudumbaraṃ tathā
bailvaṃ vaiśyasya vijñeya tatpramāṇaṃ śṛṇuṣva me / viprasya keśamānaṃ syādālalāṭaṃ nṛpasya ca
nāsāgrasaṃmitaṃ daṇḍaṃ vaiśyasyāhurvipaścitaḥ / tathā vāsāṃsi vakṣaghyāmi viprādīnāṃ yathākramam
kaṣāyaṃ caiva māñjiṣṭaṃ hāridraṃ ca prakīrtitam / upanīto dvijo vipra paricaryāparo guroḥ
vedagrahaṇaparyantaṃ nivasedguruveśmani / prātaḥ snāyī bhavedvarṇī samitkuśaphalādikān
gurvarthamāharennityaṃ kalye kalye munīśvara / yajñopavītamajinaṃ daṇḍaṃ ca munisattama
naṣṭe bhraṣṭe navaṃ mantrāddhṛtvā bhraṣṭaṃ jale kṣipet / varṇino varttanaṃ prāhurbhikṣānnenaiva kevalam
bhikṣā ca śrotriyāgārādāharetprayatendriyaḥ / bhavatpūrvaṃ brāhmaṇasya bhavanmadhyaṃ nṛpasya ca
bhavadatyaṃ viśaḥ proktaṃ bhikṣāharaṇakaṃ vacaḥ / sāṃyaprātarvahnikāryaṃ yathācāraṃ jitendriyaḥ
kuryātpratidinaṃ varṇīṃ brahmayajñaṃ ca tarpaṇam / agnikāryaparityāgī patitaḥ procyate budhaiḥ
brahmayajñavihīnaśca brahmahā parikīrtitaḥ / devatābhyarccanaṃ kuryācchuśrūṣānupadaṃ guroḥ
bhikṣānnaṃ bhojayennityaṃ naikānnāśī kadācana / ānīyānindyaviprāṇāṃ gṛhādbhikṣāṃ jitendriyaḥ
nivedya gurave 'śrīyādvāgyatastadanughajñayā / madhustrīmāṃsalavaṇaṃ tāmbūlaṃ dantadhāvanam
ucchiṣṭabhojanaṃ caiva divāsvāpaṃ ca varjayet / chātraghapāduka gandhāṃśca tathā mālyānulepanam
jalakeliṃ nṛtyagītavādyaṃ tu parivarjayet / parivādaṃ copatāpaṃ vipralāpaṃ tathāñjanam
pāṣaṇḍa janasaṃyogaṃ śūdrasaṃgaṃ ca varjayet / abhivādanaśīlaḥ syād vṛddheṣu ca yathākramam
jñānavṛddhāstapovṛddhā vayovṛddhā iti trayaḥ / ādhyātmikā diduḥkhāni nivārayati yo guruḥ
vedaśāstropadeśena taṃ pūrvamabhivādayet / asāvahamiti brūyāddijo vai hyabhivādane
nābhivādyāśca vipreṇa kṣaghatriyādyāḥ kathañcana / nāstikaṃ bhinnamaryādaṃ kṛtanghaṃ grāmayājakam
stenaṃ ca kitavaṃ caiva kadācinnābhivādayet / pāṣaṇḍaṃ patitaṃ vrātyaṃ tathā nakṣaghatrajīvinam
tathā pātakinaṃ caiva kadācinnābhivādayet / unmattaṃ ca śaṭhaṃ dhūrttaṃ dhāvantamaśuciṃ tathā
abhyaktaśirasaṃ caiva japantaṃ nābhivādayet / vivādaśīlinaṃ cañjaṃ vamantaṃ jalamadhyagam
bhikṣānnadhāriṇaṃ caiva śayānaṃ nābhivādayet / bhartṛnghīṃ puṣpiṇīṃ jārāṃ sūtikāṃ garbhapātinīm
kṛtanghīṃ ca tathā caṇḍīṃ kadācinnābhivādayet / sabhāyāṃ yajñaśālāyāṃ devatāyataneṣvapi
pratyekaṃ tu namaskāro hṝnti puṇyaṃ purākṛtam / śrāddhaṃ vrataṃ tathā dānaṃ devatābhyārcanaṃ tathā
yajñaṃ ca tarpaṇaṃ caiva kurvantaṃ nābhivādayet / kṛte 'bhivādane yastu na kuryā tprativādanam
nābhivādyaḥ sa vijñeyo yayā śūdrastathaiva saḥ / prakṣālya pādāvācamya gurorabhimukhaḥ sadā
tasya pādau ca saṃgṛhya adhīyīta vicakṣaṇaḥ / aṣṭakāsu caturdaśyāṃ pratipatparvaṇostathā
mahābharaṇyāṃ vipredraṃ śravaṇadvādaśīdine / bhādrapadāparapakṣe dvitīyāyāṃ tathaiva ca
māghasya śuklasatpamyāṃ navamyāmāśrinasya ca / pariveṣaṃ gate sūrye śrotriye gṛhamāgate
bandhite brahmaṇe caiva pravṛddhakalahe tathā / saṃdhyāyāṃ garjite meghe hyakāle parivarṣaṇe
ulkāśaniprapāte ca tathā vipre 'vamānite / manvādiṣu ca devarṣe yugādiṣu caturṣvapi
nādhīyīta dvijaḥ kaścitsarvakarmaphalotsukaḥ / tṛtīyā prādhave śuklā bhādre kṛṣṇā traghayodaśī
kārttike navamī śuddhā māghe pañcadaśī tithiḥ / etā yugādyāḥ kathitā dattasyākṣayakārikāḥ
manvādīṃśca pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva susamāhitaḥ / akṣayukchuklanavamī kārtike dvādaśī sitā
tṛtīyā caighatramāsasya tathā bhādrapadasya ca / āṣāḍhaśukladaśamī sitā māghasya satpamī
śrāvaṇasyāṣṭamī kṛṣṇā tathāṣāḍhī ca pūrṇamā / phaālgunasya tvamāvāsyā pauṣasyaikādaśī sitā
kārtikī phaālgunī caighatrīṃ jyaiṣṭhī pañcadaśī sitā / manvādayaḥ samākhyātā dattasyākṣayakārikāḥ
dvijaiḥ śraddhaṃ cakarttavyaṃ manvādiṣu yugādiṣu / śrāddhe nimantrite caivagrahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ
ayanadvitaye caiva tathā bhūkaṃpane mune / galagrahe durddine ca nādhīyīta kadācanā
evamādiṣu sarveṣu anadhyāyeṣu nārada / adhīyatāṃ sumūḍhānāṃprajāṃprajñāṃyaśaḥ śriyam
āyuṣyaṃ balamārogyaṃ nikṛntati yamaḥ svayam / anadhyāye tu yo 'dhīte taṃ vidyādvrahmaghātakam
na taṃ saṃbhāṣayedviprana tena saha saṃvaset / kuṇḍagolakayoḥ kecijjaḍādīnāṃ ca nārada
vadanti copanayanaṃ tatputrādiṣu kecana / anadhītya tu yo vedamanyatra kurute śramam
śūdratulyaḥ sa vijñeyo narakasya priyo 'tithiḥ / anadhītaśrutirvipra ācāra pratipadyate
nācāraphalamānpoti yathā śūdrastathaiva saḥ / nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ yaccānyatkarma vaidikam
anadhītasya viprasya sarvaṃ bhavati niṣphalam / śabdabrahmamayo viṣṇurvedaḥ sākṣāddhāri smṛkataḥ
vedādhyāyī tato vipraḥ sarvānkāmānavānpuyāt

iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde smārtācāreṣu varṇāśramadharmeṣvadhyayanādidharmanirupaṇaṃ nāma pañcaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sanaka uvāca vedagrahaṇaparyantaṃ śuśrūṣāniyato guroḥ / anujñātastatastena kuryādagniparigraham
vedāśca dharmaśāstrāṇi vedāṅgānyapi ca dvijaḥ / adhītya gurave dattvā dakṣiṇāṃ saṃviśedvṛham
rupalāvaṇyasaṃpannāṃ saguṇāṃ sukulodbhavām / dvijaḥ samudvahetkanyāṃ suśīlāṃ dharma cāriṇīm
mātṛtaḥ pañcamīṃ dhīmānpitataḥ satpamīṃ tathā / dvijaḥ samudvahetkanyathā gurutalparāḥ
rogiṇīṃ caiva vṛttākṣīṃ sarogakulasaṃbhavām / atikeśāmakeśāmakeśāṃ ca vācālāṃ nodvahedvudhaḥ
kopānāṃ vāmanāṃ caiva dīrghadehāṃ virupiṇīm / nyānādhikāṅgīmunmattāṃ piśunāṃ nodvahed budhaḥ
sthūlagulphaāṃ dīrghajaṅghāṃ tathaiva puruṣākṛtim / śmaśruvyañjanasaṃyuktāṃ kubjāṃ caivādvahenna ca
vṛthāhāsyamukhīṃ caiva sadānyagṛha vāsinīm / vivādaśīlāṃ bhramitāṃ niṣṭhurāṃ nodvahedrudhaḥ
bahvaśinīṃ sthīladantāṃ sthūloṣṭhīṃ ghurghurasvanām / atikṛṣṇāṃ raktavarṇāṃ dhūrtāṃ naivodvahe dvudhaḥ
sadā rodanaśīlāṃ ca pāṇḍurābhāṃ ca kutsitām / tāsaśvāsādisaṃyuktāṃ nidrāśīlāṃ ca nodvahet
anarthabhāṣiṇīṃ caiva lokadveṣa parāyaṇām / parāpavādaniratāṃ taskārāṃ nodvahedvudhaḥ
dīrghanāsāṃ ca kitavāṃ tanūruhavibhūṣigatām / garvitāṃ bakavṛttiṃ ca sarvathā nodvahedvudhaḥ
bālabhāvādavijñātasvabhāvāmudvahedyadi / pragalbhāṃ vāguṇāṃ jñātvā sarvathā tāṃ parityajet
bharttṛputreṣu yā nārī sarvadā niṣṭhurā bhavet / parānukūlinī yā ca sarvathā tāṃ parityajet
vivāhāścāṣṭadhā jñeyā brāhmādyā munisattama / pūrvaḥ pūrvo varo jñeyaḥ pūrvābhāve paraḥ paraḥ
brāhno daivastathaivārṣaḥ prājāpatyastathāsuraḥ / gāndharvo rākṣasaścaiva paiśācaścāṣṭamo mataḥ
brāhmeṇa ca vivāhena vaivāhyo vai dvijottamaḥ / daivenāpyathavā vipra kecidārṣaṃ pracakṣate
prājāpatyādayo vipra vivāhāḥ pañcaja garhitāḥ / abhāveṣu tu pūrveṣāṃ kuryādeva parānbudhaḥ
yajñopavītadvitayaṃ sottarīyaṃ ca dhārayet / suvarṇakuṇḍale caiva dhautavastradvayaṃ tathā
anulepanalitpāṅgaḥ kṛttakeśanakhaḥ śuciḥ / dhārayedvaiṇavaṃ daṇḍaṃ sodakaṃ ca kamaṇḍalum
uṣṇīṣamamalaṃ chatraṃ pāduke cāpyupānahau / dhārayetpuṣpamālye ca sugandhaṃ priyadarśanaḥ
nityaṃ svādhyāyaśīlaḥ syādyathācāraṃ samācaret / parānnaṃ naiva bhuñjīta paravādaṃ ca varjayet
pādena nākrametpādamucchiṣṭaṃ naiva laṅghayet / na saṃhatābhyāṃ hastābhyāṃ kaṇḍūyedātmanaḥ śiraḥ
pūjyaṃ devālayaṃ caiva nāpasavyaṃ vrajeddijaḥ / devārcācamanasnānavrataśrāddhakriyādiṣu
na bhavenmuktakeśaśca naikavastradharastathā / nāroheduṣṭrayānaṃ ca śuṣkavādaṃ ca varjayet
anya striyaṃ na gacchecca paiśunyaṃ parivarjayet / nāpasavyaṃ vrajedvipra goścatthānalaparvatān
catuṣpathaṃ caityavṛkṣarṃ devakhātaṃ nṛpaṃ tathā / asūyāṃ matsaratvaṃ ca divāsvāpaṃ ca varjayet
na vadetparapāpāni svapuṇyaṃ na prakāśayet / svakaṃ nāma svanakṣatraṃ mānaṃ caivātigopayet
na durjanaiḥ saha vase nnāśāstraṃ śṛṇuyāttathā / āsavadyūtagīteṣu dvijastu na rartiṃ caret
ārdrāsthi ca tathocchiṣṭaṃ śūdraṃ ca patitaṃ tathā / sarpaṃ ca bhaṣaṇaṃ spṛṣṭvā sacailaṃ snānamācaret
citiṃ ca citikāṣṭaṃ ca yūpaṃ cāṇḍālameva ca / spṛṣṭvā devalakaṃ caiva savāsā jalamāviśet
dīpakhaṭvātanucchāyākeśavas trakaṭodakam / ajāmārjaṃnimārjārareṇurddaivaṃ śubhaṃ haret
śūrppavātaṃ pretadhūmaṃ tathā śūdrānnabhojanam / vṛṣalīpatisaṅgaṃ ca dūrataḥ parivarjayet
asacchārstrārthamananaṃ khādanaṃ nakhakeśayoḥ / tathaiva nagnaśayanaṃ sarvadā parivarjayet
śirobhyaṅgāvaśiṣṭena tailenāṅgaṃ na lepayet / tāṃbūlamaśuciṃ nādyāttathā suptaṃ na bodhayet
nāśuddho 'gniṃ paricaretpūjayedgurudevatāḥ / na vāmahastenaikena pibedvakreṇa vā jalam
na cākramedgurośchāyāṃ tadājñāṃ ca munīśvara / na nindedyogino viprānvratino 'pi yatīṃstathā
parasparasya marmāṇi na kadāpi vadeddvijaḥ / darśe ca paurṇamāsyāṃ ca yāgaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi
upasanaṃ ca hotavyaṃ sāyaṃ prātardvijātibhiḥ / upāsanaparityāgī surāpītyucyate budhaiḥ
ayane viṣuve caiva yugādiṣu caturṣvapi / darśe ca pretapakṣe ca śrāddhaṃ kuryādgṛhī dvijaḥ
manvādiṣu mṛdāhe ca aṣṭakāsu ca nārada / nāvadhānye samāyāte gṛhī śrāddhaṃ samācaret
śrotriye gṛhamāyāte grahaṇe candrasūryoḥ / puṇyakṣetreṣu tīrtheṣu gṛhī śrāddhaṃ samācaret
yajño dānaṃ tapo homaḥ svādhyāyaḥ pitṛtarpaṇam / vṛthā bhavati tatsarvamūrddhapuṇḍraṃ vinā kṛtam
urddhapuṇḍraṃ ca tulasīṃ śrāddhe necchanti kecana / vṛthācāraḥ parityājyastasmācchreyo 'rthibhirdvijaiḥ
ityevamādayo dharmāḥ smṛtimārgapracoditāḥ / kāryā dvijātibhiḥ samyaksarvakarmaphalapradāḥ
sadā cāraparā ye tu teṣāṃ viṣṇuḥ prasīdati / viṣṇau prasannatāṃ yāte kimasādhyaṃ dvijottama

iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde smārttadhermaṣu vedādhyayanādikasya gṛhasthadharmasya ca nirupaṇaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sanaka uvāca gṛhasthasya sadācāraṃ vakṣyāmi munisattama / yadrūtāṃ sarvapāpāni naśyantyeva na saṃśayaḥ
brāhne muhūrte cotthāya puruṣārthāvirodhinīm / vṛttiṃ saṃcintayedvipra kṛtakeśaprasādhanaḥ
divāsaṃdhyāsu karṇasthabrahmasūtra udaḍmukhaḥ / kuryānmūtrapurīṣe tu rātrau ceddakṣiṇāmukhaḥ
śiraḥ prāvṛtya vastreṇa hyantarddhāya tṛṇairmahīm / vahankāṣṭaṃ kareṇaikaṃ tāvanmaunī bhaveddvijaḥ
pathi goṣṭe nadītīre taḍāgagṛhasannidhau / tathā vṛkṣasya cchāyāyāṃ kāntāre vahnisannidhau
devālaye tathodyāne kṛṣṭabhūmau catuṣpathe / brāhmaṇānāṃ samīpe ca tathā goguruyoṣitām
tuṣāṅgārakapāleṣu jalamadhye tathaiva ca / evamādiṣu deśeṣu malamūtraṃ na kārayet
śauce yatnaḥ sadā kāryaḥ śaucamūlo dvijaḥ smṛtaḥ / śaucācāravihīnasya samastaṃ karma niṣphalam
śaucaṃ tu dvividhaṃ proktaṃ brāhmamābhyāntaraṃ tathā / mṛjjalābhyāṃ bahiḥ śuddhirbhāvaśuddhistathāntaram
gṛhītaśiśraścotthāya śaucārthaṃ mṛdamāharet /. na mūṣakādikhanitāṃ phaālotkṛṣṭāṃ tathaiva ca
vāpīkūpataḍāgebhyo nāharedapi mṛttikām / śaucaṃ kuryātprayatnena samādāya śubhāṃ mṛdam
liṅge mṛdekā dātavyā tisro vā meḍhrayordvayoḥ / etanmūtramutsarge śaucamāhūrmanīṣiṇaḥ
ekā liṅge gude pañca daśa vāme tathobhayoḥ / satpa tisraḥ pradātavyāḥ pādayormṛttikāḥ pṛthak
etacchaucaṃ viḍutsarge gandhalepāpanuttaye / etacchaucaṃ gṛhasthasya dviguṇaṃ brahmacāriṇām
triguṇāṃ tu vanasthānāṃ yatīnāṃ taccarguṇam / svasthāne pūrṇaśaucaṃ syātpathyarddhaṃ munisattama
āture niyamo nāsti mahāpadi tathaiva ca / gandhalepakṣayakaraṃ śaurcaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ
strīṇāmanupanītānāṃ gandhalepakṣayāvadhi / vratasthānāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ yativacchaucamiṣyate
vidhavānāṃ ca virpendra etadeva nigadyate / evaṃ śaucaṃ tu nirvartya paścādvai susamāhitaḥ
prāgāsya udagāsyo vāpyācāmetprayartendriyaḥ / triścaturdhā pibedāpo gandhaphenādivarjitāḥ
dvirmārjayetkapolaṃ ca talenoṣṭhau ca sattama / tarjanyaṅguṣṭhayogena nāsārandhradvayaṃ spṛśet
aguṃṣṭānāmikābhyāṃ ca cakṣuḥ śrotre yathākramam / kaniṣṭāṅguṣṭayogena nābhideśe spṛśeddvijaḥ
talenoraḥsthalaṃ caiva aṅgulyagraiḥ śiraḥ spṛśet / talena cāṅgulāgrairvā spṛśedaṃsau vicakṣaṇaḥ
evamācamya vipredra śuddhimānpotyanuttamām / dantakāṣṭaṃ tataḥ khādetsatvacaṃ śastavṛkṣajam
bilvāsanāpāmārgaṇāṃ nimbānmārkādiśākhinām / prakṣālya vāriṇā caiva mantreṇāpyabhimantritam
āyurbalaṃ yaśo varcaḥ prajāḥ paśuvasūni ca / brahma prajñāṃ ca medhāṃ ca tvanno dhehi vanaspate
kaniṣṭāgrasamaṃ sthaulye vipraḥ khādeddaśāṅgulam / navāṅgulaṃ kṣatriyaśca vaiśyaścāṣṭāṅgulonmitam
śūdro vedāṅgulamitaṃ vanitā ca munīśvara / alābhe daitakāṣṭānāṃ gaṇḍūṣairbhānusaṃmitaiḥ
muthaśuddhirvidhīyeta tṛṇapatrasamanvitaiḥ / kareṇādāya vāmena saṃcarvedvāmadaṃṣṭrayā
dvijānsaṃgharṣya godohaṃ tataḥ prakṣālya pāṭayet / jihvāmullikhya tābhyāṃ tu dalubhyāṃ niyatendriyaḥ
prakṣālya prakṣipedū dūre bhūyaścācamya pūrvavat / tataḥ snānaṃ prakurvīta nadyādau vimale jale
taṭaṃ prakṣālya darbhāśca vinyasya praviśejjalam / praṇamya tatra tīrthāni āvāhya ravimaṇḍalāt
gandhādyairmaṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā dhyātvā devaṃ janārdanam / snāyānmantrānsmaranpuṇyāṃstīrthāni ca viriñcija
gaṅge ca yamune caiva godāvari sarasvati / narmade siṃdhukāveri jale 'sminsannidhiṃ kuru
puṣkarādyāni tīrthāni gaṅgādyāḥ saritastathā / āgacchantu mahābhāgāḥ snānakāle sadā mama
ayodhyā mathurā māyā kāśīṃ kāñcī hyavantikā / purī dvārāvatī jñeyā satpaitā mokṣadāyikāḥ
tato 'dhamarṣaṇa japtvā yatāsurvārisaṃplutaḥ / snānāṅgaṃ tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvācamyārdhyaṃ bhānaver'payet
tato dhyātvā vivasvantaṃ jalānnirgatya nārada / paridhāyāhataṃ dhautaṃ dvitīyaṃ parivīya ca
kuśāsane samāviśya saṃdhyākarma samārabhet / īśānābhimukho vipra gāyatryācamya vai dvija
ṛtamityabhimantryārtha punarevāmed budhaḥ / tatastu vāriṇātmānaṃ veṣṭayitvā samukṣya ca
saṃkalpya praṇavānte tu ṛṣicchandaḥ surānsmaran / bhūrādibhirvyāhṛtibhiḥ satpabhiḥ prokṣya mastakam
nyāsaṃ samācarenmantrī pṛthageva karāṅgayoḥ / vinyasya hṛdaye tāraṃ bhūḥ śirasyatha vinyaset
bhuvaḥ śikhāyāṃ svaścaiva kavaye bhūrbhuvo 'kṣiṣu / bhūrbhuvaḥ svastathātrāstraṃ dikṣu tālatrayaṃ nyaset
tata āvāhayetsaṃdhyāṃ prātaḥ kokanasthitām / āgaccha varade devi tryakṣare brahmavādini
gāyatri cchandasāṃ mātarbrahmayone namo 'stu te / madhyāhne vṛṣabhāruḍhāṃ śuklāṃbarasamāvṛtām
sāvitrīṃ rudrayoniṃ cāvāhayedrudravādinīm / sāyaṃ tu garuḍāruḍhāṃ pītāṃbarasamāvṛttām
sarasvatīṃ viṣṇuyonimāhvayedviṣṇuvādinīm / tāraṃ ca vyāhṛtīḥ satpa tripadāṃ ca samuccaran
śiraḥ śikhāṃ ca saṃpūrya kubhayitvā virecayet / vāmamadhyātparairvāyuṃ krameṇa prāṇasaṃyame
dvirācāmettataḥ paścātprātaḥ sūryaścameti ca / āpaḥ punantu madhyāhne sāyamagniścameti ca
āpo hiṣṭheti tisṛbhirmārjanaṃ ca tataścaret / sumutriyā na ityuktvā nāsāspṛṣṭajalena ca
dviṣadvargaṃ samutsārya drupadāṃ śirasi kṣipet / ṛtaṃ ca satyametena kṛtvā caivādhamarṣaṇam
antaścarasi mantreṇa sakṛdeva pibedapaḥ / tataḥ sūryāya vidhivadgandhaṃ puṣpaṃ jalāñjalim
kṣiptvopatiṣṭheddevarṣe bhāskaraṃ svastikāñjalim / ūrddhūbāhuradhobāhuḥ kramātkalyādike trike
uhutyaṃ citraṃ taccakṣurityetattritayaṃ japet / saurāñchaivānvaiṣṇavāṃśca mantrānanyāṃśca nārada
tejo 'si gāyatryasīti prārthayetsaviturmahaḥ / tato 'ṅgāni trirāvartya dhyāyecchaktīstadātmikāḥ

brahmaṇī caturānanākṣavalayā kumbhaṃ karaiḥ srukstravau bibhrāṇā tvaruṇendukāntivadanā ṛgrūpiṇī bālikā / haṃsārohaṇakelikhaṇkhaṇmaṇerbibārcitā bhūṣitā gāyatrī paribhāvitā bhavatu naḥ saṃpatsamṛddhyai sadā
rudrāṇī navayauvanā trinayanā vaiyāghnacarmāṃbarā khaṭvāṅgatraghiśikhākṣasūtravalayābhītiśriyai cāstu naḥ / vidyuddāmajaṭākalāpavilasadvārledumaulirmudā sāvitrī vṛṣavāhanā sitatanurdhyeyā yajūrūpiṇī

dhyeyā sā ca sarasvatī bhagavatī pītāṃbarālaṅkṛtā śyāmā śyāmatanurjaroparilasadgātrāñcitā vaiṣṇavī / tārkṣyasthā maṇinūpurāṅgadalasadgraiveyabhūṣojjvalā hastālaṅkṛtaśaṅkhacakrasugadāpahmāśriyai cāstu naḥ
evaṃ dhyātvā japettiṣṭhanprātarmadhyāhnake tathā / sāyaṅkāle samāsīno bhaktyā tadgatamānasaḥ
sahasraparamāṃ devīṃ śatamadhyāṃ daśāvarām / tripadāṃ praṇavopetāṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svarupakramām
ṣaṭtāraḥ saṃpuṭo vāpi vratinaśca yaterjapaḥ / gṛhasthasya sattāraḥ syājjapya evaṃvidho mune
tato japtvā yathāśakti savitre vinivedya ca / gāyatryai ca savitre ca prakṣipedañjalidrūyam
tato visṛjya tāṃ vipra uttare iti mantrataḥ / brahmaṇeśena hariṇānujñātā gaccha sādaram
dirabhyo digdevatābhyaśca namaskṛtya kṛtāñjaliḥ / prātarādeḥ paraṃ karma kuryādapi vidhānataḥ
prātarmadhyandine caiva gṛhasthaḥ snānamācaret / vānaprasthaśca devarṣe snāyātrniṣavaṇaṃ yatiḥ
āturāṇāṃ tu rogadyaiḥ pānthānāṃ ca sakṛnmatam / brahmayajñaṃ tataḥ kuryāddarbhapāṇirmunīśvara
divoditāni karmāṇi pramādādakṛtāni cet / śarvaryāḥ prathame yāme tāni kuryādyathākramam
nopāste yo dvijaḥ saṃdhyāṃ dhūrtabuddhiranāpadi / pāṣaṇḍaḥ sa hi vijñeyaḥ sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtaḥ
yastu saṃdhyādikarmāṇi kūṭayuktiviśāradaḥ / parityajati taṃ vidyānmahāpātakināṃ varam
ye dvijā abhibhāṣante tyaktasaṃdhyādikarmaṇaḥ / te yānti narakānghorānyāvaccandrārkatārakam
devārcanaṃ tataḥ kuryādvaiśvadevaṃ yathāvidhi / tatrātyamatithiṃ samyagannādyaiśca prapūjayet
vaktavyā madhurā vāṇī teṣvapyabhyāgateṣu tu / jalānnakandamūlairvā gṛhadānena cārcayet
atithiryasya bhagnāśo gṛhatpratinivartite / satasmaiduṣkṛtaṃ dattvā puṇyamādāya gacchati
ajñātagotranāmānamanyagrāmādupāgatam / vipaścito 'tithiṃ prāhurviṣṇuvattaṃ prapūjayet
svagrāmavāsinaṃ tvekaṃ śrotriyaṃ viṣṇutatparam / annādyaiḥ pratyahaṃ viprapitṝnuddiśya tarpayet
pañcayajñaparityāgī brahmāhetyucyate budhaiḥ / kuryādaharahastasmātpañcayajñānprayantataḥ
devayajño bhūtayajñaḥ titṛyajñastathaiva ca / nṛpajño brahmayajñaśca pañcayajñānpracakṣate
bhṛtyamitrādisaṃyuktaḥ svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ / dvijānāṃ bhojyamaśrī yātpātraṃ naiva parityajet
saṃsthāpya svāsame pādau vastrārddhaṃ paridhāya ca / mukhena vamitaṃ bhuktvā surāpītyucyate budhaiḥ
khāditārddhaṃ punaḥ khādenmodakāṃśca phalāni ca / pratyakṣaṃ lavaṇaṃ caiva gomāṃsaśīti gadyate
apośāne vācamane adyadravyeṣu ca dvijaḥ / śabda na kārayedviprastaṃ kurvannārakī bhavet
pathyamannaṃ prabhuñjīta vāgyato 'nnamasutsayanam / amṛtopastaraṇamasi apośānaṃ bhujeḥ puraḥ
amṛtāpidhānamasi bhojyānte 'paḥ sakṛtpibet / prāṇādyā āhutīrdattvācamya bhojanamācaret
tataścācamya viprendra śāstracintāparo bhavet / rātrāvapi yathāśakti śayanāsanabhojanaiḥ
evaṃ gṛhī sadācāraṃ kuryātpratidinaṃ mune / yadā'cāraparityāgī prāyaścittī tadā bhavet
dūṣitāṃ svatanuṃ dṛṣṭvā pālitādyaiśca sattama / putreṣu bhāryāṃ niḥkṣipya vanaṃ gacchetsahaiva vā
bhavetriṣavaṇasnāyī nakhaśmaśrujaṭādharaḥ / adhaḥ śāyī brahmacārī pañcayajñaparāyaṇaḥ
phalamūlāśano nityaṃ svādhyāyaniratāstathā / dayāvānsarvabhūteṣu nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ
varjaye dgrāmajātāni puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca / aṣṭau grāsāṃśca bhuñjīta na kuryādrātribhojanam
atyantaṃ varjayettailaṃ vānaprasthasamāśramī / vyavāyaṃ varjayeccaiva nidrālasye tathaiva ca
śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiṃ nityaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ smaret / vānaprasthaḥ prakurvīta tapaścāndrāyaṇādikam
saheta śītatāpādivahniṃ paricaretsadā / yadā manasi vairāgyaṃ jātaṃ sarveṣu vastuṣu
tadaiva saṃnyasedvipra patitastvanyathā bhavet / vedāntābhyāsanirataḥ śānto dānto jitendriyaḥ
nirdvedvo nirahṝṅkāro nirmamaḥ sarvadā bhavet / śamādiguṇasaṃyuktaḥ kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ
nagno vā jīrṇakaupīnau bhavenmuṇḍo yatirdvijaḥ / samaḥ śatrau ca mitre ca tathā mānāpamānayoḥ
ekarātraṃ vasedgrāme trirātraṃ nagare tathā / bhaikṣeṇa varttayennityaṃ naikānnādībhavedyatiḥ
aninditadvijagṛhe vyaṅgāre bhuktivarjite / vivādarahite caiva bhikṣārthaṃ paryaṭedyatiḥ
bhavetriṣavaṇasnāyī nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ / japecca praṇavaṃ nityaṃ jitātmā vijitendriyaḥ
ekānnādī bhavedyastu kadācillaṃpaṭo yatiḥ / na tasya niṣkṛtirddaṣṭā prāyaścittāyutairapi
lobhādyadi yatirvipra tanupoṣaparo bhavet / sa caṇḍālasamo jñeyo varṇāśramavigarhitaḥ
ātmānāṃ cintayeddrevaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam / nirdvandraṃ nirmamaṃśāntaṃ māyātītamamatsaram
avyayaṃ paripūrṇaṃ ca sadānandaikavigraham / jñānasvarupamamalaṃ paraṃ jyotiḥ sanātanam
avikāramanādyantaṃ jagaccaitanyakāraṇam / nirguṇaṃ paramaṃ dhyāyedātmānaṃ parataḥ param
paṭhedupaniṣadvākyaṃ vedāntārthāṃśca cintayet / sahasraśīrṣaṃ devaṃ ca sadā dhyāyejjitendriyaḥ
evaṃ dhyānaparo yastu yatirvigatamatsaraḥ / sa yāti paramānandaṃ paraṃ jyotiḥ sanātanam
ityevamāśramācārānyaḥ karoti dvijaḥ kramāt / sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra gatvā na śocayati
varṇāśramācāraratāḥ sarvapāpavivarjitāḥ / nārāyaṇaparā yānti tadviṣṇaḥ paramaṃ padam

iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde sadācāreṣu gṛhasthaāvānaprasthayatidharmnirupaṇaṃ nāma satpaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sanaka uvāca śṛṇuṣva muniśārdūla śrāddhasya vidhimuttamam / yacchrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
kṣayāhapūrvadivase snātvā caikāśano bhavet / adhaḥ śāyī brahmacārī niśi viprānnimantrayet
dantadhāvanatāṃbūle tailābhyaṅgaṃ tathaiva ca / ratyoṣadhiparānnāni śrāddhakarttāvivarjayet
adhvānaṃ kalahaṃ krodhaṃ vyavāyaṃ ca dhuraṃ tathā / śrāddhakarttā ca bhoktā ca divāsvāpaṃ ca varjayet
śrāddhe nimantrito yastu vyavāyaṃ kurute yadi / brahmahatyāmavānpoti narakaṃ cāpi gacchati
śrāddhe niyojayedvipraṃ śrotriya viṣṇutatparam / yathāsvācāranirataṃ praśāntaṃ satkulodbagavam
rāgadveṣavihīnaṃ ca purāṇārthaviśāradam / trimadhutrisuparṇajñaṃ sarvabhūtadayāparam
devapūjārataṃ caiva smṛtitattvaviśāradam / vedāntatattvasaṃpannaṃ sarvalokahite ratam
kṛtajñaṃ guṇasaṃpannaṃ guruśuśrūṣaṇe ratam / paropadeśanirataṃ sacchāstrakathanaistathā
ete niyojitavyā vai śrāddhe viprā munīśvara / śrāddhe varjyānmavakṣyāmi śṛṇu tānmusamāhitaḥ
npūnāṅgaścādhikāṅgaśca kadaryo rogitastathā / kuṣṭī ca kunakhī caiva laṃbakarṇaḥ kṣatavrataḥ
nakṣatrapāṭhajīvī ca tathā ca śavadāhakaḥ / kuvādī parirvattā ca tathā devalakaḥ khalaḥ
nindako 'marṣaṇo dhūrtastathaiva grāmayājakaḥ / asacchāstrābhinirataḥ parānnanigatastathā
vṛṣalīsūti poṣṭā ca vṛṣalīpatireva ca / kuṇḍaśca golakaścaiva hyayājyānāṃ ca yājakaḥ
daṃbhācāro vṛthāmuṇḍī hyanyastrīdhanatatparaḥ / viṣṇubhaktivihīnaśca śivabhaktiparāḍmukhaḥ
vedavikrayiṇaścaiva vratavikrayiṇastathā / smṛtivikrayiṇaścaiva mantravikrayiṇastathā
gāyakāḥ kāvyakarttāro bhiṣakchāstropajīvinaḥ / vedanindāparaścaiva grāmāpaṇyapradāhakaḥ
tathātikāmukaścaiva rasavikrayakārakaḥ / kūṭayuktirataścaiva śrāddhe varjyāḥ prayatnataḥ
niṃmatrayīta pūrvedyustasminneva dine 'thavā / nimantrito bhavedvipro brahmacārī jitendriyaḥ
śrāddhe kṣaṇastu karttavyaḥ prasādaśceti sattama / nimantrayeddvijaṃ prājñaṃ darbhapāṇirjitendriyaḥ
tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya prātaḥ kṛtyaṃ samāpya ca / śrāddhaṃ samācaredvidvānkāle kutapasaṃjñite
divasasyāṣṭame kāle yadā mandāyate raviḥ / sa kālaḥ kutapastatra pitṝṇāṃ dattamakṣayam
aparāhnaḥ pitṝṇāṃ tu dattaḥ kālaḥ svayaṃbhuvā / tatkāla eva dātavyaṃ kavyaṃ tasmāddvijottamaiḥ
yatkāvyaṃ dīyate dvavyairakāle munisattama / rākṣasaṃ taddhi vijñeyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ nopatiṣṭati
kāvyaṃ prattaṃ tu sāyāhne rākṣasaṃ tadbhavedapi / dātā narakamānpoti bhoktā ca narakaṃ vrajet
kṣayāhasya tithairvipra yadi daṇḍamitirbhavet / viddhāparāhni kāyāṃ tu śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ vijānatā
kṣayāhasya tithiryā tu hyaparāhnadvaye yadi / pūrvā kṣaye tu karttavyā vṛdvau kāryā tathottarā
muhūrtta dvitaye pūrvadine syādapare 'hani / tithiḥ sāyāhnagā yatra parā kāvyasya viśrutā
kiñcitpūrvadine prāhurmuhūrttadvitaye sati / naitanmataṃ hi sarveṣāṃ kāvyadāne munīśvara
nimantriteṣau vipreṣu militeṣu dvijottama / prāyaścittaviśuddhātmā tebhyo 'nujñāṃ samāharet
śrāddhārthaṃ samanujñāto viprānbhūyo nimantrayet //u ubhau ca viśvedevārthaṃ pighatrarthaṃ trīnyathāvidhi
devatārthaṃ ca pitrarthamekaikaṃ vā nimantrayet / śrāddhārthaṃ samanujñātaḥ kārayenmaṇḍaladvayam
caturastraṃ brāhmaṇasya trikoṇaṃ kṣatriyasya vai / vaiśyasya vartulaṃ jñeyaṃ śūdrasyābhyābhyukṣaṇaṃ bhavet
brāhmaṇānāmabhāve tu bhrātaraṃ putrameva ca / ātmānaṃ vā niyuñjīta na vipraṃ vedavarjitam
prakṣālya viprapādāṃśaaca hyācāṃnānupaveśya ca / yathāvadarcanaṃ kuryātsmarannārāyaṇaṃ prabhum
brāhmaṇānāṃ tu madhye ca dvāradeśe tathaiva ca / apahatā ityṛcā vai karttā tu vikirettilān
yavairdarbhaghaiśca viśveṣāṃ devānāmidamāsanam / dattveti bhūyo dadyacca daive kṣaṇapratīkṣaṇam
akṣayyāsanayoḥ ṣaṣṭī dvitīyāvāhane smṛtā / annadāne caturthī syāccheṣāḥ saṃpuddhayaḥ smṛtāḥ
āsādya pātradvitayaṃ darbhaśākhāsamanvitam / tatpātre secayettoyaṃ śannodevītyṛcā tataḥ
yavosīti ti yavān kṣitpvā gandhapuṣpe ca vāgyataḥ / āvāhayettato devānviśve devāḥsa ityṛcā
yā divyā iti mantreṇa dadyādarghyaṃ samāhitaḥ / gandhaiśca patrapuṣpaiśca dhūpairdīpairyajettataḥ
devaiśca samanujñāto yajetpitṛgaṇāṃstathā / tilasaṃyuktadarbhaiśca dadyātteṣāṃ sadāsanam
pātrāṇyāsādayettrīṇi hyarghātha pūrvavaddvijaḥ / śannodevyā jalaṃ kṣiptvā tilosīti tilānkṣaghipet
uśanta ityṛcāvāhya pitṝnvipraḥ samāhitaḥ / yā divyā iti mantreṇa dadyādarghyaṃ ca pūrvavat
gandhaiśca patrapuṣpaiśca dhūpairdīpaiśaaca sattama / vāsorbhibhūṣaṇaiśvaiva yathāvibhavamarcayet
tato 'nnāgraṃ samādāya ghṛtayuktaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ / agnau kariṣya ityuktvā tebhyo 'nujñāṃ samāharet
karavai karavāṇīti cāpṛṣṭā brāhmaṇā mune / kuruṣva kriyatāṃ veti kurviti brūyureva ca
upāsanāgnimādhāya svagṛhyoktavidhānataḥ / sāmāya ca pitṛmate svadhā nama itīrayet
agnaye kavyavāhanāya svadhā nama itīha vā / svāhāntenāpi vā prājño juhuyātpitṛyajñavat
ābhyāmevāhutibhyāṃ tu pitṝṇāṃ tṛtpirakṣayā / agnyabhāve tu viprasya pāṇau homo vidhīyate
yathācāraṃ prakurvīta pāṇāvagnau ca vā dvija / nahyagnirdūragaḥ kāryaḥ pārvaṇe samupasthaite
saṃdhāyāgniṃ tataḥ kāryaṃ kṛtvā taṃ visṛjetkṛtī / yadyāgnirdūrago vipra pārvaṇe samupasthite
bhrātṛbhiḥ kārayecchrāddhaṃ sāgnikairvidhivaddvijaiḥ / kṣayāhe caiva saṃprātpe svasyāgnirdūrago yadi
tathaiva bhrātarastatra laukikāgnāvapi sthitāḥ / upāsanāngau dūrasthe samīpebhrātari sthaite
yadyagnau juhuyādvāpi pāṇau vā sa hi pātakī / upāsanāgnā dūrasthe kecidicchanti vai dvijāḥ
tacchaṣa viprapātreṣu vikiretsaṃsmaranharim / bhakṣyairbhojyaiśaaca lehyaiśca svādyairviprānprapūjayat
annatyāgaṃ tataḥ kuryyādubhayatra samāhitaḥ / āgacchantu mahābhāgāviśvedevā mahābalāḥ
ye yatra vihitāḥ śrāddhe sāvadhānāṃ bhavantu te / iti saṃprārthayeddevānye devāsa ṛcā nu vai
tathāsaṃprārthayadviprānye ca heti ṛcā pitṝn / amūrtānāṃ mūrtānāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ dītpatejasām
namasyāmi sadā teṣāṃ dhvānināṃ yogacajakṣuṣām / evaṃ pitṝnnamaskṛtya nārāyaṇa parāyaṇaḥ
dattaṃ haviśca tatkarṇa viṣṇave vinivedayet / tataste brāhmaṇāḥ sarve bhuñjīranvāgyatā dvijāḥ
hasato vadate ko 'pi rākṣaghasaṃ tadbhaveddhaviḥ / yathaācāra pradeyaṃ ca madhunāṃsādikaṃ tathā
pākādiṃ ca praśaṃseran vāgyatā dhṛtabhaghājanāḥ / yadi pātraṃ tyajetko 'pi brāhmaṇaḥ śrāddhayojitaḥ
śrāddhahṝntā sa vijñeyo narakāyopapadyate / bhañjāneṣu ca vipreṣu hyanyonyaṃ saṃspuśedyadi
tadannamatyajanbhuktvā gāyatryaṣṭaśataṃ japet / bhujyamāneṣu vipreṣu karttā śraddhāparāyaṇaḥ
smarennārāyaṇaṃ devamanantamaparājitam / rakṣoghnānvaiṣṇavāṃścaiva paitṛkāṃścaviśeṣataḥ
japecca pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ nāciketatrayaṃ tathā / trimadhu trisuparṇaṃ ca pāvamānaṃ yajūṃṣi ca
sāmānyapitathoktāni vadetpuṇyapradāṃ stathā / itihāsapurāṇāni dharmaśāstrāṇi caiva hi
bhuñjīranbrahmaṇā yāvattāvadetāñjapeddvija / brāhmaṇeṣu ca bhukteṣu vikiraṃ vikṣipettathā
śeṣamannaṃ vadeccaiva madhusūktaṃ ca vai japet / svayaṃ ca pādau prakṣaghālya samyagācamya nārada
ācānteṣu ca vipreṣu piṇḍaṃ nirvāpayettataḥ / svastivā canakaṃ kuryādakṣayyodakameva ca
dattvā samāhitaḥ kuryāttathā viprābhivādanam / acālayitvā pātraṃ tu svasti kurvanti ye dvijāḥ
vatsaraṃ pitarasteṣāṃ bhavantyucchiṣṭabhojinaḥ / dātāro no 'bhivarddhantāmityādyaiḥ smṛtibhāṣitaiḥ
āśīrvaco labhettebhyo namaskāraṃ carettataḥ / dadyācca dakṣiṇāṃ śaktyā tāṃbūlaṃ gandhasaṃyutam
nyubjapātramathānīya svadhākāramudīrayet / vājevāje iti ṛcā pitṝndevānvisarjayet
bhoktā ca śrāddhakṛttasyāṃ rajanyāṃ maithunaṃ tyajet / tathā svādhyāyamadhvānaṃ prayatnena parityajet
adhvagaścāturaścaiva vihīnaśca dhanaistathā / āmaśrāddhaṃ prakurvīta hemnā vāstṛśyabhāryakaḥ
dravyābhāve dvijābhāve hyannamātraṃ ca pācayet / paitṛkena tu sūktena homaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ
atyanta havyaśūnyaścaitsvaśaktyā tu tṛṇaṃ gavām / snātvā ca vidhivadvipra kuryādvā tilataparṇam
athavā rodanaṃ kuryādatyuccairvijane vane / daridro 'haṃ mahāpāpī vadanniti vicakṣaṇaḥ
paredyuḥ śrāddhakṛnmartyo yo na tarpayate pitṝn / tatkulaṃ nāśamāyāti brahmahatyāṃ ca vindati
śrāddhaṃ kurvanti ye martyāḥ śraddhāvanto munīśvara / na teṣāṃ saṃtaticchedaḥ saṃpannāste bhavanti ca
pitṝnyañjati yeṃ śrāddhe taistu viṣṇuḥ prapūjitaḥ / tasmiṃstuṣṭe jagannāthe sarvāstuṣyanti devatāḥ
pitaro devatāścaiva gandharvāpsarasastathā / yakṣāśca siddhā manujā harireva sanātanaḥ
yenedamakhilaṃ jātaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam / tasmāddātā ca bhoktā ca sarvaṃ viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ
yadasti vipra yannāsti dṛśyaṃ cādṛśyameva ca / sarvaṃ viṣṇumayaṃ jñeyaṃ tasmādanyanna vidyate
ādhārabhūto viśvasya sarvabhūtātmako 'vyayaḥ / anaupamyasvabhāvaśca bhagavānhavyakavyabhuk
parabrahmābhidheyo ya eka eva janārdanaḥ / karttā kārayitā caiva sarvaṃ viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ
ityevaṃ te muniśreṣṭha śrāddhāsya vidhiruttamaḥ / kathitaḥ kurvatāmevaṃ pāpaṃ sadyo vilīyate
ya idaṃ paṭhate bhaktyā śrāddhakāle dvijottamaḥ / pitarastasya tuṣyanti saṃtatiścaiva varddhate

iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde śrāddhakriyāvarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sanaka uvāca tithīnāṃ nirṇayaṃ vakṣye prācaścittavidhiṃ tathā / śṛṇuṣva tanmuniśreṣṭha karmasiddhiryato bhavet
śrautaṃ smārttaṃ vrataṃ dānaṃ yaccānyatkarma vaidikam / anirṇītāsu tithiṣu na kiñcitphalati dvija
ekādaśyaṣṭamī ṣaṣṭī paurṇamāsī caturddaśī / amāvāsyā tṛtīyā ca hyupavāsavratādiṣu
paraviddhāḥ praśastāḥ syurna grāhyāḥ pūrvasaṃyutāḥ / nāgaviddhā tu yā ṣaṣṭī śivaviddhā tu satpamī
daśamyekādaśīviddhā nopoṣyāḥ syuḥ kadācana / darśaṃ ca paurṇamāsīṃ ca satpamīṃ pitṛvāsaram
pūrvaviddhaṃ prakurvāṇo narakāyopadyate / kṛṣṇapakṣe pūrvaviddhāṃ satpamīṃ ca caturdaśīm
praśastāṃ kecidāhuśca tṛtīyāṃ navamīṃ tathā / vratādīnāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ śuklapakṣo viśiṣyate
aparāhnācca pūrvohṇaṃ grāhyaṃ śreṣṭhattaraṃ yataḥ / asaṃbhave vratādīnāṃ yadi paurvāhnikī tithiḥ
muhūrtadvitayaṃ grāhyaṃ bhagavatyudite ravau / pradoṣavyāpinī grāhyā tithirnaktavrate sadā
upoṣitavyaṃ nakṣatraṃ yenāstaṃ yāti bhāskaraḥ / tithinakṣatrasaṃyogavihitavratakarmaṇi
pradoṣavyāpinī grāhyā tvanyathā niṣphalaṃ bhavet / arddharātrādadho yā tu nakṣatravyāpinī tithiḥ
saiva grāhyā muniśreṣṭha nakṣatravihitavrate / yadyarddharātraghagayorvyātpaṃ nakṣatraṃ tu dinadvaye
tatpuṇyaṃ tithisaṃyuktaṃ nakṣatraṃ grāhyamucyate / arddharātradvaye syātāṃ nakṣatraṃ ca tithiryadi
kṣaye pūrvā praśastā syādrṛddhau kāryā tathottarā / ardhdarātradvayavyātpā tithirnakṣatraghasaṃyutā
hnāsavṛddhiviśūnyā cet grāhyāpūrvā tathā parā / jyeṣṭhāsaṃmiśritaṃ mūlaṃ rohiṇī vahniṃsaṃyutā
maitreṇa saṃyutā jyeṣṭā saṃtānādivināśainī / tataḥ syustithayaḥ puṇyāḥ karmānuṣṭānato divā
rātrivrateṣu sarveṣu rātriyogo viśiṣyate / tithirnakṣaghatrayogena yā puṇyā parikīrtitā
tasyāṃ tu tadvataṃ kāryaṃ saiva kāryā vicakṣaṇaiḥ / udayavyāpinī grāhyā śravaṇadvādaśī vrate
sūryendugrahaṇe yāvattāvad grāhyā japādiṣu / saṃkrāntiṣu tu sarvāsu puṇyakālonigadyate
snānadānajapādīnāṃ kurvatāmakṣaya phalam / tatra karkaṭako jñeyo dakṣiṇāyanasaṃkramaḥ
pūrvato ghaṭikāstriṃśatpuṇyakālaṃ vidurbudhāḥ / vṛṣabhe vṛścike caiva siṃhe kumbhe tathaiva ca
pūrvamaṣṭamuhūrtāstu grāhyāḥ snānajapādiṣu / tulāyāṃ caiva meṣe ca pūrvataḥ paratastathā
jñeyā daśaiva ghaṭikā dattasyākṣayatāvahāḥ / kanyāyāṃ mithune caiva mīne dhanuṣi ca dvija
ghaṭikāḥ ṣoḍaśa jñeyā parataḥ puṇyadāyikāḥ / mākaraṃ saṃkramaṃ prāhuruttarāyaṇasaṃjñakam
parāstriṃśaśca ghaṭikāścatvāriṃśacca pūrvavat / ādityaśītakiraṇau grāhyāvastaṅgatau yadi
snātvā bhuñjīta viprendra paredyuḥ śuddhamaṇḍalam / dṛṣṭacandrā sinīvālī naṣṭacandrā kuhūḥ smṛtā
amāvāsyā dvidhā proktā vidvadbhirdharmālipsubhiḥ / sinīvālīṃ dvijairgrāhyā sāgnikaiḥ śrāddhakarmaṇi
kahūḥ strībhistathā śūdraipari vānagrikaistathā / aparāhnadvayavyāpinyamāvāsyātithiryadi
kṣaye pūrvā tu karttavyā vṛddhau kāryā tathottarā / amāvāsyā pratītā cenmadhyāhnātparato yadi
bhūtaviddheti vikhyātāsradbhiḥ śāstraviśāradaiḥ / atyantakṣayapakṣe tu paredyurnāparāhnagā
tatra grāhyā sinīvālī sāyāhnavyāpinī tithiḥ / arvācīnakṣaye cacaiva sāyāhnavyāpinī tathā
sinīvālī parā grāhyā sarvathā śrāddhakarmaṇi / atyantatithivṛddhau tu bhūtaviddhāṃ parityajet
grāhyā syādaparāhnasthā kuhūḥ paitṛkakarmaṇi / yathārvācīnavṛddhau tu saṃtyājyā bhūtasaṃyutāḥ
paredyurvibudhaśreṣṭhaiḥ kuhūrgrāhyā parāhnagā / madhyāhnadvitaye vyātpā hyamāvāsyā tithiryadi
tatrecchayā ca saṃgrāhyā pūrvā vātha parāthavā / anvādhānaṃ pravakṣyāmi saṃtaḥ saṃpūrṇavarvaṇi
pratipaddivase kuryādyāgaṃ ca munisattama / parvaṇo yaścaturthāṃśa ādyāḥ pratipadastrayaḥ
yāgakālaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ prātarukto manīṣibhiḥ / madhyāhnadvitaye syātāmamāvāsyā ca pūrṇimā
paredyureva viprendra sadyaḥ kālo vidhīyate
pūrvadvaye paredyuḥ syātsaṃgavātparato manīṣibhiḥ / sadyaḥ kālaḥ paredyuḥ syājjñeyamevaṃ tithikṣaye
sarvairekādaśī grāhyā daśamīparivarjitā / daśamīsaṃyutā hṝntipuṇyaṃ janmatrayārjitam
ekādaśī kalāmātrā dvādaśyāṃ tu pratīyate / dvādaśī ca trayodaśyāmasti cetsā parā smṛtā
saṃpūrṇaikādaśī śuddhā dvādaśyāṃ ca pratīyate / traghayodaśī ca rātryante tatra vakṣyāmi nirṇayam
pūrvā gṛhasthaiḥ sā kāryyā hyuttarā yatibhistathā / gṛhasthāḥ siddhimicchanti yato mokṣaṃ yatīśvarāḥ
dvādaśyāṃ tu kalāyāṃ vā yadi labhyeta pāraṇā / tadānīṃ daśamīviddhāpyupoṣyaikādaśī tithiḥ
śulke vā yadi vā kṛṣṇe bhavedekādaśīdvayam / gṛhasthānāṃ tu pūrvoktā yatīnāmuttarā smṛtā
dvādaśyāṃ vidyate kiñciddaśamīsaṃyutā yadi / dinakṣaye dvitīyaiva sarveṣāṃ parikīrtitāṃ
viddhāpyekādaśī grāhyā parato dvādaśī na cet / aviddhāpi niṣiddhaiva parato dvādaśī yadi
ekādaśī dvādaśī ca rātraghiśeṣe trayodaśī / dvādaśadvādaśīpuṇyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇe
ekādaśī kalāmātrā vidyate dvādaśīdine / dvādaśī ca trayodaśyāṃ nāsti vā vidyate 'thavā
vidvāpyekādaśī tatra pūrvā syādgṛhaṇāṃ tadā / yadibhiścottarā grāhyā hyavīrābhistathaiva ca
saṃpūrṇaikādaśī śuddhā dvādaśyāṃ nāsti kiñcana / dvādaśī ca trayodaśayāmasti tatra kathaṃ bhavet
pūrvā gṛhasthaiḥ kāryātra yatibhiścottarā tithiḥ / upoṣyaiva dvitīyeti kecidāhuśca bhaktitaḥ
ekādaśī yadāviddhā dvādaśyāṃ na pratīyate / dvādaśī ca trayodaśyāmasti tatraiva cāpare
upoṣyā dvādaśī śuddhā sarvaireva na saṃśayaḥ / kecidāhuśca pūrvāṃ tu tanmataṃ na samañjasam
saṃkrātau ravivāre ca pātagrahaṇayostathā / pāraṇaṃ copavāsaṃ ca na kuryātputravāngṛhī
arke 'hni parvarātraghau ca caturdaśyaṣṭamī divā / ekādaśyāmahorātraṃ bhuktvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret
ādityagrahaṇe prātpe pūrvayāmatraye tathā / nādyādvai yadi bhuñjīta surāpena samo bhavet
anvādhāneṣṭimadhye tu grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ / prāyaścittaṃ muniśreṣṭha karttavyaṃ tatra yājñikaiḥ
cadroparāge juhuyāddaśame soma ityṛcā / āpyāyasva ṛcā caiva somapāsta iti dvija
sūryoparāge juhuyādudutyaṃ jātavedasam / āsatyeṃnodvayaṃ caiva trayomantrā udāhṛtāḥ
evaṃ tithiṃ viniścitya smṛtimārgeṇa paṇḍitaḥ / yaḥ karoti vratādīni tasya syādakṣayaṃ phalam
vedapraṇihito dharmo dharmaistuṣyati keśavaḥ / tasmāddharmaparā yānti tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam
dharmānye karttumicchanti te vai kṛṣṇasvarupiṇaḥ / tasmāttāṃstu bhavavyādhiḥ kadācinnaiva bādhate

iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde tithyādinirṇayo nāma ekonatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sanaka uvāca prāyaścittavidhiṃ vakṣye śṛṇu nārada sāṃpratam / prāyaścittaviśuddhātmā sarvakarmaphalaṃ labhet
prāyaścittavihīnaistu yatkarma kriyate mune / tatsarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ proktaṃ rākṣasaiḥ parisevitam
kāmakrodhavihīnaiśca dharmaśāstraviśāradaiḥ / praṣṭavyā brāhmaṇā dharmaṃ sarvadharmaphalecchubhiḥ
prāyaścittāni cīrṇāni nārāyaṇaparāṅmukhaiḥ / na niṣpunanti viprendra surābhāṇḍamivāpagāḥ
brahmahā ca surāpī ca steyī ca gurutalpagaḥ / mahāpātakinanastvete tatsaṃsargī ca pañcamaḥ
yastu saṃvatsaraṃ hyataiḥ śayanāsanabhojanaiḥ / saṃvasetsaha taṃ vidyātpatitaṃ sarvakarmasu
ajñānādvāhmaṇaṃ hatvā cīravāsā jaṭī bhavet / svenaiva hataviprasya kapālamapi dhārayet
tadabhāve muniśraṣṭa kapālaṃ vānyameva vā / taddravyaṃ dhvajadaṇḍe tu dhṛtvā vanacaro bhavet
vanyāhāro vasetatra vāramekaṃ mitāśanaḥ / samyaksaṃdhyāmupāsīta trikālaṃ snānamācaret
adhyayanādhyāpanādūnvarjayetsaṃsmareddharim / brahmacārī bhavennityaṃ gandhamālyādi varjayet
tīrthānyanuvaseccaiva puṇyāścāvāśramāṃstathā / yadi vanyairna jīveta grāme bhikṣāṃ samācaret
dvādaśābdaṃ vrataṃ kuryādevaṃ hariparāyaṇaḥ / brahmahā śuddhimānpoti karmārhaścaiva jāyate
vratamadhye mṛgairvāpi rogairvāpi niṣūditaḥ / gonimittaṃ dvijārthaṃ vā prāṇānvāpi parityajet
yadvā dadyāddvijendrāṇāṃ gavāmayutamuttasam / eteṣvanyatamaṃ kṛtvā brahmahā śuddhimānpuyāt
dīkṣitaṃ kṣatriyaṃ hatvā careddhi brahmahavratam / agnipraveśanaṃ vāpi marutprapatanaṃ tathā
dīkṣītaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ hatvā dviguṇaṃ vratamācaret / ācāryādivadhe caiva vratamuktaṃ caturguṇam
hatvā tu vipramātraṃ ca caretsaṃvatsaraṃ vratam / evaṃ viprasya gaditaḥ prāyaścittavidhirdvija
/ dviguṇaṃ kṣatriyasyoktaṃ triguṇaṃ tu viśaḥ smṛtam / brāhmaṇaṃ hṝnti yaḥ śūdrastaṃ muśalyaṃ virdurbudhāḥ
rājñaiva śikṣā kartavyā iti śāsteṣu niścayaḥ / brāhmaṇīnāṃ vadhe tvarddhaṃ pādaḥ syātkanyakāvadhe
hatvā tvanupanītāṃśca tathā pādavrataṃ caret / hatvā tu kṣatriyaṃ vipraḥ ṣaḍabdaṃ kucchramācaret
saṃvatsaraṃ trayaṃ veśyaṃ śūrdraṃ hatvā tu vatsaram / dīkṣitasya striyaṃ hatvā brāhmaṇī cāṣṭavatsarān
brahmahatyāvrataṃ kṛtvā śuddho bhavati niścitam / prāvaścittaṃ vidhānaṃ tu sarvatra munisattama
vṛddhāturastrībālānāmarddhamuktaṃ manīṣibhiḥ / gauḍī paiṣṭī ca mādhvī ca vijñeyā trividhā surā
cāturvarṇyārapeyā syāttathā strībhiśca nārada / kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ vā gomūtrameteṣvanyatamaṃ mune
snātvardravāsā niyato nārāyaṇamanusmaran / pakvāyasanibhaṃ kṛtvā pibejcaivodakaṃ tataḥ
tattu lauhena pātreṇa hyāyasenāthavā pibet / tāmreṇa vāthaṃ pātreṇa tatpītvā maraṇaṃ vrajet
surāpī śuddhimānpoti nānyathā śuddhiriṣyate / ajñānādātmabuddyā tu surāṃ pītvā dvijaścaret
brahmahatyāvrataṃ samyaktaccihnaparivarjitaḥ / yadi rogānivṛttyarthamauṣadhārthaṃ surāṃ pibet
tasyopanayanaṃ bhūyastathā cāndrāyaṇadvayam / surāsaṃspṛṣṭapātraṃ tu surābhāṇḍodakaṃ tathā
surāpānasamaṃ prāhustathā candrasya bhakṣaṇam / tālaṃ ca pānasaṃ caiva drākṣaṃ khārjūrasaṃbhavam
mādhuka śailamāriṣṭaṃ maireyaṃ nālikerajam / gauḍī mādhvī surā madyamevamekādaśa smṛtāḥ
eteṣvanyatamaṃ vipro na pibedvai kadācana / eteṣvanyatamaṃ yastu pivedajñānato dvijaḥ
tasyopanayanaṃ bhūyastatpakṛcchraṃ carettathā / samakṣaṃ vā parokṣaṃ vā balāccauyaṇa vā tathā
parasvānāmupādānaṃ steyamityucyate budhaiḥ / suvarṇasya pramāṇaṃ tu manvādyaiḥ paribhāṣitam
vakṣye śṛṇuṣva viprendra prāyaścajitoktisādhanam / gavākṣāgatamārtaṇḍaraśmimadhye pradṛśyate
trasareṇupramāṇaṃ tu raja ityucyate budhaiḥ / trasareṇvaṣṭakaṃ niṣkastatrayaṃ rājasarṣapaḥ
maurasarṣapastartrayaṃ syāttatṣaṭkaṃ yava ucyate / yavatrayaṃ kṛṣṇalaḥ syānmāṣastatpañcakaṃ smṛtaḥ
māṣaṣoḍaṣamānaṃ syātsuvarṇamiti nārada / hatvā brahmasvamajñānāddvādaśāṃbdaṃ tu pūrvavat
kapāladhvajahīnaṃ tu brahmahatyāvrataṃ caret / guruṇāṃ yajñakatṝṇāṃ dhārmiṣṭānāṃ tathaiva ca
śrotriyāṇāṃ dvijānāṃ tu hṛtvā hemaivamācaret / kṛtānutāpo dehe ca saṃpūrṇe lepayed dhṛtam
karīṣacchādito dagdhaḥ steyapāpādvimucyate / brahmasvaṃ kṣatriyo hṛtvā paścāttāpamavāpya ca
punardadāti tatraiva tadvidhānaṃ śṛṇuṣva me / tatra sāṃtapanaṃ kṛtvā dvādaśāhopavāsataḥ
śuddhimāpnoti devarṣe hyanyathā patito bhavet / rantāsanamanuṣyastrīdhenubhūmyādikeṣu ca
suvarṇasahṛśeṣveṣu prāyaścitārddhamucyate / trasareṇusamaṃ hema hṛtvā kuryātsamāhitaḥ
prāṇāyāmadvayaṃ samyak tena śuddhaccati mānavaḥ / prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kuryāddhṛtvā niṣkapramāṇakam
prāṇāyāmāśca catvāro rājasarṣa pamātrake / gaurasarṣapamānaṃ tu hṛtvā hema vicakṣaṇaḥ
snātvā ca vidhivajjapyādgāyatryaṣṭasahasrakam / yavamātrasuvarṇasya steyācchuddho bhaveddijaḥ
āsāyaṃ prātarārabhya japtvā vai vedamātaram / hema kṛṣṇalamātraṃ tu hṛtvā sāṃtapanaṃ caret
māṣapramāṇe hemnastu prāyaścittaṃ nigadyate / gomūtrapakvayavabhugvarṣeṇaikena śuddhyati
saṃpūrṇasya suvarṇasya steyaṃ kṛtvā munīśvara / brahmahatyāvrataṃ kuryāddvādaśābdaṃ samāhitaḥ
suvarṇamānānnyūne tu rajatasteyakarmaṇi / kuryātsāṃtapanaṃ samyaganyathā patito bhavet
daśaniṣkāntaparyantamūrddhūṃ niṣkacatuṣṭayāt / hatvā ca rajataṃ vidvānkuryāccāndrāyaṇaṃ mune
daśādiśatiṣkāntaṃ yaḥ steyī rajatasya tu / cāndrāyaṇadvayaṃ tasya proktaṃ pāpaviśodhakam
śatādūrddhūṃ sahasrāntaṃ proktaṃ cāndrāyaṇatrayam / sahasrādadhikasteye brahmahatyāvrataṃ caret
kāṃsyapittalamukhyeṣu hyayaskānte tathaiva ca / sahasraniṣkamāne tu parākaṃ parikīrtitam
prāyaścittaṃ tu rantānāṃ steye rājatavatsmṛtam / gurutalpagatānāṃ ca prāyaścittamudīryate
ajñānānmātaraṃ gatvā tatsapatnīmathāpi vā / svayameva svamuṣkaṃ tu cchindyātpāpamudīrayan
haste gṛhītvā muṣkaṃ tu gacchandvai naiṛtīṃ diśam / gacchanmārgai sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ na kadācidvicārayet
apaśyangacchato gacchetpāṇāntaṃ yaḥ sa śuddhyati / marutprapatanaṃ vāpi kuryātpāpamudāharan
svavarṇottamavarṇastrīgamane tvavicārataḥ / brāhmahatyāvrataṃ kuryādvādaśābdaṃ samāhitaḥ
amatyābhyāsato gacchetsavarṇāṃ cottamāṃ tathā / kārīṣavahninā dagdhaḥ śuddhiṃ yāti dvijottama
retaḥsekātpūrvameva nivṛtto yadi mātari / brahmahatyāvrataṃ kuryādretaḥ seke 'gnidāhanam
savarṇottamavarṇāsu nivṛtto vīryasecanāt / brahmahatyāvrataṃ kuryānnavābdānviṣṇutatparaḥ
vaiśyāyāṃ pitṛpatnyāṃ tu ṣaḍabdaṃ vratamācaret / gatvā śūdvāṃ gurorbhāryāṃ trivarṣaṃ vratamācaret
mātṛṣvasāraṃ ca pitṛṣvasāramācāryabhāryāṃ śvaśurasya patnīm / pitṛvyabhāryāmatha mātulānīṃ putrīṃ ca gacchedyadi kāmamugdhaḥ
dinadvaye brahmahatyāvrataṃ kuryādyathāvidhi / ekasminneva divase bahuvāraṃ trivārṣikam
ekavāraṃ gate hyabdaṃvrataṃ kṛtvā viśuddhyati / dinatraye gate vahnidagdhaḥ śudhyeta nānyathā
cāñjālīṃ puṣkasīṃ caiva snuṣāṃ ca bhaginīṃ tathā / mitrastriyaṃ śiṣyapatnīṃ yastu vai kāmato vrajet
brahmahatyāvrataṃ kuryātsa ṣaḍabdaṃ munīśvara / akāmato vrajedyastu so 'bdakṛcchraṃ samācaret
mahāpātakisaṃsarge prāyaścittaṃ nigadyate / prāyaścittaviśuddhātmā sarvakarmaphalaṃ labhet
yasya yena bhavetsaṃgo brahmahāndicaturṣvapi / tattadvrataṃ sa nivrartya śuddhimānpotyasaṃśayam
ajñānātpañcarātraṃ tu saṃgamebhiḥ karotiyaḥ / kāyakṛcchraṃ caretsamyaganyathā patito bhavet
dvādaśāhetu saṃsarge mahāsāṃtapanaṃ smṛtam / saṃgaṅkṛtvārddhamāsaṃ tu dvādaśāhamupāvaset
parāko māsasaṃsarge cāndramāsatrayesmṛtam / kṛtvā saṃgaṃ tu ṣaṇmāsaṃ careccāndrāyaṇadvayam
kiñcinnyūnābdasaṃge tu ṣaṇmāsavratamācaret / etacca triguṇaṃ proktaṃ jñānātsaṃge yathākramam
maṇḍūkaṃ nakulaṃ kākaṃ varāhaṃ mūṣakaṃ tathā / mārjārājāvikaṃ śvānaṃ hatvā kukkuṭakaṃ tathā
kṛcchrārddhamācaredvipro 'tikṛcchraṃ cāśvaha caret / jatpakṛcchraṃ karivadhe parākaṃ govadhe smṛtam
kāmato govadhe naiva śuddhirddaṣṭā manīṣibhiḥ / pānaśayyāsanādyeṣu puṣpamūlaphaleṣu ca
bhakṣyabhojyāpahāreṣu pañcagavyaviśodhanam / śuṣkakāṣṭatṛṇānāṃ ca drumāṇāṃ ca guḍasya ca
carmavastrāmiṣāṇāṃ ca trirātraṃ syādabhojanam / ṭiṭṭibhaṃ cakravākaṃ ca haṃsaṃ kāraṇḍavaṃ tathā
ulūkaṃ sārasaṃ caiva pakotaṃ jalapādakam / śukaṃ cāṣaṃ balākaṃ ca śiśumāraṃ ca kacchapam
eteṣvanyatamaṃ hatvā dvādaśāhamabhojanam / prājāpatyavrataṃ kuryādretoviṇmūtrabhojane
cāndrāyaṇatrayaṃ proktaṃ śūdrocchiṣṭasya bhojane / rajasvalāṃ ca cāṇḍālaṃ mahāpātakinaṃ tathā
sūtikāṃ patitaṃ caiva ucchiṣṭaṃ rajakādikam / spṛṣṭvā sacailaṃ snāyīta ghṛtaṃ saṃprāśeyattathā
gāyatrīṃ ca viśuddhātmā japedaṣṭaśataṃ dvija / eteṣvanyatamaṃ spṛṣṭvā ajñānādhadyadi bhojane
