ādyantakālayormadhye kālo jñeyo 'tidāruṇaḥ / prajvalajjvalanākāraḥ sarvakarmasu garhitaḥ
ityetadgaṇito kiñcitproktaṃ saṃkṣepato dvija / jātakaṃ vācmi samayādrāśisaṃjñāpuraḥsaram

iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne dvitīyapāde jyotiṣavarṇanaṃ nāma catuḥpañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ sanantana uvāca mūrddhāsyabāhuhṛtkroḍāntarbastivyañjasonakhaḥ / jānujaṅghāṅghniyugalaṃ kālāṅgāni kriyādayaḥ
bhaumāsphujibudhenduśca ravisaumyasitāḥ kujaḥ / gurumandārkiguravo meṣādīnāmadhīśvarāḥ
hore viṣamabherkedoḥ samaye śaśisūryayoḥ / ādipañcanavādhīśādreṣkāṇeśāḥ prakīrtitāḥ
pañceṣṭāṣṭādripañcāṃśā kujārkījyajñaśukragāḥ / oje viparyayādyugme triśāṃśeśāḥ samīritāḥ
kriyaṇataulikarkādyā meṣādiṣu navāṃśakāḥ / svabhāddvādaśabhāgeśāḥ ṣarḍgaṃ rāśipūrvakam
gojāśca karkayugmena rātryākhyā pṛṣṭakodayāḥ / śeṣā dinākhyāstūbhayaṃ timiḥ krūraḥ saumyaḥ pumān
pumān srī ca klībaścarasthiradviḥsvabhāvakāḥ / meṣādyāḥ pūrvatodiksthāḥ svasvasthānacarāstathā
ajokṣeṇāṅganākīṭajhaṣajūkā ināditaḥ / uccāni dvitrimanuyuktithīṣubhanakhāṃśakaiḥ
tattatsaptamanīcāni prāṅmadhyāntyāṃśakāḥ kramāt / vargottamāścarādheṣu bhāvāddvādaśa mūrtimān
siṃhokṣāvisraścatau likubhāḥ sūryātrikoṇabham / caturasraṃ tūryamṛtyutrikoṇaṃ navapañcamam
riḥphaāṣṭaṣaṭkaṃ trikabhaṃ kendraṃ prākturyasaptakham / nṛpādaḥ kīṭapaśavo balāḍhyāḥ kendragāḥ kramāt
kendrātparaṃ paṇapharamāpoklimamataḥ param / raktaḥ śvetaḥ śukanibhaḥ pāṭalo dhūmrapāṇḍurau
citraḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pītapiṅgau babhruḥ svacchaḥ prabhākriyāt / sāmyāśākhyaplavatvaṃ syāddvitīye vaśirarkabhāt
kālātmārke manaścadraḥ kujaḥ satvaṃ vacobudhaḥ / jīvo jñānaṃ sukhaṃ śukraḥ kāmo duḥkhaṃ dineśajaḥ
nṛpau ravīndū netāsṛk kumāro jñaḥ kavījyakau / sacivo sūryajaḥ preṣyo mato jyotirvidāṃ varaiḥ
tāmraśuklaraktaharitpītacitrāsitā raveḥ / varṇā va avyahaharīdrā śacīkaudhipāraveḥ
raviśukrārarāhvarkenduvidījyā digīśvarāḥ / kṣīṇendvarkāraravijāḥ pāpā pāpayuto budhaḥ
klibau budhārkī śukrendū sriyau śeṣā narāḥ smṛtāḥ / śikhibhūmipayovārivāsino bhūsutādayaḥ
kavījyau kujasūryauṃ ca vedo jño varṇapāḥ kramāt / saurāeṃ'tyajādhipaḥ prokto rāhurmlecchādhipastathā
candrārkajīvājñasitau kujārkī sāttvikādikāḥ / devatendvagniraivalābhūkosakhāyoparādhipāḥ
vasraṃ sthalaṃ navaṃ vahnikahataṃ madyadaṃ tathā / sphuṭitaṃ ravitastāṃmraṃ tāre tāmrapunistathā
hemakāṃsyāyasī tryaṃśaiḥśiśirādyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ / sauraśukrāracandrajñaguruṣūdyatsu ca kramāt
tryāśatrikoṇaturyāṣṭasaptamānyena vṛddhitaḥ / saurejyārāpare pūrṇe kramātpaśyanti nārada
ayanakṣaṇaghasrartumāsārddhaśarado raveḥ / kaṭutiktakṣāramiśramadhurāmlakaṣāyakāḥ
trikoṇātsāṃtyadhādharmāyuḥ sukhakhodyapaḥ suhṛt / jīvo jīvajñau sitajñau vyarkā vyārāḥ kramādamī
vīndvarkā vikujendvarkāḥ suhṛdo 'nyeraverdhṛtāḥ / mithodhanavyayāyatribandhuvyāpāragaḥ suhṛt
dhyekānubhaktā mayān jñātvā miśrīdītsahajānmune / matkālodhisuhṛnmitrapūrvakānkalpayetpunaḥ
svoccatrikoṇagehā pranavāṃśaisthānajaṃ balam / dikṣu saumyejyayoḥ sūryārayoḥ saure sitābjayoḥ
ravāhṛtūdaganenye tu vakri ca samāgame / uttarasthā dīptakarāśceṣṭā vīryayutā matāḥ
niśīndukujasaurāśca sarvadā kṣohni cāpare / krūrāḥ kṛṣṇe site saumyāḥ mataṃ kālabalaṃ budhaiḥ
saurārajñejyaśukrendusūryādhikyaṃ parasparam / pāpāstu balinaḥ saumyā vivakṣāḥ kaṇṭakopage
klībe tadūśanādvāpi candrārkāṃśasamaṃ januḥ / svāṃśe pāpāḥ parāṃśasthāḥ saumyālagnaṃ viyonijam
nirbalaṃ ca tadādeśyaṃ viyonerjanma paṇḍitaiḥ / śīrṣaṃ vakragale pādāvaṃsau pṛṣṭamurastathā
pārśve kukṣī tvapānāṅghrī meḍhramuṣkau tathā sphijau / pucchaṃ catuṣpadāṅgeṣu meṣādyā rāśayaḥ smṛtāḥ
lagnāṃśādgrahayugdṛṣṭvā varṇānbalayutādvadet / dṛksamānapramāṇāṃśca iṣṭe rekhāṃ smarasthitaiḥ
khagatryaṃśe balāgnege caramāṃśe grahānvite / vāṃśe sthalāṃbujaḥ saurerdvīkṣāyogabhavā dvijāḥ
vipralaistanujacandrejyārkaistarūṇāṃ janiṃ vadet / sthalāṃbubhendośakṛtaścetareṣāmudāhṛtaḥ
sthalāṃbu ca patiḥ kheṭo lagnādyāvanmite gṛhe / tāvanta eva takhaḥ sthalajā jalajāstathā
antaḥsārā ravau saure durbhagāḥ kṣīriṇo vidhau / bhaume kaṇṭakino vṛkṣā ījye jñe saphalāphalau
puṣpitā bhārgave snigdhāścandre 'tha kaṭukāḥ kuje / aśubharkṣe śubhaḥ kheṭaḥ śubhaṃ vṛkṣaṃ kubhūmijam
kuryādvilomago vāpi svāṃśoktaparagaiḥ samam / kujenduhetukaṃ srīṇāṃ pratimāsamihārtavam
neṣṭasthejye 'nyathāste srīyuṅktāsannarekṣite / pāpayuktekṣite dyūne ruṣā prītyā śubhagrahaiḥ
śukrārkendujaiḥ svāṃśasthairījya cāṅgatrikoṇage / bhavedapatyaṃ viprendra puṃsāṃ sadvīryaśālinām
asrer'kendo kujārkī cetpuṃsriyorāmayapradau / vyayakhago yuktau caikadṛṣṭyā nṛtyupradau tayoḥ
śukrārkrau mātṛpitarau divā naktaṃ śaśīnajau / mātṛṣvasṛpitṛvyākhyau vā padmeji same śubhau
pāpadṛṣṭe śubhe kṣīṇe tuṅge vā lagnageyame / kṣīṇendukujasaṃdṛṣṭe mṛtyumetya gatā dhruvam
yugapadvā pṛthaksasthau lagnendū pāpamadhyagau / yadā tadā garbhayutā nārī mṛtyumavāpnuyāt
lagnāṃñcadrācca turyasthaiḥ pāpairnidhanage kuje / naṣṭendau kujaravyośca bandhuriṣpagayormṛtiḥ
tanvastasaṃsthayorbhauṃmaravyoḥ śasrabhavaḥ kṣayaḥ / yanmāsādhipatirnaṣṭastanmāsaṃ saṃsrave tyajet
lagnendugaiḥ śubhaiḥ kheṭaisrikoṇārthāstabhūkhagaiḥ / pāpaisriṣaṣṭalābhasthaiḥ sukhī garbho ravīkṣitaḥ
ojabhe puruṣāṃśer'kejyendulagnairbalānvitaiḥ / gurvakārai viṣamasthau vā yuñjanma pravadettadā
yugmabhāṃśasthitaistaistu vakrendubhṛgubhistathā / yāmasthānagatairvācyaṃ sriyo janma manīṣibhiḥ
dvyaṅgasthā budhasaṃdṛṣṭāḥ svapakṣeya malaṅkarāḥ / lagnaṃ vinaujabhāvasthaḥ sauraḥ puñjanmakṛttathā
mitho ravīndūrjñārkī vā paśyataḥ samagaṃ raviḥ / vakro vāṅgavidhū oje jajñau yugmaujasaṃsthitau
kujekṣitepumāṃśeduhitā klība janmadā / same sitendū ojasthā jñārāṅgojyā nṛvīkṣitau
lagnendusamagau yugmasthāne vā yamalaṅkarāḥ / grahodayasthāndyaṅgāṃśānpaśyati jñe svabhāgage
tritayaṃ jñāṃśakādyugmamamiśraiḥ samamādiśet / lagne cāpāntyabhāgasthe tadaṃśasthabaligrahaiḥ
vīryāḍhyajñārkisadṛṣṭaiḥ kośasthāvahavoginaḥ / sitārejyārkacandrārkijñāṅgeśorkendavo 'dhipāḥ
māsānāṃ tatsamaṃ vācyaṃ garbagasthasya śubhāśubham / trikome jñe parairnaṣṭairdvimukhāhnikapānvitaḥ
avāgāvāṭāvaśubhairbhasaṃdhisthaiḥ prajāyate / vīrānsagīścadaṣṭedhvaṣṭārkātabhasaṃhitāḥ
ārārkī cejyabhāṃśasthau sadantogarbhakastadāḥ / kharbheje bhuvimandāradṛṣṭe kubjastu garbhagaḥ / pargurmīne yamedvārairdaṣṭethāṅgebhaghasaṃdhige
pāpairjaḍo vidhau garbhaḥ śubhadṛṣṭivivarjite / mṛgāntyage vāmanakaḥ sauredrarkanirīkṣite / dhīnayodapagaistryaṃśaiḥ pāpāstairasirohradāḥ
ravīnduyukte siṃheṅge māheyārkinirīkṣite / netrahīnā miśrakheṭairdṛṣṭe buddhudalocanāḥ / vyayejo vāmanayanaṃ dakṣaṃ sūryo vināśayet
neṣṭā yogāḥ śubhairdṛṣṭāḥ pāpāḥ syurnātra saṃśayaḥ / mande 'ste mandabhāṃśeṅge niṣaikebdatraye janiḥ
dvādaśābde śaśinyevaṃ sutāvapi vicintayet
ādhānendudvādaśāṃśā pāpāstadrāśibhiḥ puraḥ
śaśāṅke janmabhāgādidvi ghnamiṣṭakalāḥ smṛtāḥ
pituḥ parokṣe janmasyādindau lagnamapaśyati
madhyādbhraṣṭerke videśasthe janane nārijanma vai / mandeṅgasthe kujeste ca jñosphuji madhyage vidhau
pāpāṅgebje tribhāge lau svāyagaiḥ sadbhirudgataḥ / sūryastaddṛṣṭigo vāpi jñeyo jyotirvidāṃ varaiḥ
catuṣpadarkṣage bhānau śerṣaibalayutaiḥ khagaiḥ / kośādatau tu yamalau jāyete munisattama
sārkyārasiṃhojñājāṃse bhāṃśatutyāṅganālayuk / lagnaminduṃ ca sārkenduṃ na paśyati yadā guruḥ
sapāpagor'ke jāyo vā paravīryaprasūtikṛt / pāpabhasthau pāpakheṭaiḥ sūryārghānatrikoṇagau
videśagaḥ pitāvṛddhaḥ khevā rāśivaśātyaye / pūrṇa iṇḍhau svabheśejñe śubhe muvyaṃvuje tanau
dyūnasthe vā vidhau yāteṅganā nārī prasūyate / abdhāṅgamanbhagaḥ pūrṇe jyo vā paśyati nārada
svabaṃlagnagaḥ sūtiḥ salile nātra saṃsayaḥ / pāpadṛṣṭe yame gudyāṃ janmāṅgājavyayasthite
karkātilagnageśaurevaṭe janmābjavīkṣite / mande janmagate lagne budhasūryenduvīkṣite
krīḍāsthāne devagehe pyūṣare ca kramājjaniḥ / śmaśāne lagnadṛgasṛgrāmyasthānebjabhārgavau
agnihotragṛhe jīvor'ke bhūṣābharaṇe gṛhe / śilpālaye budho janma kuryādbalasamanvitaḥ
bhāsamāne sare mārge sthire svarkṣāṃśage gṛhe / trikoṇagaja ārārkyoraste vā sṛjyate 'mbayā
gurudṛṣṭe tu dīrghāyuḥ paraṃ ca prāpyate punaḥ / pāpadṛṣṭe vidhaulagne 'stekuje tu vinaśyati
bhave kujārkyoḥ saṃdṛṣṭe parahastagataḥ sukhī / pāpedyatāyurbhavati māsaḥ sārthaiḥ parairapi
pitṛmātṛgehe janma tadadhīśabalānmune / tarugehe śubhe nīce naikasthadṛṣṭau lagnenduḥ
etallakṣaṇasaṃpannā prasītirvijane tadā / mandarkṣāṃśe vidhau turye mandadṛṣṭe 'bjage 'pi vā
mandārcane vā tamasi śayanaṃ nīcagebhuvi / śīrṣe pṛṣṭodaye janma tadvadeva vinirdiśet
candrāstasukhagaḥ pāpairmātuḥ pīḍāṃ samādiśet / jīrṇoddhṛtaṃ gṛhaṃ mande sṛji dagdhaṃ na vā vidhau
kāṣṭāḍhyamadṛḍhaṃ sūya bahuśilpayutaṃ budhe / citrayuktaṃ navaṃ śukre dṛḍhe ramye gurau gṛham
dhaṭājakarkyalighaṭe pūrve jñejyagṛhe hyudak / vṛṣe paścānmṛge siṃhe dakṣiṇe vasatirbhavet
gṛhaprācyādigau dvau dvau vdyaṅgāḥ koṇeṣvajādayaḥ / parthaṅke vāstuvatpādāsriṣadaṅkāntyarāśayaḥ
candrāgāntaragaiḥ kheṭaiḥ sūtikāḥ samudāhṛtāḥ / cakrāddhi bahirantaśca dṛśyādṛśyopare 'nyathā
lagrāśayasamānāṅgobālikheṭaṃsamopi vā / candranandāṃśavadvarṇaḥ śīrṣādyaṅgavibhāga yuk
śīrṣakaṃ dakśrave nāsā kapolahanavo mukham / kaṇṭhāṃsapārśvahṛddvoṣaḥ kroḍaṃnābhiśca bāstikāḥ
śiṃśnāpāte ca vṛṣaṇau jaghane jānunī tathā / jaṅghepādau cobhaghayatra tryaṃśaiḥ samuditairvadet
pāpayukte vraṇastasminnaṅge lakṣma ca tadyute / svarkṣāṃśe sthirayukte tu naija āgantuko 'nyathā
mande 'nilāśmajo bhaume viṣaśasrāgnijo budhe / bhujer'ke kāṣṭapaśujo jetuḥ śṛṅgyajayonijaḥ
yasminsaṃjñāsrayaḥ kheṭā aṅgesyustatra niścitam / vraṇośubhakṛtaḥ pṛṣṭetanau rāśisamāśrite
tilakṛnmasakṛdaṣṭasaumyairyuktaśca lakṣmavān / caturasraḥ piṅgadṛk ca paittiko 'lpakaco raviḥ
vṛto vātakaphī prājño mandavāk śubhadṛk śaśī / krṛradṛktaruṇo bhaumaḥ paittikaścapalastathā
tridhānupavṛtirhāsyarucijñaḥ śliṣṭavāktathā / piṅgake ślakṣaṇo dīrghaḥ kaphīdhīmāngururmataḥ
suvapurlocanaḥ kṛṣṇavakrakeśo bhṛguḥ sukhī / dīrghaḥ kapiladṛḍbhando nilīkharakacolasaḥ
snāyvasthiraktatvakśukravasāmajjāstu dhātavaḥ / mandārkacandrasomyāspujijjīvakubhuvaḥ kramāt
candrāṅgapāpairbhāntyasthaiḥ seṃvupāpacatuṣṭayaiḥ / cakrapūrvāpare pāpasaumyaiḥ kīṭatanau mṛtiḥ
udayāstagatau pāpau candraḥ krūrayutaiḥ śubhaiḥ / na ceddṛṣṭastadā mṛtyurjātasya bhavati dhruvam
kṣīṇe 'bje vyayage pāpairlagnāṣṭasthaiḥ śubhā na cet / kendreṣu vābjosaṃyuktaḥ smarāntyamṛtilagnagaḥ
kendrādyā hasta sankheṭairadṛṣṭo mṛtyudastathā / ṣaṣṭemebje 'sadṛṣṭesadyo mṛtyuḥ śubhekṣite
samāṣṭake miśrakheṭairdṛṣṭe mṛtiḥ śiśoḥ / kṣīṇebjeṅge randhrakende pāpe pāpāntarasthite
bhūdyūnanidhane vābje lagne 'pyevaṃ śiśormṛtiḥ / pāpaiścandrāstagairmātrā sārddhaṃ sadṛṣṭimantarā
śubhādṛṣṭe bhāntyagebje trikoṇoparataiḥ khalaiḥ / sagnasthe vā vidhaupāpairastasthairmṛtimāpnuyāt
graste 'bje 'sadbhiraṣṭasthai sṛjyavātmajayormṛtiḥ / lagne ravau tu śasreṇa savīryāsadbhiraṣṭagaiḥ
karkendvījyayute lagne kendre saumye ca bhārgave / śaṣaistryarīśagairāyuramitaṃ bhavati dhruvam
varṅgottame mīnalagne vṛṣe 'bje tattvalipsike / svatuṅgastheṣvaśeṣeṣu paramāyuḥ prakīrtitam
śubhairdṛṣṭaḥ savīryoge kendrasthe cāyurarthadaḥ / svaccobje svarkṣagaiḥ saumyaiḥ savīryeṅgādhipe tanau
ṣaṣṭyabdakendrasaumyebheṣṭaśuddhe saptatirgurau / mūlatrikoṇagaiḥ saumyairguro svoccasamanvite
lagnādhipe balayutaśītyabdaṃ tvāyurīritam / savīrye satsu kendreṣu triṃśacchuddhiyute 'ṣṭame
layeśe dharmagejīveṣṭasthe krūrakṣite jitāḥ / lagnāṣṭameśāvaṣṭasthau bhābdamāyuḥ karau matau
lagne 'śubhejyau glaudṛṣṭau mṛtyau kaścana cākṛtiḥ / dharmāṅgastheśanau śukre kendre 'bje vyayadharmage
śatābdaṃ gīṣpatau karke kaṭakasthasitejyayoḥ / layeśeṅge śubhairhīne 'ṣṭame ravābdhimitaṃ vayaḥ
lagne śeṣṭamageṣṭeśe tanusthe pañcavatsaram / kavījyayoge saumyābjau lagne mṛtyau ca sveṣavaḥ
etadyogajamāyuḥ syādatha spaṣṭamudīyate / sūryādhika bale paiṇḍaṃ nisargāñca vidhorbale
aṃśāyuḥ sabale lagne tatsādhanamatho śṛṇu / gobjāstattvatithī sūryāstithiḥ svargā nakhāḥ kramāt
nakhā vidhurdvāvaṅkāśca dhṛtiḥ svākṣikhamārgaṇāḥ
piṇḍe nisarge ravocce no grahaḥ ṣaṭbhālpako yadā / cakraśuddhastadā grāhyesyāṃśā āyuṣisaṃmatāḥ
aṃśonāḥ śantrubhe kāryā grahaṃ vakragatiṃ vinā / mandaśuktau vinārddhonā grahasyāstaṅgatasya ca
hānidvaye 'dhikāḥ kāryā yadā krūrastanau tadā / vihāyārīnaṃśādyairhanyādāyurlavān bhajet
bhagaṇāṃśairlabdhahīnāsteṣāṃ kāryā vicakṣaṇaiḥ / pāpasyāṃśāḥ samagronā saumyasyārddhavivarjitāḥ
spaṣṭāsteṃśāḥ khaṣaṭtryāsā guṇayitvā svakairgaṇaiḥ / varṣāṇi śeṣamarkadhnaṃ hārātsaṃmāsakāḥ smṛtāḥ
taccheṣaśca triguṇitaḥ tenaivāptaṃ dināni ca / śeṣe ṣaṣṭyā hate bhakte hāreṇa ghaṭikādikam
hitvā bhājyaṅgabhāgādīnkalīkṛtya khakhākṣibhiḥ / bhajedvarṣāṇi śeṣe tu guṇite dvādaśādibhiḥ
dvisaptāṃśe ca māsādilagrāyurjāyate sphuṭam / aśāyuṣī salagnānāṃ kheṭānāmaṃśakā hṛtāḥ
khayugairāyuraṃśāḥ syustatsaṃskāraṃ vadāmi te / grahanalagnaṃ ṣaḍrātyaṃ cetsaṃskāro 'nyathā nahi
tadaṃśaḥ svāgnayo bhaktā labdhonobhūrguṇo bhavet / yadaikālyaṃ tadāstāṃśāḥ svāgryāptonā ca bhūrguṇaḥ
saumayasyārddhena pāpasya samagreṇeti niścayaḥ / gumakadhnāścāyuraṃśāḥ saṃskāro 'yamudāhṛtaḥ
āyuraṃśakalābhaktādviṃśatyābdā ināhatam / śeṣaṃ dviśatabhaktaṃ syurmāsāḥ śeṣā dinādikam
lagnāyuraṃśāstriguṇā digbhiktā syuḥ samāstataḥ / śeṣer'kādiguṇe bhakte digbharmāsādikaṃ bhavet
sabaleṅgebhatulyābdairyutamāyurbhavetsphuṭam / aṃśadvidhnamakṣāṃśaṃ māsāḥ khatryādisaṃguṇāt
śeṣā dinādikaṃ yojyaṃ naitatpiṇḍanisargayoḥ / lagnārkacandramadhye tu yo balī taddaśā purā
tataḥ kendrādigānāṃ tu dvitryādau sabalasya ca / bahvāyuryo vīryasāmyerkādyutasya prāk yācakaḥ
ṣaḍvargārddhasya triṃśasya trikoṇagaśca smaragaḥ / saptamāsasya tūryasya caturasragatasya ca
kramaḥ kendrādiko 'trāpi dvitryādau sabalasya ca / pākapasyābdhināgāśca hyarṇavā sahagasya ca
trikoṇasthasya cāṣṭākṣisūryā dyūnagatasya ca / turyāṣṭagasya tu svargā guṇakāḥ parikīrtitāḥ
daśāguṇairhatā bhaktyā guṇaikyena samāgatāḥ / śeṣer'kādihate bhakte māsādyaikyena nārada
antardaśāsu vidaśāstāsu copadaśāstathā / daśeśamitrasvoccakṣaṅgobjobdhyekādrivṛddhigaḥ
śubhago yadbhagastadbhisnvādisthena taddhikṛt / proktetarasthānagatastattadbhāvakṣayaṃ karaḥ
khagasya yadbhaveddravyaṃ bhāvabhe kṣaṇayogajam / jīvikādiphalaṃ sarvaṃ daśāyāṃ tasya yojayet
viśanyāpadaśāyāṃ yo vairidṛṣṭo vipattikṛt / śubhamatrekṣitaśceṣṭasadvargasthaśca yo grahaḥ
tatkāle balavānāpannāśakṛtsamudāhṛtaḥ / yasyāṣṭavargajaṃ cāpi phalaṃ pūrṇaśubhaṃ bhavet
yaśca mūrtitanuglāvo vṛddhigaḥ svoccabhasthitaḥ / svatrikoṇasuhṛdbhasthastasya madhyamasatphalam
śreṣṭhaṃ śubhataraṃ vācyaṃ viparītagatasya tu / neṣṭamutkaṭamiṣṭaṃ tu svalpaṃ jñātvā balaṃ vadet
care sanmadhyaduṣṭābhyāmaṅgabhaṅge viparyayāt / sthire neṣṭaṣṭamadhyā ca horāyāstryaṃ śakaiḥ phalam
svāmījyajñayutā horā dṛṣṭā vā satpalāvahā / vināśa dṛṣṭayuktā ca pāpāntaragatānyathā
prāgdhvāṅkṣā bandhu mṛtyāya tayordyūne raviḥ svabhāt / vakrātsvādivasāñcārke śukrādyūnāṃ tu ṣaḍrataḥ
dharmadhyāyārigo jīvādikatryārigo vidhoḥ / pṛdhyantyadhītapāḥ sujñā tatovṛddhyantyabandhurāḥ
vṛddhigoṅgātsadhanaghītapaḥ svārācchaśī śubhaḥ / svadūvṛdhyastādiṣu pṛdhātsasāṣṭau pañcayopagaḥ
ṣaṭtryāyadhīstho mandāñca jñāddvitryāyāṣṭakendragaḥ / kendrāṣṭāyāntya ijyādvā jñajyāyāstatra sve kaveḥ
vṛddhāvinātsādidhiyā maṅgā māyārigo vidhoḥ / kendrāṣṭāpārthagaḥ svarkṣānmandādgoṣṭāyakendragaḥ
ṣaṭ tridhī bhavataḥ saumyātṣaḍvāṃśāṣṭago bhṛgoḥ / karmāyavyayaṣaṣṭastho jīvādbhaumaḥ śubhaḥ smṛtaḥ
kaverddhyāṣaṣṭamodhyāye sanjñomandānsadhītraye / sākṣāste bhūmijājjīvādyayāribhavamṛtyugaḥ
dharmāyārisatāntyerkātsādyatrisvagatā svabhāt / ṣaṭkhāyāṣṭābdhikhoṣvijyātsahādyeṣu vilagnataḥ
dikvāṣṭādyastabandhyāye kujātkhātsatrike guruḥ / sātryaṅke san raveḥ śukrāddhīkhago digbhavārigaḥ
candrādvīśārthagosteṣu mandāddhītriṣaḍantyagaḥ / gobdhidhīṣaṭkhakhādyā ye jñātsadyūne vilagnataḥ
āśu teśāṣṭagoṣvaṅgaḥtsāṃteṣvabjātsitaḥ śubhaḥ / svātsajñeṣu tridhīgobdhī dikchidrāsigatorkajāt
randhrāyavyacagaḥ sūryādoṣṭadhīkhe sagorguro / jñābdhitryāyārigorātriṣaṭdhyadhyāntyagoṣu ca
tridhīśāriṣu mandaḥ khātsākṣāntyeṣu śubho sṛjaḥ / kendrāyāṣṭadhaneṣvarkā lagnādvṛddhyādyabandhuṣu
godhvaṣṭāpārikhāntyejñāccandrāllābhatriṣadbhataḥ / ṣaḍaṣṭāntyagataḥ śukrādgurīrdvīśāntyaśatruṣu
uktasthāneṣu rekhādo hyanukteṣu tu bindudāḥ / janmabhādvadvimitroccasvabhedhiṣṭaṃ pareṣvasat
kaṣṭamarthakṣayaḥ kleśaḥ samatārthasukhāgamaḥ / dhanāptiḥ sukhamiṣṭāptiriti rekhāphalaṃ kramāt
pitṛmātṛdviṣanmitrabhrātṛstrībhṛtakādraveḥ / svāmilagrājayoḥ svasthādbhedarkasvayaśośayāt
tṛṇasvarṇāśvadhoraṇādyairarkāṃśe vṛttimādiśet / kṛṣyaṃbujasrībhyobjāṃśe kauje dhātvasrasāhasaiḥ
kāvyaśilpādibhirbodhe jave devadvijākaraiḥ / śaukre rajatagoratnairmānde hiṃsaśramādhamaiḥ
svoñceṣvārkī tathā jyārairuktaikāṅge nṛ pādhipāḥ / lagre vargottame 'bje vā caturādigrahekṣite
dvāviṃśabhūpāstuṅgesṛkcāperkendūyamastanau / bhūpakṛttuṅgagorkegestesājārkekhabhe gurau
yamendutuṅgagau lagne ṣaṣṭer'kajñau tulājagau / sitāsṛjo gurau karke sārāje lagnage nṛpāḥ
vṛṣegebjerkejyasauraiḥ suhṛjjāyākhagairnṛpaḥ / mande mṛgāṅgetryaryakāṃśasthairajādibhirnṛpa
sejyājeśve mṛgamukhe kuje tuṅgerkṣabhāgevau / lagne 'tha sejyakarkeṅge jñājaśukrairbhavopagaiḥ
meṣe 'rke bhūmipāseṃdau eṣe ṣāṅgrerkapapāsṛjaḥ / siṃhakuṃbhamṛgasthāścedbhūpaḥ sāretanāvaje
ārkejīve tanau vāpi nṛpo 'thoḥ kujabhāskarau / dhīsthau gurvidukavayo bhūmau ratryage budhairnṛpaḥ
mṛgāsyalagnagaiḥ saurejābjarkṣaharayaḥ sayāḥ / kavikṣau tulayuramasthau vai bhūpaḥ kīrtimānbhavent
yasya kasyāpi tanayaḥ proktairyogairnṛpo bhavet / vakṣyamāṇairnṛpasuto jñeyo bhūyo munīśvara
svocce trikoṇabhagatestryādyairbalayutairnṛpaḥ / siṃher'ke meṣalagne 'je mṛge bhaume ghaṭe 'ṣṭame
cāpe dharānāthaḥsyādatha svarkṣage bhṛgau / pātālage dharmage 'bje śubhadṛṣṭe yute mune
trilagnabhavagaiḥśeṣairdharādhīśaḥ prajāyate / saumye vīryayuteṃ'gasthe balāḍhyeśubhage śubhe
dharmārthopacayasthaiścaśeṣairdharmayutonṛpaḥ / meṣūraṇāyatanugāḥ śaśisūryajasūrayaḥ
jñārau dhaneśitaravā hibuke bhūpatistadā / vṛṣeṃ'ge 'bjodhanāristho jīvārkī lāṃbhagāḥ pare
sukhe guruḥ kheravīndūyamo lagne bhave karai / lagne vakrāsitau candrejyasitārkabudhāḥ kramāt
sukhāstu śubhakhāptisthānareśaṃ janayantyapi / karmalagnagaraveṭasya daśāyāṃ rājyasaṃgatiḥ
prabalasya daśāyāṃ vā śatrunīcā digārtidāḥ / āsannakendradvayagairvargadākhyaḥ sakalagrahaiḥ
tanvastagaiśca sakaṭaṃ vihago rājyabandhugaiḥ / śṛṅgāṭakaṃ dhigaugasthairlagnāyasthairhalaṃ matam
varjjoṅgesthe satsvasatsu turyakhasthairyavonyathā / vimiśraiḥ kamalaṃ prāhurvāyākaṇṭakabāhyagaiḥ
lagnāccaturbhugairyūpaḥśarastūryāccaturbhugaiḥ / dyūnādvedakṣagaiḥ śaktirṃ da'khādicaturbhagaiḥ
lagnātkramātsaptabhagairnokākūṭastu nuryataḥ / chatramastātsvabhādyāyonyasmādarddhendunāmakaḥ
lagnādekāntaragataiścakramarthātsaritpatiḥ / ṣahyusthāneṣu vīṇādyāḥ samasaptarkṣagaiḥ
vīṇādāmapāśakedārabhūśūlayugagolakāḥ / grahaiḥścarabhagai rājayogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ
sthirasthairyamusalaṃ nāma dviśarīṇatairnalaḥ / bhālā kendrasthitaiḥ saumyaiḥ pāpaiḥsarpa udāhṛtaḥ
īryyuradhvarucī rajjvāṃ musale dhanamānayuk / vyaṅgā sthirā lonalajo monīsragjohijordditaḥ
vīṇodbhavotinipuṇāgītanṛtyarucirbhṛśam / dātā samṛddho dāmāsthaḥ pāśajo dhanaśīlayuk
kedārotthaḥ kṛṣikaraḥ śūle śūrokṣato dhanaḥ / yugaṃ pāṣaṇḍayurgole vidhano malinastathā
bhūpavandyapadaścakre samudre nṛpabhogayuk / subhagāṅgorddhacaṃpātsukhīśūraśca cāmaraḥ
mitro pakārakṛcchatre kūṭe cānṛtabandharāṭ / taujaḥ sakīrtiḥ sukhabhāk mānavo bhavati dhruvam
tyāgī yajvātmavān yūthe hiṃsro guhyādhipaḥ śaraiḥ / śaktau nīco 'laso niḥsvo daṇḍe priyaviyogabhāk
vyarkaiḥ svāntyobhayagataiḥ kheṭaiḥ syātsunaphaānaphaā / durudharā caiva vidhau jñeyaḥ kemudrumo 'nyathā
svopārjitārthabhugdātā sunaphaāyāṃ dhanī sukhī / nīrogaḥ śīlavān khyātaḥ suveṣaścānaphaābhavaḥ
bhogī sukhī dhanīdānītyāgī durudhurodbhavaḥ / kemudrume 'timalino duḥkhī nīco 'tha nirdhanaḥ
yantryāśmakāraṃśājoko bhaumapuṣkarurte dhvagaḥ sujñaḥ / sukīrtirnipuṇaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ dhaninaṃ tathā
senyonyakāryanirataṃ sāsphujicchasrajīvinam / samando dhātukuśalaṃ tathā bhāḍaṃvidaṃ mune
kūṭasnyāśavapaṇyāṭhaṃ nasāsṛgindgaḥ prasūdviṣam / kuryātsajñorthanipuṇaṃ namraṃ satkīrtisaṃyutam
sajyo 'sthiravayaṃ vaṃśyaṃ vikrāntaṃ ca samarthinam / sasitosukavettāraṃ sārkiponabhavaṃ mune
āre sajñe vāhuyodhī purādhyakṣaḥ sagīṣpatau / saśukre dyūtakrarheyo nṛtī dyūti samandake
sejyejñe nṛtyagītāḍhyo māyādakṣaḥ / sabhārgavesamande lubdhakaḥ krūro naro bhavati nārada
saśukre vākpatau vidvānsāsite 'nnaghaṭaṅkaraḥ / kavau sa mandamandākṣā va vaniśrayavittavān
ekasthaiścaturādyaistu khavārthaiḥ khacaraiḥ pṛthak / kujajñejyājaśukrārkisūryaḥ parivrajennaraḥ
śākyājīvakavṛddhārthica rakākhaphalāśanaḥ / tatsvāmibhiḥ paridajitaiḥ pravrajyāpracyutirbhavet
adīkṣitālpastagataiḥ sabalaistatsthabhaktayaḥ / janmaponyairyadyadṛṣṭo mandaṃ paśyati nārada
mando vā janmapaṃ naṣṭaṃ tathā ca mandakāgaṇe / bhaumārkāṃśe sauradṛṣṭe candre vā dīkṣito bhavet
surūpo bhūṣitago 'śinyāṃ dakṣaḥ satyavacā yame / bahūbhugpadāragnau sthiradhīḥ priyavāktathā
brāhmo dhanīmṛge bhogī raudre hiṃstraḥ śaṭho 'ghakṛt / dānto rogī śubho 'dityāṃ puṣyaryajanmā kaviḥ sukhī
dhūrtaḥ śaṭhaḥ kṛtaghno 'hau pāpaḥ sarvāśano bhavet / patre bhogī dhanī bhakto dātā priyavacā bhage
dhanī bhogīnaroryamarkṣe steno dhṛṣṭo ghṛṇī kare / citrāṃbaraḥ sudṛktvāṣṭre na ca dharmadayāparaḥ
dvīśe lubdhaḥ paṭuḥ krodhī maḍhaiyo āṭhanovideśagaḥ / śākre dharmaparastuṣṭo mūle mānī dhanī sukhī
āpye mānī dṛṣṭo vaiśve namraśca dhārmikaḥ / karṇe dhanī sukhī khyāto dātā śūro dhanī vasau
śeta'rihṝntā vyasanī srījito jāhibhedinī / budhne vaktā sukhī kāntaḥ pauṣṇe śūro dhanī śuciḥ
kāmī śūraḥ kṛtajño 'je kāntastyāgī kṣamī vṛṣe / yugme srīdyūtaśāsrajñaḥ sraiṇo hrasvaḥ svabhe vidhau
srīdviṭ krodhī harau mānī vikrāntaḥ sthiradhīḥ sukhī / dharmī ślakṣṇaḥ sudhīḥ ṣaṣṭe prājñaḥ prāṃśurdhanī ghaṭe
rogī pūjyaḥ kṣatī kārairpye kaviḥ śilpījyabhe dhanī / mṛge 'laso 'ṭanaḥ svakṣaḥ paradārārthahṛddhaṭe
sabalebhaibhayevāpisa valejeśilaphalam / anyathā viparītaṃ tatpalaṃmevaṃ pare 'pi na / khyātaḥ srīdviṭ dhanī tīkṣṇojñaḥ kaviḥ śaiṇḍiko dhanī / pūjyo lubdho 'dhanasakho meṣādau bhāskare janau
niḥsvor'kabhe bhūmiputre bhūmiputre dhanī cāndre svabhedanaḥ / baudhe kṛtajño jaive tu khyātaḥ śaukre 'nyadārikaḥ
mṛge bahvātmajadhanaḥ kuṃbhe duḥkhyanṛtī khalaḥ / srīdveṣyaḥ svajanadveṣīniyaratyaḥ sadhīyanaḥ
samānārthaḥ saputrasrīsarṇaḥ sūryādibhe budhe / senānīḥ stryarthaputrāḍhyaḥ dakṣamaiśyaḥ paricchadī
maṇḍaleśaḥ sārthasukhaḥ sarṇasvāmyarkabhādgurau / stryāptārtho mandaśokāḍhyo bandhudveṣī dhanāghavān
sārthaḥ prājñaḥ samaḥ khyātiḥ srīji'torkādibhe mṛgau / vyaṅgajārtho khaprasūko vidhimitro sukhatrayaḥ
satputrastrīdhano rājā grāme śokādibherkaje / bhūpajñaguṇipaurāsvādṛṣṭebjejesṛgādibhiḥ
niḥ svastena nṛpāḥ prajñapreṣyāmavinṛyugmage / dhātvājīvī nṛpajñābhītantuvāyādhanāḥ svabhe
yuyutsukavisūrījyadhātujīvidṛgāmayāḥ / jyotirjñāḍhyejyanu khalu nṛpejñādikarharau
ṣaṣṭe śubhairnṛpacamūpanaipuṇyavatitāśayāḥ / jūke bhūpasvarṇakāravaṇijaḥ śeṣadṛgyute
dvipaitṛkābdhidhvajino vyaṅgā svakṣitipā alau / jñātikṣmājanayāścāye sadbhirdarmī śaṭhastathā
bhūpamaṇḍitasakhejyāmṛge bhūyānyadārikau / kuṃbhe śeṣaiśca hāsyajñanṛpajñāḥ sadbhirantyabhe
hāreśarkṣadalasthaistu dṛṣṭo yuktaḥ śaśī śubhaḥ / tryaṃśe tatpatimitrarkṣagateryuktekṣitastathā
dvādaśāṃśe phalaṃ proktaṃ navāṃśe 'pyatha kīrtyate / ārakṣeko vadharucirniyuddhakuśalor'thavān
kalahaḥ kṣitijāṃsthe śaukre mūrkho 'nyadāradaḥ / kaviḥ sukhī budhāṃśe tu naṭacaurajñaśilpinaḥ
svāṃśe tvalpatanuḥ sakhastapasvī lobhatatparaḥ / krodhī nidhīśo mātyo vā nṛpo hiṃsro suto hareḥ
jīvāṃśe hāsyavidyodhā balī mantrī ca dhārmikaḥ / alpāpatyo duḥkhito kho duṣṭastrīsauribhāgage
bhānārvidvādidṛṣṭe nu tadvadeva phalaṃ vadet / vargottame khe parabhe pala muktaṃ śubhaṃ kramāt
puṣṭaṃ madhyaṃ laghu jñeyaṃ yadi cāṃśapatirbalī / rāśīkṣaṇaphalaṃ ruddhvā dadātyaṃśapalaṃ spuṭam
śūrastabdho vikaladṛgnighṛṇor'ke tanusthite / meṣe dhanī taimirakaḥ siṃhe rātryandha eva ca
nīcodhosvaḥ karkager'ke udbudākṣastanusthite / dvitīyer'ke bahudhano nṛpadaṇḍyo mukhāmayī
trige budho vikramī ca vimukhaḥ pīḍito bhuvi / dhanāpatyoktito dhīsthe balī śatrujitorige
strī jito dyūnasaṃsthe ca nidhanelpātmajolpadṛk / sutārthasukhabhā bhāraye daśame śrutaśauryavāt
lābhe bahudhano mānī patito kho 'vyaye ravau /. mūkodho badhiraḥ preṣyo jege khāñcājage dhanī
buṭurvā dhanavānadhe hiṃsro vikramage bhavet / sādhubhāvaḥ sukhagate dhīsthe kanyāprajolasaḥ
alpāgnikāmastīkṣṇorauīṣyustatrimadojñarave / vyādhipūḍānvito mṛtyau bhānurddhanage mitradhanānvitaḥ
dharmadhīdhanayugrājye khyātadhīdhanayugbhavet / kṣudrāeṃ'gahīno vyayage candre proktaṃ phalaṃ budhaiḥ
lagne kuje kṣatatanurddhanage tu kadannabhuk / dharmapāpasamācāro 'nyatra sūryasamo mataḥ
vidvān dhanī ca pravaraḥ paṇḍitaḥ sacivoriyuk / dharmajño vistṛtaguṇo gādhojñeyarator'kavat
vidvānsa vācyaḥ kṛpaṇī sukhākṣo ripugṛddhimān / nīcastapasvī caṣṇavanī lobhīduṣṭastanorguro
smarī mukhī vilagnasthe kalahī suratotsukaḥ / sukhitastanapasye ca bhṛgau jīvavadanyataḥ
niḥśvo rogī kāmavaśo malinaḥ śaiśavārtiyuk / alaso lagnage mande dharmātsvoñcagate nṛpaḥ
grāmādhipaḥ sa vidvāṃśca cārvaṅgo 'nyatra sūryavat / pūrṇamuccetha pādonaphalaṃ mūlatrikoṇage
śubhagrahedalaṃ svarkṣe mitrabheṃ'ghrimitaṃ phalam / śatrubhe 'lpaṃ tathā nīcāstaṅgate phalaśūnyatā
khabharākādike kheṭe kulatulyaḥ kulādhikaḥ / bandhupūjyo 'thadhanavānsukhī bhogī nṛpaḥ kramāt
parivittasuhṛdvandhupoṣyāgaṇabalādhipau / nṛpaśca mitrabhāstheṣu kheṭe vrekādiṣu kramāt
viṣamarkṣer'kahorāyāṃ sasthite śubhabheṣu ca / khyāto mahodyamī cātitejā dhīmāndhanī balī
śubheṣu candrahorāyāṃ sthiteṣu samarāśiṣu / kāntimārddavasaubhāgyabhogadhīmānbhavennaraḥ
sūryahorāgataḥ pāpaḥ samabheṣu tu madhyamāḥ / viṣamarkṣeṣu bhāskaryā saumyā noktaphalapradāḥ
svamitratryaṃśagaścandraḥ surūpaṃ guṇinaṃ naram / karotyannagatastadvattattulyaguṇarūpiṇam
vyālāyudhe catuṣpādāṃ'jeṣu ca tryaṃśake ca / tīkṣṇe 'tihiṃsraśca bhavedgurutalpagatoṭanaḥ
steno bhoktā sadhanadhīrnṛpaḥ klībaśca śatruhā / viṣṭikṛddāsavṛttiśca pāpo hiṃsno 'matirbhavet
meṣādikottamāṃśeṣu dvādaśāṃśeṣu rāśivat / jāyābalavibhūṣāḍhyaḥ sattvayukto 'tisāhasī
tejasvī ca naraḥ khāye triṃśāṃse sṛjisaṃsthite / āmayī vā svabhāryāyāṃ viṣamaḥ pāradārikaḥ
duḥkhī paricchadayuto malinaścārkaje svake / sukhadhīdhanakīrtyālastejasvī lokapūjitaḥ
nīraguhyabhavānbhogī jīve khatriṃśabhāgage / medhākalākāvyaśilpavivādakapaṭāñcitaḥ
śāstrārthasāhasayuto budhe svatriṃśabhāgage / bahvapatsukhāraugyarogarūpārthasaṃyutaḥ
lalitāṅgo viprakīṇandriyaḥ syādbhārgave svake / śūrastabdhau ca viṣamavadhakau sadguṇānvitau
sukhejño cāru ceṣṭāṅgau candrārkkaucetkujādigau mūlatrikoṇasvarkṣocce kaṇṭhasthāstu ca ye grahāḥ
anyonyakārakāste syuḥ karmagastu viśeṣataḥ / śubhaṃ vargottame janma vesisthāne vasadgṛhaiḥ
aśūnyeṣu ca kendreṣu kārakākhyagṛheṣu ca / gurujanmeśalagneśāḥ kendrasthā madhyasaukhyādāḥ
pṛṣṭobhavakodaparkṣasthitāstvantyāntarāduṣu / praveśe bhāskarakujau bhṛgvījyo madhyagau tathā
candrārkī phala dāvantye sadā jñaḥ phaladāyakaḥ / lagnātputre kalatre vābjācchubheśayutekṣite
syāttayoḥ saṃpadaḥ svatvamanyathāthāṅgatodayaḥ / ravau bhīner'kajaḥ srīghnaḥ putrasthastu tathā kujaḥ
simāturyāṣṭagaiḥ krūrairyadvā krūrāntare sitaḥ / sadgrahāyutadṛṣṭaścedagnipātānmṛtiḥ striyāḥ
lagnadya pāṇigatayoḥ śaśiravyoḥ saha striyā / ekena yasya janmāhuratha saptamasaṃsthayoḥ
navadhīgatayorvāpi vikalasrīsitārkayoḥ / koṇodaye 'stāṃ tyasandhau bhṛgau bandhyāpaterjaniḥ
sutabhaṃ cenna saumyāḍhyamathāntyāstodayarkṣagaiḥ / pāpe dhīsthe vidhau kṣīṇajanmā sutakalatriṇaḥ
śanau khage 'ste saśukre tadṛṣṭe pāradārikaḥ / tau cetseṃdusriyā sārddhaṃ puṃścalo jāyate naraḥ
bhūgvabjayorastagayornaro bhāryā suto 'pi vā / nṛsriyo stu śubhairdṛṣṭau tau dvau pariṇatāṅgakau
ravāstāṃbugairinduśukrapāpairvaṃśavināśakaḥ / śilpī tryeśe budhayute kendrasaṃsthārkivīkṣite
dāsyāṃ jātaḥ sauribhāge riḥphage bhṛgunandane / nīcer'kendorastagayordṛṣṭayoḥ sūryajena vā
pāpadṛṣṭau śanikujāvastagau vātarukpradau / karkālyaṃ śagate kendre pāpayukte tu guhyaruk
pāpātaragateṃ'gebje ravau dyūne tu kuṣṭayuk / candre khe 'stāṅgate bhaume vikalo veśiger'kaje
mitho bhāṃśagayoḥ śūlī ravīndvoryutayoḥ kṛśaḥ / nidhanāridhanāntyasthā ravīndvārayamā yadā
caladgraheṇa doṣeṇa kurvantyanayanaṃ naram / saumyā dṛṣṭā na vāyatridhīgatāḥ pāpakhecarāḥ
karṇopaghātakā dyūne radavaikṛtyakārakāḥ / lagne gurau dyune mande vātarogādito bhavet
sukhe 'ste vā kuje jīve lagne vārkiyutodaye / kujena vātmaje dyūne saṃjñeṃ'tye 'bje ca sonmadaḥ
dhīdharmārthāntyagaiḥ pāpairbhasamasyānnibandhanam / sarpaśṛṅkhalayā śāṭhyairdṛkkairbalyaśubhekṣitaiḥ
samande 'bje vakradṛṣṭe pasmārī durvacāḥ kṣayī / ravimandakujaiḥ ravasthaiḥ saumyadṛṣṭaiḥ samaṇḍalaiḥ
bhṛtakāḥ pūrvamuditairvaramadhyādhamā narāḥ / puñjanau tu phalaṃ puṇyasrīṇāṃ yogyaṃ vadecca tat
tatsvāmiṣvakhilaṃ kāryaṃ tadbhartṛmaraṇaṃ mṛtau / lagnendugaṃ vapuścaiva yādayūpapītadyune
yugmeṣu lagnaśaśinorvanitā prakṛtisthitā / sacchīlabhūṣaṇayutā śubhasaṃdṛṣṭayostayoḥ
puruṣākṛti śīlāḍhyā tayorojasthayormatā / atha pāpā guṇonāśca pāpavīkṣitathostayoḥ
kujārkījyajñaśukrāṇāṃ kujarkṣe kramaśo 'ṅganā / bālyaduṣṭā tathā dāsī sādhvī māyāvatī tvarā
dṛṣṭā vākṛtiśīlā syāttayorojasthayormatā / atha pāpā guṇonāśca pāpavīkṣitayostayoḥ
duṣṇavāk punarbhūḥ saguṇā vijñā khyātā sphujidgrṛhe / baudhe samā yā klīvā ca satī guṇavatī calā
dvandvabhe svairiṇīśadhnī guṇāḍhyā śilpikādhamā / vācāṭā kulaṭā siṃhe rāgī pundhīragamyatā
jaive guṇāḍhyālparatirguṇajñā jñāninī satī / dāsī nīcaratā sādhvī mānde duṣṭā napatyakā
lagnenduyuktaisriṃśāṃśaiḥ phalametadvalānugam / dṛggaiḥ mithoṃśe śukrārkī śaukre cedvā ghaṭāṃśake
strībhiḥ strī maithunaṃ yāti madanānaladīpitā / śūnye kāpuruṣo dyūne bale klīvo na sadṛśi
budhārkyoścarabhe nityaṃ paradeśaparāyaṇaḥ / tatsṛṣṭā madage sūrye strībālavidhavā kuje
pāpadṛṣṭe śanau dyūne kanyaivāpadyate jarām / āgneyairvidhavāstasthaiḥ punarbhūmiśrakairbhaghavet
krūre hīnabale 'stasthe patityaktā na sadṛśi / mithoṃśagaiḥ sitārau tu kuruto 'nyaratāṃ striyam
śītaraśmiryadā dyūne tadā bharturanusayā / saurārarkṣe lagnagate seṃduśukre tu vandhakī
mātrā sārddhamasaddṛṣṭe tathā kaujeṃśake 'stage / mandadṛṣṭe vyādhiyoniḥ sadgrahāṃśe patipriyā
mandarkṣe vāṃśake dyūne vṛddhau mūrkhaḥ patiḥ striyāḥ / strīlolaḥ krodhanaḥ kauje baudhe vidvāṃśca naipuṇaḥ
jitendriyo gṛṇījaive cāndre kāmī mṛdustathā / śaukre saubhāgyayukkāntaḥ saureti mṛdukarmakṛt
śukrābjayorlagnagayoḥ sukhinīrṣyāsamanvitā / jñedvoḥ kalāsu nipuṇā sukhitā ca guṇānvitā
śukrajñayostu śubhagā kalājñā rucirāṅganā / anekasaukhyārthaguṇālagne saumyatraye sthite
krūre 'ṣṭame 'ṣṭameśāṃśe yasya syāttadvayaḥ same / vaidhavyaṃ ca mṛtistasyā svayaṃsatsvarthageṣu tu
alpāpatyatvamabje 'syāḥ kanyāliharigoṣu tu / saure madhyabale candraśukrajñairbalavarjitaiḥ
śeṣaiḥ savīryairojarkṣe lagne kurūpiṇī bhavet / jīvārakaviśaumyeṣu baliṣu samabhe tanau
vikhyātānaikaśāstrajñā vanitā brahmavādinī / pāpe 'ste navamasthasya pravrajyāmeti bhāminī
udvāhe varaṇe praśne sarvametadvicintayet / mṛtyusthānaṃ paśyatāṃ syādvalinā dhātukopataḥ
nṛṇāṃ mṛtyuhitaṃ yuktaṃ bhagātrosthopathabhūribhiḥ / savīryairbahujo 'gnyakṣatajvararugudbhavaḥ
tṛṭkṣudbhavaścāṣṭamasthaiḥ sūryādyaiśca varādiṣu / parasvādhvapradeśeṣu mṛtyuḥ sūryamahījayoḥ
svabandhusthitayoḥ puṃsaḥ śailāgnābhirutasya ca / bandhvastakarmagairmandabhūjaiḥ prahau mṛtiḥ
striyāṃ himoṣaaṇakarayoḥ svajanātpāpadṛktayoḥ / toyamṛto ravīdṛtusyātāṃyā dyubhayodaye
śastrāgnijośubhāntasthe candre bhaumagṛhagasthite / mṛtyuścātha mṛge candre karke mande jalodarāt
striyāmindau raktaśauthātsaure vājvagnipātajaḥ / putradharmasthasyorvandhātpāpayoḥ sadadṛṣṭayoḥ
sathāsaśaṃyanigaḍairdṛkairmṛtyau tu bandhanaiḥ / striyāṃ sapāpe 'bje dyūne site meṣe ravau tanau
maraṇaṃ strīkṛte gehe hyatha turye kuje ravau / yame kheṃ'gatrikoṇarstheḥ kṣīṇacandrāṃśubhaiḥ sakṛt
turyer'ke khe kujekṣīṇa candradṛṣṭe samiddhataḥ / randhrakhāṅgajalaiḥ kṣīṇendvārārkiravisaṃyutaiḥ
lakuṭenātha taireva khāṅkāṅgatanayasthitaiḥ / dhūmānibandhanaiḥ kāryaḥ kudanairmaraṇaṃ bhavet
bandhvastakhasthairbhauṃmārkarmadaiḥ śastrāgniṃrājabhiḥ / sauredvāraiḥ svāṃburavasthaiḥ kṣatakremyaṅgayā tataḥ
sver'ke turye kuje yānapātādatha kuje 'stage / yantrosīdunataḥ kṣīṇacandrayukte mṛtirbhavet
bhaumārkiśītakiraṇairjūkājaśanibhasthiteḥ / kṣīṇendvarkakujaiḥ khāstāṃbusthairvārakare mṛtiḥ
balyāradṛṣṭe kṣīṇendau mande nidhaṃnasaṃsthite / guhyarukkṛmiśastrāgnidārujo mṛtyuraṅgirāḥ
saurer'ke 'ste mṛto mande kṣīṇendau bhuvyasaṃyute / lagnadhyāyāsta paḥkhārkabhaumacandraniśākaraiḥ
śailaśṛṅgasvarugrapātaunurnidhanaṃ bhavet / dṛkkonttare turddhāviṃśastatpatirmṛtyupopi vā
svaguṇairnidha na kuryādbalavānyo dvayorbhavet / lagnāṃśeśasadṛksthāne mṛtyuryogekṣaṇādibhiḥ
modāentenuditāṃśasya tulyo dvighnaḥ svapekṣite / śubhekṣite tu triguṇaḥ kalpyamanyatsvabuddhitaḥ
vahnyaṃpabubhasmasakledaśoṣavyālairmṛtisthitaiḥ / bindutaścintanīyaśca yathokto matyuraṅginaḥ
guruḥ śaśāṅkaśukrau ca sūryabhaumau yamendujau / devapitratiraktotha nārakānkuryuraṣṭame
ravīndubalavaśraṃśanāthācchreṣṭasamādhamāḥ / tuṅgagaḥ sāṃdanūkenugatiḥ ṣaḍrandhradṛkkapaḥ
dyūnasthito gururvāpi ripukendravināśagaḥ / svoccasthoṃ'ge vyaye saumyabhāge mokṣo balānyataḥ
ādhāne janmā jñāne tu vṛkṣatāṃ lagnato vadet / pūrvāparārddhairlagnasya saumye vācyapanejaniḥ
lagnatrikoṇe dhījyatryaṃśairvikalpāvayavāḥ samāḥ / grīṣmoger'ke parai ramyāpanatāṃpṛturarkabhāt
candrajñajīvāvṛtyasyāḥ śukrārārkibhiranyathā / dṛkkairādyaiḥ pūrvamāsastithistatrānupātataḥ
vilomajanma bhāgaiśca velā rātridyusaṃjñake / trikoṇottamavārthantilagnaṃ vā labhanābhane
yāvadūno vidhurlagnāttāvaccandrācca janmabhe / goharī yugmavasubhe kriyajuke mṛgāṅgane
daśāṣṭasaptaviṣaye guṇyāḥ śeṣāḥ khasaṃkhyayā / jīvabhaumakavijñāḥ syu rāghavādyāyarejñavat
bhānāṃ nityo vidhiḥ kheṭavaśāvaddhargaṇāstathā / saptarghnaṃ bhahṛtaṃ śeṣamṛkṣaṃ navadhanarṇataḥ
dvighne samartumāsāḥ syuḥ pakṣatithyau gajāhate / saptaghnaṃ honiśārkṣāṇīṣughneṅgāṃśeṣṭahorikā
pumānparaśudhṛkkṛṣṇo raktadṛgrakṣituṃ kṣamaḥ / dṛṣṭartikapadāśvāsyā raktavastrā ghaṭākṛtiḥ
kapilo hyandhadṛkrūro raktavastraḥ kṣatavrataḥ / kṣuttṛṣārtodugdhapaṭo lūnakuñcitamūrdhajaḥ
malinaḥ kṣutparojāsyo dakṣaḥ kṛṣyādikarmaṇi / dvipakāyaḥ sarabhayātpiṃpagalo vyākulāntaraḥ
śaucikīrūpiṇī sādhvī hyaprajocchritapāṇikā / udyāne kavacī dhanvī krīḍecchargaruḍānanaḥ
nṛtyādividvaruṇavadbahuratnodhanurdharaḥ / dvipāsyakaṇṭhaḥ kroḍāsyaḥ kānaneśaramāhikaḥ
ātavyaśākhāṃ pālāśī rauti mūrddhāhikarkaśā / cipiṭāsyo hi saṃvīto nausthaḥ ratryarthaṃvrajañjale
śvā naro jaṃbukaṃ gṛdhraṃ gṛhītvā rauti śālmalau / dhanvī kṛṣṇājinī siṃhavāśvonnatamāturaḥ
phalāmiṣaghnaḥ kūrjīnā bhallāsyaḥ kapiceṣṭitaḥ / puṣpapūrṇacchaṭākanyāvidyellā malināṃvarā
dhanvī vyayāpakṛcchyāmo lipikṛdrāmaśonaraḥ / gaurīdhautāṃśukātsuccākuṃbhadṛstāsurālaye
mānonmānpāpasotaulībhāṇḍamutpavicintakaḥ / kṣuttṛṅyuto naraḥ kuṃbhīgṛdhnasya strīsutopagaḥ
dhanvīkintaraceṣṭastuhaimavarmāmṛgānugaḥ / siṃdhekūjaṃvrajantīstrīnānāsarpasita hikā
saukhyaspṛhāhyāvṛttāṅgībhatrarthakacchapākṛtiḥ / kūrmāsyo malaye siṃhaḥ śvakroṇḍamṛgabhīṣakaḥ
vāsyaḥ śvakāyo dhānuṣko raṅkṣastāpasayajñiye / caṃpakābhāsane madhyā siṃdhuratravivarddhinī
kūrmāsane caṃpakābho daṇḍī kauśeyakāninī / paramo 'tho gṛdhramukhaḥ snehamadyāśanaspṛhaḥ
dagdhānasthā lohadharā sabhūṣābhāñjakaccarā / bhāṇḍī romaścavāḥ śyāmaḥ kirīṭī phalayantradhṛk
nausthodhvosaṃvibhūṣārntha nānāratnakarāeñcitaḥ / nausthabdheḥ kūlamāyāntī sayūthāṃ campakānanā
garte sarpāvṛto nagno rudaṃścaurānalārditaḥ / etādṛśāṅkriyāṃśāḥ stu ṣatriṃśadudītāḥ kramāt
etatsaṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ jātakaṃ munisattama / nibodha saṃhitāskandhaṃ lokakṛtyupayoginam

iti śrīnāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge dvitīyapāde bṛhadupākhyāne jātakanirūpaṇannāma pañcapañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ sanandana uvāca kramāñcaitrādimāseṣu meṣādyāḥ saṃkramā matāḥ / caitraśuklapratipadi yo vāraḥ sa nṛpaḥ smṛtaḥ
meṣapraveśe senānīḥ karkaṭe sasyayo bhavet / samodyadhīśvaraḥ sūryo madhyamaścottamovidhuḥ
neṣṭaḥ kujo budho jīvo bhṛgustvatiśubhaṅkaraḥ / adhamo ravijo vācyo jñātvā caiṣāṃ balābalam
daṇḍākāre kabandhe vā dhvāṅkṣākāre 'tha kīlake / dṛṣṭer'kamaṇḍale vyādhirbhrāntiścorārthanāśanam
chatradhvajapatākādyasannibhastimitairdhvanaiḥ / varimaṇḍalagairdhūmraiḥ sasphuliṅgairjagatkṣayaḥ
sitaraktaiḥ pītakṛṣṇairvaṇairviprādipīḍanam / ghnanti dvitricaturvarṇairbhuvi rājajanānmune
ūrddhairbhānukaraistāmrairnāśa yāti camūpatiḥ / pītairnṛpasutaḥ śvetaiḥ purodhāścitritairjanāḥ
dhūmrairnṛpapiśaṅgaistu jaladādhomukhairjagat / śubhor'kaḥ śiśire tāmraḥ kuṅkumābhā vasaṃtike
grīṣmaścāpāṇḍuraścaiva vicitro jaladāgame / padmodarābhaḥ śaradi hemante lohitacchaviḥ
pītaḥ śīte vṛṣṭau grīṣme lohitabhāraviḥ / rogānāvṛṣṭibhayakṛt kramādukto munīśvara
indracāpārddhamūrtistu bhānurbhūpavirodhakṛt / śaśaraktanibhe bhānau saṃgrāmo na cirādbhuvi
mayūrapatra saṃkāśo dvādaśābdaṃ na varṣati / candramāsadṛśo bhānuḥ kuryādbhūpāntaraṃ kṣitau
arke śyāme kīṭabhayaṃ bhasmābhe rāṣṭrajaṃ tathā / chidrer'kamaṇḍale dṛṣṭaṃ mahārājavināśanam
ghaṭākṛtiḥ kṣudbhayakṛtpurahā toraṇākṛtiḥ / chatrākṛte deśahatiḥ khaṇḍabhānunṛpāntakṛt
udayāstamaye kāle vidyudulkāśaniryadi / tadā nṛpavadho jñeyastvathavā rājavigrahaḥ
pakṣaṃ pakṣārddhamarkendupariviṣṭāvaharniśam / rājānamanyaṃ kuruto lohitāmbudayāstagau
udayāstamaye bhānurācchinnaḥ śastrasannibheḥ / ghanairyuddhaṃ kharoṣṭrādyaiḥ pāparūpairbhayapradam
yāmyaśṛṅgonnattaścandraḥ śubhadī mīnameṣayoḥ / saumyaśṛṅgonnataḥ śreṣṭho nṛyuṅmakarayostathā
ghaṭokṣṇastu samaḥ karkacāpayoḥ śarasannibhaḥ / cāpavatkaurmahṝrṃyośca śūlabattulakarkayoḥ
viparītoditaścandro durbhikṣakalahapradaḥ / āṣāḍhadvayamūlendradhiṣṇyānāṃ yāmyagaḥ śaśī
agnipradasteyacaravanasarpavināśakṛt / viśākhā mitrayoryāmyapārśvagaḥ pāpagaḥ śaśī
madhyamaḥ pitṛdaivatye dvidaive saimyagaḥ śaśī / aprāpyapauṣṇabhādrāmadukṣāviśaśī śubhaḥ
madhyagodvāradakṣāṇi atītya navavāsavāt / yamendrāhīśanoyeśamarutaścārddhatārakāḥ
dhruvāditidvidaivāḥ syuradhyarddhāṃścāparāḥ samāḥ / yāmyaśṛṅgonnato neṣṭaḥ śubhaḥ śukle pipīlikā
kāryahāniḥ kāryavṛddhirhānirvṛddhiryathākramam / subhikṣakṛdviśālenduraviśāloghanāśanaḥ
adhomukhe śastrabhayaṅkalahodaṇḍasannibhe / kujādyairnihate śṛṅge maṇḍale vā yathākramam
kṣemādyaṃ vṛṣṭibhūpālajananāśaḥ prajāyate / satyāṣṭanavamarkṣeṣu sodayādvikrime kuje
tadvakramuṣṇaṃsaṃjñaṃ syātprajāpīḍāgnisaṃbhavaḥ / daśamaikādaśe ṛkṣe dvādaśarvāgratīpayaḥ
kūkraṃ vakramukhaṃ jñeyaṃ sasyavṛṣṭivināśakṛt / kuje trayodaśe ṛkṣe vakrite vā caturdaśe
bālāsyacakraṃ tattasminsasyavṛṣṭivināśanam / pañcadaśe ṣoḍaśarkṣe vakre syādrudhirānanam
durbhikṣaṃ kṣudbhayaṃ rogānkaroti kṣitinandanaḥ / aṣṭādaśe saptadaśe tadvakraṃ muśalāhvayam
durbhikṣaṃ dhanadhānyādināśane bhayakṛtsadā / phaālgunyorudito bhaumo vaiśvadeve pratīpagaḥ
astagaścaturāsyārkṣe lokatrayavināśakṛt / uditaḥ śravaṇe puṣye vaktṛgośvanahānidaḥ
yaddiggo 'bhyudito bhaumastaddigbhūpabhayapradaḥ / madhāmadhyagato bhaumastatra caiva pratīpagaḥ
avṛṣṭiśastrabhayadaḥ pīḍyaṃ devā nṛpantakṛt / pitṛdvidaivadhātṝṇāṃ bhidyante gaṇḍatārakāḥ
durbhikṣaṃ maraṇaṃ rogaṃ karoti kṣitijastadā / triṣūttarāsu rohiṇyāṃ nairṛte śravaṇe mṛge
avṛṣaaṭidaścaranbhaumo dakṣiṇerohiṇīsthitaḥ / bhūmijaḥ sarvadhiṣṇyānāmudagāmī śubhaghapradaḥ
yāmyago 'niṣṭaphalado bhavedbhedakaro nṛṇām / vinotpātena śaśinaḥ kadācinnodayaṃ vrajet
anāvṛṣṭāgnibhayakṛdanarthanṛpavigrahaṛ / vasuvaiṣṇavaviśvendudhātṛbheṣu caranbudhaḥ
bhinatti yadi tattārāṃ bādhāvṛṣṭibhayaṅkaraḥ / ārdrādipitṛbhānteṣu dṛśyate yadi candrajaḥ
tadā durbhikṣakalaharogānāvṛṣṭibhītikṛt / hastādiṣaṭsu tārāsu vicarannindunandanaḥ
kṣemaṃ subhikṣamārogyaṃ kurute roganāśanam / ahirbudhnyāryamāgneyayāmyabheṣu caranbudhaḥ
bhiṣaktaraṅgavāṇijyavṛttīnāṃ nāśakṛttādā / pūrvātrayecaransaumyo yogatārāṃ bhinatti cet
kṣucchastrānalacaurebhyo bhayadaḥ prāṇināṃ tadā / yāmyāgnidhātṛvāyavyadhiṣṇayeṣu prākṛtā gatiḥ
raudrendusārpapitryeṣu jñeyā miśrāhvayā gatiḥ / bhāgyāryamejyāditiṣu saṃkṣiptā gatirucyate
gatitīkṣṇājacaraṇāhirbudhyabhāśribheṣuyā / yomātikātiviśvābumūlamatsyainyajasya ca
ghorā gatirharitvāṣṭravasuvāruṇabheṣu ca / indrāgnimitramārtaṇḍabheṣu pāpāhvayāgatiḥ
prākṛtādyāsu gati hyudito 'stamitopivā / yāvantyeva dinānyeṣa dṛśyastāvatyadṛśyagaḥ
catvāriṃśatkramātriṃśadravīndra bhūsuto nava / pañcadaśaikādaśabhirdivasaiḥ śaśinandanaḥ
prākṛtāyāṃ gataḥ saumyaḥ kṣemārogyasubhikṣakṛt / miśrasakṣiptayormadhye phalado 'nyāsu vṛṣṭidaḥ
vaiśākha śrāvaṇe pauṣe āṣāḍhe 'bhyudito budhaḥ / jagatāṃ pāpaphaladastvitareṣu śubhapradaḥ
iṣorjamāsayoḥ śastradurbhikṣāgnibhayapradaḥ / uditaścandrajaḥ śreṣṭho rajatasphaṭikopayaḥ
dvibhāṭajodimāstasya pañcamaikādaśāstrimādhavaḥ śubhado jyeṣṭo nṛṇāṃ madhyaphalapradaḥ / śucirmadhyo nabhaḥ śreṣṭho bhādraḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kvacinnaraḥ
kārtiko mārgaśīrṣaśca nṛṇāṃ duṣṭaphalapradaḥ / śubhapradau pauṣamādhau madhyamau phaālguno madhuḥ
mādhavaḥ śubhado jyeṣṭo nṛṇāṃ madhyaphalapradaḥ / śucirmadhyo nabhaḥ śreṣṭho bhādraḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kvacinnara
atiśreṣṭha iṣaḥ prokto māsānāṃ phalamīdṛśam / saumye bhāge caranbhānāṃ kṣemārogyasubhikṣakṛt
viparīto gururyāmye madhye carati madhyamam / pītāgniśyāmaharitaraktavarṇogirāḥ kramāt
vyādhyagnicauraśastrāstrabhayadaḥ prāṇināṃ bhavet / anāvṛṣṭiṃ bhūmnanibhaḥ karoti surapūjitaḥ
divādṛṣṭo nṛpavadhyāmayaṃvārāṣṭranāśanam / saṃvatsaraśarīraṃ syātkṛttikā rohiṇī tathā
nābhistvāpāṭhayugalamādrī hṛtkusumaṃ maghā / durbhikṣāgnimarudbhītiḥ śarīraṃ krūrapīḍite
nābhyāṃ kṣuttṛṅbhayaṃ puṣye samyaṅmūlaphalakṣayaḥ / hṛdayeśasya nidhanaṃ śubhaṃ syātsaṃyutaiḥ śubhaiḥ
śasyavṛddhiḥ prajārogyaṃ yuddhaṃ jīvātyavarṣaṇam / iti dvijātimadhyāṃ tu gonṛpastrīsukhaṃ mahat
niḥsvanāvṛṣṭiphaṇi bhirvṛṣṭiḥ svāsthyaṃ mahotsavaḥ / mahārghamapi saṃpattirdeśanāśo 'tivarṣaṇam
avairaṃ rogamabhayaṃ rogabhīḥ sasyavarṣaṇe / rogo dhānyaṃ nabho 'dṛṣṭimaghādyṛkṣagate gurau
saumyamadhyamayāmyeṣu mārgeṣu vīthikātrayam / śukrasya dastrabhājjñeyaṃ paryāyaiśca tribhistribhiḥ
nāgebhairāvatāścaiva vṛṣabhoṣṭrakharāhvayāḥ / mṛgāñjadahanākhyāḥ syuryāmayāntā vīthayo nava
saumya mārge ca tisṛṣu caranvīthiṣu bhārgavaḥ / dhānyārthavṛṣṭisasyānāṃ paripūrti karoti hi
madhyamārge ca tisṛṣu sarvamapyadhamaṃ phalam / pūrvasyāṃ diśi meghastu śubhadaḥ pitṛpañcake
svātitraye paścimāyāṃ tasyāṃ śukrastathāvidhaḥ / viparīte tvanāvṛṣṭidṛdbudhasaṃyutaḥ
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyāmamāyāṃ ca yadā sitaḥ / undayāstamanaṃ yāti tadā jalamayī mahī
mithaḥ saptamarāśisthau paścātprāgvīthisaṃsthitau / guruśukrāvanāvṛṣṭidurbhikṣasamarapradau
kujajñajīvaravijāḥ śukrasyāgresarā yadi / yuddhāntivāyurdurbhikṣajalanāśakarā matāḥ
jalamitrāryamāhīndranakṣatreṣu subhikṣakṛt / sacchastrāvṛṣṭido mūle 'hirbudhnyabhayorbhayam
śravaṇānilahtārdrābharaṇībhāgyameṣu ca / caratrchaiścaro nṝṇāṃ subhikṣārogyasyakṛt
mukhe caikaṃ gude dve ca trīṇi ke nayane dvayam / hṛdaye pañca ṛkṣāṇi vāmahaste catuṣṭayam
vāmapāde tathā trīṇi dakṣiṇe trīṇe bhāni ca / catvāri dakṣiṇe haste janmabhādravijasthitiḥ
rogo lābhastathā hānirlābhaḥ saukhyaṃ ca bandhanam / āyāsaḥ śreṣṭhayātrā ca dhanalābhaḥ kramātphalam
bahudhāravijastvetadvakragaḥ phalamīdṛśam / karotyeva samaḥ sāmyaṃ śīghrageṣūtkramātphalam
viṣṇucakrotkṛttaśirāḥ haṅguḥ pūyūṣapānataḥ / amṛtyutāṃ gatastatra kheṭastatra kheṭatve parikalpitaḥ
varaṇadhāturarkendū tudateḥ sarvaparvaṇi / vikṣepāvanatervaṅgādgāhurdūragatastayoḥ
ṣaṇmāsavṛddhyā grahaṇaṃ śodhayendravicandrayoḥ / parveśāstu tathā satyadevā khyāditaḥ kramāt
brahmendrvindradhanādhīśavaruṇāgniyamāhvayoḥ / paśusasyadvijātīnāṃ vṛddhirbrahme tu parvaṇi
tadvadeva phalaṃ saumye śleṣmapīḍā ca parvaṇi / virodho bhūbhujāṃ duḥkhamaindre sasyavināśanam
dhanināṃ dhanahāniḥ syātkauberaṃ dhānyavardhanam / nṛpāṇāmaśivaṃ kṣemamitareṣāṃ ca vāruṇe
pravarṣaṇaṃ sasyavṛddhiḥ kṣemaṃ hautāśaparvaṇi / anāvṛṣṭiḥ sasyahānirdurbhikṣaṃ yāmyaparvaṇi
velāhīne syahānirnṛpāṇāṃ dāruṇaṃ raṇam / ativele puṣpahānirbhayaṃ sasyavināśanam
ekasminneva māse tu candrārkagrahaṇaṃ yadā / virodho dharaṇīśānāmarthavṛṣṭivināśanam
grastoditāvastamitau nṛpadhānyavināśadau / sarvagrastāvinendūtu kṣudvyādhyagnibhayapradau
saumyāyane kṣatraviprānitarāṃhanti dakṣiṇe / dvijātīṃścakramāddhanti rāhudṛṣṭoragāditaḥ
tathaiva grāmabhedāḥ syurmokṣabhe dāstathā daśa / no śaktā lakṣituṃ devāḥ kiṃ punaḥ prākṛtā janāḥ
ānīya kheṭāngaṇitāṃsteṣāṃ vāraṃ vicintayet / śubhāśubhānyaiḥ kālasya grāhayāmo hi lakṣaṇam
tasmādanveṣaṇīyaṃ tatkālajñānāya dhīmatā / utpātarūpāḥ ketūnāmudayāstamayā nṛṇām
divyāntarikṣā bhaumāste śubhāśubhaphalapradāḥ / yajñadhvajāstrabhavanarakṣavṛddhiṅgajopamāḥ
stambhaśūlāṅkuśākārā āntarikṣāḥ prakīrtitāḥ / nakṣatrasaṃsthitā divyā bhaumā ye bhūmisaṃsthitāḥ
eko 'pi bhinnarūpaḥ syājjanturnāma śubhāya vai / yāvanto divasānketurdṛśyate vividhātmakaḥ
tāvanmāsaiḥ phalaṃ yacchatyaṣṭau sāravyavatsaraiḥ / ye divyāḥ ketavaste 'pi śaśvajjīvaphalapradāḥ
hrasvaḥ snigdhaḥ suprasannaḥ śvetaketuḥ suvṛṣṭikṛt / kṣiprādastamayaṃ yāti dīrghaketu ravṛṣṭikṛt
aniṣṭado dhūmaketuḥ śakracāpasamaprabhaḥ / dvitricatuḥśūlarūpaḥ sa ca rājyāntakṛnmataḥ
maṇihārastuvarṇābhā dīptimanto 'rkasūnavaḥ / ketavaścoditāḥ pūrvāparayornṛpahānidāḥ
vaṃsukabiṃbakṣitijacchukatuṇḍādisannibhāḥ / hutāśanoditāste 'pi ketavaḥ phaladāḥ smṛtāḥ
bhūsutā jalatailābhā vartulāḥ kṣudbhayapradāḥ / subhikṣakṣemadāḥ śvetaketavaḥ somasūnavaḥ
pitāmahātmajaḥ ketustrivarṇastridaśānvitaḥ / brahmadaṇḍāddhūmaketuḥ prajānāmantakṛnmataḥ
aiśānyāṃ bhārgavasutāḥ śvetarūpāstvaniṣṭadāḥ / aniṣṭadāḥ paṅgusutā viśikhāḥ kamakāhvayāḥ
vikacākhyā gurusutā veṣṭā yāmye sthitā api / sūkṣmāḥ śuklā budhasutāścaurarogabhayapradāḥ
kujātmajāḥ kuṅkumākhyā raktāḥ śūlāstvaniṣṭadāḥ / agnijā viśvarūpākhyā agnivarṇāḥ sukhapradāḥ
aruṇāḥ śyāmalākārā arkaputrāśca pāpadāḥ / śukrajā ṛkṣasadṛśāḥ ke tavaḥ śubhadāyakāḥ
kṛttikāsu bhavo dhūmaketurnūnaṃ prajākṣayaḥ / prāsādavṛkṣaśaileṣu jāto rājñāṃ vināśakṛt
subhikṣakṛtkaumudākhyaḥ ketuḥ kumudasannibhaḥ / āvartaketusaṃdhyāyāṃ śaśiro neṣṭadāyakaḥ
brahmadevamanormāna pitryaṃ sauraṃ ca sāvanam / cāndramārkṣaṃ gurormānamiti mānāni vai navaḥ
eteṣāṃ navamānānāṃ vyavahāro 'tra pañcabhiḥ / teṣāṃ pṛthakpṛthakkāryaṃ vakṣyate vyavahārataḥ
grahāṇāṃ nikhilaścāro gṛhyate saura mānataḥ / vṛṣṭervidhānaṃ strīgarbhaḥ sāvanenaiva gṛhyate
pravarṣaṇāṃ same garbhauṃ nākṣatreṇa pragṛhyate / yātrodvāhavratakṣaure tithivarṣeśanirṇayaḥ
parvavāstūpavāsādi kṛtsnaṃ cāndreṇa gṛhyate / gṛhyate gurumānena prabhavādyabdalakṣaṇam
tattanmāsairdvādaśabhistattadaṣṭau bhavettataḥ / gurumadhyamacāreṇaṣaṣṭyabdāḥ prabhāvādayaḥ
prabhavo vibhavaḥ śuklaḥ pramodo 'tha prajāpatiḥ / aṅgirāḥ śrīmukho bhāvo yuvā dhātā tathaiva ca
īśvaro bahudhānyaśca pramāthī vikramo vṛṣaḥ / citrabhānuḥsubhānuśca tāraṇaḥ pārthivo 'vyayaḥ
sarvajitsarvadhārī ca virodhī vikṛtaḥ kharaḥ / nandano vijayaścaiva jayo manmathadurmukhau
hemalaṃbo vilaṃbaśca vikārī śārvarī lavaḥ / śubhakṛcchobhanaḥ krodhī viśvāvasuparābhavau
plavaṅgaḥ kīlakaḥ saumyaḥ sāmāptaśca virodhakṛt / paribhāvī pramādī ca ānando rākṣaso 'nalaḥ
piṅgalaḥ kālayuktaśca siddhārtho raudradurmatīḥ / dundubhīrudhirodgarī raktākṣaḥ krodhanaḥ kṣayaḥ
nāmatulyaphalāḥ sarve vijñeyāḥ ṣaṣṭivatsarāḥ / yugaṃ syātpañcabhirvarṣairyugānyevaṃ tu dvādaśa
teṣāmīśāḥ kramājjñeyā viṣṇurdevapurohitaḥ / purandaro lohitaśca tvaṣṭāhirbudhnyasaṃjñakaḥ
pitaraśca tato viśve śaśīndrādgnayaśino bhagaḥ / tathā yugasya varṣe śāstvagninenduvidhīśvarāḥ
athādveśacamūnāthasasyapānāṃ balābalam / tatkālaṃ grahacāraṃ ca samyak jñātvā phalaṃ padet
saumyā yanaṃ māsaṣaṭkaṃ mṛgādyaṃ bhānubhuktitaḥ / ahaḥ surāṇāṃ tadrātriḥ karkādyaṃ dakṣiṇāyanam
gṛhapraveśavaivāhapratiṣṭāmaiñjibandhanam / madhādau maṅgalaṃ karma vidheyaṃ cottarāyaṇe
yāmyāyane garhitaṃ ca karma yatnātpraśasyate / mādhādi māsau dvau dvau ca ṛtavaḥ śiśirādayaḥ
mṛgācchiśiravasaṃtaśca grīṣmāḥ syuścottarāyaṇe / varṣā śaraśca hemantaḥ karkādvai dakṣiṇāyane
cāndro darśīvadhiḥ sauraḥ saṃkrātyā sāvano dineḥ / triṃśadbhiścandrabhagaṇo māso nākṣatrasaṃjñakaḥ
madhuśca mādhavaḥ śukraḥ śuciścātha nabhastataḥ / nabhasya iṣa ūrjaśca sahāścaiva sahasyakaḥ
tapāstapasya kramaśaścaitrādīnāṃ samāhvayā / yasminmāse paurṇamāsī yena dhiṣṇena saṃyutā
tannakṣatrāhvayo māsaḥ paurṇamāsī tadāhvayā / tatpakṣau daiva pitrākhyau śuklakṛṣṇau tathāpare
śubhāśubhe karmaṇi ca praśastau bhavataḥ sadā / kramāttithīnāṃ brahmāgnī viriñciviṣṇuśailajāḥ
vināyakayamau nāgacandrau skandor'kavāsavau / mahendravāsavau nāgadurgādaṇḍadharāhvayaḥ
śivaviṣṇūhariravīkāmaḥ sarvaḥ kalītataḥ / candraviśvedarśasaṃjñatithīśāḥ pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ
nandābhadrājayāriktā pūrṇāḥ syutithayaḥ punaḥ / trirāvṛttyā kramājjñeyā neṣṭamadhyeṣṭadāḥ site
kṛṣṇapakṣe tviṣṭamadhyāniṣṭadāḥ kramaśastadā / aṣṭamī dvādaśī ṣaṣṭī caturthī ca caturdaśī
tithayaḥ pakṣarandhrākhyā hyatirūkṣā prakīrtitāḥ / samudramanurandhrāṅkatattvasaṃkhyāstu nāḍikāḥ
tyājyāḥ syustāsu tithiṣu kramātpañca ca sarvadā / amāvāsyā ca navamī hitvā viṣamasaṃjñikā
tithayastupraśastāsyurmadhyamā pratipatsitā / ṣaṣaaṭyāṃ tailaṃ tathāṣṭamyāṃ māsaṃ kṣauraṃ kalestithau
pūrṇimādarśayornārīsevanaṃ parivarjayet / derśe ṣaṣṭyāṃ pratipadi dvādaśyāṃ pratiparvasu
navamyāṃ ca na kurvīta kadāciddantadhāvanam / vyatīpāte ca saṃkrāntāvekādaśyāṃ ca parvasu
arkabhaumadine ṣaṣṭyāṃ nābhyaṅgo vaidhṛtau tathā / yaḥ karoti daśamyāṃ ca snānamāmalakairnaraḥ
putrahānirbhavettasya traṃyodaśyāṃ dhanakṣayaḥ / arthaputrakṣayastasya dvitīyāyāṃ na saṃśayaḥ
amāyāṃ ca navamyāṃ ca saptamyāṃ ca kulakṣayaḥ / yā paurṇimā divā candramatī sānumatī smṛtā
rātrau candravatī rākāpyamāvāsyā tathā dvidhā / sinīvālī cendumatī kuhūrnendumatī matā
kārtike śuklanavamī tvādiḥ kṛtayugasya ca / tretādirmādhave śukle tṛtīyā puṇyasaṃjñitā
kṛṣṇā pañcadaśī māghe dvāparādimudīritā / kalpādiḥ syātkṛṣṇapakṣe nabhastasya trayodaśī
dvādaśyūrje śuklapakṣe navamyaccheśvayujyapi / caitre bhādrapade caiva tṛtīyā śuklasaṃjñitā
ekādaśī sitā pauṣe hyāṣāḍherdeśamīsitā / māghe ca saptamī śuklā nabhasye tvasitāṣṭamī
śrāvaṇe māsyamāvāsyā phaālgune māsi paurṇimā / āṣāḍhe kārtike māsi jyaṣṭe caitre ca paurṇimā
manvādayo mānavānāṃ śrāddheṣvatyantapuṇyadā / bhādre kṛṣṇatrayodaśyāṃ maghāminduḥ kare raviḥ
gajacchāyā tadā jñeyā śrāddhe hyatyantapuṇyadā / ekasminvāsare tisrastithayaḥ syāttithikṣayaḥ
tithirvāratraye tvekā hyadhikā dve ca nindite / sūryāstamanaparyantaṃ yasminvāre tu yā tithiḥ
vidyate sā tvakhaṇḍā syānnyūnā cetkhañjasaṃjñitā / titheḥ pañcadaśo bhāgaḥ kramātpratipadādayaḥ
kṣaṇasaṃjñāstadarddhāni tāsāmarddhapramāṇataḥ / raviḥ sthiraścaraścandraḥ krūro vakrokhilo budhaḥ
laghurījyo mṛduḥ śukrastrīkṣṇo dinakarātmajaḥ / abhyakto bhānuvāre yaḥ sa naraḥ kleśavānbhavet
ṛkṣeśe kāntibhāgbhaume vyādhi saubhāgyaminduje / jīve naivaṃ site hānirmande sarvasamṛddhayaḥ
laṅkodayātsyādvārādista smādūrdhvamadho 'pivā / deśāntarasvacarārddhanāḍībhirapare bhavet
balapradasya kheṭasya karma siddhyati yatkṛtam / tatkarma balahīnasya duḥkhenāpi na siddhyāti
indujñajīvaśukrāṇāṃ vāsarāḥ sarvakarmasu / phaladāstvitare krūre karmasvabhimatapradāḥ
raktavarṇauṃ raviścandrau gauro bhaumastulohitaḥ / dūrvāvarṇo vudho jīvaḥ pītaśvetastu bhārgavaḥ
kṛṣṇaḥ sauriḥ svavāreṣu svasvavarṇakriyā hitāḥ / adrivāṇāśca yastarkapātālavasudhādharāḥ
bāṇāgnilocanānihyavedabāhuśilīmukhāḥ / tryekāhayo netragotrarāmāśvadrarasartavaḥ
kulikāścopakulikā vāravelā stathā kramāt / praharārddhapramāṇāste vijñeyāḥ sūryavāsarāt
yasminvāre kṣaṇo vāradṛṣṭastadvāsarādhipaḥ / ādyaḥ ṣaṣṭo dvitīyo 'smattatṣaṣṭhastutṛtīyakaḥ
ṣaṣṭaḥ ṣaṣṭaścetareṣāṃ kālahorādhipāḥ smṛtāḥ / sārddhanāḍīdvayenaiva divā rātrau yathākramāt
vāraprokte karmakārye tadgrahasya kṣaṇe 'pi san / nakṣatreśāḥ kramāddasrayamavahnipitāmahāḥ
candreśāditijīvāhipitaro bhagasaṃjñakaḥ / aryamārkatvaṣṭṛmarucchakrāgnimitravāsavaḥ
nairṛtyudakaviśvejagovindavasutoyapāḥ / ajaikapādahirbudhnyā pūṣā ceti prakīrtitāḥ
pūrvātrayaṃ madhāhyagniviśākhāya mamūlabham / adhomukhaṃ tu navakaṃ bhānau tatra vidhīyate
bilapraveśagaṇitabhūtasādhanalekhanam / śilpakarmakalākūpanikṣepoddharaṇādi yat
mitrendutvāṣṭrahastendrāditibhāntyāśvivāyubham / tiryaṅmukhākhyaṃ navakaṃ bhānau tatra vidhīyate
halapravāhagamanaṃ gantrīpatragajoṣṭrakam / kharagorathanauyānalulāyahayakarma ca
brahmaviṣṇumaheśāryaśatatārāvasūttarāḥ / ūrddhāsyaṃ navakaṃ bhānāṃ proktamatra vidhīyate
nṛpābhiṣekamāṅgalyavāraṇadhvajakarmaca / prāsādatoraṇārāmaprākārādyaṃ ca siddhyati
sthiraṃ rohiṇyuttarākhyaṃ kṣipraṃ sūrayāśvipuṣyabham / sādhāraṇaṃ dvidaivatyaṃ vahnibhaṃ ca prakīrtitam
vasvadityaṃvupuṣyāṇi viṣṇubhaṃ carasaṃjñitam / mṛdvindumitracitrāntyamugraṃ pūrvāmaghātrikam
mūlārdrāhīndrabhaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ svanāmasadṛśaṃ phalam / citrādityaṃbuviṣṇvaṃbāntyādhimitravasūḍuṣu
samṛgejyeṣu bālānāṃ karṇavedhaṅkriyā hitā / dasrendvadititiṣyeṣu karāditritaye tathā
gajakarmākhilaṃ yattadvidheyaṃ sthirabheṣu ca / vājikarmākhilaṃ kāryaṃ sūryavāre viśeṣataḥ
citrāvaruṇavairiñcatryuttarāsu gamāgamam / darśāṣṭabhyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ paśūnāṃ na kadācana
mṛdudhruvakṣipracaraviśākhāpitṛbheṣu ca / halapravāhaṃ prathamaṃ vidadhyānmūlabhe vṛṣaiḥ
halādau vṛṣānāśāya bhatrayaṃ sūryamuktabhāt / agre vṛddhyai trayaṃ lakṣmye saumyapārśve ca pañcakam
śūlatrayepi navakaṃ maraṇāya ca pañcakam / śriyai puṣṭyai trayaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ syāccakre lāṅgalāhvaye
mṛdudhruvakṣiprabheṣu pitṛvāyuvasūṅṣu / samūlabheṣu bījoptiratyuntkṛṣṭaṃ phalapradā
bhavedbhatritayaṃ mūrghni dhānyanāśāya rāhubhāt / gale trayaṃ kajjalāya vṛddhyai ca dvādaśodare
nistaṃhulatvaṃ lāṅgūle bhacatuṣṭayabhītidam / nābhau vahniḥ pañcakaṃ yadvījoptāviti cintayet
sthireṣvaditisārpāntyapitṛmārutabheṣu ca / na kuryādrogamuktasya snānamāhīṃ duśukrayoḥ
uttarātrayamaitrendravasuvāruṇabheṣu ca / puṣyārkapauṣṇadhiṣṇyeṣu nṛtyāraṃbhaḥ praśasyate
pūrvārddhayuñji ṣaṅbhani pauṣṇabhādudabhāttataḥ / madhyayuñji dvādaśarkṣāṇīndrabhānnavabhāni ca
parārddhayuñji kramaśaḥ saṃprītirdampatermathaḥ / jaghanyāstoyapārdrāhipavanāntakanākapāḥ
kramāditidvidaivatyā bṛhattārāḥ parāḥ samāḥ / tāsāṃ pramāṇaghaṭikāstriṃśannavatidyaṣṭayaḥ
kramādabhyudite candre nayatyarghasamāni ca / aśvagrīndvījyanairṛtyatvāṣṭrajattyuttarābhavāḥ
pitṛdvidaivavasvākhyāstārāḥ syuḥ kulasaṃjñikāḥ / dhātṛjyeṣṭāditisvātīpauṣṇārkaharidevatāḥ
ajāhyantyakabhaujaṅgatārāścaivākulāhvayāḥ / śeṣāḥ kulākulāstārāstāsāṃ madhye kuloḍuṣu
prayāti yadi bhūpālastadāpnoti parājayam / bheṣūpakulasaṃjñeṣu jayamāpnoti niścitam
saṃdhirvāpi tayoḥ sāmyaṃ kulākulagaṇoḍuṣu / arkārkibhaumavāre cedbhadrāyā viṣamāṅghribham
tripuṣkaraṃ triguṇadaṃ dviguṇaṃ yamalāhibham / tadyāttaddoṣanāśāya gotrayaṃ mūlyameva vā
dvipuṣkare dvayaṃ dadyānna doṣastvṛkṣabho 'pi vā / krūraviddho yuto vāpipuṣyo yadi balānvitaḥ
vinā pāṇigrahaṃ sarvamaṅgaleṣviṣṭadaḥ sadā / rāmāgniṛtubāṇāgnibhūvedāgniśareṣu ca
netrabāhuśaredvindubāhuvedāgnisaṃkarāḥ / vedanetrābdhyagniśatabāhunetraradāḥ kramāt
tārāsaṃkhyāśca vijñeyā dasrādīnāṃ pṛthak pṛthak / yā dṛśyante dīptatārāḥ svagaṇe yogatārakāḥ
vṛṣo vṛkṣoścabhāyāmyadhiṣṇyeyamakarastaruḥ / uḍuṃbaraścāgnidhiṣṇye rohiṇyāṃ jaṃbukastaruḥ
indubhātkhadiro jātaḥ kṛṣṇaplakṣaśca raudrabhāt / saṃbhūto 'ditibhādvaṃśaḥ pippalaḥ puṣyasaṃbhavaḥ
sarvadhiṣṇyānnāgavṛkṣo vaṭaḥ pitṛbhasaṃbhavaḥ / pālāśo bhāgyabhājjātaḥ akṣaścāryamasaṃbhavaḥ
ariṣṭavṛkṣo ravibhācchrīvṛkṣastvāṣṭrasaṃbhavaḥ / svātyukṣajor'juno vṛkṣo dvidaivatyādvikaṅkataḥ
mitrabhādbakulojāto viṣṭiḥ paurandararkṣajaḥ / sarjjavṛkṣo mūlabhāñca vañjulo vāridhiṣṇyajaḥ
panaso vaiśvabhājjātaścārkavṛkṣaśca viṣṇubhāt / vasudhiṣṇyācchamīvṛkṣaḥ kadaṃbo vāruṇarkṣajaḥ
ajāheścūtavṛkṣobhūdbudhnyajaḥ picumandakaḥ / madhuvṛkṣaḥ pauṣṇadhiṣṇyāddhiṣṇyavṛkṣāḥ prakīrtitāḥ
yasmiñchaṃnaiśvaro dhiṣṇye tadrṛkṣo 'rcyaḥ prayatnataḥ / yogeśā yamaviśvendudhātṛjīvaniśākarāḥ
indratoyāhivahnyarkabhūmirudrakatoyapāḥ / gaṇeśarudradhanadatvaṣṭṭamitraṣaḍānanāḥ
sāvatrī kamalā gaurī nāsatyau pitaro 'ditiḥ / vaidhṛtiśca vyatīpāto mahāpātāvubhau sadā
parighasya ca pūrvārddhaṃ sarvakāryeṣu garhitam / viṣkaṃbhavajrayostisraḥ ṣaḍvā gaṇḍātigaṇḍayāīḥ
vyāgaghāte nava śūle tu pañca nāḍyo hi garhitāḥ / aditīndumadhāhyaśvamūlamaitrejyabhāni ca
jñeyāni sahacitrāṇi mūrddhabhāni yathākramam / likhedūrdhvagatāmekāṃ tiryagrekhāstrayodaśa
tatra ravārjūrike cakre kathitaṃ mūrdhni bhaṃ nyaset / bhājyaikareravāgatayoḥ sūryācandramasormithaḥ
ekārgalo dṛṣṭipātaścābhijidvarjitāni vai / vināḍībhirdvādaśabhī rahitaṃ ghaṭikādvayam
yogaṃ prakaraṇaṃ yogāḥ kramāttu saptaviṃśatiḥ / indraḥ prajāpatirmitrastvaṣṭābhūharitipriyā
kīnāśaḥ kalirudrākhyo tithyarddheśāstvahirmarut / bavādivaṇijāntāni śubhāni karaṇāni ṣaṭ
parītā viparītā vā viṣyirneṣṭā tu maṅgale / mukhe pañcagale caikā vakṣasyekādaśa smṛtaḥ
nābhau catasraḥ ṣaṭ kaṭyāṃ tisraḥ pucchākhyanājikāḥ / kāryahānirmukhe mṛtyurgale vakṣasi niḥsvatā
kaṭyāmunmattatā nābhau cyutiḥ pucche dhruvaṃ jayaḥ / sthirāṇi madhyamānyeṣāṃ madhyanāgacatuṣpadau
divāmuhūrtā rudrāhimitrapitṛvasūdakam / viśvevidhātṛbrahmendrarudrāgnivasutoyapāḥ
aryamā bhagasaṃjñaśca vijñeyā daśa pañca ca / īśājapādāhirbudhnyapūṣāśviyamavahnayaḥ
dhātṛ indrāditījyākhyā viṣṇvarkatvaṣṭṛvāyavaḥ / ahnaḥ pañcadaśo bhāgastathā rātripramāṇataḥ
muhūrtamānaṃ dvarāvakṣaṇarkṣāṇi sameśvaram / aryamā rākṣasabrāhnau pitryāgneyau tathābhijit
rākṣasākhyau brāhmapitryau bhargājāṃśāvalinādiṣu / vāreṣu varjanīyāste muhūrtāḥ śubhakarmasu
yeṣu ṛkṣeṣu yatkarma kathitaṃ nikhilaṃ ca tat / taddaivatye muhūrte 'pi kāryaṃ yātrādikaṃ sadā
bhūkaṃpaḥ sūryabhātsaptamarkṣe vidyuñca pañcame / śūlo 'ṣṭame ca daśame śāniraṣṭādaśe tataḥ
ketuḥ pañcadaśe daṇḍa ulkā ekonaviṃśatau / nirghātapātasaṃjñaśca jñeyaḥ sa navapañcame
mohanirghātakaṃ pāśca kuliśaṃ pariveṣaṇam / vijñeyā ekaviṃśarkṣādārabhya ca yathākramam
candrayukteṣu bheṣveṣu śubhakarma na kārayet / sūryabhātsarvapitryarkṣaṃ tvāṣṭramitraptabheṣu ca
saviṣaaṇubheṣu kramaśo hastabhāñcandrasaṃyutaḥ / dhiṣṇye tāvati satyatra duṣṭayogaḥ patatyasau
caṇḍīśacaṇḍāyudhākhyastasminnaivācarecchubham / trayodaśa syurmilanasaṃkhyayā tithivārayoḥ
krakaco nāma yogo 'yaṃ maṅgaleṣvatigardditaḥ / saptamyāmarkavāraścetpratipatsaumyabāsare
saṃvatayogo vijñeyaḥ śubhakarmavināśakṛt / ānandaḥ kāladaṇḍākhyo dhūmradhātṛsudhākarāḥ
dhvāṅkṣadhvajākhyaśrīvatsavajramudgarachatrakāḥ / mitramānasapadmākhyalumbakotpātamṛtyavaḥ
kāṇasiddhiśubhā mṛtyumuśalāntakarkujarāḥ / rākṣasākhyavarasthairyavarddhamānāḥ kramādamī
yogāḥ svasaṃjñāphaladā aṣṭāviṃśatirīritāḥ / ravivāre kramādeva dasrabhārdidubhādvidhau
sārpāddhaume pudhe hastānmaitrabhātsuramantriṇi / vaiśvadevādbhagusute vāruṇādbhāskarātmaje
hastarkṣaṃ ca khārvidau candrabhaṃ dasrabhaṃ kuje / saumye mitrabhamācāryaṃ tiṣyaḥ pauṣṇaṃ bhṛgoḥ sute
rohiṇī mandavāre ca siddhiyogāhvayā amī / ādityabhaumayornandā bhadrā śukraśaśāṅkayoḥ
jayāsaumye gurau riktā śanaupūrṇeti no śubhāḥ / nandā tithiḥ śukravāre saumye bhadrā kuje jayā
riktā mande gurorvāre pūrṇā siddhāhvayā amī / ekādaśyāminduvāro dvādaśyāmarkavāsaraḥ
ṣaṣṭī gurau tṛtīyā jñe 'ṣṭamī śukre śanaiścare / navamī pañcamī bhaume dagdhayogāḥ prakīrtitāḥ
bharaṇyarkadine candre citrābhaumetu viśvabham / budhe śraviṣṭāryamabhe gurau jyeṣṭā bhṛgordine
revatī mandavāre tu grahajanmarkṣanāśanam / viśākhādicaturvargamarkamarkavārādiṣu kramāt
utpātamṛtyukāraṇākhyasiddhiyogāḥ prakīrtitāḥ / tithivārodbhavā neṣṭā yogā vārarkṣasaṃbhavāḥ
hūṇavaṅgakhaseṣvanyadeśeṣvatiśubhapradāḥ / ghorāṣṭākṣīmahodaryo mandā mandākinī tathā
miśrā rākṣasikā sūryavārādiṣu yathākramam / śūdrataskaravaiśyakṣmādevabhūpagavāṃ kramāt
anuktānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ ghorādyāḥ sukhadāḥ smṛtāḥ / pūrvāhne nṛpatīnhanti viprānmadhyandine viśaḥ
aparāhne 'stage śūdrānpradoṣe ca piśācakān / niśi rātricarānnāṭyakārānapararātrike
gopānuṣasi saṃdhyāyāṃ liṅgino ravisaṃkramaḥ / divā cenmeṣasaṃkrāntiranarthakalahapradā
rātrau subhikṣamatulaṃ saṃdhyayorvṛṣṭināśanam / hariśārdūlavārāhakharakuñjaramāhiṣāḥ / aśvaśpavājavṛṣāḥ pādāyudhāḥ karaṇavāhanāḥ
bhuśuḍī ca gadākhaḍgau daṇḍa iṣaavāsatomarau
kuntapāśāṅkuśāstreṣūnbibharti karayostvinaḥ / annaṃ ca pāyasaṃ bhaikṣyaṃ sayūṣaṃ ca payo dadhi
miṣṭānnaṃ guḍamadhvājyaśarkarā vavato haviḥ / vavovīvaṇijeviśvāṃ bālave gocarasthitau
kaulave śakunau bhānuḥ kiṃstughne corddhasaṃsthitathaḥ / catuḥ pāde tilenāge suptaḥ krāntiṃ karoti hi
dharmāyurvṛṣṭiṣu samaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ naṣṭaṃ phalaṃ kramāt / āyudhaṃ vāhanāhārau yajjātīyaṃ janasya ca
svāpopaviṣṭāstiṣṭhantaste lokāḥ kṣemamāpnuyuḥ / andhakaṃ mandasaṃjñaṃ ca madhyasaṃjñaṃ sulocanam
papīyādgaṇayodbhāni rohiṇyādicaturvidham / sthirabheṣvarkasaṃkrāntirjñeyā viṣṇupadāhvayā
ṣaḍaśītimukhā jñeyā dvisvabhāveṣu rāśiṣu / tulāghaṭājayorjñeyo viṣuvatsūryasaṃkramaḥ
yāmyāyane sthire tvādyāḥ parāḥ saumyendumūrtibhaiḥ / medhyā viṣuvati proktāḥ puṇyanāḍyastu ṣoḍaśa
saṃdhyā trināḍī pramitārkabiṃborddhodayāstataḥ / prākpaścādyāmyasaumye cetpuṇyaṃ pūrvāṃpare 'hani
yādṛśenendunā bhānoḥ saṃkrāntistādṛśaṃ phalam / naraḥ prāpnoti tadrāśau śītāṃśoḥ sādhvasādhu ca
saṃkrānteḥ parato bhānurbhuktvā yāvadbhiraṃśakaiḥ / raverayanasaṃkrāntistadā tadrāśisaṃkramāt
sakrāntigrahagarkṣaṃvā janmanyubhayapārśvayoḥ / vratodvāhādikeṣveva dvayaṃ neṣṭaṃ tu tatkramāt
tiloparilikheccakraṃ tritriśūlaṃ trikoṇakam / tatra hema vinikṣipya dadyāddoṣāpavṛttayeḥ
tārābalena śītāṃśurbalavāṃstadvaśādraviḥ / balī saṃkramamāṇastu tadvatkheṭā balādhikāḥ
śubhor'ke janmatastryāyadaśaṣaṭsu munīśvara / navapañcāṃburiṣphasthairvyarkibhirvidhyate na cet
śubho janmarkṣataścandro dyūnāṅgāyārisvatriṣu / yatheṣṭāntyāṃbudharmasthaivibudhairvidhyate na cet
tryāyāriṣu kujaḥ śreṣṭho janmanā cenna vidhyate / vyayeṣvaṅkasthitaiḥ saurisaumyasūryaiḥ śubhauṣadhāt
jñaḥ svāyāryaṣṭaravayiṣu janmataścenna vidhaayate / dhītryakādigajāntasthaiḥ śaśāṅkarahitaiḥ śubhaiḥ
janmarāśerguruḥ śreṣṭhaḥ svāyago 'dhyastago na cet / vidhyatentyāṣṭaravāṃbutrigataiḥ ravaiṭairmunīśvarā
janmabhādāsutāṣṭāṅkāntyāyeṣviṣṭo bhṛgoḥsutaḥ / cenna viddho 'ṣṭasaptāṅgam ravāṅkādyāyārirāmagaiḥ
na dadāti śubhaṃ kiñcidgocare vedhasaṃyute / tasmādvedhaṃ vicāryātha kathanīyaṃ śubhāśubham
vāmabhedavidhānena duṣṭo 'pi syācchubhaṅkaraḥ / saumyekṣito 'niṣṭaphalaḥ śubhadaḥ pāpavīkṣitaḥ
niṣphalau tau grahau svena śatruṇā ca vilokitau / nīcarāśigataḥ svasya śatroḥ kṣetragato 'pi vā
śubhāśubhaphalaṃ naiva dadyādastamitopi vā / graheṣu viṣamastheṣu śāntiṃ kuryātprayatnataḥ
hānirvṛddhirgrahādhīnā tasmātpūjyatamā grahāḥ / maṇirmuktāphalaṃ vidrumākhyaṃ maraka taṃ tathā
puṣparāgaṃ tathā vajraṃ nīlaṃ gomedasaṃjñitam / dūryyaṃ bhāskarādīnāṃ tuṣṭya dhāryaṃ yathākramam
śuklapakṣādidivase candro yasya śubhapradaḥ / sa pakṣastasya śubhadaḥ kṛṣṇapakṣonyathāśubhaḥ
śuklapakṣe śubhaścandro dvitīyanavapañcame / riḥpharandhrāṃbusaṃsthaiścainna viddho gagane caraiḥ
janma saṃpadvipat kṣema pratyariḥ sādhako vadhaḥ / mitraṃ paramamitraṃ ca janmabhāttu punaḥ puna
janmatripañcasaptākhyāstārā neṣṭa phalapradāḥ / śākaṃ guḍaṃ ca lavaṇaṃ satilaṃ kāñcanaṃ kramāt
aniṣṭaphalanāśāya dadyādetaddvijātaye / kṛṣṇe balavatī tārā śuklapakṣe balū śaśī / candrasya dvādaśāvasthā rāśaurāśau yathākramam
yātrodvāhādikāryeṣu nāmatulyaphalapradāḥ / ṣaṣṭighnaṃ gatacandrarkṣaṃ tatkālaghaṭikānvitam / vedaghnamiṣuvedāntyamavasthā bhānubhāgataḥ
pravāsanaṣṭākhyamṛtā jayo hāsyaṃ ratimudā / śinibhuktirjvaraḥ kaṃpaḥ susthitirnāmasannibhāḥṛ
paṭṭabandhanayānograsaṃdhivigrahabhūṣaṇam / dhātvākaraṃ yuddhakarma meṣalagne prasiddhyati
maṅgalāni sthirāṇyaṃvuveśmakarmapravartanam / kṛṣivāṇijyapaśvādiduṣṭalagne prasiddhyati
kalāvijñānaśilpāni bhūṣaṇāhavasaṃśravam / gajodvāhābhiṣekādyaṃ karttavyaṃ mithunodaye
vāpīkūpataḍāgādi vāribandhanamokṣaṇam / pauṣṭikaṃ lipilekhādi kartavyaṃ karkaṭodaye
ikṣudhānyavaṇikpaṇyakṛṣisevādayaḥsthire / sāhasāhavabhūpādyaṃ siṃhalagne prasiddhyati
vidyāśilpauṣadhaṃ kṛtyaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ ca carasthiram / kanyā lagne vidheyaṃ ca pauṣṭikākhilamaṅgalam
kṛṣivāṇijyayānaṃ ca paśūdvāhavratādikam / tulāyāmakhilaṃ karma tulābhārāśrite ca yat
sthirakarmākhilaṃ kāryaṃ rājasevābhiṣecanam / cauryakarmasthirāraṃbhāḥ kartavyā vṛścikodaye
vratodvāhaprayāṇāśvagajaśilpakalādikam / carasthiravimiśraṃ ca kartavyaṃ kārmukodaye
cāpabandhanamokṣāstrakṛṣigośvādikam yat / prasthānaṃ paśudāsādi kartavyaṃ makarodaye
kṛṣivāṇijyapaśvaṃbuśilpaṅkarmakalādikam / jalapātrāstrāśastrādi kartavyaṃ kalaśodaye
vratodvāhābhiṣekāṃbusthāpanaṃ sanniveśanam / bhūṣaṇaṃ jalapātrāśvakarma mīnodaye śubham
meṣādiṣu kligneṣu śuddheṣvevaṃ prasiddhyati / krūragrahekṣiteṣūgrasaṃyuteṣūgrameva hi
goyugmakarkakanyāntyatulācāpadharāḥ śubhāḥ / śubharkṣatvāśubhāsatya itarā pāparāśayaḥ
grahayogāvalokābhyāṃ rāśirdhatte grahodbhavam / phalaṃ tābhyāṃ vihīno 'sau svabhāvamupasarpati
ādau saṃpūrṇaphaladaṃ madhye madhyaphalapradam / ante tucchaphale lagne sarvasminnevameva hi
sarvatra prathamaṃ lagnaṃ kartuścandrabalaṃ tataḥ / kalpyāmadindau balini saptame balino grahāḥ
candrasya valimādhāramādheya cānyakheṭakam / ādhārabhūtenādheyaṃ dhīyate paridhiṣṭinam
cendinduḥ śubhadaḥ sarve grahāḥ śubhaphalapradāḥ / aśubhaścedaśubhadā varjayitvā dhanādhipam
lagnasyābhyuditā yeṃśāsteṣvaṃśeṣu sthito grahaḥ / lagnodbhavaṃ phalaṃ dhatte dhanātīto dvitīyakam
evaṃ sthāneṣu śeṣeṣu caivamevaṃ prakalpayet / lagnaṃ sarvaguṇopetaṃ labhyate 'lpairdinairno
doṣālpatvaṃ guṇādhikyaṃ bahu saṃtatamiṣyate / doṣādduṣṭo hi kālastamapi mārṣṭuṃ pitāmahaḥ
apyaśaucatuṇādhikyaṃ doṣānyatte tato hi te / amāriktāṣṭamīṣaṣṭīdvādaśīpratipatsvapi
parighasya ca pūrvārddhaṃ vyatīpāte savaidhṛtau / saṃdhyāsūpaplave viṣṭyāmaśubhaṃ prathamārttavam
rugṇā patipriyā duḥkhī putriṇī bhogamī tathā / pativratā keśayuktā sūryavārādiṣu kramāt
yāmāgniraudrabhāgyayāhidvīśendrādihyupadviṣāḥ / tārakā na hitā māsā madhūrjaśucipauṣakāḥ
bhadrā ca saṃkramonidrā rātriścandrārkayorgrahaḥ / kulaṭā pāpabhogeṣu nindyarkṣe nindyavāsare
tilājyadūrvā juhuyādgāyatryāṣṭaśataṃ budhaḥ / suvarṇagotilāndadyātsarvadoṣāpanuttaye
ādyā niśaścatasrastu tyājyā hyapi samāḥ paraiḥ / ojarāśyaṃśage candre lagne puṅgrahavīkṣite
upavītī yugmatithāvanagnaḥ kāmayetstriyam / putrārthī puruṣaśastyaktvā pauṣṇamūlāhipitryabham
prasiddhe prathame garbhe tṛtīye vā dvitīyake / māse puṃsavanaṃ kāryaṃ sīmantaṃ ca yathā tathā
caturthe māsi ṣaṣṭe vāpyaṣṭame vā tadīśvare / balopapanne daṃpatyoścandratārābalānvite
ariktāparvadivase kujajīvārkavāsare / tīkṣṇamiśrārkavarjyeṣu puṃbhāṃśerātrināyake
śuddhe 'ṣṭame janmalagnāttayorlagne na naidhane / śubhagrahayute dṛṣṭe pāpadṛṣṭivivarjite
śubhagraheṣu dhīdharmakendreṣvaribhave triṣu / pāpeṣu satsu candretyanidhanādyarivarjite
krūragrahāṇāmekopi lagnādantyātmajāṣṭagaḥ / sīmantinīṃ vā tadgarbhaṃ balī hṝnti na saṃśayaḥ
tasmiñjanmamuhūrte 'pi sūtakāntepi vā śiśoḥ / jātakarma prakartavyaṃ pitṛpūjanapūrvakam
sūtakānte nāmakarma vidheyaṃ tatkulocitam / nāmapūrvaṃ praśastaṃ syānmaṅgalaiḥ susamīkṣitaiḥ
deśakālopaghātādyaiḥ kālātikramaṇaṃ yadā / anastage bhṛgāvījye tatkārye cottarāyaṇe
carasthiramṛdukṣipranakṣatre śubhavāsare / candrātārābalopete divase ca śiśoḥ pituḥ
śubhalagne śubhāṃśe ca nidhane śuddhisaṃyute / ṣaṣṭe māsyaṣṭame vāpi puṃsāṃ strīṇāṃ tu pañcame
saptame māsi vā kāryaṃ navānnapraśanaṃ śubham / riktāṃ dinakṣayaṃ nandāṃ dvādaśīmaṣṭamīmatha
tyaktvānyatithiṣu proktaṃ praśanaṃ śubhavāsare / carasthiramṛdukṣipranakṣatre śubhanaidhane
daśame śuddhisaṃyukte śubhalagne śubhāṃśake / pūrvārddhe saumyakheṭena saṃyukte vīkṣitepi vā
triṣaṣṭalābhagaiḥ krūraiḥ kendradhīdharmagaiḥ śubhaiḥ / vyayārinidhanasthe ca candre 'nnaprāśanaṃ śubham
tṛtīye pañcame cābde svakulācārato 'pi vā / bālānāṃ janmataścaulaṃ svagṛhyoktavidhānataḥ
saumyāyane nāstagayoḥ surārisuramantriṇoḥ / aparvariktātithiṣu śukrejyajñenduvāsare
dasrāditījyacandrendrapūṣabhāni śubhāni ca / caulakarmaṇi hastakṣārrtrīṇitrīṇi ca viṣṇubhāt
paṭṭabandhanacaulānnaprāśane copanāyane / śubhadaṃ janmanakṣatramaśubhaṃ tvanyakarmaṇi
aṣṭame śuddhisaṃyukteṃ śubhalagne śubhāṃśake / janmāṣṭame na śītāṃśau ṣaṣṭāṣṭāntyavivarjite
dhanatrikoṇakendrasthaiḥ śubhaistryāyārigaiḥ paraiḥ / abhyakte sandhyayornāre niśi bhuktvā na vāhave
notkaṭe bhūṣite naiva yāne na navame 'hni ca / kṣaurakarma mahīpānāṃ pañcamepañcame 'hani
kartavyaṃ kṣoranakṣatre 'pyatha vāsyodaye śubham / nṛpaviprājñayā yajñe maraṇe bandhamokṣaṇeṃ
udvāhe 'khilavārarkṣatithiṣu kṣauramiṣṭadam / kartavyaṃ maṅgaleṣvādau maṅgalāya kṣurārpaṇam
navame saptame vāpi pañcame divase 'pi vā / tṛtīye bījanakṣatre śubhavāre śubhodaye
samyaggṛhāṇyalaṅkṛtya vitānadhvajatoraṇaiḥ / āśiṣo vācanaṃ kāryaṃ puṇyaṃ puṇyāṅganādibhiḥ
sahavāditranṛtyādyairgatvā prāguttarāṃ diśam / tatra mṛdatatastīkṣṇā gṛhītvā punarāgataḥ
mṛṇyaye 'pyathavā vaiṇave 'pi pātre prapūrayet / anekabījasaṃyuktaṃ toyaṃ puṣpābhiśobhitam
ādhānādaṣṭame varṣe janmato vāgrajanmanām / rājñā mekādaśe maiñjībandhanaṃ dvādaśe viśām
janmataḥ pañcame varṣe vedaśāstrariṃśāradaḥ / upavītī yataḥ śrīmānkāryaṃ tatropanāyanam
bālasya balahīno 'pari sito jīvaḥ śubhapradaḥ / yathoktavatsare kāryamanukte nopanāyanam
dṛśyamānagurau śukre śākheśe cottarāyaṇe / vedānāmadhipā jīvaśukrabhaumabudhāḥ kramāt
śaradgrīṣmavasaṃteṣu vyutkramāttu dvijanmanām / mukhyaṃ sādhāraṇaṃ teṣāṃ tapomāsādipañcasu
svakulācāradharmajño mādhamāse tu phalgune / vidhijñaścārthavāṃścaitre vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ
vaiśāṣe dhanavānvendaśāstravidyāviśāradaḥ / upanīto balāḍhyaśca jyeṣṭhe vidhividāṃ varaḥ
śuklapakṣe dvitīyā ca tṛtīyā pañcamī tathā / trayodaśī ca daśamī saptamī vratabandhane
śreṣṭhā tvekādaśī ṣaṣṭī dvādaśyanyāstu madhyamāḥ / kṛthaṣṇe dvitrīṣusaṃkhyāśca tithyo 'nyā hyatininditāḥ
dhiṣṇānyarkatrayāntejyarudrādityuttarāṇi ca / viṣṇutrayāṃśvimitrābjayonibhānyupanāyane
janmabhāddaśamaṃ karma saṃghātarkṣaṃ tu ṣoḍaśam / aṣṭādaśaṃ samudayaṃ trayoviṃśaṃ vināśanam
mānasaṃ mānasaṃ pañcaviṃśarkṣaṃ nācarecchubhameṣu tu / ācāryasaumyakāvyānāṃ vārāḥ śastāḥ śaśīnayoḥ
vārau tu madhyamau caiva vrate 'nyau ninditau matau / tridhā vibhajya divasaṃ tatrādau karma daivikam
dvitīye mānuṣaṃ kāryaṃ tṛtīye ḥṃśe ca paitṛkam / svanīcage tadaṃśe vā svāribhe vā tadaṃśake
guruśikhinośca śākheśe kalāśīlavivarjitaḥ / svādhiśatrugṛhasthe vā tadaṃśasthe 'tha vā vratī
śākheśe vā gurau śukre mahāpātakakṛdbhavet / svoccasaṃsthe tadaṃśe vā svarāśau rāśige gaṇe
śākheśe vā gurau śukre kendrage vā trikoṇage / atīva dhanavāṃścaiva vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ
paramoccagate jīve śākheśe vātha vā sate / vratī viśuddhe nidhane vedaśāstraviśāradaḥ
svādhimitragṛhasthe vā tasyoñcasthe tadaṃśage / gurau bhṛgau vā śākheśe vidyādhanasamanvitaḥ
śākhādhipativāraśca śākhādhipabalaṃ śiśoḥ / śaākhādhipatilagnaṃ ca durlabhaṃ tritayaṃ vrate
tasmādvedvāṃśage candre vratī vidyāviśāradaḥ / pāpāṃśage vā daridro nityaduḥkhitaḥ
śravaṇādini nakṣatre karkāṃśasthe niśākare / tadā vratī vedaśāstradhanadhānyasamṛddhimān
śubhalagne śubhāṃśe ca naidhane śuddhisaṃyute / lagne tu nidhane saumyaiḥ saṃyute vā nirīkṣite
iṣṭairjīvārkacandrādyaiḥ pañcabhirbalibhirgrahai / sthānādibalasaṃpūrṇaiścaturbhirvā śubhānvitaiḥ
īkṣannaivātraikaviṃśamahādoṣavivarjite / rāśayaḥ sakalāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ śubhagrahayutekṣitāḥ
śubhanavāṃśakagatā grāhyāste śubharāśayaḥ / na kadācitkarkaṭāṃśaśubhekṣitayuto 'pi vā
tasmādgomithunāṃśāśca tulākanyāṃśakāḥ śubhāḥ / evaṃvidhe lagnagate navāṃśe vratamīritam
triṣaḍāyagataiḥ pāpaiḥ ṣaḍaṣṭāntyavivarjitaiḥ / śubhaiḥ ṣaṣṭāṣṭalagnāntyavarjitena himāṃśunā
svoñcasaṃstho 'pi śītāṃśurvratino yadi lagnagaḥ / na karoti śiśuṃ niḥsvaṃ sarvataḥ kṣayarogiṇam
sphūrjite kendrage bhānau vratināṃ pitṛnāśanam / pañcadoṣonitaṃ lagnaṃ śubhadaṃ copanāyane
vinā vasaṃtaṛtunā kṛṣṇapakṣe galagrahe / anadhyāye viṣṭiṣaṣṭyorna tu saskāramarhati
trayodaśyādicatvāri saptamyādidinatrayam / caturthī vā śubhāḥ proktā aṣṭāvete galagrahāḥ
kṣurikābandhaṃ vakṣye nṛpāṇāṃ prākkaragrahāt / vivāhokteṣu māseṣu śuklapakṣe 'pyanastage
jīve śukre ca bhūputre candratārābalānvite / maiñjībandhoktatithiṣu kujavarjitavāsare
nacennavāṃśake karturaṣṭamodayavarjite / śuddhe 'ṣṭame vidhau lagne ṣaṣṭāṣṭāntyavivarjite
dhanatrikoṇakendrasthaiḥ śubhaistryāyārigaiḥ paraiḥ / kṣurikābandhanaṃ kāryamarcayitvāmarānpitṝn
arcayetkṣurikāṃ samyagdevatānāṃ ca sannidhau / tataḥ sulagne badhnīyātkaṭyāṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyutām
āyāmārddhāgravistārapramāṇenaivacchedayat / tacchedakhaṇḍānyāyāḥ syurdhvajāye ripunāśanam
ghūmrāye maraṇaṃ siṃhe jayaḥ śuni ca rogitā / dhanalābho vṛṣe 'tyantaṃ duḥkhī bhavati gardabhe
gajāye 'tyantasaṃprītirdhvāṅkṣe vittavināśanam / khaḍgaputrikayormānaṃ gaṇayetsvāṅgulena tu
mānāṅguleṣu paryāyāmekādaśamitāṃ tyajet / śeṣāṇāmagulīnāṃ ca phalāni syuryathākramam
putralābhaḥ śatruvadhaḥ strīlābho gamana śubham / arthahāniścārthavṛddhiḥ prīti siddhijayaḥ stutiḥ
sthito dhvaje vṛṣāye vā naṣṭācetpūrvato vraṇam / siṃhegaje madhyabhāge tvantabhāge śvakākayoḥ
dhṛmragarddabhayornaiva vraṇaṃ śrayontyabhāgagam / athottarāyaṇe śukrajīvayorddaśyamānayoḥ
dvijātīnāṃ gurorgehānnivṛttānāṃ yatātmanām / citrottarāditījyāntyaharimitravidhātṛṣu
bheṣvarkendujñejyaśukravāralagnāṃśakeṣu ca / pratipatparvariktā mā cāṣṭamī ca dinatrayam
hitvānyadivase kāryaṃ samāvartanamuṇḍanam / sarvāśramāṇāṃ viprendra hyuttamo 'yaṃ gṛhāśramaḥ
sukhaṃ tatrāpi bhāminyāṃ śīlavatyāṃ sthitaṃ tataḥ / tasyāḥ sacchīlarlā dhastu sulagnavaśataḥ khalu
pitāmahoktaṃ saṃvīkṣya lagnaśuddhiṃ pravacmyaham / puṇye 'hnilakṣaṇopetaṃ sukhāsīnaṃ sucetasam
praṇamya devavatpṛccherddaivajñaṃ bhaktipūrvakam / tāṃbūlaphalapuṣpādyaiḥ pūrṇāñjalirupāgataḥ
tatra cellagnagaḥ krūrastasmātsaptamagaḥ kujaḥ / daṃpatyormaraṇa vācya varṣāṇāmaṣṭakātpurā
yadi lagnagataścandrastasmātsaptamagaḥ kujaḥ / vijñeyaṃ bhartṛmaraṇamaṣṭavarṣānttare budhaiḥjha
lagnātpañcamagaḥ pāpaḥ śatrudṛṣṭaśca nīcagaḥ / mṛtaputrātha vā kanyā kulaṭā vā na saṃśayaḥ
tṛtīyapañcasaptāyakarmago vā niśākaraḥ / lagnātkaroti saṃbandhaṃ daṃpatyorguruvīkṣitaḥ
tulāgokarkaṭā lagnasaṃsthaḥ śukrendusaṃyutāḥ / vīkṣitāḥ pṛcchatāṃ nṝṇāṃ kanyālābho bhavettadā
strīdreṣkāṇaḥ strīnavāṃśe yugmalagnaṃ samāgatam / vīkṣitaṃ candraśukrābhyāṃ kanyālābho bhavettadā
evaṃ strīṇāṃ bhartṛlabdhiḥ puṃlagne puṃnavāṃśake / pṛcchakasya bhavellagnaṃ puṅgrahairavalokitam
kṛṣṇapakṣe praśnalagnādyasya rāśī yadā / pāpadṛṣṭo 'tha vā randhre na saṃbandho bhavettadā
puṇyairnimittaśakunaiḥ praśnakāle tu maṅgalam / daṃpatyoraśubhairetairaśubhaṃ sarvato bhavet
pañcāṅgaśuddhidivase candratārābalānvite / vivāhabhasyodaye vā kanyāvaraṇamanvayaiḥ
bhūṣaṇaiḥ puṣpatāṃbūlaphalairgandhākṣatādibhiḥ / śuklāṃbarairgītavādyaiṃrvighnāśīrvacanaiḥ saha
kārayetkanyakāgehe varaḥ praṇavapūrvakam / tadā kuryātpitā tasyāḥ pradānaṃ prītipūrvakam
kulaśīlavayorūpavittavidyāyutāya ca / varāya ca rūpavatīṃ kanyāṃ dadyādyavīyasīm
saṃpūjya prārthayitvā ca śacīṃ devīṃ guṇāśrayām / trailokyasundarīṃ divyagandhamālyāṃbarāvṛtām
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām / anarghamaṇimālābhirbhāsayantīṃ digantarān
vilāsinīsahasrādyaiḥ sevamānāmaharniśam / evaṃvidhāṃ kumārīṃ tāṃ pūjānte prārthayediti
devīndrāṇi namastubhyāṃ devendrapriyabhāmini / vivāhe bhāgyamārogyaṃ putralābhaṃ ca dehi me
yugme 'bde janmataḥ strīṇāṃ pītidaṃ pāṇipīḍanam / etatpuṃsāmayugme 'bde vyatyayenāśanaṃ tayoḥ
māghaphaālgunavaiśākhajyeṣṭamāsāḥ śubhapradāḥ / madhyamā kārtiko mārgaśīrṣo vai ninditāḥ pare
na kadācidvaśarkṣeṣu bhānorārdrāpraveśanāt / vivāho devatānāṃ ca pratiṣṭāṃ copanāyanam
nāstaṅgate site jīve na tayorbālavṛddhayoḥ / na gurau siṃharāśisthe siṃhāṃśakagatepi vā
paścātprāguditaḥ śukro daśatridivasaṃ śiśuḥ / buddhaḥ pañcadinaṃ pakṣaṃ guruḥ pakṣaṃ ca sarvataḥ
aprabuddho hṛṣīkeśo yāvattāvanna maṅgalam / utsave vāsudevasya divase nānyamaṅgalam
na janmamāse janmarkṣe na janmadivase 'pi ca / ādya garbhasutasyātha duhiturvā karagrahaḥ
naivodvāho jyeṣṭhaputrīputrayośca parasparam / jyeṣṭamāse tayorekajyeṣṭhe śreṣṭhaśca nānyathā
utpātagrahaṇādūrddhaṃ saptāhamakhilagrahe / nākhile tridinaṃ neṣṭaṃ tridyuspṛk ca kṣayaṃ tathā
grastāste tridinaṃ pūrvaṃ paścādgrastodaye 'thavā / saṃdhyāyāṃ tridinaṃ tadvanniśīthe sapta eva ca
māsānte pañca divasāṃstyajedriktāṃ tathāṣṭamīm / vyatīpātaṃ vaidhṛtiṃ ca saṃpūrṇaṃ parighārddhakam
pauṣṇabhatryuttarāmaitramaruñcandrārkapitryabhaiḥ / samūlabhairaviddhaistaiḥ strīkaragraha iṣyate
vivāhe balamāvaśyaṃ daṃpatyorgurusūryayoḥ / cetpūjā yatnataḥ kāryā durbala grahayostayoḥ
gocaraṃ vedhajaṃ cāṣṭavargajaṃ rūpajaṃ balam / yathottaraṃ balādhikyaṃ sthūlaṃ gocaramārgajam
candratārābalaṃ vīkṣya tataḥ pañcāṅgajaṃ balam / tithirekaguṇā vāro dviguṇastriguṇaṃ ca bham
yogaścaturguṇaḥ pañcaguṇaṃ tithyarddhasaṃjñitam / tato manahūrto balavāṃstato lagnaṃ balādhikam
tato balavatī horā dreṣkāṇo balavāṃstataḥ / tato navāṃśo balavāndvādaśāṃśo balī tataḥ
triṃśāṃśo balavāṃstasmādvīkṣyametadbalābalam / śubhekṣitayutāḥ śastā udvāhe 'khilarāśayaḥ
candrārkejyādayaḥ paca yasya rāśestukhecarāḥ / iṣṭāstacchubhadaṃ lagnaṃ catvāro 'pi balānvitāḥ
jāmitraśuddhyaikaviṃśanmahādoṣavivarjitam / ekaviṃśatidoṣāṇāṃ nāmarūpaphalāni ca
vakṣyante 'tra samāsena śṛṇu nārada sāṃpratam / pañcāṅgaśuddhirāhityaṃ doṣastvādyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ
udayāstaśuddhirhānirdvitīyaḥ sūryasaṃkramaḥ / tṛtīyaḥ pāpaṣaḍvargo bhṛguḥ ṣaṣṭaḥ kujo 'ṣṭamaḥ
gaṇḍāntaṃ kartarī riṣaaphaṣaḍaṣṭendugato grahaḥ / daṃpatyoraṣṭamaṃ lagnaṃ rāśirviṣaghaṭī tathā
durmuhīrto vāradoṣaḥ khārjūrikasamāṅghribham / grahaṇotpātabhaṃ krūraviddharkṣaṃ krūrasaṃyutam
kunavāṃśo mahāpāto vaidhṛtiścaikaviṃśatiḥ / tithivārarkṣayogānāṃ karaṇasya ca melanam
pañcāṅgamasya śuddhistu pañcāṅgaśuddhirīritā / yasminpañcāṅgadoṣo 'sti tasmiṃllagne nirarthakam
tyajetpañcaiṣṭikaṃ cāpi viṣasaṃyuktadugdhavat / lagnalagnāṃśakau svasvapatinā vīkṣitau yutau
na cedvānyonyapatinā śubhaghamitreṇa vā tathā / varasya mṛtyuḥ syāttābhyāṃ saptasaptodayāṃśakau
evaṃ tau na yutau dṛṣṭau mutyurvadhvāḥ karagrahe / tyājyāḥ sūryasya saṃkrānteḥ pūrvataḥ paratastathā
vivāhādiṣu kāryeṣu nāḍyaḥ ṣoḍaśaṣoḍaśā / / ṣaḍvargaḥ śubhadaḥ śreṣṭho vivāhasathāpanādiṣu
bhṛguṣaṣṭhāhvayo doṣo lagnātṣaṣṭhagate site / uccage śubhasaṃyukte tallagnaṃ sarvadā tyajet
kujo 'ṣṭamo mahādoṣo lagnādaṣṭamage kuje / śubhatrayayutaṃ lagnaṃ na tyajettuṅgago yadi
pūrṇānandāṅkhyayostithyoḥ saṃdhirnāḍīdvayaṃ yadā / gaṇḍāntaṃ mṛtyudaṃ janmayātrodvāhavratādiṣu
kulīrasiṃhayoḥ kīṭacāpayorminameṣayoḥ / gaṇḍātaṃmantarālaṃ syāddhaṭikārddhaṃ mṛtipradam
sārpaindrapauṣṇobheṣvantyaṣoḍaśeśā bhasaṃdhayaḥ / tadagnimeṣvādyapādā bhānāṃ gaṇḍātasaṃjñakāḥ
ugraṃ ca saṃdhitritayaṃ gaṇḍātaṃ trividhaṃ mahat / lagnābhimukhayoḥ pāpagrahayorṛjuvakrayoḥ
sā kartarīti vijñeyā daṃpatyorgalakartarī / kartarīyogaduṣṭaṃ yallagnaṃ tatparivarjayet
api saumyagrahairyukta guṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ samanvitam / ṣaḍaṣṭariṣphage candre lagnadoṣaḥ svasaṃjñakaḥ
tallagnaṃ varjayedyatrājjīvaśukrasamanvitam / uccage nīcage vāpi mitrabhe śatrurāśige
api sarvaguṇopetaṃ daṃpatyornidhanapradam / śaśāṅke grahasaṃyukte doṣaḥ saṃgrahasaṃjñakaḥ
tasminsaṃgrahadoṣe tu vivāhaṃ naiva kārayet / sūryeṇa saṃyute candre dāridyaṃ bhavati sphuṭam
kujena maraṇaṃ vyādhiḥ saumyena tvanapatyatā / daurbhāgyaṃ guruṇā yukte sāpatyaṃ bhārgaveṇa tu
pravrajyā sūryaputreṇa rāhuṇā mūlasaṃkṣayaḥ / ketunā saṃyute candre nityaṃ kaṣṭaṃ daridratā
pāpagrahayute candre daṃpatyormaraṇaṃ bhavet / śubhagrahayute candre svoccasthe mitrarāśige
doṣāyanaṃ bhavellagnaṃ daṃpatyoḥ śreyase sadā / svoccago vā svarkṣago vā mitra kṣetragatopi vā
pāpagnahayutaścandraḥ karoti maraṇaṃ tayoḥ / daṃpatyoraṣṭamaṃ lagnamaṣṭamo rāśireva ca
yadi lagnagataḥ sopi daṃpatyormaraṇapradaḥ / sa rāśiḥ śubhasaṃyukto lagnaṃ vā śubhasaṃyutam
lagnaṃ vivarjayedyatnāttadaṃśāṃśatadīśvarām / daṃpatyordvādaśaṃ lagnaṃ rāśirvā yadi lagnagaḥ
arthahānistayorasmāttadaṃśasvāminaṃ tyajet / janmarāśyudayaścaiva janmalagnodayaḥ śubhaḥ
tayorupacayasthānaṃ lagnetyantaśubhapradam / khamārgaṇā vedapakṣāḥ kharāmā vedamārgaṇāḥ
vahnicandrā rūpadasrāḥ kharāmā vyomabāhavaḥ / dvirāmāḥ svāgnaṃyaḥ śūnyadasrāḥ kuñjarabhūmayaḥ
rūpapakṣā vyomadasrā vedacandrāścaturddaśa / śūnyacandrā vedacandrā ṣaḍṛkṣā vedabāhavaḥ
śūnyadasrāḥ śūnyacandrāḥ pūrṇacandrā gatendravaḥ / tarkacandrā vedapakṣāḥ kharāmāścāśvibhātkramāt
ābhyāḥ parāstu ghaṭikāścatasro viṣasaṃjñitāḥ / vivāhādiṣu kāryeṣu viṣanāḍīṃ vivarjayet
bhāskarādiṣu vāreṣu ye muhūrtāśca ninditāḥ / vivāhādiṣu te varjyā apilakṣaguṇairyutāḥ
nihitāvāradoṣā ye sūryavārādiṣu kramāt / api sarvaguṇopetāste varjyāḥ sarvamaṅgale
ekārgalāṅghritulyaṃ yattallagnaṃ ca vivarjayet / apiśukrejyasaṃyuktaṃ viṣasaṃyuktadugdhavat
grahaṇotpātabhaṃ tyājyaṃ maṅgaleṣu ṛtutrayam / yāvacca śaśinā bhuktvā muktabhaṃ dagdhakāṣṭavat
maṅgaleṣu tyajetśeṭairviddhaṃ ca krūrasaṃyutam / akhilarkṣaṃ pañcagavyaṃ surābinduyutaṃ tathā
pāda eva śubhairviddhamaśubhaṃ naiva kṛtstrabham / krūraviddhaṃ yutaṃ dhiṣṇyaṃ nikhilaṃ naiva maṅgalam
tulāmithunakanyāṃśā dhanurantyārddhasaṃyutāḥ / ete navāṃśāḥ śubhadā vṛṣabhasyāṃśakāḥ khalu
antyāṃśāstepi śubhadā yadi vargottamāhvayāḥ / anye navāṃśā na grāhyā yataste kunavāṃśakāḥ
kunavāṃśakalagnaṃ yattyājyaṃ sarvaguṇānvitam / yasmindine mahāpātastaddinaṃ varjayecchubhe
api sarvaguṇopetaṃ dampatyormṛtyudaṃ yataḥ / anuktāḥ svalpadoṣāḥ syurvidyunnīhāravṛṣṭayaḥ
pratyarkapariveṣendracāpāṃbudharagarjanāḥ / lattopagrahapātākhyā māsadagdhāhvayā tithiḥ
dagdhalagnāndhabadhirapaṅgusaṃjñāśca rāśayaḥ / evamādyāstatasteṣāṃ vyavasthā kriyate 'dhunā
akālajā bhavantyete vidyunnīhāravṛṣṭayaḥ / doṣāya maṅgale nūnamadoṣāyaiva kālataḥ
bṛhaspatiḥ kendragataḥ śukro vā yadi vā budhaḥ / eko 'pi doṣanicayaṃ haratyeva na saṃśayaḥ
tiryakpañcorddhūgāḥ pañca rekhā dve dve ca koṇayoḥ / dvitīye śaṃbhukoṇe 'gnidhiṣṇyaṃ cakre pravinyaset
bhānyatra sābhijityekarekhākheṭena viddhabham / purataḥ pṛṣṭator'kādyā dinarkṣaṃ lattayanti yat
arkākṛtiguṇādynaṅgabāṇāṣṭanavasaṃkhyabham / sūryabhātsārppapitryāntyatvāṣṭramitroḍuviṣṇubham
saṃkhyāyā dinabhetāvadaśvibhātpātaduṣṭabham / saurāṣṭre sālvadeśe tu lattitaṃ bhaṃ vivarjayet
kaliṅgavaṅgadeśeṣu pātitaṃ na śubhapradam / bāhlike kurudeśe cānyasmindeśe na dūṣaṇam
tithayo māsadagdhāśca dagdhalagnāni yānyapi / madhyadeśe vivarjyāni na dṛṣṭānītareṣu ca
ṣaṅgvaṃ dhakāṇalagnāni māsaśūnyāśca rāśayaḥ / gauḍamālavayostyājyā anyadeśe na garhitāḥ
doṣaduṣṭaṃ sadā kālaṃ sannimārṣṭuṃ na śakyate / api dhāturato grāhyaṃ doṣālpatvaṃ guṇādhikam
evaṃ sulagne daṃpatyoḥ kārayetsamyagīkṣaṇam / hastocchritāṃ caturhastaiścaturasrāṃ samantataḥ
staṃbhaścaturbhiḥ suślakṣṇairvāmabhāge tu sannatām / samaṇḍapāṃ caturdikṣu sopānairatiśobhitām
prāgudakpravaṇāṃ raṃbhāstaṃbhairhaṃsaśukādibhiḥ / vicitritāṃ citrakuṃbhairvividhaistoraṇāṅkuraiḥ
śṛṅgārapuṣpanicayairvarṇakaiḥ samalaṅkṛtām / viprāśīrvacanaiḥ puṇyasrībhirdivyairmanoramām
vāditranṛtyagītādyairhṛdayānandinīṃ śubhām / evaṃ vidhāṃ samārohenmithunaṃ svāgnivedikām
