vāmāṅkasthitayā lakṣmyāliṅgataṃ padmahastayā / viṣamṛtyūparogādisarvopadravanāśanam
narasiṃhaṃ mahābhīmaṃ kālānala samaprabham / āntramālādharaṃ raudraṃ kaṇṭhahāreṇa bhūṣitam
nāgayajñopavītaṃ ca pañcānanasuśobhitam / candramauliṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ prativaktraṃ trinetrakam
bhujaiḥ parighasaṃkāśairddaśabhiścopaśobhitam / akṣasūtraṃ gadāpadmaṃ śaṅkhaṃ gokṣīrasannibham
dhanuśca muśalaṃ caiva bibhrāṇaṃ cakrasuttamam / khaḍgaṃ śūlaṃ ca bāṇaṃ ca nṛhariṃ rudrarūpiṇam
indragopābhanīlābhaṃ candrābhaṃ svarṇasannibham / pūrvādi cottaraṃ yāvadūddhvārsyaṃ sarvavarṇakam
evaṃ dhyātvā japenmantrī sarvavyādhivimuktaye / sarvamṛtyuharaṃ divya smaraṇātsarvasiddhidam
dhyāyedyadā mahātkarma tadā ṣoḍaśahastavān / nṛsiṃhaḥ sarvalokeśaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ
dvau vidāraṇakarmāptau dvau cāntroddharaṇānvitau / śaṅkhacacakradharau dvau tu dvau ca bāṇaghanurddharau
khaḍgakheṭadharau dvau ca dvau gadāpadmadhāriṇau / pāśāṅkuśadharau dvau ca dvau ripormukuṭārpitau
iti ṣoḍaśadordaṇḍamaṇḍitaṃ nṛhariṃ vibhum / dhyāyennārada nīlābhamugrakarmamaṇyananyadhīḥ
dhyeyo mahatame kārye dvātriṃśaddhastavānbudhaiḥ / nṛsiṃhaḥ sarvabhūteśaḥ sarvasiddhikaraḥ paraḥ
dakṣiṇe cakrapadme ca paraśuṃpāśameva ca / halaṃ ca muśalaṃ caiva abhayaṃ cāṅkuśaṃ tathā
paṭṭiśaṃ bhindipālaṃ ca khaḍgamudgaratomarān / vāmabhāge karaiḥ śaṃṅkhaṃ kheṭaṃ pāśaṃ ca śūlakam
agniṃ ca varadaṃ śaktiṃ kuṇḍikāṃ ca tataḥ param / kārmukaṃ tarjanīmudrāṃ gadāṃ ḍamaruśūrpakau
dvābhyāṃ karābhyāṃ ca riporjānumastakapīḍanam / ūrddhvīkṛtābhyāṃ bāhubhyāṃ āntramālādharaṃ vibhum
adhaḥ sthitābhyāṃ bāhubhyāṃ hiraṇyakavidāraṇam / priyaṅkaraṃ ca bhaktānāṃ daityānāṃ ca bhayaṅkaram
nṛsihaṃ taṃ smareditthaṃ mahāmṛtyubhayāpaham / evaṃ dhyātvā japenmantrī sarvakāryārthasiddhaye
athocyate dhyānamanyanmukharogaharaṃ śubham / svarṇavarṇasuparṇasthaṃ vidyunmālāsaṭānvitam
koṭipūrṇenduvarṇaṃ ca sumukhaṃ tryakṣivīkṣaṇam / pītavastrorubhūṣāḍhyaṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ śāntavigraham / cakraśaṅkhābhayavarāndadhataṃ karapallavaiḥ
kṣveḍarogādiśamanaṃ svairdhyānaiḥ sukhanditam / śatroḥ senānirodhena yatnaṃ kuryāñca sādhakam
akṣakāṣṭairedhite 'gnau vicintya ripumardanam / devaṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ saṃpūjya kusumādyupacārakaiḥ
samūlamūlairjuṃhuyāccarairdaśaśataṃ pṛthak / ripuṃ khādanniva japennirdahanniva taṃ kṣipet
hutvā saptadinaṃ mantrī senāmiṣṭāṃ mahīpateḥ / prasthāpayecchubhe lagne pararāṣṭrajayecchayā
tasyāḥ purastānnṛhariṃ nighnantaṃ ripumaṇḍalam / smṛtvā japaṃ praklarvīta yāvadāyāti sā punaḥ
nirjatya nikhilāñchatrūnsaha vīraśriyāsukhāt / prīṇayenmantriṇaṃ rājā vibhavaiḥ prītamānasaḥ
gajāśvaratharatnaiśca grāmakṣetradhanādibhiḥ / yadi mantrī na tuṣyeta tadānartho mahīpateḥ
jāyate tasya rāṣṭreṣu prāṇebhyo 'pi mahābhayam / aṣṭottaraśatamūlamantramantritabhasmanā
nāśayenmūṣikālūtāvṛścikādyutthitaṃ viṣam / liptāṅgaḥ sarvarogaiśca mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
sevantīkusumairhutvā mahatīṃ śriyamāpnuyāt / audumbarasamidbhistu bhaveddhānyasamṛddhimān
apūpalakṣahome tu bhavedvaiśravaṇopamaḥ / kruddhasya sannidhau rājño japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam
sadyo nairmalyamāpnoti prasādaṃ cādhigacchati / kundaprasūnairudayaṃ mocābhirvighnanāśanam
tulasīpatrahomena mahatīṃ kīrtimāpnuyāt / śālyutthasaktuhomena vaśayedakhilaṃ jagat
madhūkapuṣpairiṣṭaṃ syātstaṃbhanaṃ dhātrikhaṇḍakaiḥ / dadhimadhvājyamiśrāṃ tu guḍūcīṃ caturaṅgulām
juhuyā dayutaṃ yo 'sau śataṃ jīvati rogajit / śanaiścaradine 'śvatthaṃ spṛṣṭvā cāṣṭottaraṃ śatam
japejjitvāso 'pamṛtyuṃ śatavarṣāṇi jīvati / atha te saṃpravakṣyāmi yantraṃ trailokyamohanam
yasya saṃdhāraṇādeva bhaveyuḥsarvasaṃpadaḥ / śvetabhūrjje likhetpadmaṃ dvātriṃśatsiṃhasaṃyutam
madhye siṃhe svabījaṃ ca likhetpūrvavadeva tu / śrībījena tu tusaṃvedya valayatrayasaṃyutam
pāśāṅkuśaiśca saṃveṣṭya pūjayedyantramuttamam / trailokyamohanaṃ nāma sarvakāmārthasādhanam
cakrarājaṃ mahārājaṃ sarvacarkeśvareśvaram / dhāraṇājjayamāpnoti satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
atha yantrāntaraṃ vakṣye śṛṇu nārada siddhidam / aṣṭāraṃ vilikhedyantraṃ ślakṣṇaṃ karṇikayā yutam
mūlamantraṃ likhettatra praṇavena samanvitam / ekākṣaraṃ nārasiṃhaṃ madhye caiva sasādhyakam
japedaṣṭasahasraṃ tu sūtreṇāveṣṭya tadbahiḥ / svarṇaraupyasutāmraiśca veṣṭayetkramataḥ sudhīḥ
lākṣayā veṣṭitaṃ kṛtvā punarmantreṇa mantrayet / kaṇṭhe bhuje śikhāyāṃ vā dhārayedyantramuttamam
naranārīnaredrāśca sarve syurvaśagā bhuvi / duṣṭāstaṃ naiva bādhante piśācoragarākṣasāḥ
yantrarājaprasādena sarvatra jayamāpnuyāt / athānyatsaṃpravakṣyāmi yantraṃ sarvavaśaṅkaram
dvādaśāraṃ mahācakraṃ pūrvavadvilikhetsudhīḥ / mātrādvādaśasaṃbhinnadalena vilikhedrudhaḥ
madhye mantraṃ śaktiyuktaṃ śrībījena tu veṣṭayeta / kālāntakaṃ nāma cakraṃ surāsukhaśaṅkaram
cakramullekhayedbhūrje sarvaśatrunivāraṇam / yasya dhāraṇamātreṇa sarvatra vijayī bhavet
atha sarveṣṭadaṃ jvālāmālisaṃjñaṃ vadāmyaham / bījaṃ hṛdbhagavānṅeṃto narasiṃhāya tatparam
jvāline māline dīptadaṃṣṭrāya agnine padam / trāya sarvādirakṣoghnāya ca naḥ sarvabhūpadam
harirvināśanāyānte sarvajvaravināśanaḥ / nāmānte dahayugmaṃ ca pacadvayamudīrayet
rakṣayugmaṃ ca varmāstraṭhadūyānto dhruvādikaḥ / aṣṭaṣaṣṭyakṣaraiḥ prokto jvālāmālī manūttamaḥ
puṇyādikaṃ tu pūrvoktaṃ trayodaśabhirakṣaraiḥ / paṅktibhī rudrāsaṃkhyākairaṣṭādaśabhirakṣaraiḥ
bhānubhiḥ karaṇairmantrī varairaṅgāni kalpayet / pūrvoktarūpiṇaṃ jvālāmālina nṛhariṃ smaret
lakṣaṃ japo daśāṃśaṃ ca juhuyātkapilāghṛtaiḥ / raudrāpasmārabhūtādināśako 'yaṃ manūttamaḥ
prāṇo māyā nṛsiṃhaśca sṛṣṭirbrahmāstramīritaḥ / ṣaḍakṣaro mahāmantraḥ sarvābhīṣṭapradāyakaḥ
munirbrahmā tathā chandaḥ paṅktirdevo nṛkesarī / ṣaḍdīrghabhājā bījena ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret
pūrvoktenaiva vidhinā dhyānaṃ pūjāṃ samācaret / siddhena manunānena sarvasiddhirbhavennṛṇām
ramābījādiko 'nuṣṭuptrayastriṃśārṇavānmanuḥ / prajāpatirmuniścchando 'nuṣṭup lakṣmīnṛkesarī
devatā caja padaiḥ sarveṇāṅgakalpanamīritam / vinyasyaivaṃ tu pañcāṅgaṃ svātmarakṣāṃ samācaret
saṃspṛśan dakṣiṇaṃ bāhuṃ śarabhasya manuṃ japet / praṇavo hṛcchivāryanti mahate śarabhāya ca
vahnipriyānto mantrastu rakṣārthe samudāhṛtaḥ / athavā rāmamantrānte paraṃ kṣadvitayaṃ paṭhet
athavā keśavādyaistu rakṣāṃ kuryātprayatnataḥ / keśavaḥ pātu pādau me jaṅghe nārāyaṇo 'vatu
mādhavo me kaṭiṃ pātu govindo guhyameva ca / nābhiṃ viṣṇuśca me pātu jaṭharaṃ madhusūdanaḥ
ūrū trivikramaḥ pātu hṛdayaṃ pātu me naraḥ / śrīdharaḥ pātu kaṇṭhaṃ ca hṛṣīkeśo mukhaṃ mama
padmanābhaḥ stanau pātu śīrṣaṃ dāmodaro 'vatu / evaṃ vinyasya cāṅgeṣu japakāle tu sādhakaḥ
nirbhayo jāyate bhūtavetālagraharākṣasāt / punarnyasetprayatnena dhyānaṃ kurvansamāhitaḥ
purastātkeśavaḥ pātuḥ cakrī jāṃbūnadaprabhaḥ / paścānnārāyaṇaḥ śaṅkhī nīlajīmūtasannibhaḥ
urddhvamindīvaraśyāmo mādhavastu gadādharaḥ / givindo dakṣiṇe pārśve dhanvī candraprabho mahān
uttare haladhṛgviṣṇuḥ padmakiñjalkasannibhaḥ / āgneyyāmaravindākṣo musalīmadhusūdanaḥ
trivikramaḥ khaḍgapāṇirnairṛtyāṃ jvalanaprabhaḥ / vāyavyāṃ mādhavo vajrī taruṇādityasannibhaḥ
aiśānyāṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ śrīdharaḥ paṭṭiśāyudhaḥ / vidyutprabho hṛṣīkeśa urddhū pātu samudgaraḥ
adhaśca padmanābho me sahasrāṃśusamaprabheḥ / sarvāyudhaḥ sarvaśaktiḥ sarvādyaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ
indragopaprabhaḥ pāyātpāśahasto 'parājitaḥ / sa bāhyābhyantare dehamavyāddāmo daro hariḥ
evaṃ sarvatra niśchidraṃ nāma dvādaśapañjaram / praviṣṭo 'haṃ na me kiñcidbhayamasti kadācana
evaṃ rakṣāṃ vidhāyātha durddharṣo jāyate naraḥ / sarveṣu nṛharermantravargeṣvevaṃ vidhirmataḥ
pūrvoktavidhinā sarvaṃ dhyānapūjādikaṃ caret / jitaṃ te puṇḍarīkākṣa namaste viśvabhāvana
namaste 'stu hṛṣīkeśa mahāpuruṣa te namaḥ / itthaṃ saṃprārthya japtvā ca paṭitvā visṛjedvibhum
evaṃ siddhe manau mantrī jāyate sampadāṃ padam / jayadvayaṃ śrīnṛsiṃhetyaṣṭārṇo 'yaṃ manūttamaḥ
munirbrahmātha gāyatrī chandaḥ prokto 'sya devatā / śrīmāñjayanṛsiṃhastu sarvābhīṣṭapradāyakaḥ
seṃdugorvidapūrveṇa viyatā sendunā punaḥ / ṣaḍvīrghāḍhye na kurvīta ṣaḍaṅgāni viśāladhīḥ
tato dhyāyeddhṛdi vibhuṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ candraśekharam
śrīmannṛkesaritano jagadekabaṃndho śrīnīlakaṇṭha karuṇārṇave sāmarāja / vahnīndutīvrakaranetra pinākapāṇe śītāṃśuśekhara rameśvara pāhi viṣṇo
dhyātvaivaṃ prapellakṣāṣṭakaṃ mantrī daśāṃśataḥ / sājyena pāyasānnena juhuyātprāgvadarcanam
tāro māyā svabījānte karṇograṃ vīramīrayet / mahāviṣṇu tato brūyājjvalantaṃ sarvatomukham
sphuraddvayaṃ prasphureti dvayaṃ ghorapadaṃ tataḥ / vadeddhorataraṃ te tu tanurūpaṃ ca ṭhadvayam
pracaṭadvayamābhāṣya kahayugma ca madvayam / bandhadvayaṃ ghātayeti dvayaṃ varmāstramīrayet
nṛsiṃhaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ bhadraṃ mṛtyumṛtyuṃ namāmyaham / pañcāśītyakṣaro mantro bhajatāmiṣṭadāyakaḥ
ṛṣī hyaghorabrahmaṇau tathā triṣṭubanuṣṭubhau / chandasī ca tathā ghoranṛsiṃho devatā mataḥ
dhyānārcanādikaṃ cāsya kuryādānuṣṭubhaṃ sudhīḥ / viśeṣānmantravaryo 'yaṃ sarvarakṣākaro mataḥ
bījaṃ jayayugaṃ paścānnṛsiṃhetyaṣṭavarṇavān / ṛṣiḥ prajāpatiścāsyānuṣṭupchanda udāhṛtam
vidāraṇanṛsiṃho 'sya devatā parikīrtitaḥ / jaṃ bījaṃ haṃ tathā śaktirviniyogo 'khilāptaye
dīrghāḍhyena nṛsiṃhena ṣaḍaṅganyāsamācaret / raudraṃ dhyāyennṛsiṃhaṃ tu śatruvakṣo vidāraṇam
nakhadaṃṣṭrāyudhaṃ bhaktābhayada śrīniketanam / taptahāṭakakeśāntajvalaptāvakalocanam
vajrādhikanakhasparśa divyasiṃha namo 'stu te /. munirbrahmā samākhyāto 'nuṣṭupchandaḥ samīritaḥ
devatāsya ragadārṇasya divyapūrvo nṛkesarī / pādaiścaturbhiḥ sarveṇa pañcāṅgāni samācaret
dhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ prāgvatproktaṃ munīśvara / pūrvoktāni ca sarvāṇi kāryāṇyāyānti siddhatām
tāro namo bhagavate narasiṃhāya hṛñca te / jastejase āvirāvirbhava vajranakhāntataḥ
vrajadaṃṣṭreti karmānte tvāsayākrandayadvayam / tamo grasadvayaṃ paścātsvāhānte cābhayaṃ tataḥ
ātmanyante ca bhūyiṣṭā dhruvo bījāntimo manuḥ / dviṣaṣṭyarmo 'sya munyādi sarvaṃ pūrvavadīritam
tāro nṛsiṃhabījaṃ ca namo bhagavate tataḥ / narasiṃhāya tāraśca bījamasya yadā tataḥ
rūpāya tāraḥ svarbījaṃ kūrmarūpāya tārakam / bījaṃ varāharūpāya tāro bīja nṛsiṃhataḥ
rūpāya tāra svaṃ bījaṃ vāmanānte ca rūpataḥ / pāpadhruvatrayaṃ bījaṃ rāmāya nigamāditaḥ
bījaṃ kṛṣṇāya tārānte bījaṃ ca kalkine tataḥ / jayadvayaṃ tataḥ śālagrāmānte ca nivāsine
divyasiṃhāya ṅentaḥ syātsvayaṃbhūḥ puruṣāya hṛt / tāraḥ svaṃ bījamityeṣa mahāsāmrājyadāyakaḥ
nṛsiṃhamantraḥ khāṅkārṇo muniratriḥ prakīrtitaḥ / chando 'tijagatī proktaṃ devatā kathitā manoḥ
daśāvatāro nṛhariṃ bījaṃ khaṃ śaktiravyayaḥ / ṣaḍūdīrghāḍhyena bījena kṛtvāṅgāni ca bhāvayet
anekacandrapratimo lakṣmīmukhakṛtekṣaṇaḥ / daśāvatāraiḥ sahitastanotu nṛhariḥ sukham
japo 'yutaṃ daśāṃśena homaḥ syātpāyasena tu / prāgukte pūjayetpīṭhe mūrtisaṃkalpya mūlataḥ
aṅgānyādau ca matsyādyāndigdaleṣu tator'cayet / indrādyānapi vajrādyānsampūjyeṣṭamavāpnuyāt
sahasrārṇaṃ mahāmantraṃ vakṣye tantreṣu gopitam / tāro māyā ramā kāmo bījaṃ krodhapadaṃ tataḥ
mūrte nṛsiṃha śabdānte mahāpuruṣa īrayet / pradhānadharmādharmānte nigaḍetipadaṃ vadet
nirmocanānte kāleti tatataḥ puruṣa īrayet / kālāntakasadṛktoyaṃ sveśvarānte sadṛgjalam
śrāntānte tu niviṣṭeti caitanyacitsadā tataḥ / bhāsakānte tu kālādyatītanityoditeti ca
udayāstamayākrāntamahākāruṇiketi ca / hṛdayābjacatuścoktā dalānte tu niviṣṭitaḥ
caitanyātmaṃścaturāmandvādaśātmaṃstataḥ param / caturviṃśātmannante tu pañcaviṃśātmannityapi
bako hariḥ sahasrānte mūrte ehyehi śabdataḥ / bhagavannṛsiṃhapuruṣa krodheśvara rasā saha
sravanditānte pādeti kalpāntāgnisahasra ca / koṭyābhānte mahādeva nikāyadaśaśabdataḥ
śatayajñātalaṃ jñeyaṃ tataścāmalayugmakam / piṅgalekṣaṇasaṭādaṣṭrā daṃṣṭrāyudha nakhāyudha
dānavendrāntakāvahniṇaśoṇitapadaṃ tataḥ / saṃ saktivigrahānte tu bhūtāpasmārayātudhān
surāsuravandyamānapādapaṅkajaśabdataḥ / bhagavanvyomacakreśvarānte tu prabhavāpyaya
rūpeṇottiṣṭa cottiṣṭa avidyānicayaṃ daha / daha jñānaiśvaryamante prakāśayayugaṃ tataḥ
oṃ sarvajña aroṣānte jaṃbhājṛṃbhyavatārakam / satyapuruṣa śabdānte sadasanmadhya īrayet
niviṣṭaṃ mama duḥsvapnabhayaṃ nigaḍaśabdataḥ / bhayaṃ kāntāraśabdānte bhayaṃ viṣapadāttataḥ
jvarānte ḍākinī kṛtyādhvarevatībhayaṃ tataḥ / aśanyante bhayaṃ durbhikṣabhayaṃ mārīśabdataḥ
bhayaṃ mārīcaśabdānte bhayaṃ chāyāpadaṃ tataḥ / skandāpasmāraśabdānte bhayaṃ caurabhayaṃ tataḥ
jalasvapnāgnibhayaṃ gajasiṃhabhujaṅgagataḥ / bhayaṃ janmajarānte maraṇādiśabdamīrayet
bhayaṃ nirmocayayugaṃ praśamayayugaṃ tataḥ / jñeyarūpadhāraṇānte nṛsiṃhabṛhatsāmataḥ
puruṣānte sarvabhayanivāraṇapadaṃ tataḥ / aṣṭāṣṭakaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭi ceṭikābhayamīrayet
vidyāvṛtastrayastriṃśaddevatākoṭiśabdataḥ / namitānte padapadātpaṅkajānvita īrayet
saha sravadanānte tu sahasrodara saṃvadet / sahasrekṣaṇaśabdānte sahasrapādamīrayet
sahasrabhuja saṃprocya sahasrajihva saṃvadet / sahastānte lalāṭeti sahasrāyudhato dharāt
tamaḥprakāśaka puramathanānte tu sarva ca / mantrerājeśvarapadādvihāyasagatiprada
pātālagatipradānte yantramarddana īrayet / ghorāṭṭahāsahasitaviśvāvāsapadaṃ tataḥ
vāsudeva tato 'krūra tato hayamukheti ca / paramahaṃsa viśveśa viśvānte tu viḍaṃbana
niviṣṭānte tataḥpradurbhāvakāraka īrayet / hṛṣīkeśa ca svacchanda niḥśeṣajīva vinyaset
grāsakānte mahā paścātpiśitāsṛgitīrayet / laṃpaṭānte khecarīti siddhyateṃ tu pradāyaka
ajeyāvyaya avyakta brahmāṇḍodara ityapi / tato brahmasahasrānte koṭisragruṇḍaśabdataḥ
māla paṇḍitamuṇḍeti matsya kūrmaṃ tataḥ param / varāhānte nṛsiṃheti vāmanānte samīrayet
trailokyākramaṇānte tu pādaśālika īrayet / rāmatraya tato viṣṇurūpānte dhara eva ca
tattvatrayānte praṇavādhāratastacchikhāṃ padam / niviṣṭavahnijāyānte svadhā caiva tato vaṣaṭ
netra varmāstramuñcāryya prāṇādhāra itariyet / ādidevapadātprāṇāpānapaścānniviṣṭitaḥ
pāñcarātrika ditija vinidhanānte kareti ca / mahāmāyā amoghānte daryaṃ daityandraśabdataḥ
daryānte dalanetyuktā tejorāśin dhruvaṃ smaraḥ / tejasvarānte puruṣapaṃṅeṃte satyapūruṣa
astratāro 'cyutāstraṃ ca tāro vācā sudeva phaṭ / tāramāyāmūrteḥ phaṭ vaḥ kāmaḥ svarādimaḥ
mūrtestramavyayobījaṃ viśvamūrtestrimavyayaḥ / māyāviśvātmane ṣaṭ ca tāraḥ saucaṃ turātmane
phaṭ tārohaṃ viśvarūpinnastraṃ ca tadanantaram / tārauhnaiparamānte tu hraṃsaphaṭpraṇavastataḥ
hraḥ hiraṇaayagarbharūpa dhāraṇānte ca phaṭ dhruvaḥ / hraiṃ anaupamyarūpadhāriṇāstraṃ dhruvastataḥ
kṣaiṃ nṛsiṃharūpadhārin oṃ klaṃ ślaśca svarādikaḥ / ṣṭāṅgavinyāsavinya stamūrtidhāriṃstataśca phaṭ
hrau nisargasiddhyaikarūpadhāriṃstataśca phaṭ / tāro varmatrayaṃ saṃkaraṃ vaṃ cāmukamastakam
khaṇḍadvayaṃ khāda yetidvayaṃ klīṃ sādhyamānaya / dvayaṃ tato mahātmansyānsamyagdarśayayugmakam
ṣaḍdīrghāḍyāṃ svabījaṃ ca kṣapitānte tu kalmaṣa / uttarāyaṃ dvayaṃ pañcabāṇabījāni voñcaret
nṛsiṃhānte tato jvālātmane svāhā samīrayet / nṛsiṃhānte tataḥ kālātmane svāhā dhruvastataḥ
khabījaṃ kāmabījaṃ ca lakṣmībījadvayaṃ tataḥ / māyātārāntimo mantraḥ sahasrākṣarasaṃmitaḥ
kapilo 'sya muniśchando jagatī devatā punaḥ / śrīlakṣmīrnṛharirbījaṃ kṣaiṃ śaktirvahnivallabhā
śveto varṇa udāttaśca svaraḥ prokto manīṣibhiḥ / kṣetraṃ ca paramātmā tu viniyogo 'khilātpaye
kṣaḥ sahasrabāhavente sahasrāyudhadharāya ca / nṛsiṃhāntaṃ vahnijāyāstrāyaphaṭū mantra īritaḥ
anena karaśuddhiṃ ca kṛtvāṅgāni samācaret / tāraḥ kṣāṃ ca sahasrānte kṣaraśabdādvijṛṃbhitam
nṛsiṃhāyāgnijāyānto hṛdaye manurīritaḥ / māraḥ kṣīṃ ca mahātenuṃ prabhānte vikareti ca
nṛsiṃhāyāgnijāyānte śiromantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ / tāraḥ kṣūṃ taptayaṃhāyaścādṛkkeśānta īrayet
jvalatyāvakalo mūrmo dīrghā vajrādhiketi ca / nakha sparśāddivyasiṃha namo 'stu bhagavan hariḥ
mahādhvasta jagadrūpa nṛsiṃhāya dvayandvayam / anena ca śikhā proktā kavacaṃ tadanantaram
tāraḥ kṣaiṃ ca suvarṇaṃ te madamattapadaṃ tataḥ / vihvalitanṛsiṃhāya svāhāntaṃ kavacaṃ smṛtam
tāraḥ rkṣau ca sahasrākṣa viśvasrākṣa viśvarūpapadaṃ vadet / dhāraṇegni priyānto 'yaṃ netramantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ
tāro kṣaśca sahasrānte vārāvepadamīrayet / sahasrānte yudhāyāthaṃ nṛsiṃhāyāgnisuṃdarī
astramantraḥ samākhyātastato dhyāyennṛkesarī / udyadarkasahasrābhaṃ trīkṣaṇaṃ bhīsabhūṣaṇam
sutīkṣṇāgrabhujo daṇḍairdaityadāraṇakaṃ smaret / evaṃ dhyātvā japenmantrī sahasraṃ pāyena caga
ājyaplutena juhuyātsamyaksiddho bhavenmanuḥ / prāgukte vaiṣṇave pīṭhe mūrtiṃ saṃkalpya mūlataḥ
saṃpūjya nṛhariṃ paścādādāvaṅgāni pūjayet / cakra śaṅkhaṃ ca pāśaṃ vāṅkuśaṃ kuliśameva ca
gadākṛpāṇikṣveḍāni daleṣu paripūjayet / lokeśānapi vajrādyānpūjayettadanantaram
evaṃ siddhe manau mantrī prayogānkartumarhati / bhasmābhimantritaṃ kṛtvā grahagrastaṃ vilepayet
bhasmasaṃlepanādeva sarvagrahavināśanam / anenaiva vidhānena yakṣarākṣasakinnaraḥ
bhūtapretapiśācāśca naśyantyeva na saṃśayaḥ / parābhicārakṛtyāni manunānena mantritam
bhasma saṃlepayetsadyo durādharṣo bhavennaraḥ / sudine sthāpayetkumbhe sarvatobhadramaṇḍale
tīrthatoyena saṃpūrya japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam / tenābhiṣikto manujaḥ sarvāpattiṃ tared dhruvam
kiṃ bahūktena sarveṣṭadāyako 'yaṃ manūttamaḥ / vajranakhāya vidmahe tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrāya dhīmahi / tanno nṛsiṃhaḥ śabdānte vadeṃścaiva pracodayāt
eṣā nṛsiṃhagāyatrī sarvābhīṣṭapradāyinī / etasyāḥ smaraṇādeva sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet

iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne tṛtīyapāde nṛsiṃhopāsanāmantragāyatryādinirūpaṇaṃ nāmaikasaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ sanatkumāra uvāca praṇavo hṛdayaṃ viṣṇurnentaḥ surapatistathā / mahābalāya svāhānto mantro vasudharākṣaraḥ
munirindurvirāṭ chando devatā dadhivāmanaḥ / tāro bījaṃ tathā śaktirvahnijāyā prakīrtitā
candrākṣirāmabāṇeṃṣu netrasaṃkhyairmanūdbhavaiḥ / varṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ kṛtvā ca mūrdhni bhāle ca netrayoḥ
karṇayorghrāṇayoroṣṭatālukaṇṭhabhujeṣu ca / pṛṣṭe hṛdyudare nābhau guhye corusthale punaḥ
jānudvayaṃ jaṅghayośca pādayorvinyasetkramāt / aṣṭādaśaiva mantrotthāstato devaṃ vicintayet
muktāgauraṃ ratnabhūṣaṃ candrasthaṃ bhṛṅgasannibhaiḥ / alakairvilasadvaktraṃ kumbhaṃ śuddhāṃbupūritam
dadhyannapūrṇacaṣakaṃ dorbhyāṃ saṃdadhanaṃ bhajet / lakṣatrayaṃ japenmantraṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ ghṛtaplutaiḥ
pāyasānnaiḥ prajuhuyāddadhyannena yathāvidhi / candrānte kalpite pīṭhe pūrvokteṃ pūjayeñca tam
saṃkalpamūrtimūlena saṃpūjya ca vidhānataḥ / kesareṣu ṣaḍaṅgāni saṃpūjya digdaleṣu ca
vāsudevaṃ saṃkarṣaṇaṃ pradyumnamaniruddhakam / koṇapatreṣu śāntiṃ ca śriyaṃ sarasvatīṃ ratim
dhvajaṃ ca vainateyaṃ ca kaustubhaṃ vanamālikam / śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ śārṅgaṃ daleṣvaṣṭasu pūjayet
dalāgreṣu keśavādīndikpālāṃstadanantaram / tadastrāṇi ca sampūjya gajānaṣṭau samarcayet
airāvataḥ puṇḍarīko vāmanaḥ kumudāeṃ'janaḥ / puṣpadantaḥ sārvabhaumaḥ supratīkaśca diggajāḥ
kariṇyo 'bhramukapilopiṅgalānupamāḥ kramāt / tāmrakarṇī śubhradantī cāṅganā hyañjanā vatī
evamārādhito mantrī dadyādiṣṭāni mantriṇe / śrīkāmaḥ pāyasājyena sahasraṃ juhuyātsudhīḥ
mahatīṃ śriyamāpnoti dhānyāptirdhānya homataḥ / śatapuṣpāsamutthaiśca bījairhutvā sahasrataḥ
mahābhayaṃ nāśayeddhi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā / daddhyodanena śuddhena hutvā mucyate durgateḥ
dhyātvā traivikramaṃ rūpaṃ japenmantraṃ samāhitaḥ / kārāgṛhādbhavanmukto baddho mantraprabhāvataḥ
bhittau saṃpādya deveśaṃ phalake vā prapūjayet / nityaṃ sugandhakusumairmahatīṃ śriyamāpnuyāt
hutvā raktotpalairmantrī vaśayetsakalaṃ jagat / annājyairjuhuyānnityamaṣṭāviṃśatisaṃkhyayā
sitājyānnaṃ ca vidhivatprāpnuyādannamakṣayam / apūpaiḥ ṣaḍrasopetairhunedvasusahasrakam
alakṣmīṃ ca parābhūya mahatīṃ śriyamāpnuyāt / juhuyādayutaṃ mantrī dadhyannaṃ ca sitānvitam
yatra yatra vasetso 'pi tatrānnagirimāpnuyāt / padmākṣarairyutaṃ bilvāntikastho juhuyānnaraḥ
mahālakṣmīṃ sa labhate tatra tatra na saṃśayaḥ / juhuyātpāyasairlakṣaṃ vācaspatisamo bhavet
lakṣaṃ japtvā taddaśāṃśaṃ putrajīvaphalairhunet / tatkāṣṭairedhite vahnau śreṣṭhaṃ putramavāpnuyāt
sasādhyatāraṃ vilasatkarṇikaṃ ca suvarṇakaiḥ / vilasatkesaraṃ mantrākṣaradvandvāṣṭapatrakam
śeṣayugmārṇāntyapatraṃ dvādaśākṣaraveṣṭitam / tadbahirmātṛkāvarṇairyantraṃ sampatpradaṃ nṛṇām
raktaṃ trivikramaṃ dhyātvā prasūnai raktavarṇakaiḥ / juhuyādayutaṃ mantrī sarvatra vijayī bhavet
dhyāyeñcandrāsanagataṃ padmānāmayutaṃ hunet / labhedakaṇṭakaṃ rājyaṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam
hutvā lavaṅgairmadhvāktairapāmārgadalaistu vā / ayutaṃ sādhyanāmāḍhyaṃ sa vaśyo jāyate dhruvam
aṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā hyapāmārgadalaiḥ śubhaiḥ / tāvajjaptvā ca saptāhānmahārogātpramucyate
uhiratpadamābhāṣya praṇavohīya śabdataḥ / sarvavārgīśvaretyante pravadedīśvaretyatha
sarvavedamayācintyapadānte sarvamīrayet / bodhayadvitavānto 'yaṃ mantrastārādirīritaḥ
ṛṣirbrahmāsya nirdiṣṭaśchando 'nuṣṭubudāhṛtam / devatā syāddhayagrīvo vāgaiśvaryaprado vibhuḥ
tāreṇa pādairmantrasya pañcāṅgāni prakalpayet / tuṣārādrisamacchāyaṃ tulasīdāmabhūṣitam
turaṅgavadanaṃ vande tuṅgasārasvataḥ padam / dhyātvaivaṃ prajapenmantramayutaṃ taddaśāṃśataḥ
madhvaktaiḥ pāyasairhutvā vimalādisamanvite / pūjayedveṣṇave pīṭhe mūrtiṃ saṃkalpya mūlataḥ
karṇikāyāṃ caturdikṣu yajetpūrvāditaḥ kramāt / sanandanaṃ ca sanakaṃ śriyaṃ ca pṛthivīṃ tathā
tadvahirdikṣu vedāśca ṣaṭkoṇeṣu tator'cayet / niruktaṃ jyotiṣaṃ paścādyajedvyākaraṇaṃ tataḥ
kalpaṃ śikṣāṃ ca chandāṃsi vedāṅgāni tvimāni vai / tato 'ṣṭadalamūle tu mātaro 'ṣṭau samarcayet
vakratuṇḍādikānaṣṭo dalamadhye prapūjayet / dalāgreṣyarcayetpaścātsādhakaścāṣṭabhairavān
asitāṅgaṃ ruruṃ caiva bhīṣaṇaṃ raktakanetrakam / baṭukaṃ kāladamanaṃ danturaṃ vikaṭaṃ tathā
tadbahiḥ ṣoḍaśadaleṣvavatārānharerdaśa / śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ padmaṃ nandakaṃ śārṅgameva ca
tadbahirbhūgṛhe śakramukhāndaśa digīśvarān / vajrādyāṃstadbahiśceṣṭvādvāreṣu ca tataḥ kramāt
mahāgaṇapatiṃ durgāṃ kṣetreśaṃ baṭukaṃ tathā / samastaprakaṭādyāśca yoginyastadbahirbhavet
tadbahiḥ sapta nadyaśca tadbāhye tu grahānnava / tadbāhye parvatānaṣṭau nakṣatrāṇi ca tadbahiḥ
evaṃ pañcadaśāvṛttyā saṃpūjya turagānanam / vāgīśvarasamo vāci dhanairdhanapatirbhavet
evaṃ siddhe manau mantrī prayogānkartumarhati / aṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu śuddhaṃ vāryabhimantritam
bījena māsamātraṃ yaḥ pibeddhīmān jitandriyaḥ / janmamūko 'pi sa naro vāksiddhiṃ labhate dhruvam
viyadbhugusthamardhīrābindumadbījamīritam / candrasūryoparāge tu pātre rukmamaye kṣipet
dugdhaṃ vacāṃ tato mantrī kaṇṭhamātrodake sthitaḥ / sparśādvimokṣaparyantaṃ prajapenmantramādarāt
pibettatsarvamacirāttasya sārasvataṃ bhavet / jyotiṣmatīlatābījaṃ dineṣvekaikavarddhitam
aṣṭottaraśataṃ yāvadbhakṣayedabhimantritam / sarasvatyavatāro 'sau satyaṃ syādbhuvi mānavaḥ
kirṃ bahūktena viprendra manorasya prasādataḥ / sarvavedāgamādīnāṃ vyākhyātā jñānavān bhavet

iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne sanatkumāravibhāge tṛtīyapāde hayagrīvopāsanānirūpaṇaṃ nāma dvisaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ sanatkumāra uvāca atha rāmasya manavo vakṣyante siddhidāyākāḥ / yeṣāmārādhanānmartyāstaranti bhavasāgaram
sarveṣu mantravaryeṣu śreṣṭhaṃ vaiṣṇavamucyate / gāṇapatyeṣu saureṣu śāktaśaiveṣvabhīṣṭadam
vaiṣṇaveṣvapi mantreṣu rāmamantrāḥ phalādhikāḥ / gāṇapatyādimantrebhyaḥ koṭikoṭiguṇādhikāḥ
viṣṇuśayyāsthito vahnirindubhūṣitamastakaḥ / rāmāya hṛdayānto 'yaṃ mahāghaudhavināśanaḥ
sarveṣu rāmamantraṣu hyatiśreṣṭhaḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ / brahmahatyāsahasrāṇi jñātājñātakṛtāni ca
svarṇasteya surāpānagurutalpāyutāni ca / koṭikoṭisahasrāṇi hyupapāpāni yāni vai
mantrasyoñcāraṇātsadyo layaṃ yānti na saṃśayaḥ / brahmā muniḥ syādgāyatrī chando rāmaśca devatā
ādyaṃ bījaṃ ca hṛcchaktirviniyogo 'khilāptaye / ṣaḍdīrghabhājā bījena ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret
brahmarandhre bhruvormadhye hṛnnābhyorguhyapādayoḥ / mantravarṇānkramānnyasya keśavādīnpravinyaset
pīṭhanyāsādikaṃ kṛtvā dhyāyeddhṛdi raghūttamam / kālāṃbhodharakāntaṃ ca vīrā sanasamāsthitam
jñānamudrāṃ dakṣahaste dadhataṃ jānunītaram / saroruhakarāṃ sītāṃ vidyudābhāṃ ca pārśvagām
paśyantīṃ rāmavakrābjaṃ vividhākalpabhūṣitām / dhyātvaivaṃ prajapedvarṇalakṣaṃ mantrī daśāṃśataḥ
kamalairjuhuyādvahnau brāhmaṇānbhojayettataḥ / pūjayedvaiṣṇave pīṭhe vimalādisamanvite
mūrtiṃ mūlena saṃkalpya tasyāmāvāhya sādhakaḥ / sītāṃ vāme samāsīnāṃ tanmantreṇa prapūjayet
ramāsītāpadaṃ ṅeṃtaṃ dviṭhānto jānakīmanuḥ / agreḥ śārṅgaṃ ca sampūjya śarānpārśvadvayer'cayet
keśareṣu ṣaḍaṅgāni patreṣvetānsamarcayet / hanumantaṃ ca sugrīvaṃ bharataṃ sabibhīṣaṇam
lakṣmaṇāṅgadaśatrughnān jāṃbavantaṃ kramātpunaḥ / vācayantaṃ hanūmantagrato dhṛtapustakam
yajedbharataśatrughnau pārśvayordhṛtacāmarau / dhṛtātapatraṃ hastābhyāṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ pṛṣṭator'cayet
tato 'ṣṭapatre sṛṣṭiṃ ca japantaṃ vijayaṃ tathā / surāṣṭraṃ rāṣṭrapālaṃ ca akopaṃ dharmapālakam
sumantaṃ ceti sampūjya loke śānāyudhairyutān / evaṃ rāmaṃ samārādhya jīvanmuktaḥ prajāyate
candanāktaiḥ prajuhuyājjātīpuṣpaiḥ samāhitaḥ / rājavaśyāya kamalairdhanadhānyādisiddhaye
lakṣmīkāmaḥ prajuhuyātprasūnairvilvasaṃbhavaiḥ / ājyāktairnīlakamalairvaśayedakhilaṃ jagat
ghṛtāktaśatavarvībhirdīrghāyuśca nirāmayaḥ / raktotpalānāṃ homena dhanaṃ prāpnoti vāñchitam
pālāśakusumairhutvā medhāvī jāyate naraḥ / tajjaptāṃbhaḥ pibetprātarvatsarātkavirāḍ bhavet
tanmantritānnaṃ bhuñjītamahārogapraśāntaye / rogoktauṣadhahomena tadrogānmucyate kṣaṇām
nadītīre ca goṣṭhe vā japellakṣaṃ payobrataḥ / pāyasenājyayuktena hutvā vidyānidhirbhavet
parikṣīṇādhipatyo yaḥ śākāhāro jalāntare / japellakṣaṃ ca juhuyādvilvapuṣpairdaśāṃśataḥ
tadaiva punarāpnoti svādhipatyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ / upoṣya gaṅgātīrānte sthitvā lakṣaṃ japennaraḥ
daśāṃśaṃ kamalairhutvā vilvotthairvā prasūnakaiḥ / madhuratrayasaṃyuktairādajyaśriyamavāpnuyāt
mārgamāse jale sthitvā kandamūlaphalāśanaḥ / lakṣaṃ japtvā daśāṃśena pāyasairjuhuyādvasau
śrīrāmacandrasadṛśaḥ putraḥ pautro 'pi jāyate / anye 'pi bahavaḥ saṃti prayogāmantrarājake
kintu prayogakartṛāṇāṃ paraloko na vidyate / ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vasupatraṃ ca tadbāhyārkadalaṃ likhet
ṣaṭkoṇeṣu ṣaḍarṇāni mantrasya vilikhed budhaḥ / aṣṭapatre tathāṣṭārṇāṃllikhetpraṇavagarbhitān
kāmabījaṃ ravidale madhye mantrāvṛtābhidhām / sudarśanāvṛtaṃ bāhye dikṣu yugmāvṛtaṃ tathā
vajrollasadbhūmigehaṃ kandarpāṅkuśapāśakaiḥ / bhūmyā ca vilasatkoṇaṃ yantrarājamidaṃ smṛtam
bhūrje 'ṣṭagandhaiḥ saṃlikhya pūjayeduktavartmanā / ṣaṭkoṇeṣu dalārkābjānyāveṣṭavṛttayugmataḥ
keśareṣvaṣṭapatrasya svaradvandvaṃ likhed budhaḥ / bahistu mātṛkāṃ caiva mantraṃ prāṇanidhayanama
yantrametacchubhe ghasre kaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe bhuje / mūrdhni vā dhārayenmantrī sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
sudine śubhanakṣatre sudeśe śalyavarjite / vaśyākarṣaṇavidveṣadrāvaṇoccāṭanādikam
puṣyadvayaṃ tathādityārdrāmaghāsu yathākramam / dūrvotthā lekhanī vaśye tathākṛṣṭau karañjajā
narāsthijā māraṇe tu staṃbhane rājavṛkṣajā / śāntipuṣṭaṣṭyāyuṣāṃ siddhayai sarvāpacchamanāya ca
vibhramotpādane caiva śilāyāṃ vilikhed budhaḥ / kharacarmaṇi vidveṣe dhvaje tūñcāṭanāya ca
śatrūṇāṃ jvarasantāpaśokamāraṇakarmaṇi / pītavasraṃ likhitvā tu sādhayetsādhakottamaḥ
vaśyākṛṣṭau cāṣṭagandhaiḥ sampūjya ca yathāvidhi / citāṅgārādinā caiva tāḍanoccāṭanādikam
viṣārkakṣīrayogena māraṇaṃ bhavati dhruvam / likhitvaivaṃ yantrarājaṃ gandhapuṣpādibhiryajet
trilohaveṣṭitaṃ kṛtvā dhārayetsādhakottamaḥ / bījaṃ rāmāya ṭhadvandvaṃ mantro 'yaṃ rasavarṇakaḥ
mahāsudarśanamanuḥ kathyate siddhidāyakaḥ / sudarśanamahāśabdāccakrarājeśvareti ca
duṣṭāntakaduṣṭabhayānakaduṣṭabhayaṅkaram / chindhidvayaṃ bhindhiyugmaṃ vidārayayugaṃ tataḥ
paramantrān grasadvandvaṃ bhakṣayadvitayaṃ tataḥ / trāsayadvitayaṃ varmāstrāgnijāyāntimo manuḥ
aṣṭaṣaṣṭyakṣaraḥ prokto yantrasaṃveṣṭane tvayam / tāro hṛdbhagavān ṅeṃto ṅeṃto hi raghunandanaḥ
rakṣoghnaviśadāyānte madhurādiprasanna ca / varadānāyāmitānte nutejasepadamīrayet
bālāyānte tu rāmāya viṣṇave hṛdayāntimaḥ / saptacatvāriṃśadarṇo mālāmantro 'yamīritaḥ
viśvāmitro muniścāsya gāyatrī chanda īritam / śrīrāmo devatā bījaṃ dhruvaḥ śaktiśca ṭhadvayam
ṣaḍdīrghasvarayugmāyābījenāṅgāni kalpayet / dhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvamasya pūrvavadācaret
ayamārādhito mantraḥ sarvānkāmānprayacchati / svakāmasatyavāglakṣmītārāḍhyaḥ pañcavarṇakaḥ
ṣaḍakṣaraḥ ṣaḍvidhaḥ syāñcaturvargaphalapradaḥ / brahmā saṃmohanaḥ śaktirdakṣiṇāmūrtisaṃjñakaḥ
agastyaḥ śrīśivaḥ proktāste teṣāṃ munayaḥ kramāt / athavā kāmabījāderviśvāmitro muniḥ smṛtaḥ
chandaḥ proktaṃ ca gāyatrī śrīrāmo devatā punaḥ / bījaśaktirādhamāntyaṃ mantrārṇaiḥ syātṣaḍaṅgakam
bījaiḥ ṣaḍdīrghayuktairvā mantrārṇānpūrvavannyaset / dhyāyetkalpatarormūle suvarṇamayamaṇḍape
puṣpakākhyavimānāntaḥ siṃhāsanaparicchade / padme vasudaledevamindranīlasamaprabham
vīrāsanasamāsīnaṃ jñānamudropaśobhitam / vāmorunyastataddhastasītālakṣmaṇasevitam
ratnākalpaṃ vibhundhyātvā varṇalakṣaṃ japenmanum / yadvā smārādimantrāṇāṃ jayābhaṃ ca hariṃ smaret
yejanaṃ kāmyakarmāṇi sarvaṃ kuryātṣaḍarṇavat / rāmaśca candrabha drānto ṅenamonto dhruvādikaḥ
mantrāvaṣṭākṣarau hyetau tārāntyau cennavākṣarau / eteṣāṃ yajanaṃ sarvaṃ kuryānmantrī ṣaḍarṇavat
jānakīvallabho ṅeṃto dviṭhāntaḥ kavacādikaḥ / daśārṇo 'yaṃ mahāmantro viśiṣṭo 'sya muniḥ svarāṭ
chandaśca devatā sītā patirbījaṃ tathādimam / svāhā śaktiśca kāmena kuryādaṅgāni ṣaṭ kramāt
śirolalāṭabhrūmadhyatālukaṇṭheṣu hṛdyapi / nābhyaṅghrijānupādeṣu daśārṇānvinyasenmanoḥ
ayodhyānagare ratnacitrasauvarṇamaṇḍape / mandārapuṣpairābaddhavitāne toraṇānvite
siṃhāsanasamāsīna puṣpakopari rāghavam / rakṣobhirharibhirdevaiḥ suvimānagataiḥ śubhaiḥ
saṃstūyamānaṃ munibhiḥ prahvaiśca parisevitam / sītālaṅkṛtavāmāṅgaṃ lakṣmaṇenopaśobhitam
śyāmaṃ prasannavadanaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam / evaṃ dhyātvā japenmantrī varṇalakṣaṃ samāhitaḥ
daśāṃśaḥ kamalairhemo yajanaṃ ca ṣaḍarṇavat / rāmo ṅeṃnto dhanuṣpāṇirṅaitoṃ'te vahnisuṃdarī
daśākṣaro 'yaṃ mantro 'sya munirbrahmā virāṭ punaḥ / chandastu devatā prokto rāmo rākṣasamardanaḥ
ādyaṃ bījaṃ dviṭhaḥ śaktibīñjenāṅgāni kalpayet / varṇanyāsaṃ tathā dhyānaṃ puraścaryārcanādikaman
daśākṣaroktavatkuryāccāpabāṇadharaṃ smaret / tāro namo bhagavate rāmānte candrabhadrakau
ṅeṃtāvarkākṣarau mantrau ṛṣidhyānādi pūrvavat / śrīpūrvaṃ jayapūrvaṃ ca taddvidhā rāmanāma ca
trayodaśākṣaro mantro munirbrahmā virāṭ smṛtam / chandastu devatā prokto rāmaḥ pāpaughanāśanaḥṛ
ṣaḍaṅgāni prakurvīta dvirāvṛttyā padatrayaiḥ / dhyānārcanādikaṃ sava hyasya kuryāddaśārṇavat
tāro namo bhagavate rāmāyānte mahāpadam / puruṣāya hṛdanto 'yaṃ manuraṣṭādaśākṣaraḥ
viśvāmitro muniśchado dhṛtī rāmo 'sya devatā / tāro bījaṃ namaḥ śaktiścandrākṣyabdhyagniṣaḍbhujaiḥ
varṇaimantrotthitaiḥ kuryātṣaḍaṅgāni samāhitaḥ / niḥśāṇabherīpaṭahaśaṅkhaturyādiniḥsvanaiḥ
pravṛttanṛtye parito jayamaṅgalabhāṣite / candanāgarukastūrīkarpūrādisuvāsite
nānākusumasaurabhyavāhigandhavahānvite / devagandharvanārībhirgāyantībhiralakṛte
siṃhāsane samāsīnaṃ puṣpakopari rāghavam / saumitrisītāsahitaṃ jaṭāmukuṭaśobhitam
cāpabāṇadharaṃ śyāmaṃ sasugrīvavibhīṣaṇam / hatvā rāvaṇamāyāntaṃ kṛtatrailokyarakṣaṇam
evaṃ dhyātvā japedvarṇaṃ lakṣaṃ matrī daśāṃśataḥ / ghṛtāktaiḥ pāyasairhutvā yajanaṃ pūrvavañcaret
praṇavo hṛdayaṃ sītāpataye tadanantaram / rāmāya hanayugmānte varmāstrāgnipriyāntimaḥ
ekonaviṃśadvarṇo 'yaṃ mantraḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ / viśvāmitro muniścāsyānuṣṭupchanda udāhṛtam
devatā rāmabhadro jaṃ bījaṃ śaktirnama iti / mantrotthitaiḥ kramādvarṇaistato dhyāyeñca pūrvavat
pūjanaṃ kāmyakarmādi sarvamasya ṣaḍarṇavat / tāraḥ svabījaṃ kamalā rāmabhadreti saṃpaṭhet
maheṣvāsapadānte tu raghuvīra nṛpottama / daśāsyāntakaśabdānte māṃ rakṣa dehi saṃpaṭhet
paramānte me śriyaṃ syānmantro bāṇaguṇākṣaraḥ / bījairviyukto dvātriṃśadarṇo 'yaṃ phaladāyakaḥ
viśvāmitro muniścāsyānuṣṭupchanda udāhṛtam / devatā rāmabhadro 'tra bījaṃ svaṃ śaktirindirā
bījatrayādyaiḥ kurvīta padaiḥ sarveṇa mantravit / pañcāṅgāni ca vinyasya mantravarṇānkramānnyaset
mūrdhni bhāle dṛśoḥ śrotre gaṇḍayugme sanāsike / āsye doḥsaṃdhiyugale stanahṛnnābhiṣu kramāt
kaṭau meḍhre pāyupādasaṃdhiṣvarṇānnyasenmanoḥ / dhyānārcanādikaṃ cāsya pūrvavatsamupācaret
lakṣatrayaṃ puraścaryāṃ pāyasairhavanaṃ matam / dhyātvā rāmaṃ pītavarṇaṃ japellakṣaṃ samāhitaḥ
daśāṃśaṃ kamalairhutvā dhanairdhanapatirbhavet / tāro māyā ramādvandvaṃ dāśarathāya hṛñca vai
ekādaśākṣaro mantro munyādyarcāsya pūrvavat / trailokyānte tu nāthāya hṛdanto vasuvarṇavān
asyāpi pūrvavatsarvaṃ nyāsadhyānārcanādikam / āñjaneyapadānte tu gurave hṛdayāntimaḥ
mantro navākṣaro 'syāpi yajanaṃ pūrvavanmatam / ṅetaṃ rāmapada paścāddhṛdayaṃ pañcavaṇavat
munidhyānārcanaṃ cāsya proktaṃ sarvaṃ ṣaḍarṇavat / rāmānte candrabhadrau ca ṅeṃtau pāvakavallabhā
mantro dvau ca samākhyātau munyādyarcādi pūrvavat / vahniḥ śeṣānvitaścaiva candrabhūṣitamastakaḥ
ekākṣaro raghupatermantraḥ kalpadrumo 'paraḥ / brahmā muniḥ syādgāyatrī chando rāmo 'sya devatā
ṣaḍdīrghāḍhyena mantreṇa ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret / sarayūtīramandāravedikāpaṅkajāsane
śyāmaṃ vīrāsanāsīnaṃ jñānamudropaśobhitam / vāmorunyastaṃ taddhastaṃ sītālakṣmaṇasaṃyutam
avekṣaṇāṇamātmānaṃ manmathāmitatejasam / śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ kevalaṃ mokṣakāṅkṣayā
cintayetparamātmānamṛtulakṣaṃ japenmanum / sarvvaṃ ṣaḍarṇavañcāsya homanityārcanādikam
vahniḥ śeṣāsano bhāntaḥ kevalo dvyakṣaro manuḥ / ekākṣarokta vatsarvaṃ munidhyānārcanādikam
tāramānāramānaṅgacāstrabījairdvivarṇakaḥ / tryakṣaro mantrarājaḥ syātṣaḍvidhaḥ sakaleṣṭadaḥ
vdyakṣaraścandrabhadrānto dvividhaścaturakṣaraḥ / ekārṇoktavadeteṣāṃ munidhyānārcanādikam
tāro rāmaścaturthyanto varmāstraṃ vahnivallabhā / aṣṭārṇo 'yaṃ mahāmantro munyādyarcā ṣaḍarṇavat
tāro mayā hṛdante syādrāmāya praṇavāntimaḥ / śivomārāmamantro 'yamaṣṭārṇaḥ sarvasiddhidaḥ
ṛṣiḥ sadāśivaḥ prokto gāyatrī chanda īritam / śivomārāmacandro 'tra devatā parikīrtitaḥ
ṣaḍvīryayāmāya yātu dhruvapañcārṇayuktayā / ṣaḍaṅgāni vidhāyātha dhyāyeddhṛdi surārcitam
rāmaṃ trinetraṃ somārddhadhāriṇaṃ śūlinaṃ varam / bhasmoddhūlitasarvāṅgaṃ kaparddinamupāsmahe
rāmābhirāmaṃ saindaryasīmāṃ somāvataṃsinīm / pāśāṅkuśadhanurbāṇadharāṃ dhyāyetrilocanām
evaṃ dhyātvā japedvarṇalakṣaṃ trimadhurānvitaiḥ / bilpapatraiḥ phalaiḥ puṣpaistilairvā paṅkajairhunet
svayamāyānti nidhayaḥ siddhayaśca surepsitāḥ / tāro māyā ca bharatāgrajarāmamanobhavaḥ
vahnijāyādvādaśārṇo mantraḥ kalpadrumo 'paraḥ / aṅgirāśca muniśchando gāyatrī devatā punaḥ
śrīrāmo bhuvanābījaṃ svāhāśaktiḥ samīritaḥ / candraikamunibhūnetrairmantrārṇairaṅgakalpanam
dhyānapūjādikaṃ cāśca sarvaṃ kuryātṣaḍarṇavat / praṇavo hṛdayaṃ sītāpate rāmaśca ṅeṃtimaḥ
hanadvayānte varmāstraṃ mantraḥ ṣoḍaśavarṇavān / agastyo 'sya muniśchando bṛhatī devatā punaḥ
śrīrāmo 'haṃ tathā bījaṃ rāṃ śaktiḥ samudīritā / rāmābdhivahnivedākṣivarṇaiḥ pañcāṅgakalpanā
dhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvamasya kuryātṣaḍarṇavat / tāro hṛñcaiva brahmaṇyasevyāya padamīrayet
rāmāyākuṇṭhaśabdāntaṃ tejase ca samīrayet / uttamaślokadhuryāya svaṃ bhṛguḥ kāmikānvitaḥ
daṇḍārpitāṃ priye mantro rāmarāmākṣaro mataḥ / ṛṣiḥ śukrastathānuṣṭupchando rāmo 'sya devatā
pādaiḥ sarveṇa pañcāṅgaṃ kuryāccheṣaṃ ṣaḍarṇavat / lakṣaṃ japo daśāṃśena juhuyātpāyasaiḥ sudhīḥ
siddhamantrasya bhuktiḥ syānmuktiḥ pātakanāśanam / ādau dāśarathāyānte vidmahe padamuccaret
tataḥ sītāvallabhāya dhīmahīti samuccaret / tanno rāmaḥ proco varṇo dayāditi ca saṃvadet
eṣoktārā magāyatrī sarvābhīṣṭaphalapradā / padmāsītāpadaṃ ṅetaṃ ṭhadvayāntaḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ
vālmīkiśca muniśchando gāyatrī devatā punaḥ / sītā bhagavatī proktā śrīṃ bījaṃ vahnisundarī
śaktiḥ ṣaḍdīrghayuktena bījenāṅgāni kalpayet / tato dhyāyanmahādevīṃ sītāṃ trailokyapūjitām
taptahāṭakavarṇābhāṃ padmayugmaṃ karadvaye / sadratnabhūṣaṇasphūrjaddivyadehāṃ śubhātmikām
nānāvastrāṃ śaśimukhīṃ padmākṣīṃ muditāntarām / paśyantīṃ rāghavaṃ puṇyaṃ śayyārdhyāṃ ṣaḍguṇeśvarīm
evaṃ dhyātvā japedvarṇalakṣaṃ mantrī daśāṃśataḥ / juhuyātkamalaiḥ phullaiḥ pīṭhe pūrvodite yajet
mūrtiṃ saṃkalpya mūlena tasyāmāvāhya jānakīm / saṃpūjya dakṣiṇe rāmamabhyarcyāgre 'nilātmajam
pṛṣaṭe lakṣmaṇamabhyarcya ṣaṭkoṇeṣvaṅgapūjanam / patreṣu mantrimukhyaṃśca bāhye lokeśvarānpunaḥ
vajrādyānapi saṃpūjya sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet / jātīpuṣpaiścandanāktai rājavaśyāya homayet
kamalairdhanadhānyāptirnīlābjairvaśayan jagat / bilvapatraiḥ śriyaḥ prāptyai dūrvābhīrorāśāntaye
kiṃ bahūktuna saubhāgyaṃ putrānpautrānparaṃ sukham / dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ ca mokṣaṃ ca sītārādhanato labhet
śakraṛ seṃdurlakṣmaṇāya hṛdayaṃ saptavarṇavān / agastyo 'sya muniśchando gāyatrī devatā punaḥ
lakṣmaṇākhyo mahāvīraścāḍhyaṃ hṛdvījaśaktike / ṣaḍdīrghāḍhyena bījena ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret
dvibhujaṃ svarṇarucuratanuṃ padmanibhekṣaṇam / dhanurbāṇakaraṃ rāmasevāsaṃsaktamānasam
dhyātvaivaṃ prajapedvarṇalakṣaṃ mantrī daśāṃśataḥ //ṭha madhvāktaiḥ pāyasairhutvā rāmapīṭhe prapūjayeta
rāmavadyajanaṃ cāsya sarvasiddhiprado hyayam / sākalyaṃ rāmapūjāyā yadīcchenniyataṃ naraḥ
tena yatnena karttavyaṃ lakṣmaṇārcanamādarāt / śrīrāmacandrabhedāstu bahavaḥ saṃti siddhidāḥ
tatsādhakaiḥ sadā kāryaṃ lakṣmaṇārādhanaṃ śubham / aṣṭottarasahasraṃ vā śataṃ vā susamāhitaiḥ
lakṣmaṇasya manurjapyo mumukṣubhiratandritaiḥ / ajaptvā lakṣmaṇamanuṃ rāmamantrān japanti ye
na teṣāṃ jāyate siddhirhānireva pade pade / yo japellakṣmaṇamanuṃ nityamekāntamāsthitaḥ
mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt / jayapradhāno mantro 'yaṃ rājyaprāptyaikasādhanam
naṣṭarājyāptaye mantraṃ japellakṣaṃ samāhitaḥ / so 'cirānnaṣṭarājyaṃ svaṃ prāpnotyeva na saṃśayaḥ
dhyāyanrāmamayodhyāyāmabhiṣikta mananyadhīḥ / pañcāyutaṃ manuṃ japtvā naṣṭarājyamavāpnuyāt
nāgapāśavinirmuktaṃ dhyātvā lakṣmaṇamādarāt / ayutaṃ prajapenmantraṃ nigaḍānmucyate dhruvam
vātātmajenānītābhiroṣadhībhirgatavyatham / dhyātvā lakṣaṃ japanmantramalpamṛtyuṃ jayeddhuvam
ghātayantaṃ meghanādaṃ dhyātvā lakṣaṃ japenmanum / durjayaṃ vāpi vegena jayedripukulaṃ mahat
dhyātvā śūrpaṇakhānāsāchedanodyuktamānasam / sahasraṃ prajapenmantraṃ puruhūtādikān jayet
rāmapādābjasevārthaṃ kṛtodyogamatho smaran / prajapallaṅkṣamekānte mahārogātpramucyate
trimāsaṃ vijitāhāro nityaṃ saptasahasrakam / aṣṭottaraśataiḥ puṣpairniśchedraiḥ śātapatrakaiḥ
pūjayitvā vidhānena pāyasaṃ ca saśarkaram / nivedya prajapenmantraṃ kuṣṭarogātpranucyate
vijane vijitāhāraḥ ṣaṇmāsaṃ vidhināmunā / kṣayarogātpramucyeta satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
abhimantrya jalaṃ prātarmantreṇa triḥ samāhitaḥ / trisaṃdhyaṃ vā pibennityaṃ mucyate sarvarogataḥ
dāridrayaṃ ca parābhūtaṃ jāyate dhanadopamaḥ / viṣādidoṣasaṃsparśo na bhavettu kadācana
manunā mantritaistoyaiḥ pratyehaṃ kṣālayenmukham / mukhanetrādisaṃbhūtāñjayeddvrogāṃśca dāruṇān
pītvābhimantritaṃ tvaṃbhaḥ kukṣirogān jayeddhruvam / lakṣmaṇapratimāṃ kṛtvā dadyādbhaktyā vidhānataḥ
sa sarvebhyo 'tha rogebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ / kanyārthī vimalāpāṇigrahaṇāsaktamānasaḥ
dhyāyan lakṣaṃ japenmantrī abjairhutvā daśāṃśataḥ / īpsitāṃ labhate kanyāṃ śīgrameva na saṃśayaḥ
dīkṣitaṃ juṃbhaṇāstrāṇāṃ mantreṣu niyatavratam / dhyātvā ca vidhivannityaṃ japenmāsatrayaṃ manum
pūjāpuraḥsaraṃ saptasahasraṃ vijitendriyaḥ / sarvāsāmapi vidyānāṃ tattvajño jāyate naraḥ
viśvāmitrakratuvare kṛtādbhutaparākramam / dhyāyaṃllakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ mucyate mahato bhayāt
kṛtanityakriyaḥ śuddhastrikālaṃ prajapenmanum / sarvapāpavinirmukto yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam
dīkṣito vidhivanmantrī guṇairvigatakalmaṣaḥ / svācāraniyato dānto gṛhastho vijitendriyaḥ
aihikānanapekṣyaiva niṣkāmo yor'cayedvibhum / sa sarvānpuṇyapāpaudhāndagdhvā nirmalamānasaḥ
punarāvṛttirahitaḥ śāśvataṃ padamaśvataṃ padamaśnute / sakāmo vāñchitān labdhvā bhuktvā bhogān manogatān
jātiramaraściraṃ bhūtvā yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam / nidrācandrānvitā paścādbharatāya hṛdantimaḥ
saptākṣaro manuścāsya munyādyarcādi pūrvavat / bakaḥ seṃduśca śatrudhnaparaṃ ṅetaṃ hṛdantimaḥ
saptākṣaro 'yaṃ śatrudhnamantraḥ sarveṣṭasiddhidaḥ

iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge buhadupākhyāne sanatkumāravibhāge tṛtīyapāde rāmādyupāsanāvarṇanaṃ nāma trisaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ sanatkumāra uvāca athocyante hanumato mantrāḥ sarveṣṭadāyakāḥ / yānsamārādhya viprendra tattulyācaraṇā narāḥ
manuḥ svaredusaṃyuktaṃ gaganaṃ ca bhagānvitāḥ / hasaphaāgniniśādhīśāḥdvitīyaṃ bījamīritam
svaphaāgnayo bhagendvāḍhyāstṛtīyaṃ bījamīritam / viyadbhṛgvagnimanvinduyuktaṃ syāñca caturthakam
pañcamaṃ bhagacandrāḍhyāviyadbhṛgusvakāgnayaḥ / manvindvāḍhyau hasau ṣaṣṭaṃ ṅeṃtaḥ syāddhanumāṃstataḥ
hṛdayānto mahāmantrarājo 'yaṃ dvādaśākṣaraḥ / rāmacandro muniścāsya jagatīchanda īritam
devatā hanumānbījaṃ ṣaṣṭaṃ śaktirdvatīyakam / ṣaḍbījaiśca ṣaḍaṅgāni śirobhāle dṛśormukhe
galabāhudvaye caiva hṛdi kukṣau ca nābhitaḥ / dhvaje jānudvaye pādadvaye varṇānkramānnyaset
ṣaḍbījāni padadvandvaṃ mūrdhni bhāle mukhe hṛdi / nābhāvūrvorjaṅghayośca pādayorvinyasetkramāt
añjanīgarbhasaṃbhūtaṃ tato dhyāyetkapīśvaram / udyatkoṭyarkasaṃkāśaṃ jagatprakṣobhakārakam
śrīrāmāṅghridhyānaniṣṭaṃ sugrīvapramukhārcitam / vitrāsayantaṃ nādena rākṣasānmārutiṃ bhajet
dhyātvaivaṃ prajapedbhānusahasraṃ vijitaindriyaḥ / daśāṃśaṃ juhuyādbīhīnpayodadhyājyamiśritān
pūrvokte vaiṣṇave pīṭhe mūrttiṃ saṃkalpya mūlataḥ / āvāhya tatra saṃpūjya pādyādibhirupāyanaiḥ
keśareṣvaṅgapūjā syātpatreṣu ca tator'cayet / rāmabhakto mahātejāḥ kapirājo mahābalaḥ
droṇādrihārako merupīṭhakārcanakārakaḥ / dakṣiṇāśābhāskaraśca sarvavighnavināśakaḥ
itthaṃ sampūjya nāmāni dalāgreṣu tator'cayet / sugrīvamaṅgada nīlaṃ jāṃbavantaṃ nalaṃ tathā
suṣeṇaṃ dvividaṃ maindaṃ lokapālastator'cayet / vajrādyānapi saṃpūjya siddhaścaivaṃ manurbhavet
mantraṃ navaśataṃ rātrau japeddaśadināvadhi / yo narastasya naśyanti rājaśatrūtthabhītayaḥ
mātuliṅgāmrakadalīphalairhutvā sahasrakam / dvāviṃśatibrahmacāri viprānsaṃbhojayecchucīn
evaṅkṛte bhūtaviṣagraharogādyupadravāḥ / naśyanti tatkṣaṇādeva vidveṣigrahadānavāḥ
aṣṭottaraśatenāṃbu mantritaṃ viṣanāśanam / bhūtāpasmārakṛtyotthajvare tanmantramantritaiḥ
bhasmabhiḥ salilairvāpi tāḍayejjvariṇaṃ krudhā / tridinājjvaramukto 'sau sukhaṃ ca labhate naraḥ
auṣadhaṃ vā jalaṃ vāpi bhuktvā tanmantramantritam / sarvānrogānparābhūya sukhī bhavati tatkṣaṇāt
tajjaptabhasmaliptāṅgo bhuktvā tanmantritaṃ payaḥ / yoddhuṃ gacchecca yo mantrī śastrasaṃghairṃna bādhyate
śaskṣataṃ vraṇasphoṭo lūtāsphoṭo 'pi bhasmanā / trirjaptena ca saṃspṛṣṭāḥ śuṣyantyeva na saṃśayaḥ
japedarkāstamārabhya yāvadarkedayo bhavet / mantraṃ saptadinaṃ yāvañcādāya bhasmakīlakau
nikhanedabhimantryāśuśatrūṇāṃ dvāryalakṣitaḥ / vidveṣaṃ mitha āpannāḥ palāyante 'rayo 'cirāt
bhasmāṃbu candanaṃ mantrī mantreṇānena mantritam / bhakṣyādiyojitaṃ yasmai dadāti sa tu dāsavat
krūrāśca jantavo 'pyevaṃ bhavanti vaśavartinaḥ / gṛhītveśanadiskaṃsthaṃ karañjatarumūlakam
kṛtvā tenāṅguṣṭamātrāṃ pratimāṃ ca hanūmataḥ / kṛtvā prāṇapratiṣṭāṃ ca siṃdūrādyaiḥ prapūjya ca
gṛhasyābhimukhī dvāre nikhanenmantramuñcaran / grahābhicārarogāgniviṣacauranṛpodbhavāḥ
na jāyante gṛhe tasmin kadācidapyupadravāḥ / tadgṛhaṃ dhanaputrādyairedhate pratyahaṃ ciram
niśi yatra vane bhasma mṛtsnayā vāpi yatnataḥ / śatroḥ pratikṛtiṃ kṛtvā hṛdi nāma samālikhet
kṛtvā prāṇapratiṣṭāntaṃ bhindyācchastrairmanuṃ japan / mantrānte proñcarecchatrornāma chindhi ca bhindhi ca
mārayeti ca tasyānte dantairoṣṭaṃ nipūḍya ca / pāṇyostale prapīḍyātha tyaktvā taṃ svagṛhaṃ vrajet
kurvansaptadinaṃ caivaṃ hanyācchatruṃ na saṃśayaḥ / rājikālavaṇairmuktacikuraḥ pitṛkānane
dhattūraphalapuṣpaiśca nakharomaviṣairapi / dvika(kāka)kauśikagṛdhrāṇāṃ pakṣaiḥ śleṣmāntakākṣajaiḥ
samiddhistriśataṃ yāmayadiṅmukho juhuyānniśi / evaṃ saptadinaṃ kurvanmārayeduddhataṃ ripun
vitrāsastridinaṃ rātrau śmaśāne ṣaṭśataṃ japet / tato vetāla utthāya vadedbhāvi śubhāśubham
kiṅkarībhūya vartteta kurute sādhakoditam / bhāsmāṃbumantritaṃ rātrau sahasrāvṛttikaṃ punaḥ
dinatrayaṃ ca tatpaścātprakṣipetpratimāsu ca / yāsu kāsu ca sthūlāsu laghuṣvapi viśeṣataḥ
mantraprabhāvāñcalanaṃ bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ / aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ kuje vā ravivāsare
hanumatpratimāṃ paṭṭe māṣaiḥ snehapariplutaiḥ / kuryādramyāṃ viśuddhātmā sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitām
tailadīpaṃ vāmabhāge ghṛtadīpaṃ tu dakṣiṇe / saṃsthāpyāvāhayetpaścānmūlamantreṇa mantravit
prāṇapratiṣṭāṃ kṛtvā ca pādyādīni samarpayet / raktacandanapuṣpaiśca siṃdūrādyaiḥ samarcayet
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ pradāyātha naivedyaṃ ca samarpayet / apūpamodanaṃ śākamodakānvaṭakādikam
sājyaṃ ca tatsamarpyātha mūlamantreṇa mantravit / akhaṇḍitānyahilatādalāni saptaviṃśatim
tridhā kṛtvā sapūgāni mūlenaiva samarpayet / evaṃ saṃpūjya mantrajño japeddaśaśanta manum
karpūrārārtikaṃ kṛtvā stutvā ca bahudhā sudhīḥ / nijepsitaṃ nivedyātha vidhivadvisṛjettataḥ
naivedyānnena saṃbhojya brāhmaṇānsaptasaṃkhyayā / niveditāni parṇāni tebhyo dadyādvibhajya ca
dakṣiṇāṃ ca yathā śakti dattvā tān visṛjetsudhīḥ / tata iṣṭagaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ
taddine bhūmiśayyāṃ ca brahmacaryyaṃ samācaret / evaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ so 'cirādeva niścitam
prāpnuyātsakalānkāmānkapīśasya prasādataḥ / hanumatpratimāṃ bhūmau vilikhettatpuro manum
sādhyanāma dvitīyāntaṃ vimocaya vimocaya / tatpūrvaṃ mārjayedvāmapāṇinātha punarlikhet / evamaṣṭottaraśataṃ likhitvā mārjayetpunaḥ
evaṃ kṛte mahākārāgṛhācchīghraṃ vimucyate / evamanyāni karmāṇi kuryyāntpallavamullikhan
sarṣapairvaśyakṛddhomo vidveṣe hayamārajaiḥ / kuṅkumairidhmakāṣṭhairvā marīcairjīrakairapi
jvare dūrvāguḍūcībhirdadhnā kṣīreṇa vā ghṛtaiḥ / śūle karañjavātārisamidbhistailalolitaiḥ
tailāktābhiśca nirguṇḍīsamidbhirvā prayatnataḥ / saubhāgye candanaiścendralocanairvā lavaṅgakaiḥ
sugandhapuṣpairvastrāptyai tattaddhānyaistadāptaye / ripupādarajobhiśca rājīlavaṇamiśritaiḥ
homayetsaptarātraṃ ca ripuryāti yamālayam / dhānyaiḥ saṃprāpyate dhānyamannairannasamucchrayaḥ
tilājyakṣīramadhubhirmahiṣīgosamṛddhaye / kiṃ bahūktairviṣe vyādhau śāntau mohe ca māraṇe
vivāde staṃbhane dyūte bhūtabhītau ca saṃkaṭe / vaśye yuddhe kṣate divye bandhamokṣe mahāvane
sādhito 'yaṃ nṛṇāṃ dadyānmantraḥ śreyaḥ suniścitam / vakṣye 'tha hanumadyantraṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam
lāṅgūlākārasaṃyuktaṃ valayatritayaṃ likhet / sādhyanāma likhenmadhye pāśibīja praveṣṭitam
uparyaṣṭacchadaṃ kṛtvā patreṣu kavacaṃ likhet / tadbahirdaṃhamālikhya tadbahiścaturasrakam
caturasasrasya rekhāgre triśūlāni samālikhet / saiṃ bījaṃ bhūpurasyāṣṭavajreṣu vilikhettataḥ
koṇeṣvakuṃśamālikhya mālāmantreṇa veṣṭayet / tatsarvaṃ veṣṭayedyantravalayatritayena ca
śilāyāṃ phalake vastre tāmrapatre 'tha kuḍyake / tāḍapatre 'tha bhūrje vā rocanānābhikuṅkubhaiḥ
yantrametatsamālikhya nirāhāro jitendriyaḥ / kapeḥ prāṇānpratiṣṭāpya pūjayettadyathāvidhi
aśeṣaduḥkhaśāntyarthaḥ yantraṃ saṃdhārayed budhaḥ / mārījvarābhicārādisarvopadravanāśanam
yoṣitāmapi bālānāṃ dhṛtaṃ janamanoharam / bhūtakṛtyāpiśācānāṃ darśanādeva nāśanam
mālāmantramatho vakṣye tāro vāgviṣṇugehinī / dīrghatrayānvitā māyā prāguktaṃ kūṭapañcakam
dhruvo hṛddhanumānṅeṃto 'tha prakaṭaparākramaḥ / ākrāntadigmaṇḍalānte yaśovitānasaṃvadet
dhavalīkṛtavarṇānte jagattritayavajra ca / dehajvaladagnisūrya koṭyante ca samaprabha
tanūruhapadānte tu rudrāvatāra saṃvadet / laṅkāpurī tataḥ paścāddahanodadhilaṅghana
daśagrīvaśiraḥ paścātkṛtāntakapadaṃ vadet / sītānte śvasanapadaṃ vāyvante sutamīrayet
añjanāgarbhasaṃbhūtaḥ śrīrāmalakṣmaṇānvitaḥ / nandanti kara varṇānte sainyaprākāra īrayet
sugrīvasakhyakādūrṇādraṇavālinivarhaṇa / kāraṇadroṇaśabdānte parvatotpāṭaneti ca
aśokavanavīthyante dāruṇākṣakumāraka / chedanānte vanarakṣākarānte tu samūha ca
vibhañjanānte brahmāstrabrahmaśakti graseti ca / lakṣmaṇānte śaktibhedanivāraṇapadaṃ vadet
viśalyoṣadhiśabdānte samānayana saṃpaṭhet / bālodita tato bhānumaṇḍalagrasaneti ca
meghanādahomapadādvidhvaṃsanapadaṃ vadet / indrajidūdhakārānte ṇasītāsakṣaketi ca
rākṣasīsaṃghaśabdānte vidāraṇapadaṃ vadet / kuṃbhakarṇādisaṃkīrtyavadhānte ca parāyaṇa
śrīrāmabhaktivarṇānte tatpareti samudra ca / vyomadrumalaṅghaneti mahāsāmarthya saṃvadet
mahātejaḥpuñjaśabdādvirājamānavoñcaret / svāmivacanasaṃpāditārjunānte ca saṃyuga
sahāyānte kumāreti brahmacārinpadaṃvadet / gaṃbhīraśabdodayānte dakṣiṇāpatha saṃvadet / mārttāṇḍameru śabdānte vadetparvatapīṭikā
arcanānte tu sakalamantrānte mapadaṃ vadet / ācāryamama śabdānte sarvagrahavināśana
sarvajvaroñcāṭanānte sarvaviṣavināśana / sarvāpattinivāraṇa sarvaduṣṭanibarhaṇa
sarvavyādhyādi samprocya bhayānte ca nivāraṇa
sarvaśatrucchedaneti tato mama parasya ca
tatastribhuvanānte tu puṃstrīnapuṃsakātmakam / sarvajīvapadānte tu jātaṃ vaśayayugmakam
mamājñākārakaṃ paścātsaṃpādaya yugaṃ punaḥ / tato nānānāmadheyānsarvān rājñaḥ sa saṃpaṭhet
parivārānmametyante sevakān kuru yugmakam / sarvaśastravītyante ṣāṇi vidhvaṃsaya dvayam
lajjādīrghatrayopetā hotrayaṃ caihi yugmakam / vilomaṃ pañcakūṭāni sarvaśatrūnhanadvayam
parabalāni parānte sainyāni kṣobhayadvayam
mama sarvaṃ kāryajātaṃ sādhayeti dvayaṃ tataḥ
sarvaduṣṭadurjanānte mukhāni kīlayadvayam / dhetrayaṃ varmatritayaṃ phaṭtrayaṃ hāntrayaṃ tataḥ
vahnipriyānto mantro 'yaṃ mālāsaṃjño 'khileṣṭadaḥ
vasvaṣṭabāṇavarṇo 'yaṃ mantraḥ sarveṣṭāsādhakaḥ
mahābhaye mahotpāte smṛto 'yaṃ duḥkhanāśanaḥ / dvādaśārṇasya ṣaṭkūṭaṃ tyaktvā bījaṃ tathādimam
pañcakūṭātmako mantraḥ sarvakāmapradāyakaḥ / rāmacandro muniścāsya gāyatrī chanda īritam
hanumāndevatā prokto viniyogo 'khilāptaye / pañcabījaiḥ samastena ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret
rāmadūto lakṣmaṇānte prāṇadātāñjanīsutaḥ / sītāśokavināśo 'yaṃ laṅkāprāsādabhañjanaḥ
hanumadādyāḥ pañcaite bījādyā ṅeyutāḥ punaḥ / ṣaḍaṅgamanavo hyete dhyānapūjādi pūrvavat
praṇavo vāgbhavaṃ padmā māyā dīrghatrayānvitā / pañcakūṭāni mantro 'yaṃ rudrārṇaḥ sarvasiddhidaḥ
dhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvamasyāpi pūrvavanmatam / ayamārādhito mantraḥ sarvābhīṣṭapradāyakaḥ
namo bhagavate paścādanantaścandraśekharāṃ / janeyāya mahānte tu balāyānte 'gnivallabhā
aṣṭādaśārṇo mantro 'yaṃ sunirīśvarasaṃjñakaḥ / chando 'nuṣṭupdevatā tu hanumānpavanātmajaḥ
haṃ bījaṃ vahnivanitā śaktiḥ proktā manīṣibhiḥ / āñjaneyāya hṛdayaṃ śiraśca rudramūrtaye
śikhāyāṃ vāyuputrāyāgnigarbhāya varmaṇi / rāmadūtāya netraṃ syādbahyāstrāyāstramīritam
tatpacāmīkaranibhaṃ bhīghnasaṃvihitāñjalim / calatkuṇḍaladīptāsyaṃ padmakṣaṃ mārutiṃ smaret
dhyātvaivamayutaṃ japtvā daśāṃśaṃ juhuyāttilaiḥ / vaiṣṇave pūjayetpīṭhe prāguddiṣṭena vartmanā
aṣṭottaraśataṃ nityaṃ naktabhojī jitendriyaḥ / japitvā kṣudrarogebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
mahāroganivṛttyai tu sahasraṃ pratyahaṃ japet / rākṣasaughaṃ vinighnantaṃ kapiṃ dhyātvādhanāśanam
ayutaṃ prajapennityamacirājja yati dviṣam / sugrīveṇa samaṃ rāmaṃ saṃdadhānaṃ kapiṃ smaran
prajapedayutaṃ yastu saṃdhiṃ kuryāddvipadvayoḥ / dhyātvā laṅkāṃ dahṝntaṃ tamayutaṃ prajapenmanum
acirādeva śatrūṇāṃ grāmānsaṃpradahetsudhīḥ / dhyātvā prayāṇasamaye hanumantaṃ japenmanum
yo yāti so 'cirātsveṣṭaṃ sādhayitvā gṛhe vrajet / hanumantaṃ sadā gehe yor'cayejjapatatparaḥ
ārogyaṃ ca śriyaṃ kāntiṃ labhate nirupadravam / kānane vyāghracaurebhyo rakṣenmanurayaṃ smṛtaḥ
prasvāpakāle śayyāyāṃ smarenmantramananyadhīḥ / tasya duḥsvapnacaurādibhayaṃ naiva bhavetkvacit
viyatseṃdurhanumate tato rudrātmakāya ca / varmāstrānto mahāmantro dvādaśārṇo 'ṣṭasiddhikṛt
rāmacandro muniścāsya jagatī chanda īritam / hanumāndevatāṃ bījamādyaṃ śaktirhumīritā
ṣaḍdīrghabhājā bījena ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret / mahāśailaṃ samutpāṭya dhāvantaṃ rāvaṇaṃ prati
lākṣāraktāruṇaṃ raudraṃ kālāntakayamopamam / jvaladagnisamaṃ jaitraṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham
aṅgadādyairmahāvīrairveṣṭitaṃ rudrarūpiṇam / tiṣṭha tiṣṭha raṇe duṣṭa sṛjantaṃ ghoraniḥ svanam
śaivarūpiṇamabhyarcya dhyātvā lakṣa japenmanum / daśāṃśaṃ juhuyādvīhīnpayodadhyājyamiśritān
pūrvokte vaiṣṇave pīṭhe vimalādisamanvite / mūrtiṃ saṃkalpya mūlena pūjā kāryā hanūmataḥ
dhyānaikamātro 'pi nṛṇāṃ siddhireva na saṃśayaḥ / athāsya sādhanaṃ vakṣye lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā
hanumatsādhanaṃ puṇyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam / etadguhyatamaṃ loke śīghrasiddhikaraṃ param
mantrī yasya prasādena trailokyavijayī bhavet / prātaḥ snātvā nadītīre upaviśya kuśāsane
prāṇāyāmaṣaḍaṅge ca mūlena sakalaṃ caret / puṣpāñjalyaṣṭakaṃ datvā dhyātvā rāmaṃ sasītakam
tāmrapātre tataḥ padmamaṣṭapatraṃ sakeśaram / kucandanena ghṛṣṭena saṃlikhettacchalākayā
karmikāyāṃ likhenmantraṃ tatrāvāhya kapīśvaram / mūrtiṃ mūlena saṃkalpya dhyātvā pādyādikaṃ caret
gandhapuṣpādikaṃ sarvaṃ nivedya mūlamantrataḥ / kesareṣu ṣaḍaṅgāni daleṣu ca tator'cayet
sugrīvaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ caiva hyaṅgadaṃ nalanīlakau / jāṃbavantaṃ ca kumudaṃ kesarīśaṃ daler'cayet
dikpālāṃścāpi vajrādīnpūjayettadanantaram / evaṃ siddhe manau mantrī sādhayetsveṣṭamātmani
nadītīre kānane vā parvate vijane 'thavā / sādhayetsādhaka śreṣṭho bhūmigrahaṇapūrvakam
jitāhāro jitaśvāso jitavākca jitendriyaḥ / digbandha nādikaṃ kṛtvā nyāsadhyānādipūrvakam
lakṣaṃ japenmantrarājaṃ pūjayitvā tu pūrvavat / lakṣānti divasaṃ prāpya kuryyāñca pūjanaṃ mahat
ekāgramanasā samyagdhyātvā pavananandanam / divārātrau japaṃ kuryādyāvatsaṃdarśanaṃ bhavet
sudṛḍhaṃ sādhakaṃ matvā niśīthe pavanātmajaḥ / suprasannastato bhūtvā prayāti sādhakāgrataḥ
yathepsitaṃ varaṃ datvā sādhakāya kapīśvaraḥ / varaṃ labdhvā sādhakandro viharedātmanaḥ sukhaiḥ
etaddhi sādhanaṃ puṇyaṃ lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā / prakāśitaṃ rahasyaṃ vai devānāmapi durlabham
anyānapiprayogāṃśca sādhayedātmano hitān / viyadinduyutaṃ paścānṅeṃtaṃ pavananandanam
vahnipriyānto mantro 'yaṃ daśārṇaḥ sarvakāmadaḥ / munyādikaṃ ca pūrvoktaṃ ṣaḍaṅgānyapi pūrvavat
dhyāyedraṇe hanūmantaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham / dhāvantaṃ rāvaṇaṃ jetuṃ dṛṣṭvā satvaramutthitam
lakṣmaṇaṃ ca mahāvīraṃ patitaṃ raṇabhūtale / guruṃ ca krodhamutpādya grahotuṃ guruparvatam
hāhākāraiḥ sadarpaiśca kaṃpayantaṃ jagattrayam / ābrahmāṇḍaṃ samākhyāpya kṛtvā bhīmaṃ kalevaram
lakṣaṃ japeddaśāṃśena juhuyātpūrvavatsudhīḥ / pūrvavatpūjanaṃ proktaṃ mantra syāsya vidhānataḥ
evaṃ siddhe manau mantrī sādhayedātmano hitam / asyāpi mantravaryasya rahasyaṃ sādhanaṃ tu vai
sugopyaṃ sarvatantreṣu na deyaṃ yasya kasyacit / brāhme muhūrte cotthāya kṛtanityakriyaḥ śuciḥ
gatvā nadīṃ taḥ snātvā tīrthamāvāhya cāṣṭadhā / mūlamantraṃ tato japtvā siṃcedādityasaṃkhyayā
evaṃ snānādikaṃ kṛtvā gaṅgātīre 'thavā punaḥ / parvate vā vane vāpi bhūmigrahaṇapūrvakam
ādyavarṇaiḥ pūrakaṃ syātpañcavargaiśca kumbhakam / recakaṃ ca punaryādyairevaṃ prāṇānniyanya ca
vidhāya bhūtaśuddhyādi pīṭhanyāsāvadhi punaḥ / dhyātvā pūrvoktavidhinā saṃpūjya ca kapīśvaram
tadagre prajapennityaṃ sādhako 'yutamādarāt / saptame divase prāpte kuryāñca pūjanaṃ mahat
ekāgramanasā mantrī divārātraṃ japenmanum / mahābhayaṃ pradatvā tribhāgaśeṣāsu niścitam
yāminīṣu samāyāti niyataṃ pavanātmajaḥ / yathepsitaṃ varaṃ dadyātsādhakāya kapīśvaraḥ
vidyāṃ vāpi dhanaṃ vāpi rājyaṃ vā śatrunigraham / tatkṣaṇādeva cāpnoti satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
iha loke 'khilānkāmānbhuktvānte muktimāpnuyāt / sadyācitaṃ vāyuyugmaṃ hanūmanteti coddharet
phalānte phakriyānetrayuktā ca kāmikā tataḥ / dhaggante dhagitetyuktvā āyurāsva padaṃ tataḥ
lohito garuḍo hetibāṇanetrākṣaro manuḥ / munyādikaṃ tu pūrvoktaṃ plīharogaharo hariḥ
devatā ca samuddiṣṭā plīhayuktodare punaḥ / nāgavallīdalaṃ sthāpyamuparyācchādayettataḥ
vastraṃ caivāṣṭaguṇitaṃ tataḥ sādhakasattamaḥ / śakalaṃ vaṃśajaṃ tasyopari muñcetkapiṃ smaret
āraṇyasāṇakotpanne vahnau yaṣṭiṃ pratāpayet / badarībhūruhotthāṃ tāṃ mantreṇānena saptadhā
tayā saṃtāḍayedvaṃśaśakalaṃ jaṭharasthitam / saptakṛtvaḥ plīharogo nāśamāyāti niścitam
tāro namo bhagavate āñjaneyāya coñcaret / amukasya śṛṅkhalāṃ troṭayadvitayamīrayet
bandhamokṣaṃ kuruyugaṃ svāhānto 'yaṃ manurmataḥ / īśvaro 'sya muniśchando 'nuṣṭupca devatā punaḥ
śṛṅkhalāmocaraḥ śrīmānhanūmānpavanātmajaḥ / haṃ bījaṃ ṭhadvayaṃ śaktirbandhamokṣe niyogatā
ṣaḍdīrghavahriyuktena bījenāṅgāni kalpayet / vāme śailaṃ vairibhidaṃ viśuddhaṃ ṭaṅkamanyataḥ
dadhānaṃ svarṇavarṇaṃ ca dhyāyetkuṇḍalinaṃ harim / evaṃ dhyātvā japellakṣadaśāṃśaṃ cūtapallavaiḥ
juhuyātpūrvavatproktaṃ yajanaṃ vāsya sūribhiḥ / mahākārāgṛhe prāpto hyayutaṃ prajapennaraḥ
śīghraṃ kārāgṛhānmuktaḥ sukhī bhavati niścitam / yantraṃ cāsya pravakṣyāmi bandhamokṣakaraṃ śubham
aṣṭacchadāntaḥ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ sādhyanāmasamanvitam / ṣaṭkoṇeṣu dhruvaṃ ṅeṃtamāñjaneyapadaṃ likhet
aṣṭacchadeṣu vilikhetpraṇavo vātuvātviti / gorocanākuṅkumena likhitvā yantramuttamam
dhṛtvā mūrdhni japenmantramayutaṃ bandhamuktaye / yantrametallikhitvā tu mṛttikopari mārjayet
dakṣahastena mantrajñaḥ pratyahaṃ maṇḍalā vadhi / evaṃ kṛte mahākārāgṛhānmantrī vimucyate
gaganaṃ jvalanaḥ sākṣī markaṭeti dvayaṃ tataḥ / toyaṃ śaśeṣe makare parimuñcati muñcati
tataḥ śṛṅkhalikāṃ ceti vedanetrākṣaro manuḥ / imaṃ mantraṃ dakṣakare likhitvā vāmahastataḥ
dūrikṛtya japenmantramaṣṭottaraśataṃ budhaḥ / trisaptāhātprabaddho 'sau mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
munyādyarcādikaṃ sarvamasya pūrvavadācaret / lakṣaṃ japo daśāṃśena śubhairdravyaiśca homayet
pucchākāre suvastre ca lekhanyā kṣurakotthayā / gandhāṣṭakairlikhedvūpaṃ kapirājasya sundaram
tanmadhye 'ṣṭadaśārṇaṃ tu śatrunāmānvitaṃ likhet / tena mantrābhijaptena śirobaddhvena bhūmipaḥ
jayatyarigaṇaṃ sarvaṃ darśanādeva niścitam / candrasūryo parāgādau pūrvoktaṃ lekhayeddhvaje
dhvajamādāya mantrajñaḥ saṃsparśānmokṣaṇāvadhi / mātṛkāṃ jāpayetpaścāddaśāṃśena ca homayet
tilaiḥ sarṣapasaṃmiśraiḥ saṃskṛte havyavāhane / gaje dhvajaṃ samāropya gacchedyuddhvāya bhūpatiḥ
gajasthaṃ taṃ dhvajaṃ dṛṣṭvā palāyante 'rayo dhruvam / mahārakṣākaraṃ yantraṃ vakṣye samyagdhanūmataḥ
likhedvasudalaṃ padmaṃ sādhyākhyāyutakarṇikam / dale 'ṣṭakoṇamālikhya mālāmantreṇa veṣṭayet
tadbahir māyayāveṣṭya prāṇasthāpanamācaret / likhitaṃ svarṇalekhanyā bhūrjapatre suśobhane
kāśmīrarocanābhyāṃ tu trilohena ca veṣṭitam / sampātasādhitaṃ yantraṃ bhuje vā mūrdhni dhārayet
raṇe durodare vāde vyavahāre jayaṃ labhet / grahairvighnairviṣaiḥ śastraiścaurairnaivābhibhūyate
sarvānro gānapākṛtya ciraṃ jīvecchataṃ samāḥ / ṣaḍdīrghayuktaṃ gagana vahnyākhyaṃ tārasaṃpuṭam
aṣṭārṇo 'yaṃ mahāmantro mālāmantro 'tha kathyate / praṇavo vajrakāyeti vajratuṇḍeti saṃpaṭhet
kapilānte piṅgaleti urddhvakeśamahāpadam / balaraktamukhānte tu taḍijjihva mahā tataḥ
raudradaṃṣṭrotkaṭaṃ paścātkahadvandvaṃ karāliti / mahadṛḍhaprahāreṇa laṅkeśvaravadhāttataḥ
vāyurmahāsetupadaṃ bandhānte ca mahā punaḥ / śailapravāha gaganecara ehyehi saṃvadet
bhagavanmahābalānte parākramapadaṃ vadet / bhairavājñāpayaihyehi mahāraudrapadaṃ tataḥ
dīrghapucchena varṇānte vadedveṣṭaya vairiṇam / jaṃbhayadvayamābhāṣya varmāstrānto manurmataḥ
mālāhvayo dvijaśreṣṭha śaranetradharākṣaraḥ / mālāmantrāṣṭārṇayośca munyādyarcā tu pūrvavat
japto yuddhe jayaṃ dadyādvyādhau vyādhivināśanaḥ / evaṃ yo bhajate mantrī vāyuputraṃ kapīśvaram
sarvānsa labhate kāmānde vairapi sudurlabhān / dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ sutānpautrānsaubhāgyamatulaṃ yaśaḥ
medhāṃ vidyāṃ prabhāṃ rājyaṃ vivāde vijayaṃ tathā / vaśyādyāni ca karmāṇi saṃgare vijayaṃ tathā
upāsitoṃ'janāgarbhasaṃbhūtaḥ pradadātyalam

iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne sanatkumāravibhāge tṛtīyapāde hanumanmantrakathanaṃnāma catuḥsaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ sanatkumāra uvāca atha dīpavidhiṃ vakṣye sarahasyaṃ hanūmataḥ / yasya vijñānamātreṇa siddho bhavati sādhakaḥ
dīpapātrapramāṇaṃ ca tailamānaṃ krameṇa tu / dravyasya ca pramāṇaṃ vai tattu mānamanukramāt
sthānabhedaṃ ca mantraṃ ca dīpadānamanuṃ pṛthak / puṣpavāsitatailena sarvakāmapradaṃ matam
tilatailaṃ śriyaḥ prāptyai pathikāgamanaṃ prati / atasītailamuddiṣṭaṃ vaśyakarmaṇi niścitam
sārṣāpaṃ roganāśāya kathitaṃ karmakovidaiḥ / māraṇe rājikotthaṃ vā vibhītakasamudbhavam
uñcāṭane karajotthaṃ vidveṣe madhuvṛkṣajam / alābhe sarvatailānāṃ tilajaṃ tailamuttamam
godhūmāśca tilā māṣā mudgā vai taṇḍulāḥ kramāt / pañcadhānyamidaṃ proktaṃ nityadīpaṃ tu māruteḥ
pañcadhānyasamudbhūtaṃ piṣṭamātraṃ suśobhanam / sarvakāmapradaṃ proktaṃ sarvadā dīpadānake
vaśye taḍulapiṣṭotthaṃ māraṇe māṣapiṣṭajam / uñcāṭane kṛṣṇatilapiṣṭajaṃ ca prakīrtitam
pathikāgamane proktaṃ godhūmotthaṃ sataṇḍulam / mohane tvāḍhakījāta vidveṣe ca kulatthajam
saṃgrāme kevalā māṣāḥ proktā dīpasya pātrake / saṃdhau tripiṣṭajaṃ lakṣmīhetoḥ kastūrikābhavam
elālavaṅgakarpūramṛganābhisamudbhavam / kanyāprāptyai tathā rājavaṃśye sakhye tathaiva ca
alābhe sarvavastūnāṃ pañcadhānyaṃ varaṃ smṛtam / aṣṭamuṣṭirbhavetkiñcitkiñcidaṣṭau caḥ puṣkalam
puṣkalānāṃ caturṇāṃ ca hyāḍhakaḥ parikīrtitaḥ / caturāḍhako bhaveddroṇaḥ khārī droṇacatuṣṭayam
khārīcatuṣṭaya prasthasaṃjñā ca parikīrtitā / athavānyaprakāreṇa mānamatra nigadyate
paladvayaṃ tu prasṛtaṃ dviguṇaṃ kuḍavaṃ matam / caturbhiḥ kuḍavaiḥ prasthastaiścaturbhistathāḍhakaḥ
caturāḍhako bhaveddroṇaḥṛ khārī droṇacatuṣṭayam / krameṇaitena te jñeyāḥ pātre ṣaṭkarmasaṃbhave
pañca sapta nava tathā pramāṇāste yathākramam / saugandhe naiva mānaṃ syāttadyathāruci saṃmatam
nityapātre tu tailānāṃ niyamo vārtikodbhavaḥ / somavāre gṛhītvātaddhvānyaṃ toyaplutaṃ dharet
paścātpramāṇato jñeyaṃ kumārīhastapeṣaṇam / tatpiṣṭaṃ śuddhapātre tu nadītoyena piṇḍitam
dīpapātraṃ tataḥ kuryācchuddhaḥ prayatamānasaḥ / dīpapātre jvālyamāne māruteḥ kavacaṃ paṭhet
śuddhabhūmau samāsthāpya bhaume dīpaṃ pradāpayet / mālāmanūnāṃ ye varṇāḥ sādhyanāmasamanvitāḥ
vartikāyāṃ prakarttavyāstantavastatpramāṇakāḥ / tattriṃśāṃśena vā grāhyā gurukārye 'khilāḍhyatā
kūṭatulyāḥ smṛtā nitye sāmānye 'tha viśeṣake / rudrāḥ kūṭagaṇāḥ proktā na pātre niyamo mataḥ
ekaviṃśatisaṃkhyākāstantavo 'thādhvani smṛtāḥ / raktasūtraṃ hanumato dīpadāne prakīrtitam
kṛṣṇamuñcāṭane dveṣe 'ruṇaṃ māraṇakarmaṇi / kūṭatulyapalaṃ tailaṃ gurukārye śivairguṇam
nitye pañcapalaṃ proktamathavā mānasī ruciḥ
hanumatpratimāyāstu sannidhau dīpadāpanam / śivālaye 'thavā kuryānnityanaimittike sthale
viśeṣo 'styatra yaḥ kaścinmārute rucyate mayā
pratimāgre pramodena grahabhūtagraheṣu ca / catuṣpathe tathā proktaṃ ṣaṭsu dīpapradāpanam
sannidhau sphaāṭike liṅge śālagrāmasya sannidhau / nānābhogaśriyai proktaṃ dīpadānaṃ hanūmataḥ
gaṇeśasannidhau vighnamahāsaṃkaṭanāśane / viṣavyādhibhaye ghore hanumatsannidhau smṛtam
durgāyāḥ sannidhau proktaṃ saṃgrāme dīpadāpanam / catuṣpathe vyādhinaṣṭau duṣṭadṛṣṭau tathaiva ca
rājadvāre bandhamuktau kārāgāre 'thavā matam / aśvatthavaṭamūle tu sarvakāryaprasiddhaye
vaśye bhaye vivāde ca veśmasaṃgrāmasaṃkaṭe / dyūte dṛṣṭistaṃbhane ca vidveṣe māraṇe tathā
mṛtakotthāpane caiva pratimācālane tathā / viṣe vyādhau jvare bhūtagrahe krṛtyāvimocane
kṣatagranthau mahāraṇye durgevyāghne ca dantini / krūrasattveṣu sarveṣu śaśvadūndhavimokṣaṇe
pathikāgamane caiva duḥsthāne rājamohane / āgame nirgame caiva rājadvāre prakīrtitam
dīpadānaṃ hanumato nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
rudraikaviṃśapiṇḍāṃśca tridhā maṇḍalamānakam / laghumānaṃ smṛtaṃ pañca sapta vā nava vā tathā
kṣīreṇa navanūtena dadhnā vā gomayena ca / pratimākaraṇaṃ proktaṃ māruterdīpadāpane
dakṣiṇābhimukhaṃ vīraṃ kṛtvā kesarivikramam
ṛkṣavinyastapādaṃ ca kirīṭena virājitam / likhedbhittau paṭe vāpi pīṭhe vā māruteḥ śubhe
mālāmantreṇa dātavyaṃ dīpadānaṃ hanūmataḥ / nityadīpaḥ prakarttavyo dvādaśākṣaravidyayā
viśeṣastatra yastaṃ vai dīpadāne 'vadhāraya / ṣaṣṭyādau ca dvitīyādāvimaṃ dīpamitīrayet
gṛhāṇeti padaṃ paścāccheṣaṃ pūrvavaduñcaret / kūṭādau nityadīpe ca mantraṃ sūryākṣaraṃ vadet
tatra mālākhyamanunā tattatkāryeṣu kārayet / gomayenopaliptāyāṃ bhūmau tadgatamānasaḥ
ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vasupatraṃ ca bhūmau rekhāsamanvitam / kamalaṃ ca likhedbhadraṃ tatra dīpaṃ nidhāpayet
śaive vā vaiṣṇave pīṭhe pūjayedañjanāsutam / kūṭaṣaṭkaṃ ca ṣaṭkoṇe antarāle paralikhet
ṣaṭkoṇeṣu ṣaḍaṅgāni bījayuktāni saṃlikhet / saumyaṃ madhyagataṃ lekhyaṃ tatra saṃpūjya mārutim
ṣaṭkoṇeṣu ṣaḍaṅgāni nāmāni ca puroktavat / vasupatre kramātpūjyā aṣṭāvete ca vānarāḥ
sugrīvāyāṅgadāyātha suṣeṇāya nalāya ca / nīlāyātho jāṃbavate prahastāya tathaiva ca
suveṣāya tataḥ paścādyajetṣaḍaṅgadevatāḥ / ādāvañjanāputrāya tataśca rudramūrtaye
tato vāyusutāyātha jānakījīvanāya ca / rāmadūtāya brahmāstranivāraṇāya tatparam
pañcopacāraiḥ saṃpūjya deśakālau ca kīrtet / kuśodakaṃ samādāya dīpamantraṃ samuñcaret
uttagabhimukho japtvā sādhayetsādhakottamaḥ / taṃ mantraṃ kūṭadhā japtvā jalaṃ bhūmau vinikṣipet
tataḥ karapuṭaṃ kṛtvā yathāśakti japenmanum / anena dīpavaryeṇa udaṅmukhagatena vai
tathā vidhehi hanumanyathā syurme manorathaāḥ / trayodaśaivaṃ dravyāṇi gomayaṃ mṛttikā masī
alaktaṃ daradaṃ raktacandanaṃ candanaṃ madhu / kastūrikā dadhi kṣīraṃ navanītaṃ ghaṛtaṃ tathā
gomayaṃ dvividhaṃ tatra proktaṃ gomahiṣībhavam / paścādvinaṣṭadravyāptau māhiṣaṃ gomayaṃ smṛtam
pathikāgamane dūrānmahādurgasya rakṣaṇe / bālādirakṣaṇe caiva caurādibhayanāśane
strīvaśyādiṣu kāryeṣu śastaṃ gogomayaṃ mane / bhūmispṛṣṭaṃ na tadgrāhyamantarikṣāñca bhājane
caturvidhā mṛttikā tu śvetā pītāruṇāsitā / tatra gopīcandanaṃ tu haritālaṃ ca gaurikam
maṣī lākṣārasodbhūtā sarvaṃ vānyatsphuṭaṃ matam / kṛtvā gopīcadaṃnena caturasraṃ gṛhaṃ sudhīḥ
tanmadhye māhiṣeṇātha kuryānmūrtiṃ hanūmataḥ / bījaṃ krodhāñca tatpucchaṃ likhenmantrī samāhitaḥ
tailena snāpayenmūrtiṃ guḍena tilakaṃ caret / śatapatrasamo dhūpaḥ śālaniryāsasaṃbhavaḥ
kuryyāñca tailadīpaṃ tu vartipañcakasaṃyutam / dadhyodanena naivedyaṃ dadyātsādhakasattamaḥ
vāratrayaṃ kaṇṭhadeśe saśeṣaviṣamuñcaran / evaṃ kṛte tu naṣṭānāṃ mahiṣīṇāṃ gavāmapi
dāsīdāsādikānāṃ ca naṣṭānāṃ prāptirīritā / caurādiduṣṭasattvānāṃ sarpādīnāṃ bhaye punaḥ
tālena ca caturdvāraṃ gṛhaṃ kṛtvā suśobhanam / pūrvadvāre gajaḥ sthāpyo dakṣiṇe mahiṣastathā
sarpastu paścime dvāre vyāghraścaivottare tathā / evaṃ krameṇa khaḍgaṃ ca kṣurikādaṇḍamudgarān
vilikhya madhye mūrtiṃ ca mahiṣīgomayena vai / kṛtvā ḍamaruhastāṃ ca cakitākṣīṃ prayatnataḥ
payasā snāpanaṃ raktacandanenānulepanam / jātīpuṣpaistu saṃpūjya śuddhadhūpa prakalpayet
ghṛtena dīpaṃ dattvātha pāyasānnaṃ nivedayet / gaganaṃ dīpikendvāḍhyāṃ śāstraṃ ca purato japet
evaṃ saptadinaṃ kṛtvā mucyate mahato bhayāt / anayorbhauṃmavāre tu kuryādāraṃbhamādarāt
śatrusenābhaye prāpte gairikeṇa tu maṇḍalam / kṛtvā tadantare tālamīṣṭannamraṃ samālikhet
tatrāvalaṃbamānāṃ ca pratimāṃ gomayena tu / vāmahastena tālāgraṃ dakṣiṇe jñānamudrikā
tālamūlātsvakāṣṭāyāṃ mārge hastamite gṛham / caturasra vidhāyātha tanmadhye mūrtimālikhet
dakṣiṇābhamukhīṃ rimyāṃ hṛdaye vihitāñjalim / toyena snānagandhādi yathāsaṃbhavamarpayet
kṛśārānnaṃ ca naivedyaṃ sājyaṃ tasyai nivedayet / kilidvayaṃ japaṃ proktamevaṃ kuryāddine dine
evaṃ kṛte bhavecchīghraṃ pathikānāṃ samāgamaḥ / śyāmapāṣāṇakhaṇḍena likhitvā bhūpatergṛham
prākāraṃ tu caturdvārayuktaṃ dvāreṣu tatra vai / anyonyapuccha ridhitrayayuktāṃ hanūmataḥ
kuryānmūrtiṃ gomayena dhattūrakusumaiyajet / jaṭāmāṃsībhavaṃ dhūpaṃ tailāktaghṛtadīpakam
naivedyaṃ tilatailāktasakṣārā māṣaroṭikā / dhyeyo dakṣiṇahastena roṭikāṃ bhakṣayanhariḥ
vāmahastena pāṣāṇaistrāsayanparasainikān / pnārayanbhrukuṭīṃ baddhvā bhīṣayanmathayansthitaḥ
japeñca bhugbhugiti vai sahasraṃ dhyānatatparaḥ / evaṃ kṛtavidhānena parasainyaṃ vināśayet
rakṣā bhavati durgāṇāṃ satyaṃ satya na saṃśayaḥ / prāyogā bahavastatra saṃkṣepādgaditā mayā
pratyahaṃ yo vidhānena dīpadānaṃ hanūmataḥ / tasyāsādhyaṃ na vai kiñcidvidyate bhuvanatraye
na deyaṃ duṣṭahṛdaye duṣṭacintanabuddhaye / avinītāya śiṣyāya piśunāya kadācana
kṛtaghnāya na dātavyaṃ dātavyaṃ ca parīkṣite / bahunā kimihoktena sarvaṃ dadyātkapīśvaraḥ
atha mantrāntaraṃ vakṣye tattvajñānapradāyakam / tāro namo hanumate jāṭharatrayamīrayet
danakṣobhaṃ samābhāṣya saṃharadvayamīrayet / ātmatattvaṃ tataḥ paścātprakāśayayugaṃ tataḥ
varmāstravahnijāyāntaḥ sārddhūṣaḍviṃśadarṇavān / vasiṣṭho 'sya muniśchando 'nuṣṭup ca devatāḥ punaḥ
hanumānmunisaptartuvedāṣṭanigamaiḥ kramāt / mantrārṇaiśca ṣaḍaṅgāni kṛtvā dhyāyetkapīśvaram
jānusthāvāmabāhuṃ ca jñānamudrāparaṃ hṛdi / adhyātmacittamāsīnaṃ kadalīvanamadhyagam
bālārkakoṭipratimaṃ dhyāyejjñānapradaṃ harim / dhyātvaivaṃ prajapellakṣaṃ daśāṃśaṃ juhuyāttilaiḥ
sājyaiḥ saṃpūjayetpīṭhe pūrvokte pūrvavatprabhum / japto 'yaṃ madanakṣobhaṃ nāśayatyeva niścitam
tattvajñānamavāpnoti kapīndrasya prasādataḥ / atha mantrātaraṃ vākṣye bhūtavidrāvaṇaṃ param
tāraḥ kāśīṅkukṣiparavarāhaścāñjanāpadam / pavano vanaputrānte āveśidvayamīrayet
tāraḥ śrīhanumatyaścādastraracabhujākṣaraḥ / brahmā muniḥ syādgāyatrī chando 'tra devatā punaḥ
hanumānkamalā bījaṃ phaṭ śaktiḥ parikīrtitaḥ / ṣaḍdīrghāḍhyena bījena ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret
āñjaneya pāṭalāsyaṃ svarṇādrisamavigraham / pārijātadrumūlasthaṃ cintayetsādhakottamaḥ
evaṃ dhyātvā japellakṣaṃ daśāṃśaṃ juhuyāttilaiḥ / trimadhvaktairyañjatpīṭhe pūrvoktepūrvavatsudhīḥ
anena manunā mantrī grahagrastaṃ pramārjayet / ākrandaṃstaṃ vimucyātha grahaḥ śīghraṃ palāyate
manavo 'mī sadāgopyā na prakāśyā yatastataḥ / parīkṣitāya śiṣyāya deyā vā nijasūnave
hanumadbhajanāsaktaḥ kārtavīryārjunaṃ sudhīḥ / viśeṣataḥ samārādhya yathoktaṃ phalamāpnuyāt

iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne tṛtīyapāde dīpavidhinirūpaṇaṃ nāma pañcasaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ nārada uvāca kārtavīryataprabhṛtayo nṛpā bahuvidhā bhuvi / jāyante 'tha pralīyante svasvakarmānusārataḥ
tatkathaṃ rājavaryo 'sau lokesevyatvamāgataḥ / samullaṅghya nṛpānanyānetanme nuda saṃśayam
sanatkumāra uvāca śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi saṃdehavinivṛttaye / yathā sevyatvamāpannaḥ kārtavīryārjuno bhuvi
yaḥ sudarśanacakrasyāvatāraḥ pṛthivītale / dattātreyaṃ samārādhya labdhavāṃsteja uttamam
tasya kṣitīśvaredrasya smaraṇādeva nārada / śatrūñjayati saṃgrāme naṣṭaṃ prāpnoti satvaram
tenāsya mantrapūjādi sarvatantreṣu gopitam / tubhyaṃ prakāśayiṣye 'haṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam
vahnitārayutā raudrī lakṣmīragnīnduśāntiyuk / vedhādharenduśāntyāḍhyo nidrayāśāgni binduyuk
pāśo māyāṅkuśaṃ padmāvarmāstre kārtavīpadam / rephovā dyāsano 'nanto vahnijau karṇasaṃsthitau
meṣaḥ sadīrghaḥ pavano manurukto hṛdantimaḥ / ūnarviśativarṇo 'yaṃ tārādirnakhavarṇakaḥ
dattātreyo muniścāsyacchando 'nuṣṭubudāhṛtam / kārtavīryārjuno devo bījaśaktirdhruvaśca hṛt
śeṣāḍhyabījayugmena hṛdayaṃ vinyasedadhaḥ / śāntiyuktacaturthena kāmādyena śirāḥeṃ'gakam
indvāḍhyaṃ vāmakarṇādyamāyayorvīśayuktayā / śikhāmaṅkuśapadmābhyāṃ savāgbhyāṃ varma vinyaset
varmāstrābhyāmastramuktaṃ śeṣārṇairvyāpakaṃ punaḥ / hṛdaye jaṭhare nābhau jaṭhare guhyadeśataḥ
dakṣapāde vāmapāde sakthni jānuni jaṅghayoḥ / vinyasedbījadaśakaṃ praṇavadvayamadhyagam
tārādyānatha śeṣārṇānmastake ca lalāṭake / bhruvoḥ śrutyostathaivākṣṇornasi vaktre galeṃ'sake
sarvamantreṇa sarvāṅge kṛtvā vyāpakamādṛtaḥ / sarveṣṭasiddhaye dhyāyetkārtavīryaṃ janeśvaram
udyadrarkasahasrābhaṃ sarvabhūpativanditam / dorbhiḥ pañcāśatā dakṣairbāṇānvāmairdhanūṃṣi ca
dadhataṃ svarṇamālāḍhyaṃ raktavastrasamāvṛtam / cakrāvatāraṃ śrīviṣṇordhyāyedarjunabhūpatim
lakṣamekaṃ japenmantraṃ daśāṃśaṃ juhuyāttilaiḥ / sataṇḍulaiḥ pāyasena viṣṇupīṭhe yajattutam
ṣaṭkoṇeṣu ṣaḍaṅgāni tato dikṣu vivikṣu ca / cauramadavibhañjanaṃ mārīmadavibhañjanam
arimadavibhañjanaṃ daityamadavibhañjanam / duṣṭanāśaṃ duḥkhanāśaṃ duritāpadvināśakam
dikṣvaṣṭaśaktayaḥ pūjyāḥ prācyādiṣvasitaprabhāḥ / kṣemaṅkarī vaśyakarī śrīkarī ca yaśaskarī
āyuḥ karī tathā prajñākarī vidyākarī punaḥ / dhanakaryaṣṭamī paścāllokeśā astrasaṃyutāḥ
evaṃ saṃsādhito mantraḥ prayogārhaḥ prajāyate / kārtavīryārjunasyātha pūjāyantramihocyate
svabījānaṅgadhruvavākkarṇikaṃ digdalaṃ likhet / tārādivarmāntadalaṃ śeṣavarṇadalāntaram
ūṣmāntyasvarakiñjalkaṃ śeṣārṇaiḥ pariveṣṭitam / koṇālaṅkṛtabhūtārṇabhūgṛhaṃ yantramīśituḥ
śuddhabhūmāvaṣṭagandhairlikhitvā yantramādarāt / tatra kuṃbhaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya tatrāvāhyārcayennṛpam
spṛṣṭvā kuṃbhaṃ japenmantraṃ sahasraṃ vijitendriyaḥ / abhiṣiṃ cettadaṃbhobhiḥ priyaṃ sarveṣṭasiddhaye
putrānyaśo roganāśamāyuḥ svajanarañjanam / vāksiddhiṃ sudṛśaḥ kumbhābhiṣikto labhate naraḥ
śatrūpadrava āpanne grāme vā puṭabhedane / saṃsthāpaṃyedidaṃ yantraṃ śatrubhītinivṛttaye
sarṣapāriṣṭalaśunakārpāsairmāryate ripuḥ / dhattūraiḥ stabhyate nimbairdveṣyate vaśyateṃ'bujaiḥ
uñcāṭane vibhītasya samidbhiḥ khadirasya ca / kaṭutailamahiṣyājyairhemadravyāñjanaṃ smṛtam
yavairhute śriyaḥ prāptistilairājyairaghakṣayaḥ / tilataṇḍulasiddhārthajālairvaśyo nṛpo bhavet
apāmārgārkadūrvāṇāṃ homo lakṣmīprado 'ghanut / strīvaśyakṛtpriyaṅgūṇāṃ murāṇāṃ bhūtaśāntidaḥ
aśvatthoduṃbaraplakṣavaṭabilvasamudbhavāḥ / samidho labhate hutvā putrānāyurddhanaṃ sukham
nirmokahemasiddhārthalavaṇaiścauranāśanam / rocanāgomayaistaṃbho bhūprāptiḥ śālibhirhutaiḥ
homasaṃkhyā tu sarvatra sahasrādayutāvadhi / prakalpanīyā mantrajñaiḥ kāryyagauravalāghavāt
kārtavīryyasya mantrāṇāmucyate lakṣaṇaṃ budhāḥ / kārtavīryārjunaṃ ṅeṃtaṃ sarvamantreṣu yojayet
svabījādyo daśārṇo 'sau anye navaśivākṣarāḥ / ādyabījadvayenāsau dvitīyo mantra īritaḥ
svakāmābhyāṃ tṛtīyo 'sau svabhrūbhyāṃ tu caturthakaḥ / svapāśābhyāṃ pañcamo 'sau ṣaṣṭaḥ svena ca māyayā
svāṅkuśābhyāṃ saptamaḥ syātsvaramābhyāmathāṣṭamaḥ / svavāgbhavābhyāṃ navamo varmāstrābhyāmathāntimaḥ
dvitīyādinavānteṣu bījayoḥ syādvyatikramaḥ / mantre tu daśame varṇā navavarmāstramadhyagāḥ
eteṣu mantravaryeṣu svānukūlaṃ manuṃ bhajet / eṣāmādye virāṭchado 'nyeṣu triṣṭubudāhṛtam
daśa mantrā ime proktā yadā syuḥ praṇavādikāḥ / tadādimaḥ śivārṇaḥ syādanye tu dvādaśākṣarāḥ
triṣṭupūchandastathādye syādanyeṣu jagatī matā / evaṃ viṃśatimantrāṇāṃ yajanaṃ pūrvavanmatama
dīrghāḍhyamūlabījena kuryādeṣāṃ ṣaḍaṅgakam / tāro hṛtkārtavīryārjunāya varmāstraṭhadvayam
caturdaśārṇo mantro 'yamasyejyā pūrvavanmatā / bhūnetrasamanetrākṣivarṇerasyāṅgapañcakam
tāro hṛdbhagavān ṅeṃtaḥ kārtavīryārjunastathā / varmāstrāgnipriyāmantraḥ prokto hyaṣṭādaśārṇakaḥ
trivedasaptayugmākṣivarṇaiḥ pañcāṅgakaṃ manoḥ / namo bhagavate śrīti kārtavīryārjunāya ca
sarvaduṣṭāntakāyeti tapobalaparākramaḥ / paripālitasaptānte dvīpāya sarvarāpadam
janyacūḍā maṇānte ye mahāśaktimate tataḥ / sahasradahanaprānte varmāstrānto mahāmanuḥ
triṣaṣṭivarṇavānproktaḥ smaramātsarvavighnahṛt / rājanyakravartī ca vīraḥ śūrastṛtīyakaḥ
māhiṣmatīpatiḥ paścāñcaturthaḥ samudīritaḥ / revāṃbuparitṛptaśca kāṇo hastaprabādhitaḥ
daśāsyeti ca ṣaḍbhiḥ syātpadairṅetaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakam / siṃcyamānaṃ yuvatibhiḥ krīḍantaṃ narmadājale
hastairjalaudhaṃ rundhantaṃ dhyāyenmattaṃ nṛpottamam / evaṃ dhyātvāyutaṃ mantraṃ pajedanyattu pūrvavat
pūrvaṃ tu prajapellakṣaṃ pūjāyogaśca pūrvavat / kārtavīryārjuno nāma rājā bāhusahasravān
tasya saṃsmaraṇādeva hṛtaṃ naṣṭaṃ ca saṃvadet / labhyate mantravaryo 'yaṃ dvātriṃśadvarṇasaṃyutaḥ
pādaiḥ sarveṇa pañcāṅgaṃ dhyānapūjādi pūrvavat / kārtavīryāya śabdānte vidmahe padamuñcaret
mahāvīryāya varṇānte dhīmahīti padaṃ vadet / tannor'junaḥ pravarṇānte codayātpadamīrayet
gāyatryeṣārjuna syoktā prayogādau japettu tām / anuṣṭubhaṃ manuṃ rātrau japatāṃ caurasaṃcayāḥ
palāyante gṛhāddūraṃ tarpaṇāddhravanādapi / atho dīpavidhiṃ vakṣye kārtavīryapriyaṅkaram
vaiśākhe śrāvaṇe mārge kārtikāśvinapauṣataḥ / māghaphālgunayormāsordīpāraṃbhaṃ samācaret
tithau riktāvihīnāyāṃ vāre śanikujau vinā / hastottarāśviraudreyapuṣyavaiṣṇavavāyubhe
dvidaivate ca rohiṇyāṃ dīpāraṃbho hitāvahaḥ / carame ca vyatīpāte dhṛtau vṛddhau sukarmaṇi
prītau harṣaṃ ca saubhāgye śobhanāyuṣmatorapi / karaṇe viṣṭirahite grahaṇe 'rddhodayādiṣu
yogeṣu rātrau pūrvāhne dīpāraṃbhaghaḥ kṛtaḥ śubhaḥ / kārtike śuklasaptamyāṃ niśīthe 'tīva śobhanaḥ
yadi tatra ravervāraḥ śravaṇaṃ bhaṃ ca durlabham / atyāvaśyakakāryeṣu māsādīnāṃ na śodhanam
ādye hyupoṣya niyato brahmacārī sapītakaiḥ / prātaḥ snātvā śuddhabhūmau liptāyāṃ gomayodakaiḥ
prāṇānāyamya saṃkalpya nyāsānpūrvoditāṃścaret / ṣaṭkoṇaṃ racayedbhūmau raktacandanataṇḍulaiḥ
ataḥ smaraṃ samālikhya ṣaṭkoṇeṣu samālikhet / navārṇairveṣṭayettañca trikoṇaṃ tadbahiḥ punaḥ
evaṃ vilikhite yantre nidadhyāddīpabhājanam / svarṇajaṃ rajatotthaṃ vā tāmrajaṃ tadabhāvataḥ
kāṃsyapātraṃ mṛṇmayaṃ ca kaniṣṭhaṃ lohajaṃ mṛtau / śāntaye mudgacūrṇotthaṃ saṃdhau godhūmacūrṇajam
ājye palasahasre tu pātraṃ śatapalaṃ smṛtam / ājye 'yutapale pātraṃ palapañcaśatā smṛtam
pañcasaptatisaṃkhye tu pātraṃ ṣaṣṭipalaṃ smṛtam / trisāhasrī ghṛtapale śarkarāpalabhājanam
dvisāhakhtryāṃ dviśatamitaṃ ca bhājanamiṣyate / śate 'kṣicarasaṃśyātamevamanyatra kalpayet
nityadīpe vahnipalaṃ pātramājyaṃ palaṃ smṛtam / evaṃ pātraṃ pratiṣṭhāpya vartīḥ sūtrotthitāḥ kṣipet
ekā tisro 'thavā pañcasaptādyā viṣamā api / tithimānādāsahasraṃ tantusaṃkhyā vinirmitā
goghṛtaṃ prakṣipettatra śuddhavastraviśodhitam / sahasrapalasaṃkhyādidaśāṃśaṃ kāryagauravāt
suvarṇādikṛtāṃ ramyāṃ śalākāṃ ṣoḍaśāṅgulām / tadarddhāṃ vā tadarddhāṃ vā sūkṣmāgrāṃ sthūlamūlikām
vimuñceddakṣiṇe pātramadhye cāgre kṛtāgrikām / pātradakṣiṇadigdeśe muktvāṃ gulacatuṣṭayam
adhogrāṃ dakṣiṇādhārāṃ nikhanecchurikāṃ śubhām / dīpaṃ prajvālayettatra gaṇeśasmṛtipūrvakam
dīpātpūrvatra digbhāge sarvatobhadramaṇḍale / taṇḍulāṣṭadale vāpi vidhivatsthāpayeddhūṭam
tatrāvāhya nṛpādhīśaṃ pūjayetpūrvavatsudhīḥ / jalākṣatānsamādāya dīpaṃ saṃkalpayettataḥ
dīpasaṃkalpamantro 'yaṃ kathyate dvīṣubhūmitaḥ / praṇavaḥ pāśamāye ca śikhā kārtākṣarāṇi ca
vīryārjunāya māhiṣmatīnāthāya sahasra ca / bāhave iti varṇānte sahasrapadamuccaret
kratudīkṣitahastāya dattātreyapriyāya ca / ātreyāyānusūyānte garbharatnāya tatparam
namo grīvāmakarṇendusthitau pāśa imaṃ tataḥ / dīpaṃ gṛhāṇa amukaṃ rakṣa rakṣa padaṃ punaḥ
duṣṭānnāśayayugmaṃ syāttathā pātaya ghātaya / śatrūn jahidvayaṃ māyā tāraḥ svaṃ bījamātmabhūḥ
vahnīpriyā anenātha dīpavaryeṇa paścimā / bhimukhenāmukaṃ rakṣa amukānte varaprada
māyākāśadvayaṃ vāmanetracandrayutaṃ śivā / vedādikāmacāmuṇḍāḥ svāhā tu pūsabindukau
praṇavo 'gnipriyā mantro netrabāṇādharākṣaraḥ / dattātreyo munirmālāmantrasya parikīrtitaḥ
chando 'mitaṃ kārtavīryurjuno devo 'khilāptikṛt / cāmuṇḍayā ṣaḍaṅgāni caretṣaḍdīrghayuktayā
dhyātvā devaṃ tato mantraṃ paṭhitvānte kṣipejjajalam / govindāḍhyo halī seṃduścāmuṇḍābījamīritam
tato navākṣaraṃ mantraṃ sahasraṃ tatpuro japet / tāro 'nanto binduyukto māyāsvaṃ vāmanetrayuk
kūrmāgnī śāntibindvāḍhyau vahni jāyāṅkuśaṃ dhruvam / ṛṣiḥ pūrvoditonuṣṭupchando 'nyatpūrvavatpunaḥ
sahasraṃ mantrarājaṃ ca japitvā kavacaṃ paṭhet / evaṃ dīpapradānasya kartāpnotyakhile 'psitam
dīpaprabodhakāle tu varjayedaśubhāṃ giram / viprasya darśanaṃ tatra śubhadaṃ parikīrtitam
śūdrāṇāṃ pradhyamaṃ proktaṃ mlecchasya vadhabandhanam / ākhvotvordarśanaṃ duṣṭaṃ gavāśvasya sukhāvaham
dīpajvālā samā siddhyai vakrā niśavidhāyinī / śabdā bhayadā karturujjvalā sukhadā matā
kṛṣṇā śatrubhayotpattye vamantī paśunāśinī / kṛte dīpe yadā pātraṃ bhagnaṃ dṛśyate daivataḥ
pakṣādarvāktadā gacchedyajamāno yamālayam / vartyataraṃ yadā kuryātkāryaṃ siddhyedvilaṃbataḥ
netrahīno bhavetkartā tasmindīpāntare kṛte / aśucisparśane vyādhirdīpanāśe tu caurabhīḥ
śvamārjārākhusaṃsparśe bhavedbhūpatito bhayam / pātrāraṃbhe vasupalaiḥ kṛto dīpo 'khileṣṭadaḥ
tasmāddīpaḥ prayatnena rakṣaṇīyoṃ'tarāyataḥ / āsamāpteḥ prakurvīta brahmacaryaṃ ca bhūśayaḥ
strīśūdrapatitādīnāṃ saṃbhāṣāmapi varjayet / japetsahasraṃ pratyekaṃ mantrarājaṃ navākṣaram
stotrapāṭhaṃ pratidinaṃ niśīthinyāṃ viśeṣataḥ / ekapādena dīpāgre sthitvā yo mantranāyakam
sahasraṃ prajapedvātrau so 'bhīṣṭaṃ kṣipramāpnuyāt / samāpya śobhanadine saṃbhojya dvijasattamān
kuṃbhodakena kartāramabhiṣiñcanmanuṃ japet / kartā tu dakṣiṇāṃ dadyātpuṣkalāṃ toṣahetave
gurau tuṣṭe dadātīṣṭaṃ kṛtavīryasuto nṛpaḥ / gurvājñayā svayaṃ kuryādyadi vā kāraye dguruḥ
dattvā dhanādikaṃ tasmai dīpadānāya nārada / gurvājñāmantarā kuryādyo dīpaṃ sveṣṭasiddhaye
siddhirna jāyate tasya hānireva pade pade / uttamaṃ goghṛtaṃ proktaṃ madhyamaṃ mahaṣībhavam
tilatailaṃ tu tādṛk syātkanīyo 'jādijaṃ ghṛtam / āsyaroge sugandhena dadyāttailena dīpakam
siddhvārthasaṃbhavenātha dviṣatāṃ nāśanāya ca / sahasreṇa palairdīpe vihite ca na dṛśyate
kāryasiddhastadā kuryātrrivāraṃ dīpajaṃ vidhim / tadā sudurlabhamapi kāryyaṃ siddhvyenna saṃśayaḥ
dīpapriyaḥ kārtavīryo mārtaṇḍo nativallabhaḥ / stutiproyo mahāviṣṇurgaṇeśa staparṇapriyaḥ
durgārcanapriyā nūnamabhiṣekapriyaḥ śivaḥ / tasmātteṣāṃ pratoṣāya vidadhyāttattadādarāt

iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne tṛtīyapāde kārtavīryamāhātmyamantradīpakathanaṃ nāma ṣaṭsaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ nārada uvāca sādhu sādhu mahāprājña sarva tantraviśārada / tvayā mahyaṃ samākhyātaṃ vidhānaṃ tantragopitam
adhunā tu mahābhāga kīrtavīryahanūmatoḥ / kavace śrotumicchāmi tadvadasvakṛpānidhe
sanatkumāra uvāca śṛṇu viprendra vakṣyāmi kavacaṃ paramādbhutam / kārtavīryasya yenāsau prasannaḥ kāryasiddhikṛt
sahasrādityasaṃkāśe nānāratnasamujjvaṃle / bhāsvaddhvajapatākāḍhye turagāyutabhūṣite
mahāsaṃvartakāṃbhodhibhīmarāvavirāviṇi / samuddhṛtamahāchattravitānitaviyatpathe
mahārathavare dīptanānāyudhavirājite / susthitaṃ vipulodāraṃ sahasrabhujamaṇḍitam
vāmairuddaṇḍakodaṇḍāndadhānamaparaiḥ śarān / kirīṭahāramukuṭakeyūravalayāṅgadaiḥ
mudrikodarabandhādyairmāaiñjīnūpurakādibhiḥ / bhūṣitaṃ vividhākalpairbhāsvaraiḥ sumahādhanaiḥ
ābaddhakavacaṃ vīraṃ suprasannānanāṃbujam / dhanurjyā siṃhanādena kaṃpayantaṃ jagattrayam
sarvaśatrukṣayakaraṃ sarvavyādhivināśanam / sarvasaṃpatpradātāraṃ vijayaśrīniṣevitam
sarvasaubhāgyadaṃ bhadraṃ bhaktābhayavidhāyinam / divyamālyānulepāḍhyaṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam
rathanāgāśvapādātavṛndamadhyagamīśvaram / varadaṃ cakravartīnaṃ sarvalokaikapālakam
samānoditasāhasradivākarasamadyutim / mahāyogabhavaiśvaryakīrtyākrāntajagattrayam
śrīmañṭataṃ hareraṃśādavatīrṇaṃ mahītale / samyagātmādibhedena dhyātvā rakṣāmudīrayet
asyāṅgamūrtayaḥ pañca pāntu māṃ sphaṭikojjvalāḥ / agnīśāsuravāyavyakoṇeṣu hṛdayādikāḥ
sarvatosrajvaladrūpā daracarmāsipāṇayaḥ / avyāhatabalaiśvaryaśaktisāmarthyavigrahāḥ
kṣemaṅkarīśaktiyutaścauravargavibhañjanaḥ / prācīṃ diśaṃ rakṣatu me bāṇabāṇāsanāyudhaḥ
śrīkarīśaktisahito mārībhayavināśakaḥ / śaracāpadharaḥ śrīmān diśaṃ me pātu dakṣiṇām
mahāvaśyakarīyuktaḥ sarvaśatruvināśakṛt / maheṣucāpadhṛkpātu mama prācetasīṃ diśam
yaśaḥkaryā samāyukto daityasaṃghavināśanaḥ / parirakṣatu me samyagvidiśaṃ caitrabhānavīm
vidyākarīsamāyuktaḥ sumahahuḥkhanāśanaḥ / pātu me nairṛtīṃ cāpapāṇirvidiśamīśvaraḥ
dhanakaryā samāyukto mahādurita nāśanaḥ / iṣvāsaneṣudhṛkpātu vidiśaṃ mama vāyavīm
āyuḥkaryā yutaḥ śrīmānmahābhayavināśanaḥ / cāpeṣudhārī śaivīṃ me vidiśaṃ parirakṣatu
vijayaśrīyutaḥ sākṣātsahasrāradharo vibhuḥ / diśamūrddhvāmavatu me sarvaduṣṭabhayaṅkaraḥ
śaṅkhabhṛtsumahāśaktisaṃyuto 'pyadharāṃ diśam / parirakṣatu me duḥkhadhvāntasambhedabhāskaraḥ
mahāyogasamāyuktaḥ sarvadikcakramaṇḍalaḥ / mahāyogīśvaraḥ pātu sarvato mama padmabhṛt
etāstu mūrtayo raktā raktamālyāṃśukāvṛtāḥ / pradhānadevatārūpāḥ pṛthagrathavare sthitāḥ
śaktayaḥ padmahastāścata nīlendīvarasannnibhāḥ / śuklamālyānuvasanāḥ suliptatilakojjvalāḥ
tatpārśadeśvarāḥ svasvavāhanāyudhabhūṣaṇāḥ / svasvadikṣu sthitāḥ pāntu māmindrādyā mahābalāḥ
etastasya samākhyātāḥ sarvāvaraṇadevatāḥ / sarvato māṃ sadā pātuṃ sarvaśaktisamanvitāḥ
hṛdaye codare nābhau jaṭhare guhyamaṇḍale / tejorūpāḥ sthitāḥ pātuṃ vāñchāsukhanadrumāḥ
diśaṃ cānye mahāvarṇā mantrarūpā mahojjvalāḥ / vyāpakatvena pāntvasmānāpādatalamastakam
kārtavīryaḥ śiraḥ pātu lalāṭaṃ haihayeśvaraḥ / sumukho me mukhaṃ pātu karṇauṃ vyāptajagattrayaḥ
sukumāro hanuṃ pātu bhrūyugaṃ me dhanurdharaḥ / nayanaṃ puṃmaḍarīkākṣago nāsikāṃ me guṇākaraḥ
adharoṣṭhau sadā pātu brahjñeyo dvijānkaviḥ / sarvaśāstrakalādhārī jihvāṃ cibukamavyayaḥ
dattātreyapriyaḥ kaṇṭhaṃ skandhau rājakuleśvaraḥ / bhujau daśāsyadarpaghno hṛdayaṃ me mahābalaḥ
